entry.summary: Presents PrecisionDiff, a differential testing framework for detecting precision-induced behavioral disagreements in LLMs across different numerical formats (bfloat16, float16, int8). Generates precision-sensitive test inputs for cross-precision analysis.

entry.title: ChipCraftBrain: Validation-First RTL Generation via Multi-Agent Orchestration

author.name: Cagri Eryilmaz

entry.summary: Presents ChipCraftBrain, a multi-agent framework for RTL code generation combining symbolic-neural reasoning with PPO-based adaptive orchestration over six specialized agents. Targets functional correctness on industrial-difficulty benchmarks.

entry.title: Toward Safe Autonomous Robotic Endovascular Interventions using World Models

author.name: Harry Robertshaw, Nikola Fischer, Han-Ru Wu, Andrea Walker Perez, Weiyuan Deng, Benjamin Jackson, Christos Bergeles, Alejandro Granados, Thomas C Booth

entry.summary: Investigates world-model-based RL (TD-MPC2) for autonomous endovascular navigation in robotic surgery, evaluating across patient-specific vasculatures. Addresses challenges of variable anatomy and real-time control for mechanical thrombectomy.

entry.title: Auto-ART: Structured Literature Synthesis and Automated Adversarial Robustness Testing

author.name: Abhijit Talluri

entry.summary: Introduces Auto-ART, an open-source adversarial robustness testing framework with 50+ attacks, 28 defenses, gradient-masking detection, and compliance mapping to NIST AI RMF and OWASP. Includes structured synthesis of robustness literature from 2020-2026.

entry.title: PR-CAD: Progressive Refinement for Unified Controllable and Faithful Text-to-CAD Generation with Large Language Models

author.name: Jiyuan An, Jiachen Zhao, Fan Chen, Liner Yang, Zhenghao Liu, Hongyan Wang, Weihua An, Meishan Zhang, Erhong Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PR-CAD, a progressive refinement framework unifying CAD generation and editing from text using LLMs. Curates a lifecycle dataset spanning multiple CAD representations with both qualitative and quantitative descriptions.

entry.title: To Know is to Construct: Schema-Constrained Generation for Agent Memory

author.name: Lei Zheng, Weinan Song, Daili Li, Yanming Yang

entry.summary: Proposes schema-constrained generation for agent memory inspired by constructivist epistemology. Addresses failure modes of both dense retrieval (context-mismatched entries) and open-ended generation (structural hallucination) through schema-guided memory access.

entry.title: Effects of Cross-lingual Evidence in Multilingual Medical Question Answering

author.name: Anar Yeginbergen, Maite Oronoz, Rodrigo Agerri

entry.summary: Investigates multilingual medical QA across high-resource and low-resource languages, evaluating different external evidence sources and retrieval strategies. Finds web-retrieved English data helps high-resource languages while LLM-generated explanations best support low-resource languages.

entry.title: Can "AI" Be a Doctor? A Study of Empathy, Readability, and Alignment in Clinical LLMs

author.name: Mariano Barone, Francesco Di Serio, Roberto Moio, Marco Postiglione, Giuseppe Riccio, Antonio Romano, Vincenzo Moscato

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs including GPT-5 and Claude for clinical communication quality across semantic fidelity, readability, and empathy. Finds that larger models produce overly complex text compared to physicians, and empathy-oriented prompting can partially mitigate this.

entry.title: Camera Control for Text-to-Image Generation via Learning Viewpoint Tokens

author.name: Xinxuan Lu, Charless Fowlkes, Alexander C. Berg

entry.summary: Presents a framework for precise camera control in text-to-image generation by learning parametric viewpoint tokens, fine-tuned on combined 3D-rendered images and photorealistic augmentations.

entry.title: Opportunistic Bone-Loss Screening from Routine Knee Radiographs Using a Multi-Task Deep Learning Framework with Sensitivity-Constrained Threshold Optimization

author.name: Zhaochen Li, Xinghao Yan, Runni Zhou, Xiaoyang Li, Chenjie Zhu, Gege Wang, Yu Shi, Lixin Zhang, Rongrong Fu, Liehao Yan, Yuan Chai

entry.summary: Develops STR-Net, a multi-task deep learning system for opportunistic bone-loss screening from routine knee radiographs, enabling osteoporosis/osteopenia detection without additional DXA imaging.

entry.title: Fourier Series Coder: A Novel Perspective on Angle Boundary Discontinuity Problem for Oriented Object Detection

author.name: Minghong Wei, Pu Cao, Zhihao Chen, Zhiyuan Zang, Lu Yang, Qing Song

entry.summary: Proposes Fourier Series Coder for oriented object detection that addresses angle boundary discontinuity through orthogonal Fourier basis decomposition, avoiding structural noise amplification in non-orthogonal decoding.

entry.title: RefAerial: A Benchmark and Approach for Referring Detection in Aerial Images

author.name: Guyue Hu, Hao Song, Yuxing Tong, Duzhi Yuan, Dengdi Sun, Aihua Zheng, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Introduces RefAerial, a large-scale dataset for referring detection in aerial images with characteristics including low object-to-scene ratios, numerous targets, and fine-grained descriptions, plus a human-in-the-loop annotation engine.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Conditional Diffusion for Motion-Robust Retinal Temporal Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging

author.name: Qian Chen, Yuehao Chen, Qiang Wang, Lei Zhu, Yanye Lu, Qiushi Ren

entry.summary: Proposes RetinaDiff, a physics-informed conditional diffusion model for retinal laser speckle contrast imaging that is robust to motion artifacts and requires only a few frames for temporal reconstruction.

entry.title: Stochastic Barrier Certificates in the Presence of Dynamic Obstacles

author.name: Rayan Mazouz, Luca Laurenti, Morteza Lahijanian

entry.summary: Introduces time-invariant and time-varying stochastic barrier certificates for ensuring safety of discrete-time systems with dynamic obstacles. The time-varying formulation uses Bellman's optimality perspective to capture temporal structure, yielding less conservative bounds than prior approaches.

entry.title: ALAS: Adaptive Long-Horizon Action Synthesis via Async-pathway Stream Disentanglement

author.name: Yutong Shen, Hangxu Liu, Lei Zhang, Penghui Liu, Yinqi Liu, Liuxiang Yang, Tongtong Feng

entry.summary: ALAS is a framework for long-horizon human-scene interaction tasks that uses biologically-inspired dual-stream disentanglement (where/what pathways) to separate environment observation from self-state, enabling cross-domain generalization to new environment-skill combinations.

entry.title: Marginal Risk is BS

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: Critiques the concept of 'marginal risk' in AI policy - the idea that one can justify building dangerous AI by arguing the incremental risk is small given others are already building similar systems. Uses gain-of-function research analogy to argue this reasoning is fundamentally flawed.

entry.title: AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically

author.name: Marti\~no R\'ios-Garc\'ia, Nawaf Alampara, Chandan Gupta, Indrajeet Mandal, Sajid Mannan, Ali Asghar Aghajani, N. M. Anoop Krishnan, Kevin Maik Jablonka

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Evaluates LLM-based scientific agents across 8 domains with 25,000+ runs, finding that agents produce results without adhering to epistemic norms of scientific reasoning. The base model accounts for 41.4% of performance variance, and agents exhibit confirmation bias and lack self-correction.

entry.title: OmniMouse: Scaling properties of multi-modal, multi-task Brain Models on 150B Neural Tokens

author.name: Konstantin F. Willeke, Polina Turishcheva, Alex Gilbert, Goirik Chakrabarty, Hasan A. Bedel, Paul G. Fahey, Yongrong Qiu, Marissa A. Weis, Michaela Vystr\v{c}ilov\'a, Taliah Muhammad, Lydia Ntanavara, Rachel E. Froebe, Kayla Ponder, Zheng Huan Tan, Emin Orhan, Erick Cobos, Sophia Sanborn, Katrin Franke, Fabian H. Sinz, Alexander S. Ecker, Andreas S. Tolias

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Presents OmniMouse, a multi-modal multi-task brain model trained on 150 billion neural tokens from 3.1 million neurons across 73 mice. Achieves state-of-the-art neural prediction, behavioral decoding, and neural forecasting, demonstrating scaling laws apply to brain modeling.

entry.title: From Experience to Skill: Multi-Agent Generative Engine Optimization via Reusable Strategy Learning

author.name: Beining Wu, Fuyou Mao, Jiong Lin, Cheng Yang, Jiaxuan Lu, Yifu Guo, Siyu Zhang, Yifan Wu, Ying Huang, Fu Li

entry.summary: Reframes Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as a strategy learning problem, proposing MAGEO, a multi-agent framework that distills reusable optimization skills for improving content visibility in AI-generated answers.

entry.title: Agent-GWO: Collaborative Agents for Dynamic Prompt Optimization in Large Language Models

author.name: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Chenghao Li, Shuxu Chen, Qigan Sun, Jiaquan Zhang, Fachrina Dewi Puspitasari, Tae-Ho Kim, Jiwei Wei, Malu Zhang, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Agent-GWO, a multi-agent framework using Grey Wolf Optimization for joint optimization of LLM prompts and decoding hyperparameters, addressing limitations of single-agent prompt optimization.

entry.title: REVEAL: Multimodal Vision-Language Alignment of Retinal Morphometry and Clinical Risks for Incident AD and Dementia Prediction

author.name: Seowung Leem, Lin Gu, Chenyu You, Kuang Gong, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Introduces REVEAL, a multimodal vision-language framework that aligns retinal morphometric features with clinical risk factors for early prediction of Alzheimer's disease and dementia, using cross-modal alignment to capture joint patterns.

entry.title: SCURank: Ranking Multiple Candidate Summaries with Summary Content Units for Enhanced Summarization

author.name: Bo-Jyun Wang, Ying-Jia Lin, Hung-Yu Kao

entry.summary: Proposes SCURank, a framework for ranking summary candidates using Summary Content Units (SCUs) rather than surface-level metrics or unstable LLM comparisons, improving distillation of summaries from diverse LLMs.

entry.title: IndiaFinBench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Model Performance on Indian Financial Regulatory Text

author.name: Rajveer Singh Pall

entry.summary: Introduces IndiaFinBench, the first evaluation benchmark for LLMs on Indian financial regulatory text (SEBI, RBI), with 406 expert-annotated QA pairs across four task types including regulatory interpretation and contradiction detection.

entry.title: LePREC: Reasoning as Classification over Structured Factors for Assessing Relevance of Legal Issues

author.name: Fanyu Wang, Xiaoxi Kang, Paul Burgess, Aashish Srivastava, Chetan Arora, Adnan Trakic, Lay-Ki Soon, Md Khalid Hossain, Lizhen Qu

entry.summary: LePREC addresses legal issue identification using LLMs, showing that GPT-4o achieves only 62% precision on this task. Proposes a structured reasoning approach inspired by legal professionals, tested on 769 Malaysian Contract Act court cases.

entry.title: BEAT: Tokenizing and Generating Symbolic Music by Uniform Temporal Steps

author.name: Lekai Qian, Haoyu Gu, Jingwei Zhao, Ziyu Wang

entry.summary: BEAT proposes tokenizing symbolic music using uniform temporal steps (beats) rather than variable-duration event sequences, offering a more natural representation of musical time for language model-based music generation.

entry.title: Environmental Sound Deepfake Detection Using Deep-Learning Framework

author.name: Lam Pham, Khoi Vu, Dat Tran, Phat Lam, Vu Nguyen, David Fischinger, Alexander Schindler, Martin Boyer, Son Le

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework for environmental sound deepfake detection, exploring spectrograms, architectures, and pre-trained models. Finds that sound scene and sound event deepfake detection should be treated as separate tasks.

entry.title: Transparent Screening for LLM Inference and Training Impacts

author.name: Arnault Pachot, Thierry Petit

entry.summary: Presents a transparent screening framework for estimating environmental impacts (inference and training) of current LLMs under limited observability, with an auditable proxy methodology for comparing market models.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Generating Covalent Inhibitor Candidates

author.name: Renee Gil

entry.summary: Applies multi-objective RL with Pareto crowding distance to generate covalent inhibitor candidates for EGFR and ACHE, using SMILES-based LSTM with policy gradient optimization balancing multiple scoring functions.

entry.title: Distributional Value Estimation Without Target Networks for Robust Quality-Diversity

author.name: Behrad Koohy, Jamie Bayne

entry.summary: Introduces QDHUAC, a sample-efficient quality-diversity algorithm that removes target networks by using distributional value estimation, significantly reducing computational overhead while maintaining diversity in skill discovery.

entry.title: Amortized Vine Copulas for High-Dimensional Density and Information Estimation

author.name: Houman Safaai

entry.summary: Proposes Vine Denoising Copula (VDC), an amortized vine-copula pipeline that trains a single bivariate denoising model reused across all vine edges, with Sinkhorn projection for copula constraints. Maintains exact vine likelihood while replacing per-edge optimization with GPU inference.

entry.title: Closing the Domain Gap in Biomedical Imaging by In-Context Control Samples

author.name: Ana Sanchez-Fernandez, Thomas Pinetz, Werner Zellinger, G\"unter Klambauer

entry.summary: Proposes CS-ARM-BN, a meta-learning method that exploits negative control samples (present in every experimental batch) to close the domain gap caused by batch effects in biomedical imaging. Claims to be the first to successfully close this gap for deep learning.

entry.title: EvoForest: A Novel Machine-Learning Paradigm via Open-Ended Evolution of Computational Graphs

author.name: Kamer Ali Yuksel, Hassan Sawaf

entry.summary: Presents EvoForest, a hybrid neuro-symbolic system for open-ended evolution of computational graphs, discovering what transformations to compute rather than just optimizing weights. Targets non-differentiable objectives and interpretable models.

entry.title: Improving Molecular Force Fields with Minimal Temporal Information

author.name: Ali Mollahosseini, Mohammed Haroon Dupty, Wee Sun Lee

entry.summary: Explores incorporating minimal temporal information from molecular dynamics simulations into neural network force fields, leveraging the sequential nature of MD trajectories rather than treating configurations independently.

entry.title: Decision-Focused Federated Learning Under Heterogeneous Objectives and Constraints

author.name: Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos, Alexander Vinel

entry.summary: Proposes Decision-Focused Federated Learning (DFFL), combining predict-then-optimize with federated learning where clients have heterogeneous objectives and constraints. Develops theoretical heterogeneity bounds for the SPO+ surrogate loss using support function representations. This bridges two important ML subfields but is fairly niche in scope.

entry.title: RADS: Reinforcement Learning-Based Sample Selection Improves Transfer Learning in Low-resource and Imbalanced Clinical Settings

author.name: Wei Han, David Martinez, Anna Khanina, Lawrence Cavedon, Karin Verspoor

entry.summary: Introduces RADS, using reinforcement learning for sample selection in transfer learning under extremely low-resource and class-imbalanced clinical settings. Outperforms traditional active learning methods that tend to favor outliers under these conditions.

entry.title: MOMO: A framework for seamless physical, verbal, and graphical robot skill learning and adaptation

author.name: Markus Knauer, Edoardo Fiorini, Maximilian M\"uhlbauer, Stefan Schneyer, Promwat Angsuratanawech, Florian Samuel Lay, Timo Bachmann, Samuel Bustamante, Korbinian Nottensteiner, Freek Stulp, Alin Albu-Sch\"affer, Jo\~ao Silv\'erio, Thomas Eiband

entry.summary: Presents MOMO, a multimodal robot skill adaptation framework combining kinesthetic touch, natural language, and graphical interfaces. Integrates energy-based intention detection, LLM-based tool architecture, and interactive visualization for non-expert robot programming.

entry.title: Towards Certified Malware Detection: Provable Guarantees Against Evasion Attacks

author.name: Nandakrishna Giri, Asmitha K. A., Serena Nicolazzo, Antonino Nocera, Vinod P

entry.summary: Proposes a certifiably robust malware detection framework using randomized smoothing through feature ablation and noise injection. Provides formal certificates guaranteeing robustness against feature-space perturbations within specific radii.

entry.title: LEXIS: LatEnt ProXimal Interaction Signatures for 3D HOI from an Image

author.name: Dimitrije Anti\'c, Alvaro Budria, George Paschalidis, Sai Kumar Dwivedi, Dimitrios Tzionas

entry.summary: Proposes LEXIS with InterFields, a representation encoding dense continuous proximity across body and object surfaces for 3D human-object interaction reconstruction from single images. Uses learned interaction signatures conditioned on action and object geometry.

entry.title: Dual-Cluster Memory Agent: Resolving Multi-Paradigm Ambiguity in Optimization Problem Solving

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Yuchen Wan, Boxuan Zhang, Zesheng Yang, Lingling Zhang, Bifan Wei, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes DCM-Agent, a training-free agent that helps LLMs solve optimization problems with structural ambiguity by leveraging dual-cluster memory (modeling and coding clusters) of historical solutions, distilled into structured guidance types.

entry.title: Decoding Text Spans for Efficient and Accurate Named-Entity Recognition

author.name: Andrea Maracani, Savas Ozkan, Junyi Zhu, Sinan Mutlu, Mete Ozay

entry.summary: Proposes SpanDec, an efficient span-based NER framework that consolidates span representation interactions into a decoder, reducing inference cost compared to methods that enumerate and process all candidate spans individually.

entry.title: SAKE: Self-aware Knowledge Exploitation-Exploration for Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Jielong Tang, Xujie Yuan, Jiayang Liu, Jianxing Yu, Xiao Dong, Lin Chen, Yunlai Teng, Shimin Di, Jian Yin

entry.summary: Proposes SAKE for Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition, combining self-aware knowledge exploitation (internal MLLM knowledge) with exploration (external retrieval) to handle long-tailed and unseen entities in social media.

entry.title: Lucky High Dynamic Range Smartphone Imaging

author.name: Baiang Li, Ruyu Yan, Ethan Tseng, Zhoutong Zhang, Adam Finkelstein, Jiawen Chen, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Proposes a Lucky HDR method for smartphone photography that robustly captures high dynamic range from bracketed exposures using lightweight networks, where every output pixel is a convex combination of input pixels to avoid hallucination.

entry.title: FurnSet: Exploiting Repeats for 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Paul Dobre, Xin Wang, Hongzhou Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FurnSet, a framework for single-view 3D scene reconstruction that explicitly identifies and leverages repeated object instances (like furniture) to improve reconstruction through set-aware self-attention and complementary observation aggregation.

entry.title: From Scene to Object: Text-Guided Dual-Gaze Prediction

author.name: Zehong Ke, Yanbo Jiang, Jinhao Li, Zhiyuan Liu, Yiqian Tu, Qingwen Meng, Heye Huang, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-branch gaze prediction framework for autonomous driving that predicts both scene-level and object-level driver attention with text grounding, constructing a new object-level driver attention dataset.

entry.title: ConeSep: Cone-based Robust Noise-Unlearning Compositional Network for Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Mingyu Zhang, Zhiheng Fu, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Proposes ConeSep for composed image retrieval that addresses noisy triplet correspondence using cone-based representations, identifying unique challenges of 'hard noise' that breaks the small loss hypothesis.

entry.title: Where are they looking in the operating room?

author.name: Keqi Chen, S\'eraphin Baributsa, Lilien Schewski, Vinkle Srivastav, Didier Mutter, Guido Beldi, Sandra Keller, Nicolas Padoy

entry.summary: Introduces gaze-following to the surgical domain by extending the 4D-OR and Team-OR datasets with gaze annotations, demonstrating potential for understanding clinical roles, surgical phases, and team communication.

entry.title: RSRCC: A Remote Sensing Regional Change Comprehension Benchmark Constructed via Retrieval-Augmented Best-of-N Ranking

author.name: Roie Kazoom, Yotam Gigi, George Leifman, Tomer Shekel, Genady Beryozkin

entry.summary: Presents RSRCC, a 126K-question benchmark for remote sensing change question-answering focused on localized, change-specific questions requiring reasoning about particular semantic changes.

entry.title: MAPRPose: Mask-Aware Proposal and Amodal Refinement for Multi-Object 6D Pose Estimation

author.name: Yang Luo, Yan Gong, Yongsheng Gao, Xiaoying Sun, Jie Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MAPRPose, a two-stage framework for multi-object 6D pose estimation using mask-aware correspondences for proposals and amodal-driven ROI prediction for refinement in cluttered scenes.

entry.title: Secure Rate-Distortion-Perception: A Randomized Distributed Function Computation Approach for Realism

author.name: Gustaf {\AA}hlgren, Onur G\"unl\"u

entry.summary: Studies secure rate-distortion-perception trade-offs for neural image compression over public channels, characterizing exact secure RDP regions for noiseless channels and deriving bounds for broadcast channels.

entry.title: Response time of lateral predictive coding and benefits of modular structures

author.name: Guanghui Cai, Zhen-Ye Huang, Weikang Wang, Hai-Jun Zhou

entry.summary: Investigates response-time reduction in lateral predictive coding neural circuits, finding that modular network structures can minimize response time without compromising prediction quality.

entry.title: OVPD: A Virtual-Physical Fusion Testing Dataset of OnSite Auton-omous Driving Challenge

author.name: Yuhang Zhang, Jiarui Zhang, Bowen Jian, Xin Zhou, Zhichao Lv, Peng Hang, Rongjie Yu, Ye Tian, Jian Sun

entry.summary: OVPD is a virtual-physical fusion testing dataset from the 2025 OnSite Autonomous Driving Challenge, integrating virtual background traffic with real vehicle-in-the-loop testing on a proving ground. Designed to provide more realistic evaluation than purely virtual or open-road datasets.

entry.title: Aligned AI is the most dangerous AI

author.name: Shivam

entry.summary: Argues that aligned AI is paradoxically the most dangerous kind because a rogue AI would act identically to an aligned one, alignment evaluations can only detect misalignment (not prove alignment), and the core risk is about agency and power concentration rather than behavioral compliance.

entry.title: NeuroAI and Beyond: Bridging Between Advances in Neuroscience and ArtificialIntelligence

author.name: Anthony Zador, Jean-Marc Fellous, Terrence Sejnowski, Gina Adam, James B Aimone, Akwasi Akwaboah, Yiannis Aloimonos, Carmen Amo Alonso, Chiara Bartolozzi, Michael J. Bennington, Michael Berry, Bing W. Brunton, Gert Cauwenberghs, Hillel J. Chiel, Tobi Delbruck, John Doyle, Jason Eshraghian, Ralph Etienne-Cummings, Cornelia Fermuller, Matthew Jacobsen, Ali A. Minai, Barbara Oakley, Alexander G. Ororbia II, Joe Paton, Blake Richards, Yulia Sandamirskaya, Abhronil Sengupta, Shihab Shamma, Michael P. Stryker, Seong Jong Yoo, Steven W. Zucker

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Major position paper from Anthony Zador, Terrence Sejnowski, and 30+ researchers identifying three capability gaps in AI (physical interaction, brittle learning, energy inefficiency) and mapping neuroscience principles to address them.

entry.title: Learning Spatial-Temporal Coherent Correlations for Speech-Preserving Facial Expression Manipulation

author.name: Tianshui Chen, Jianman Lin, Zhijing Yang, Chunmei Qing, Guangrun Wang, Liang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes STCCL for speech-preserving facial expression manipulation, discovering that speakers conveying the same content with different emotions exhibit correlated local facial animations, providing supervision without paired training samples.

entry.title: Radar Odometry Subject to High Tilt Dynamics of Subarctic Environments

author.name: Mat\v{e}j Boxan, William Lariv\'ee-Hardy, Fran\c{c}ois Pomerleau

entry.summary: Benchmarks radar odometry methods under demanding subarctic conditions with extreme tilt dynamics and proposes a novel radar-inertial odometry method with tilt-proximity submap search.

entry.title: Harmful Intent as a Geometrically Recoverable Feature of LLM Residual Streams

author.name: Isaac Llorente-Saguer

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Demonstrates that harmful intent is geometrically recoverable from LLM residual streams as a linear direction (AUROC 0.98) across 12 models spanning four architectural families and three alignment variants. Shows angular deviation captures harm in layers where projection fails.

entry.title: Reasoning Structure Matters for Safety Alignment of Reasoning Models

author.name: Yeonjun In, Wonjoong Kim, Sangwu Park, Chanyoung Park

entry.summary: Previously covered in yesterday's Research roundup, Shows that safety failures in large reasoning models stem from the reasoning structure itself, and proposes AltTrain—a simple SFT method that alters reasoning structure with only 1K training examples. Requires no RL training or reward design.

entry.title: On Accelerating Grounded Code Development for Research

author.name: Santosh Ganji

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for grounded code development in niche scientific domains, addressing the limitation that coding agents lack access to domain-specific, up-to-date knowledge.

entry.title: Industrial Surface Defect Detection via Diffusion Generation and Asymmetric Student-Teacher Network

author.name: Shuo Feng, Runlin Zhou, Yuyang Li, Guangcan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised industrial defect detection method combining DDPM for generating synthetic defects with an asymmetric teacher-student network for detection.

entry.title: A-MAR: Agent-based Multimodal Art Retrieval for Fine-Grained Artwork Understanding

author.name: Shuai Wang, Hongyi Zhu, Jia-Hong Huang, Yixian Shen, Chengxi Zeng, Stevan Rudinac, Monika Kackovic, Nachoem Wijnberg, Marcel Worring

entry.summary: Proposes A-MAR, an agent-based multimodal art retrieval framework that decomposes artwork understanding into structured reasoning plans for targeted evidence retrieval.

entry.title: SPRITE: From Static Mockups to Engine-Ready Game UI

author.name: Yunshu Bai, RuiHao Li, Hao Zhang, Chien Her Lim, Ming Yan, Mengtian Li

entry.summary: Introduces SPRITE, a pipeline transforming static game UI screenshots into editable engine assets using Vision-Language Models with structured YAML intermediate representation.

entry.title: Thermal Anomaly Detection using Physics Aware Neuromorphic Networks: Comparison between Raw and L1C Sentinel-2 Data

author.name: Stephen Smith, Cormac Purcell, Gabriele Meoni, Roberto Del Prete, Zdenka Kuncic

entry.summary: Proposes Physics-Aware Neuromorphic Networks for thermal anomaly detection (bushfires, volcanoes) using satellite data, addressing domain shift between raw and processed sensor data.

entry.title: Curvature-Aware PCA with Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation for Semi-Supervised Learning

author.name: Alexandre L. M. Levada

entry.summary: Proposes Geodesic Tangent Space Aggregation PCA (GTSA-PCA), which extends PCA with curvature-weighted local covariance operators and geodesic consistency for manifold-aware dimensionality reduction in semi-supervised learning.

entry.title: The Triadic Loop: A Framework for Negotiating Alignment in AI Co-hosted Livestreaming

author.name: Katherine Wang, Nadia Berthouze, Aneesha Singh

entry.summary: Introduces the Triadic Loop framework for AI alignment in multi-user social environments like livestreaming, reconceptualizing alignment as bidirectional adaptation among streamer, AI co-host, and audience rather than a dyadic user-AI relationship.

entry.title: Multi-modal Test-time Adaptation via Adaptive Probabilistic Gaussian Calibration

author.name: Jinglin Xu, Yi Li, Chuxiong Sun, Xiao Xu, Jiangmeng Li, Fanjiang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive probabilistic Gaussian calibration for multi-modal test-time adaptation, addressing the lack of explicit category-conditional distribution modeling that undermines existing methods under modality distribution asymmetry.

entry.title: DP-FlogTinyLLM: Differentially private federated log anomaly detection using Tiny LLMs

author.name: Isaiah Thompson, Tanmay Sen, Ritwik Bhattacharya

entry.summary: Proposes a privacy-preserving federated framework for log anomaly detection using parameter-efficient tiny LLMs with differential privacy, enabling collaborative learning across organizations without sharing raw log data.

entry.title: TACENR: Task-Agnostic Contrastive Explanations for Node Representations

author.name: Vasiliki Papanikou, Evaggelia Pitoura

entry.summary: TACENR provides task-agnostic contrastive explanations for graph node representations, identifying attribute, proximity, and structural features that contribute most in the representation space. Addresses the gap in explaining overall node representation structure rather than individual dimensions.

entry.title: M$^{2}$GRPO: Mamba-based Multi-Agent Group Relative Policy Optimization for Biomimetic Underwater Robots Pursuit

author.name: Yukai Feng, Zhiheng Wu, Zhengxing Wu, Junwen Gu, Junzhi Yu

entry.summary: M²GRPO combines Mamba-based selective state-space models with group relative policy optimization for multi-agent cooperative pursuit with biomimetic underwater robots. Addresses long-horizon decision making and partial observability in underwater robotics.

entry.title: WorkflowGen:an adaptive workflow generation mechanism driven by trajectory experience

author.name: Ruocan Wei, Shufeng Wang, Ziwei Shi

entry.summary: WorkflowGen is an adaptive trajectory experience-driven framework for automatic workflow generation that captures and reuses execution knowledge at node and workflow levels to reduce token usage and improve efficiency.

entry.title: Meta Additive Model: Interpretable Sparse Learning With Auto Weighting

author.name: Xuelin Zhang, Xinyue Liu, Lingjuan Wu, Hong Chen

entry.summary: Meta Additive Model (MAM) addresses sparse additive models' sensitivity to complex noise through a bilevel optimization approach with automatic sample reweighting, improving robustness to outliers and non-Gaussian perturbations.

entry.title: Trajectory-Aware Reliability Modeling of Democratic Systems

author.name: Dmitry Zaytsev, Valentina Kuskova, Michael Coppedge

entry.summary: Introduces trajectory-aware reliability modeling for democratic systems using Dynamic Causal Neural Autoregression, modeling how institutional weakening propagates through networks to predict democratic deterioration.

entry.title: Lever: Inference-Time Policy Reuse under Support Constraints

author.name: Ihor Vitenki, Noha Ibrahim, Sihem Amer-Yahia

entry.summary: Introduces LEVER, a framework for composing new RL policies from a library of pre-trained ones entirely offline, without additional environment interaction. Focuses on the support-limited regime where value propagation is not possible, using behavioral embeddings and offline Q-value composition.

entry.title: Cold-Start Forecasting of New Product Life-Cycles via Conditional Diffusion Models

author.name: Ruihan Zhou, Zishi Zhang, Jinhui Han, Yijie Peng, Xiaowei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CDLF, a conditional diffusion model for forecasting new product lifecycle trajectories under cold-start conditions. Combines static product descriptors, reference trajectories from similar products, and early sparse signals.

entry.title: Unlocking the Forecasting Economy: A Suite of Datasets for the Full Lifecycle of Prediction Market: [Experiments \& Analysis]

author.name: Huaiyu Jia, Luofeng Zhou, Wentao Zhang, Lin William Cong, Siguang Li, Shuo Sun

entry.summary: Presents the first continuously maintained dataset suite for the full lifecycle of decentralized prediction markets, built on Polymarket. Provides unified relational data covering market creation through final settlement.

entry.title: Differentially Private Clustered Federated Learning with Privacy-Preserving Initialization and Normality-Driven Aggregation

author.name: Jie Xu, Haaris Mehmood, Rogier Van Dalen, Karthikeyan Saravanan, Mete Ozay

entry.summary: Addresses the challenge of combining differential privacy with clustered federated learning, proposing privacy-preserving initialization and normality-driven aggregation to handle excessive DP noise in individual client updates.

entry.title: Generative Flow Networks for Model Adaptation in Digital Twins of Natural Systems

author.name: Pascal Archambault, Houari Sahraoui, Eugene Syriani

entry.summary: Presents a GFlowNet-based approach to model adaptation for digital twins of natural systems, formulating adaptation as generative modeling over simulator configurations to sample plausible parameterizations proportionally to their posterior probability.

entry.title: Efficient Multi-Cohort Inference for Long-Term Effects and Lifetime Value in A/B Testing with User Learning

author.name: Dario Simionato, Andrea Tonon, Mingxue Wang, Weiguo Wang, Tong Gui, Xiaoyue Li

entry.summary: Proposes a method for estimating long-term treatment effects and residual lifetime value change in multi-cohort A/B tests, accounting for user learning and churn in streaming platforms.

entry.title: Explainable AML Triage with LLMs: Evidence Retrieval and Counterfactual Checks

author.name: Dorothy Torres, Wei Cheng, Ke Hu

entry.summary: Proposes an explainable AML triage framework using LLMs with retrieval-augmented evidence bundling, structured output contracts, and counterfactual checks for anti-money laundering alert investigation.

entry.title: Co-Located Tests, Better AI Code: How Test Syntax Structure Affects Foundation Model Code Generation

author.name: \'Eric Jacopin

entry.summary: Large-scale empirical study (830+ files, 12 models) showing that co-located/inline test syntax (like Python doctests) produces dramatically better AI-generated code than separated test blocks, achieving near-perfect preservation and correctness.

entry.title: DistortBench: Benchmarking Vision Language Models on Image Distortion Identification

author.name: Divyanshu Goyal, Akhil Eppa, Vanya Bannihatti Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces DistortBench, a diagnostic benchmark (13,500 questions, 27 distortion types) evaluating VLMs' ability to identify image distortion type and severity. Finds VLMs struggle with fine-grained severity discrimination despite strong overall performance.

entry.title: Properties and limitations of geometric tempering for gradient flow dynamics

author.name: Francesca Romana Crucinio, Sahani Pathiraja

entry.summary: Analyzes geometric tempering for gradient flow dynamics, providing convergence bounds for both Wasserstein and Fisher-Rao gradient flows. Shows that geometric tempering can improve convergence in continuous time but may introduce complications in discretized settings.

entry.title: Self-Aware Vector Embeddings for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Neuroscience-Inspired Framework for Temporal, Confidence-Weighted, and Relational Knowledge

author.name: Naizhong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes SmartVector, augmenting RAG embeddings with temporal awareness, confidence decay, and relational awareness, modeled on hippocampal memory consolidation. Addresses the problem of static, context-free embeddings returning temporally invalid content.

entry.title: Can We Locate and Prevent Stereotypes in LLMs?

author.name: Alex D'Souza

entry.summary: Investigates locating stereotype-related activations in GPT-2 Small and Llama 3.2 through contrastive neuron activations and attention head analysis. Aims to map 'bias fingerprints' for potential mitigation.

entry.title: Self-Describing Structured Data with Dual-Layer Guidance: A Lightweight Alternative to RAG for Precision Retrieval in Large-Scale LLM Knowledge Navigation

author.name: Hung Ming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Describing Structured Retrieval (SDSR) as a lightweight alternative to RAG that addresses the Lost-in-the-Middle effect through dual-layer guidance for structured data. Avoids RAG infrastructure overhead for semantically well-defined knowledge libraries.

entry.title: How Much Does Persuasion Strategy Matter? LLM-Annotated Evidence from Charitable Donation Dialogues

author.name: Tatiana Petrova, Stanislav Sokol, Radu State

entry.summary: Analyzes persuasion strategies in charitable donation dialogues using LLM annotation of 10,600 turns with 41 strategies. Finds strategy categories explain very little variance (R²≈0.015) in donation outcomes, with Guilt Induction the only strategy significantly reducing donations.

entry.title: AFMRL: Attribute-Enhanced Fine-Grained Multi-Modal Representation Learning in E-commerce

author.name: Biao Zhang, Lixin Chen, Bin Zhang, Zongwei Wang, Tong Liu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes AFMRL, an attribute-enhanced multimodal representation learning framework for e-commerce product retrieval. Uses MLLMs to extract fine-grained product attributes and a two-stage training framework combining contrastive learning with attribute-guided refinement.

entry.title: Multi-Perspective Evidence Synthesis and Reasoning for Unsupervised Multimodal Entity Linking

author.name: Mo Zhou, Jianwei Wang, Kai Wang, Helen Paik, Ying Zhang, Wenjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MSR-MEL, a multi-perspective evidence synthesis and reasoning framework using LLMs for unsupervised multimodal entity linking, mimicking human expert decision-making with multi-perspective judgment in a two-stage framework.

entry.title: Explainable Speech Emotion Recognition: Weighted Attribute Fairness to Model Demographic Contributions to Social Bias

author.name: Tomisin Ogunnubi, Yupei Li, Bj\"orn Schuller

entry.summary: Proposes a fairness modeling approach for Speech Emotion Recognition that captures allocative bias by learning the joint relationship between demographic attributes and model error, going beyond traditional metrics like Equalized Odds.

entry.title: TactileEval: A Step Towards Automated Fine-Grained Evaluation and Editing of Tactile Graphics

author.name: Adnan Khan, Abbas Akkasi, Majid Komeili

entry.summary: Presents TactileEval, a pipeline for automated evaluation of tactile graphics for blind/visually impaired learners, establishing a five-category quality taxonomy aligned with BANA standards and collecting 14,095 structured annotations.

entry.title: RareSpot+: A Benchmark, Model, and Active Learning Framework for Small and Rare Wildlife in Aerial Imagery

author.name: Bowen Zhang, Jesse T. Boulerice, Charvi Mendiratta, Nikhil Kuniyil, Satish Kumar, Hila Shamon, B. S. Manjunath

entry.summary: Presents RareSpot+, a detection framework for small rare wildlife in aerial imagery that combines multi-scale consistency learning, context-aware augmentation, and geospatially guided active learning, applied to prairie dog detection.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Flow Matching for Mosaiced and Panchromatic Fusion Imaging

author.name: Peiming Luo, Nan Wang, Litong Liu, Jiahan Huang, Chenxu Wu, Renwei Dian, Junming Hou

entry.summary: Proposes a semi-supervised flow matching framework for fusing low-resolution mosaiced hyperspectral images with high-resolution panchromatic images, enabling video-rate hyperspectral imaging via single-shot acquisition.

entry.title: MD-Face: MoE-Enhanced Label-Free Disentangled Representation for Interactive Facial Attribute Editing

author.name: Xuan Cui, Yunfei Zhao, Bo Liu, Wei Duan, Xingrong Fan

entry.summary: Proposes MD-Face, a label-free disentangled representation learning framework for facial attribute editing using Mixture of Experts with geometry-aware loss for better attribute independence.

entry.title: Stability-Driven Motion Generation for Object-Guided Human-Human Co-Manipulation

author.name: Jiahao Xu, Xiaohan Yuan, Xingchen Wu, Chongyang Xu, Kun Li, Buzhen Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a flow-matching framework for human co-manipulation motion generation that ensures coordination with shared objects using affordance-guided strategies and stability constraints.

entry.title: MLG-Stereo: ViT Based Stereo Matching with Multi-Stage Local-Global Enhancement

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Jingyi Zhou, Peng Ye, Jiakang Yuan, Lin Zhang, Feng Xu, Tao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes MLG-Stereo, a ViT-based stereo matching method with multi-stage local-global enhancement to address ViTs' limitations in resolution sensitivity and local information handling.

entry.title: Structure-Augmented Standard Plane Detection with Temporal Aggregation in Blind-Sweep Fetal Ultrasound

author.name: Keli Niu, He Zhao, Qianhui Men

entry.summary: Proposes a structure-augmented system for detecting standard fetal ultrasound planes in blind-sweep acquisition using segmentation priors and temporal sliding window aggregation.

entry.title: Neuro-evolutionary stochastic architectures in gauge-covariant neural fields

author.name: Rodrigo Carmo Terin

entry.summary: Extends gauge-covariant stochastic neural-field framework by promoting architecture parameters to slow stochastic variables, introducing Markovian evolutionary scheme compatible with local U(1) structure.

entry.title: SL(C)AMma: Simultaneous Localisation, (Calibration) and Mapping With a Magnetometer Array

author.name: Thomas Edridge, Manon Kok

entry.summary: Proposes two filtering algorithms for magnetic field-based SLAM using magnetometer arrays, addressing calibration inconsistencies and enabling simultaneous localization, calibration, and mapping.

entry.title: Benefits of Low-Cost Bio-Inspiration in the Age of Overparametrization

author.name: Kevin Godin-Dubois, Anil Yaman, Anna V. Kononova

entry.summary: Systematically compares CPG and MLP controllers for robot locomotion across varying parameter space sizes, finding that shallow MLPs and densely connected CPGs consistently outperform larger architectures when input/output spaces are small and performance is bounded.

entry.title: Passive Variable Impedance For Shared Control

author.name: Maximilian M\"uhlbauer, Nepomuk Werner, Ribin Balachandran, Thomas Hulin, Jo\~ao Silv\'erio, Freek Stulp, Alin Albu-Sch\"affer

entry.summary: Studies passivity-based stabilization for shared control in robotic manipulation, unifying variable stiffness impedance control and arbitration of multiple controllers into a holistic framework. Identifies and addresses passivity violations in the closed-loop system.

entry.title: Co-Refine: AI-Powered Tool Supporting Qualitative Analysis

author.name: Athikash Jeyaganthan, Kai Xu, Franziska Becker, Steffen Koch

entry.summary: Presents Co-Refine, an AI-augmented qualitative coding platform that provides real-time detection of temporal drift in coding consistency using a three-stage audit pipeline combining embedding metrics with LLM-based verification.

entry.title: uLEAD-TabPFN: Uncertainty-aware Dependency-based Anomaly Detection with TabPFN

author.name: Sha Lu, Jixue Liu, Stefan Peters, Thuc Duy Le, Craig Xie, Lin Liu, Jiuyong Li

entry.summary: Proposes uLEAD-TabPFN, a dependency-based anomaly detection framework using Prior-Data Fitted Networks to identify anomalies as violations of conditional dependencies among features. Addresses limitations of proximity-based methods that miss dependency-violation anomalies.

entry.title: FedSIR: Spectral Client Identification and Relabeling for Federated Learning with Noisy Labels

author.name: Sina Gholami, Abdulmoneam Ali, Tania Haghighi, Ahmed Arafa, Minhaj Nur Alam

entry.summary: Proposes FedSIR, a multi-stage framework for federated learning with noisy labels that uses spectral analysis of client feature representations to identify clean vs. noisy clients, then performs selective relabeling and aggregation.

entry.title: Fast-then-Fine: A Two-Stage Framework with Multi-Granular Representation for Cross-Modal Retrieval in Remote Sensing

author.name: Xi Chen, Xu Chen, Xiangyang Jia, Xu Zhang, Shuquan Wei, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a fast-then-fine two-stage retrieval framework for remote sensing image-text retrieval that decomposes retrieval into efficient recall and fine-grained reranking stages.

entry.title: Revac: A Social Deduction Reasoning Agent

author.name: Mihir Shriniwas Arya, Avinash Anish, Aditya Ranjan

entry.summary: Describes Revac-8, a competition-winning AI agent for the social deduction game Mafia, using multi-module architecture with memory-based player profiling and strategic reasoning under deception.

entry.title: Who Shapes Brazil's Vaccine Debate? Semi-Supervised Modeling of Stance and Polarization in YouTube's Media Ecosystem

author.name: Geovana S. de Oliveira, Ana P. C. Silva, Fabricio Murai, Carlos H. G. Ferreira

entry.summary: Presents the largest longitudinal study of Brazil's vaccine discourse on YouTube, using semi-supervised stance detection to analyze pro- and anti-vaccine dynamics over time.

entry.title: Assessing Capabilities of Large Language Models in Social Media Analytics: A Multi-task Quest

author.name: Ramtin Davoudi, Kartik Thakkar, Nazanin Donyapour, Tyler Derr, Hamid Karimi

entry.summary: Evaluates multiple LLMs (GPT-4, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) across three social media analytics tasks: authorship verification, post generation, and user attribute inference on Twitter data, with a systematic sampling framework.

entry.title: Improved Anomaly Detection in Medical Images via Mean Shift Density Enhancement

author.name: Pritam Kar, Gouri Lakshmi S, Saptarshi Bej

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid medical anomaly detection framework combining self-supervised representation learning with Mean Shift Density Enhancement for manifold-based density estimation in medical imaging.

entry.title: Streamliners for Answer Set Programming

author.name: Florentina Voboril, Martin Gebser, Stefan Szeider, Alice Tarzariol

entry.summary: Adapts the StreamLLM approach from Constraint Programming to Answer Set Programming, using LLMs to generate candidate streamliner constraints that reduce the search space of combinatorial problems.

entry.title: A Multi-Plant Machine Learning Framework for Emission Prediction, Forecasting, and Control in Cement Manufacturing

author.name: Sheikh Junaid Fayaz, Nestor D. Montiel-Bohorquez, Wilson Ricardo Leal da Silva, Shashank Bishnoi, Matteo Romano, Manuele Gatti, N. M. Anoop Krishnan

entry.summary: Develops a multi-plant ML framework for cement manufacturing emission prediction and control, benchmarking 9 ML architectures across 4 plants and revealing that NOx formation carries substantial process memory.

entry.title: Machine Learning for Two-Stage Graph Sparsification for the Travelling Salesman Problem

author.name: Bo-Cheng Lin, Yi Mei, Mengjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage graph sparsification approach for the Travelling Salesman Problem, using ML to refine heuristic candidate graphs. Stage 1 builds a candidate set via traditional heuristics, Stage 2 uses ML to further prune while preserving optimal tour edges.

entry.title: CHASM: Unveiling Covert Advertisements on Chinese Social Media

author.name: Jingyi Zheng, Tianyi Hu, Yule Liu, Zhen Sun, Zongmin Zhang, Zifan Peng, Wenhan Dong, Xinlei He

entry.summary: Presents CHASM, the first benchmark for evaluating multimodal LLMs on detecting covert advertisements on Chinese social media (Rednote), with 4,992 manually curated instances. Evaluates capabilities of MLLMs in content moderation.

entry.title: F\textsuperscript{2}LP-AP: Fast \& Flexible Label Propagation with Adaptive Propagation Kernel

author.name: Yutong Shen, Ruizhe Xia, Jingyi Liu, Yinqi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes F²LP-AP, a training-free label propagation method that constructs class prototypes via geometric median and dynamically adjusts propagation based on local graph topology. Addresses heterophily limitations of standard label propagation.

entry.title: Algorithm and Hardware Co-Design for Efficient Complex-Valued Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Zehuan Zhang, Mark Chen, He Li, Wayne Luk

entry.summary: Proposes dropout-based Bayesian Complex-Valued Neural Networks for uncertainty quantification with an automated search approach for optimal configurations. Includes hardware co-design for efficient implementation.

entry.title: Cognis: Context-Aware Memory for Conversational AI Agents

author.name: Parshva Daftari, Khush Patel, Shreyas Kapale, Jithin George, Siva Surendira

entry.summary: Presents Lyzr Cognis, a memory architecture for conversational AI agents combining BM25 and Matryoshka vector search with temporal boosting and context-aware ingestion. Enables persistent memory across sessions with version tracking.

entry.title: CoAuthorAI: A Human in the Loop System For Scientific Book Writing

author.name: Yangjie Tian, Xungang Gu, Yun Zhao, Jiale Yang, Lin Yang, Ning Li, He Zhang, Ruohua Xu, Hua Wang, Kewen Liao, Ming Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CoAuthorAI, a human-in-the-loop system for scientific book writing combining RAG, hierarchical outlines, and automatic reference linking. Achieved 98% soft-heading recall and 82% satisfaction rate. Used to generate a published book on AI for Rock Dynamics.

entry.title: AgentSOC: A Multi-Layer Agentic AI Framework for Security Operations Automation

author.name: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh

entry.summary: Introduces AgentSOC, a multi-layered agentic AI framework for Security Operations Center automation that integrates perception, anticipatory reasoning, and risk-based action planning for alert correlation and response.

entry.title: SignDATA: Data Pipeline for Sign Language Translation

author.name: Kuanwei Chen, Tingyi Lin

entry.summary: Presents SignDATA, a config-driven preprocessing toolkit for standardizing heterogeneous sign language corpora into training-ready pose or video artifacts, supporting end-to-end recipes for pose extraction and video processing.

entry.title: Bio-inspired Color Constancy: From Gray Anchoring Theory to Gray Pixel Methods

author.name: Kai-Fu Yang, Fu-Ya Luo, Yong-Jie Li

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive technical framework integrating biological mechanisms and computational theory for bio-inspired color constancy, connecting gray anchoring theory to gray pixel methods.

entry.title: Object Referring-Guided Scanpath Prediction with Perception-Enhanced Vision-Language Models

author.name: Rong Quan, Yantao Lai, Dong Liang, Jie Qin

entry.summary: Proposes ScanVLA for object referring-guided scanpath prediction using a Vision-Language Model with history-enhanced decoder for predicting human attention patterns when searching for described objects.

entry.title: On the Impact of Face Segmentation-Based Background Removal on Recognition and Morphing Attack Detection

author.name: Eduarda Caldeira, Guray Ozgur, Fadi Boutros, Naser Damer

entry.summary: Investigates impact of face segmentation-based background removal on face recognition and morphing attack detection in unconstrained scenarios relevant to border security systems like the EU Entry/Exit System.

entry.title: Diagnosing Urban Street Vitality via a Visual-Semantic and Spatiotemporal Framework for Street-Level Economics

author.name: Xinxin Zhuo, Mengyuan Niu, Ruizhe Wang, Junyan Yang, Qiao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a visual-semantic framework for street-level economic assessment using Street View Imagery, with instance segmentation of commercial elements and a VLM-LLM pipeline for brand hierarchy standardization.

entry.title: CO$_2$ sequestration hybrid solver using isogeometric alternating-directions and collocation-based robust variational physics informed neural networks (IGA-ADS-CRVPINN)

author.name: Askold Vilkha, Tomasz S{\l}u\.zalec, Marcin {\L}o\'s, Maciej Paszy\'nski

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid solver for CO2 sequestration combining isogeometric analysis with physics-informed neural networks (CRVPINN) for pressure field computation, requiring only 100 Adam iterations per timestep.

entry.title: A Hough transform approach to safety-aware scalar field mapping using Gaussian Processes

author.name: Muzaffar Qureshi, Trivikram Satharasi, Tochukwu E. Ogri, Kyle Volle, Rushikesh Kamalapurkar

entry.summary: Presents a framework for safe autonomous mapping of unknown scalar fields using Gaussian Processes for field modeling and Hough Transform for real-time estimation of unsafe high-intensity regions. The robot avoids dangerous areas while efficiently mapping.

entry.title: From Natural Language to Executable Narsese: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark and Pipeline for Reasoning with NARS

author.name: Mina Gabriel, Pei Wang

entry.summary: Presents a neuro-symbolic pipeline translating natural language reasoning problems into executable Narsese (NARS language) via first-order logic. Introduces NARS-Reasoning-v0.1 benchmark with True/False/Uncertain labels.

entry.title: DW-Bench: Benchmarking LLMs on Data Warehouse Graph Topology Reasoning

author.name: Ahmed G. A. H Ahmed, C. Okan Sakar

entry.summary: Introduces DW-Bench, a benchmark evaluating LLMs on graph-topology reasoning over data warehouse schemas with foreign-key and data-lineage edges. 1,046 questions across five schemas.

entry.title: A Dual Perspective on Synthetic Trajectory Generators: Utility Framework and Privacy Vulnerabilities

author.name: Aya Cherigui, Florent Gu\'epin, Arnaud Legendre, Jean-Fran\c{c}ois Couchot

entry.summary: Introduces a dual framework evaluating privacy-utility tradeoffs in synthetic trajectory generators for human mobility data.

entry.title: Human-Machine Co-Boosted Bug Report Identification with Mutualistic Neural Active Learning

author.name: Guoming Long, Shihai Wang, Hui Fang, Tao Chen

entry.summary: Introduces MNAL, a cross-project framework for automated bug report identification using neural active learning with human-machine collaboration, combining neural language models with active learning for generalization across GitHub repositories.

entry.title: S2MAM: Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model for Robust Estimation and Variable Selection

author.name: Xuelin Zhang, Hong Chen, Yingjie Wang, Tieliang Gong, Bin Gu

entry.summary: Proposes Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model (S2MAM) that addresses issues with graph Laplacian matrix dependency on prespecified similarity metrics in manifold regularization for semi-supervised learning.

entry.title: Relational AI in Education: Reciprocity, Participatory Design, and Indigenous Worldviews

author.name: Roberto Martinez-Maldonado, Vanessa Echeverria, Jenna Hawes, YJ Kim, Zara Maddigan, Mikaela Milesi, Todd Nelson, Yi-Shan Tsai

entry.summary: Argues for re-centering AI in education as relational rather than efficiency-focused, drawing on Indigenous worldviews and participatory design to frame learner-AI interactions as context-specific relationships with defined purposes and boundaries.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning Enabled Adaptive Multi-Task Control for Bipedal Soccer Robots

author.name: Yulai Zhang, Yinrong Zhang, Ting Wu, Linqi Ye

entry.summary: Proposes a modular RL framework for bipedal soccer robots combining open-loop oscillators with RL feedback residual strategy, using posture-driven state machine for switching between ball-seeking/kicking and fall recovery.

entry.title: Physics-Enhanced Deep Learning for Proactive Thermal Runaway Forecasting in Li-Ion Batteries

author.name: Salman Khan, Muhammad Zunair Zamir, Syed Sajid Ullah, Jie Li

entry.summary: Proposes a Physics-Informed LSTM (PI-LSTM) for predicting thermal runaway in lithium-ion batteries, integrating heat transfer equations into the loss function to enforce thermodynamic consistency. Bridges the gap between purely data-driven and physics-based thermal models.

entry.title: ACT: Anti-Crosstalk Learning for Cross-Sectional Stock Ranking via Temporal Disentanglement and Structural Purification

author.name: Juntao Li, Liang Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses 'crosstalk' — unintended information interference across predictive factors — in graph-based stock ranking models. Proposes temporal disentanglement and structural purification to separate different signal types for better cross-sectional ranking.

entry.title: Causal-Transformer with Adaptive Mutation-Locking for Early Prediction of Acute Kidney Injury

author.name: Weizhi Nie, Haolin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes CT-Former for early prediction of Acute Kidney Injury, combining continuous-time modeling with a Causal-Transformer that generates directed structural causal maps from attention. Addresses both irregular sampling and interpretability for clinical trust.

entry.title: Formalising the Logit Shift Induced by LoRA: A Technical Note

author.name: Xiang Shi, Shuaizhi Cheng, Mingwei Li

entry.summary: Provides a first-order Fréchet approximation showing that multi-layer LoRA effects can be decomposed into a linear sum of layerwise contributions plus a higher-order remainder. A short technical note formalizing the logit shift induced by LoRA.

entry.title: Lifecycle-Aware Federated Continual Learning in Mobile Autonomous Systems

author.name: Beining Wu, Jun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a lifecycle-aware dual-timescale framework for federated continual learning in autonomous systems, combining training-time forgetting prevention with post-training cumulative drift correction.

entry.title: Spatio-temporal modelling of electric vehicle charging demand

author.name: Kaoutar Bouaachra, Yvenn Amara-Ouali, Yannig Goude, Rapha\"el Lachieze-Rey

entry.summary: Introduces a new large-scale EV charging dataset from Scotland (2022-2025) and models demand as a spatio-temporal latent Gaussian field using INLA for Bayesian inference.

entry.title: What Makes a Bacterial Model a Good Reservoir Computer? Predicting Performance from Separability and Similarity

author.name: Laura Alonso Bartolom\'e (MICALIS, Mnemosyne), Jean-Loup Faulon (MICALIS), Xavier Hinaut (Mnemosyne)

entry.summary: Investigates whether bacterial metabolic models can serve as reservoir computers, simulating growth dynamics of multiple species and assessing computational performance on nonlinear classification tasks.

entry.title: Evaluating Assurance Cases as Text-Attributed Graphs for Structure and Provenance Analysis

author.name: Fariz Ikhwantri, Dusica Marijan

entry.summary: Proposes a graph diagnostic framework for analyzing assurance cases, with link prediction for argument structure and graph classification to distinguish LLM-generated vs. human-created assurance cases. Relevant for regulatory compliance and AI safety documentation.

entry.title: Evidence of Layered Positional and Directional Constraints in the Voynich Manuscript: Implications for Cipher-Like Structure

author.name: Christophe Parisel

entry.summary: Presents a systematic analysis of the Voynich Manuscript revealing two structural layers: right-to-left optimization within words and left-to-right dependency at word boundaries. Tests structured generators and finds none can reproduce all observed signatures, arguing against the gibberish hypothesis.

entry.title: KoALa-Bench: Evaluating Large Audio Language Models on Korean Speech Understanding and Faithfulness

author.name: Jinyoung Kim, Hyeongsoo Lim, Eunseo Seo, Minho Jang, Keunwoo Choi, Seungyoun Shin, Ji Won Yoon

entry.summary: Introduces KoALa-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Korean speech understanding and faithfulness in large audio language models across six tasks including ASR, speech translation, and speech QA.

entry.title: Depression Risk Assessment in Social Media via Large Language Models

author.name: Giorgia Gulino, Manuel Petrucci

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based system for depression risk assessment in Reddit posts through multi-label classification of 8 depression-associated emotions. Evaluates zero-shot on 6K annotated posts and applies to 470K in-the-wild comments.

entry.title: Structured Disagreement in Health-Literacy Annotation: Epistemic Stability, Conceptual Difficulty, and Agreement-Stratified Inference

author.name: Olga Kellert, Sriya Kondury, Candice Koo, Nemika Tyagi, Steffen Eikenberry

entry.summary: Presents large-scale analysis of health-literacy annotation disagreement from 6,323 COVID-19 responses in Ecuador and Peru. Shows that disagreement is structured by question difficulty rather than annotator noise, challenging single-ground-truth assumptions.

entry.title: Not all ANIMALs are equal: metaphorical framing through source domains and semantic frames

author.name: Yulia Otmakhova, Matteo Guida, Lea Frermann

entry.summary: Presents a computational framework for analyzing metaphors through the interplay of source domains and semantic frames, applying it to climate change and immigration discourse to show how different political ideologies employ different frames within the same source domains.

entry.title: Enhancing Research Idea Generation through Combinatorial Innovation and Multi-Agent Iterative Search Strategies

author.name: Shuai Chen, Chengzhi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent iterative planning search strategy inspired by combinatorial innovation theory for research idea generation, using LLM agents to generate, evaluate, and refine ideas through repeated interaction.

entry.title: Automated Detection of Dosing Errors in Clinical Trial Narratives: A Multi-Modal Feature Engineering Approach with LightGBM

author.name: Mohammad AL-Smadi

entry.summary: Presents a LightGBM-based system for detecting dosing errors in clinical trial narratives using 3,451 multi-modal features spanning TF-IDF, embeddings, medical patterns, and transformer scores across 42,112 clinical trial samples.

entry.title: Enhancing ASR Performance in the Medical Domain for Dravidian Languages

author.name: Sri Charan Devarakonda, Ravi Sastry Kolluru, Manjula Sri Rayudu, Rashmi Kapoor, Madhu G, Anil Kumar Vuppala

entry.summary: Proposes a confidence-aware training framework for ASR in low-resource Dravidian medical domains, integrating real and synthetic speech through a hybrid confidence mechanism combining static similarity metrics with dynamic model entropy.

entry.title: ActuBench: A Multi-Agent LLM Pipeline for Generation and Evaluation of Actuarial Reasoning Tasks

author.name: Jan-Philipp Schmidt

entry.summary: Presents ActuBench, a multi-agent LLM pipeline for generating and evaluating actuarial assessment items aligned with the IAA syllabus. Evaluates 50 language models with results published as a browsable web interface.

entry.title: KD-Judge: A Knowledge-Driven Automated Judge Framework for Functional Fitness Movements on Edge Devices

author.name: Shaibal Saha, Fan Li, Yunge Li, Arun Iyengar, Lucas Alves, Lanyu Xu

entry.summary: Proposes KD-Judge, a knowledge-driven automated judging framework for functional fitness movements that converts rulebook standards into executable representations using LLM-based RAG and chain-of-thought reasoning for edge device deployment.

entry.title: SGAP-Gaze: Scene Grid Attention Based Point-of-Gaze Estimation Network for Driver Gaze

author.name: Pavan Kumar Sharma, Pranamesh Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes SGAP-Gaze for driver point-of-gaze estimation that incorporates scene images alongside face images, using scene-grid attention to leverage surrounding traffic cues. Introduces UD-FSG benchmark dataset with synchronized driver-face and scene images.

entry.title: A Computational Model of Message Sensation Value in Short Video Multimodal Features that Predicts Sensory and Behavioral Engagement

author.name: Haoning Xue, Jingwen Zhang, Xiaohui Wang, Diane Dagyong Kim, Yunya Song

entry.summary: Develops a computational model of Message Sensation Value for short videos using multimodal feature analysis, finding an inverted U-shaped relationship between MSV and behavioral engagement validated across three platforms with 14,492 videos.

entry.title: Topology-Aware Skeleton Detection via Lighthouse-Guided Structured Inference

author.name: Daoyong Fu, Xiang Zhang, Zhaohuan Zhan, Fan Yang, Ke Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Lighthouse-Skel, a topology-aware skeleton detection method using a dual-branch framework that jointly learns skeleton confidence fields and structural anchors (endpoints and junctions) to maintain structural continuity.

entry.title: Semantic-Fast-SAM: Efficient Semantic Segmenter

author.name: Byunghyun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes Semantic-Fast-SAM, combining Fast SAM with a semantic labeling pipeline to achieve real-time semantic segmentation without sacrificing accuracy, tested on Cityscapes and ADE20K.

entry.title: MambaLiteUNet: Cross-Gated Adaptive Feature Fusion for Robust Skin Lesion Segmentation

author.name: Md Maklachur Rahman, Soon Ki Jung, Tracy Hammond

entry.summary: Proposes MambaLiteUNet for skin lesion segmentation, integrating Mamba state space modeling into U-Net with adaptive multi-branch fusion, local-global feature mixing, and cross-gated attention modules.

entry.title: Efficient INT8 Single-Image Super-Resolution via Deployment-Aware Quantization and Teacher-Guided Training

author.name: Pham Phuong Nam Nguyen, Nam Tien Le, Thi Kim Trang Vo, Nhu Tinh Anh Nguyen

entry.summary: Presents a deployment-oriented quantized single-image super-resolution framework using INT8 quantization with a three-stage training pipeline including teacher guidance and DCT-domain supervision.

entry.title: Random Walk on Point Clouds for Feature Detection

author.name: Yuhe Zhang, Zhikun Tu, Zhi Li, Jian Gao, Bao Guo, Shunli Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RWoDSN for feature point extraction on point clouds using random walks and a novel Disk Sampling Neighborhood descriptor that preserves matrix structure for context-dependent analysis.

entry.title: Adapting TrOCR for Printed Tigrinya Text Recognition: Word-Aware Loss Weighting for Cross-Script Transfer Learning

author.name: Yonatan Haile Medhanie, Yuanhua Ni

entry.summary: First adaptation of TrOCR for printed Tigrinya text using Ge'ez script, introducing Word-Aware Loss Weighting to handle word-boundary failures when applying Latin-centric BPE to a new script. Achieves 0.22% CER.

entry.title: From Image to Music Language: A Two-Stage Structure Decoding Approach for Complex Polyphonic OMR

author.name: Nan Xu, Shiheng Li, Shengchao Hou

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage approach for Optical Music Recognition of complex polyphonic scores, formulating second-stage decoding as topology recognition with probability-guided search.

entry.title: Kinematic Optimization of Phalanx Length Ratios in Robotic Hands Using Potential Dexterity

author.name: HyoJae Kang, Joonho Lee, Jeongdo Ahn, Dong Il Park

entry.summary: Presents a framework for optimizing phalanx length ratios in five-finger robotic hands using kinematic metrics like manipulability, workspace volume, and fingertip sensitivity without requiring specific task or object definitions.

entry.title: Only Politics Can Prevent Extinction*

author.name: Oliver Kuperman

entry.summary: Argues that implementing ambitious AI regulation requires building a political movement, challenging the rationalist community's typical aversion to electoral politics. Questions how Yudkowsky-style AI regulation could pass without organized political support.

entry.title: Multi-Level Temporal Graph Networks with Local-Global Fusion for Industrial Fault Diagnosis

author.name: Bibek Aryal, Gift Modekwe, Qiugang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-level temporal graph network with local-global feature fusion for industrial fault diagnosis, using dynamic Pearson correlation graphs and hierarchical GNN architectures to capture sensor relationships at multiple scales.

entry.title: Design Rules for Extreme-Edge Scientific Computing on AI Engines

author.name: Zhenghua Ma, G Abarajithan, Dimitrios Danopoulos, Olivia Weng, Francesco Restuccia, Ryan Kastner

entry.summary: Provides design rules for deploying ML models on AI Engines in modern FPGA SoCs for extreme-edge scientific applications, comparing spatial dataflow with AI Engine implementations for low-latency, on-chip inference.

entry.title: On-Meter Graph Machine Learning: A Case Study of PV Power Forecasting for Grid Edge Intelligence

author.name: Jian Huang, Zixiang Ming, Yongli Zhu, Linna Xu

entry.summary: Studies deploying GCN and GraphSAGE models on edge intelligent meters for photovoltaic power forecasting, including custom ONNX operator development for on-device inference.

entry.title: Robustness of Spatio-temporal Graph Neural Networks for Fault Location in Partially Observable Distribution Grids

author.name: Burak Karabulut, Carlo Manna, Chris Develder

entry.summary: Evaluates spatio-temporal GNN architectures for fault location in distribution grids with sparse measurements. Compares a measured-only graph topology strategy against full-topology approaches, introducing STGNN for this grid application.

entry.title: Storm Surge Modeling, Bias Correction, Graph Neural Networks, Graph Convolution Networks

author.name: Noujoud Nader, Stefanos Giaremis, Clint Dawson, Carola Kaiser, Karame Mohammadiporshokooh, Hartmut Kaiser

entry.summary: Introduces StormNet, a spatio-temporal GNN for bias correction of storm surge forecasts, integrating graph convolutional, attention, and LSTM mechanisms. Addresses uncertainties in traditional numerical models like ADCIRC.

entry.title: Option Pricing on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum Computers: A Quantum Neural Network Approach

author.name: Sebastian Zaj\k{a}c, Rafa{\l} Pracht

entry.summary: Implements quantum neural networks for option pricing on actual quantum hardware using the Black-Scholes-Merton framework as benchmark. One of the first QNN implementations for option pricing on real quantum devices.

entry.title: Towards High-Quality Machine Translation for Kokborok: A Low-Resource Tibeto-Burman Language of Northeast India

author.name: Badal Nyalang, Biman Debbarma

entry.summary: Presents KokborokMT, an NMT system for Kokborok (Tibeto-Burman language, ~1.5M speakers) fine-tuning NLLB-200 on 36K parallel sentences including synthetic back-translations. Advances from prior BLEU <7 to significantly improved translation quality.

entry.title: LLM StructCore: Schema-Guided Reasoning Condensation and Deterministic Compilation

author.name: Serhii Zabolotnii

entry.summary: Describes a two-stage system for filling clinical Case Report Forms from notes: Stage 1 uses an LLM for schema-guided reasoning to produce a JSON summary, Stage 2 uses a deterministic compiler to parse and map to 134 CRF items, handling extreme sparsity.

entry.title: Utterance-Level Methods for Identifying Reliable ASR-Output for Child Speech

author.name: Gus Lathouwers, Lingyun Gao, Catia Cucchiarini, Helmer Strik

entry.summary: Develops utterance-level methods for identifying reliable ASR outputs for child speech, with separate approaches for read speech and dialogue material. Evaluations on English and Dutch datasets show high precision for reliable transcription selection.

entry.title: Online CS-based SAR Edge-Mapping

author.name: Conor Flynn, Radoslav Ivanov, Birsen Yazici

entry.summary: Proposes an online edge-mapping technique for SAR that bypasses image reconstruction to directly classify scenes from compressed sensing data, reducing memory burden for small UAV onboard processing.

entry.title: Weighted Knowledge Distillation for Semi-Supervised Segmentation of Maxillary Sinus in Panoramic X-ray Images

author.name: Juha Park, Jiho Choi, Jong Pil Yun, Yong Chan Park, Han-Gyeol Yeom, Byung Do Lee, Sang Jun Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a semi-supervised segmentation framework for maxillary sinus in panoramic X-rays using weighted knowledge distillation to leverage both labeled and unlabeled radiographs.

entry.title: Strain in Sound: Soft Corrugated Tube for Local Strain Sensing with Acoustic Resonance

author.name: Michael Chun, Ananya Nukala, Tae Myung Huh

entry.summary: Presents a soft corrugated tube sensor that estimates local strain by analyzing acoustic resonance changes as air flows through it. A gradient boosting regressor processes resonance frequency data across flow speeds to estimate segmental strain. Novel sensing modality for soft robotics.

entry.title: A Kinematic Framework for Evaluating Pinch Configurations in Robotic Hand Design without Object or Contact Models

author.name: HyoJae Kang, Joonho Lee, Hyunmok Jung, Dong Il Park

entry.summary: Proposes a kinematic evaluation method for analyzing pinch configurations of robotic hands based on fingertip workspace interactions, without requiring object geometry or contact force models. Designed for early-stage hand design evaluation.

entry.title: [LLM|car]-centric [websites|cities]

author.name: Ben (Berlin)

entry.summary: Draws an analogy between car-centric urban design and the risk of LLM-centric web design, warning that optimizing websites for AI agents rather than humans could create a locked-in, hard-to-reverse infrastructure shift, especially given LLMs' persuasive capabilities.

entry.title: Formally Verified Patent Analysis via Dependent Type Theory: Machine-Checkable Certificates from a Hybrid AI + Lean 4 Pipeline

author.name: George Koomullil

entry.summary: Applies formal verification via Lean 4 to patent analysis, encoding patent claims as DAGs and using dependent type theory for freedom-to-operate and claim construction analysis.

entry.title: Plausible Reasoning and First-Order Plausible Logic

author.name: David Billington

entry.summary: Defines Plausible Logic (PL), a first-order logic for defeasible reasoning without probabilities, satisfying 15 of 17 proposed principles for plausible reasoning.

entry.title: Integrating Anomaly Detection into Agentic AI for Proactive Risk Management in Human Activity

author.name: Farbod Zorriassatine, Ahmad Lotfi

entry.summary: Proposes integrating anomaly detection into agentic AI for fall detection/prediction in elderly populations, arguing these can be formulated as anomaly detection problems.

entry.title: Tadabur: A Large-Scale Quran Audio Dataset

author.name: Faisal Alherran

entry.summary: Presents Tadabur, a large-scale Quran audio dataset with 1400+ hours of recitation from 600+ reciters, providing diversity in recitation styles and recording conditions for Quranic speech research.

entry.title: Product-of-Experts Training Reduces Dataset Artifacts in Natural Language Inference

author.name: Aby Mammen Mathew

entry.summary: Applies Product-of-Experts training to reduce dataset artifacts in NLI by downweighting examples where biased models are overconfident, achieving debiasing with minimal accuracy loss on SNLI.

entry.title: Attention-based Multi-modal Deep Learning Model of Spatio-temporal Crop Yield Prediction with Satellite, Soil and Climate Data

author.name: Gopal Krishna Shyam, Ila Chandrakar

entry.summary: Presents an attention-based multi-modal deep learning framework combining satellite imagery, meteorological time-series, and soil properties for spatio-temporal crop yield prediction.

entry.title: RoLegalGEC: Legal Domain Grammatical Error Detection and Correction Dataset for Romanian

author.name: Mircea Timpuriu, Mihaela-Claudia Cercel, Dumitru-Clementin Cercel

entry.summary: Introduces the first Romanian-language legal domain grammatical error correction dataset using synthetic parallel data generation based on structured Romanian grammar understanding.

entry.title: Adaptive MSD-Splitting: Enhancing C4.5 and Random Forests for Skewed Continuous Attributes

author.name: Jake Lee

entry.summary: Adaptive MSD-Splitting extends the MSD-Splitting technique for C4.5 and Random Forests to handle skewed continuous attributes by dynamically adjusting cutoffs based on data distribution shape.

entry.title: Graph-Theoretic Models for the Prediction of Molecular Measurements

author.name: Anna Niane, Prudence Djagba

entry.summary: Evaluates graph-theoretic polynomial models based on external/internal activity indices for molecular property prediction across MoleculeNet benchmarks, finding limitations in generalizing from small flavonoid datasets to larger chemically diverse datasets.

entry.title: Federated Learning over Blockchain-Enabled Cloud Infrastructure

author.name: Saloni Garg, Amit Sagtani, Kamal Kant Hiran

entry.summary: Surveys federated learning over blockchain-enabled cloud infrastructure with a four-dimensional architectural categorization covering coordination, consensus, storage, and trust models.

entry.title: Towards Event-Aware Forecasting in DeFi: Insights from On-chain Automated Market Maker Protocols

author.name: Huaiyu Jia, Jiehshun You, Yizhi Luo, Jingyu Liu, Shuo Sun

entry.summary: Constructs a dataset covering multiple AMM protocols with fine-grained event classification and proposes an event-aware modeling framework for DeFi price forecasting. Fills a gap in understanding micro-structural dynamics of automated market makers.

entry.title: A Hierarchical MARL-Based Approach for Coordinated Retail P2P Trading and Wholesale Market Participation of DERs

author.name: Patrick Wilk, Ethan Cantor, Yikui Liu, Jie Li

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-agent deep RL framework enabling prosumers with distributed energy resources to participate in both peer-to-peer retail trading and wholesale electricity markets simultaneously.

entry.title: Improving clinical interpretability of linear neuroimaging models through feature whitening

author.name: Sara Petiton, Antoine Grigis, Rapha\"el Vock, Edouard Duchesnay

entry.summary: Proposes feature whitening applied to groups of correlated brain regions to improve interpretability of linear models in neuroimaging. Leverages anatomical priors about hemispheric correlations to disentangle shared variance.

entry.title: Fast Bayesian equipment condition monitoring via simulation based inference: applications to heat exchanger health

author.name: Peter Collett, Alexander Johannes Stasik, Simone Casolo, Signe Riemer-S{\o}rensen

entry.summary: Applies simulation-based inference using amortized neural posterior estimation for real-time condition monitoring of heat exchangers, replacing MCMC with trained neural density estimators for instant posterior inference.

entry.title: Machine learning moment closure models for the radiative transfer equation IV: enforcing symmetrizable hyperbolicity in two dimensions

author.name: Juntao Huang

entry.summary: Extends ML moment closure models for the radiative transfer equation from 1D to 2D, enforcing symmetrizable hyperbolicity. Fourth in a series of papers combining ML with physics-based constraints for computational physics simulations.

entry.title: Global Offshore Wind Infrastructure: Deployment and Operational Dynamics from Dense Sentinel-1 Time Series
