author.name: Feiyu Zhao, Yiming Chen, Wenhuan Lu, Daipeng Zhang, Xianghu Yue, Jianguo Wei

entry.summary: Introduces HalluAudio, the first large-scale hallucination benchmark for Large Audio-Language Models spanning speech, environmental sound, and music with 5K+ human-verified QA pairs across diverse task types.

entry.title: A neural operator framework for data-driven discovery of stability and receptivity in physical systems

author.name: Chengyun Wang, Liwei Chen, Nils Thuerey

entry.summary: Presents a data-driven framework using neural operators and automatic differentiation to discover stability properties and resolvent modes from observation data alone, without requiring governing equations.

entry.title: Detecting Hallucinations in SpeechLLMs at Inference Time Using Attention Maps

author.name: Jonas Waldendorf, Bashar Awwad Shiekh Hasan, Evgenii Tsymbalov

entry.summary: Proposes attention-derived metrics (AudioRatio, AudioConsistency, AudioEntropy, TextEntropy) for detecting hallucinations in Speech LLMs at inference time without gold-standard outputs, using lightweight logistic regression classifiers.

entry.title: Robust Continual Unlearning against Knowledge Erosion and Forgetting Reversal

author.name: Eun-Ju Park, Youjin Shin, Simon S. Woo

entry.summary: Identifies two critical phenomena in continual unlearning: Knowledge Erosion (progressive accuracy degradation) and Forgetting Reversal (previously unlearned data being re-memorized). Proposes a robust approach to address both.

entry.title: The Logical Expressiveness of Topological Neural Networks

author.name: Amirreza Akbari, Amauri H. Souza, Vikas Garg

entry.summary: Analyzes the logical expressiveness of Topological Neural Networks (TNNs) through isomorphism testing and first-order logic, characterizing precisely which binary classifiers TNNs can represent.

entry.title: Safe Continual Reinforcement Learning in Non-stationary Environments

author.name: Austin Coursey, Abel Diaz-Gonzalez, Marcos Quinones-Grueiro, Gautam Biswas

entry.summary: Studies the intersection of continual RL and safe RL in non-stationary environments, addressing the understudied problem of maintaining safety constraints while adapting to changing dynamics.

entry.title: Beyond Bellman: High-Order Generator Regression for Continuous-Time Policy Evaluation

author.name: Yaowei Zheng, Richong Zhang, Shenxi Wu, Shirui Bian, Haosong Zhang, Li Zeng, Xingjian Ma, Yichi Zhang

entry.summary: Studies continuous-time policy evaluation from discrete trajectories, using higher-order generator estimation from multi-step transitions to go beyond first-order Bellman recursion. Provides end-to-end error decomposition.

entry.title: Auditing LLMs for Algorithmic Fairness in Casenote-Augmented Tabular Prediction

author.name: Xiao Qi Lee, Ezinne Nwankwo, Angela Zhou

entry.summary: Audits algorithmic fairness of LLM-based tabular classification on a real housing placement task, finding that fine-tuned models with casenote summaries can improve both accuracy and fairness simultaneously.

entry.title: Phase Transitions in the Fluctuations of Functionals of Random Neural Networks

author.name: Simmaco Di Lillo, Leonardo Maini, Domenico Marinucci

entry.summary: Establishes central and non-central limit theorems for functionals of infinitely-wide random neural networks on spheres, identifying three distinct limiting regimes based on covariance function fixed points as depth increases.

entry.title: Investigating Counterfactual Unfairness in LLMs towards Identities through Humor

author.name: Shubin Kim, Yejin Son, Junyeong Park, Keummin Ka, Seungbeen Lee, Jaeyoung Lee, Hyeju Jang, Alice Oh, Youngjae Yu

entry.summary: Investigates counterfactual unfairness in LLMs through humor, examining how model responses change when swapping speaker/addressee identities across humor generation, intention inference, and impact prediction tasks.

entry.title: LogosKG: Hardware-Optimized Scalable and Interpretable Knowledge Graph Retrieval

author.name: He Cheng, Yifu Wu, Saksham Khatwani, Maya Kruse, Dmitriy Dligach, Timothy A. Miller, Majid Afshar, Yanjun Gao

entry.summary: Introduces LogosKG, a hardware-aligned framework for scalable k-hop knowledge graph retrieval that uses symbolic KG formulations with decomposed representations, scaling to billion-edge graphs with substantial efficiency gains.

entry.title: What Makes an LLM a Good Optimizer? A Trajectory Analysis of LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search

author.name: Xinhao Zhang, Xi Chen, Fran\c{c}ois Portet, Maxime Peyrard

entry.summary: Large-scale study of LLM-guided evolutionary search across 15 LLMs and 8 tasks, analyzing optimization trajectories. Finds strong LLM optimizers act as local refiners with incremental improvements rather than making large leaps, and zero-shot ability only partially explains optimization outcomes.

entry.title: Superficial Success vs. Internal Breakdown: An Empirical Study of Generalization in Adaptive Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Namyoung So (Department of Computer Science, Hanyang University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Seokgyu Jang (Department of Computer Science, Hanyang University, Seoul, Republic of Korea), Taeuk Kim (Department of Computer Science, Hanyang University, Seoul, Republic of Korea)

entry.summary: Empirically studies generalization of adaptive multi-agent systems, revealing 'topological overfitting' (failure across domains) and 'illusory coordination' (surface accuracy without genuine agent coordination). Highlights fundamental limitations of current adaptive MAS.

entry.title: Toward Clinically Acceptable Chest X-ray Report Generation: A Qualitative Retrospective Pilot Study of CXRMate-2

author.name: Aaron Nicolson, Elizabeth J. Cooper, Hwan-Jin Yoon, Claire McCafferty, Ramya Krishnan, Michelle Craigie, Nivene Saad, Jason Dowling, Ian A. Scott, Bevan Koopman

entry.summary: Presents CXRMate-2, a chest X-ray report generation model combining multimodal conditioning with RL, achieving significant improvements over MedGemma. Includes a blinded radiologist evaluation comparing AI vs human reports.

entry.title: Unveiling Fine-Grained Visual Traces: Evaluating Multimodal Interleaved Reasoning Chains in Multimodal STEM Tasks

author.name: Jing Jin, Hao Liu, Yan Bai, Yihang Lou, Zhenke Wang, Tianrun Yuan, Juntong Chen, Yongkang Zhu, Fanhu Zeng, Xuanyu Zhu, Yige Xu

entry.summary: Introduces StepSTEM, a graduate-level benchmark of 283 STEM problems for evaluating fine-grained cross-modal reasoning in MLLMs. Enforces strict modality complementarity to prevent unimodal shortcuts and evaluates reasoning processes, not just final answers.

entry.title: Face Anything: 4D Face Reconstruction from Any Image Sequence

author.name: Umut Kocasari, Simon Giebenhain, Richard Shaw, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner

entry.summary: Presents Face Anything, a unified method for 4D facial reconstruction from any image sequence using canonical facial point prediction, enabling temporally consistent geometry and reliable correspondences in a single feed-forward model. From Matthias Nießner's group.

entry.title: Reflectively stable consequentialists are expected utility maximisers

author.name: Pedro Afonso

entry.summary: Presents a new coherence theorem showing that 'reflectively stable consequentialists'—agents whose decision procedure endorses itself—must be expected utility maximizers. Provides a formal justification for EU maximization from self-consistency.

entry.title: Towards Scalable Lifelong Knowledge Editing with Selective Knowledge Suppression

author.name: Dahyun Jung, Jaewook Lee, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes LightEdit for scalable lifelong knowledge editing of LLMs, selecting relevant knowledge from retrieved information to modify queries efficiently while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Reasoning-Aware AIGC Detection via Alignment and Reinforcement

author.name: Zhao Wang, Max Xiong, Jianxun Lian, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: Introduces REVEAL, a detection framework for AI-generated content that generates interpretable reasoning chains before classification, using SFT then RL. Also releases AIGC-text-bank, a multi-domain dataset.

entry.title: DT2IT-MRM: Debiased Preference Construction and Iterative Training for Multimodal Reward Modeling

author.name: Zhihong Zhang, Jie Zhao, Xiaojian Huang, Jin Xu, Zhuodong Luo, Xin Liu, Jiansheng Wei, Xuejin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DT2IT-MRM for multimodal reward modeling with debiased preference construction, addressing granularity, textual style bias, and unreliable preference signals in existing datasets.

entry.title: Detecting Data Contamination in Large Language Models

author.name: Juliusz Janicki, Savvas Chamezopoulos, Evangelos Kanoulas, Georgios Tsatsaronis

entry.summary: Studies black-box membership inference attacks against LLMs for data contamination detection, compares SOTA methods under unified datasets, and proposes a new 'Familiarity Ranking' approach.

entry.title: Two-dimensional early exit optimisation of LLM inference

author.name: Jan H\r{u}la, David Adamczyk, Tom\'a\v{s} Filip, Martin Pavl\'i\v{c}ek, Petr Sos\'ik

entry.summary: Introduces a 2D early exit strategy for LLM inference that coordinates both layer-wise and sentence-wise exiting, achieving multiplicative speedups of 1.4-2.3x over layer-only early exit.

entry.title: Evaluating Answer Leakage Robustness of LLM Tutors against Adversarial Student Attacks

author.name: Jin Zhao, Marta Kne\v{z}evi\'c, Tanja K\"aser

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM tutor robustness against adversarial students trying to extract answers instead of learning, testing multiple model families and attack strategies.

entry.title: Experiments or Outcomes? Probing Scientific Feasibility in Large Language Models

author.name: Seyedali Mohammadi, Manas Gaur, Francis Ferraro

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs on scientific feasibility assessment—predicting whether a claim is consistent with established knowledge. Tests under controlled conditions varying what context is provided (hypothesis-only, experiments, outcomes). Finds that outcome evidence is more reliable than experiment descriptions for improving accuracy.

entry.title: Self-Improving Tabular Language Models via Iterative Group Alignment

author.name: Yunbo Long, Tejumade Afonja, Alexandra Brintrup, Mario Fritz

entry.summary: Introduces TabGRAA, the first self-improving framework for tabular data generation using iterative group-relative advantage alignment. Addresses the limitations of static fine-tuning and autoregressive objectives that neglect global statistical properties of tabular data.

entry.title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora

author.name: Hanjun Cho, Jay-Yoon Lee

entry.summary: Introduces RARE, a redundancy-aware retrieval evaluation framework for corpora with high inter-document similarity (financial reports, legal codes). Shows standard QA benchmarks unfairly penalize retrievers that find sufficient but non-canonical evidence.

entry.title: LBLLM: Lightweight Binarization of Large Language Models via Three-Stage Distillation

author.name: Siqing Song, Chuang Wang, Yong Lang, Yi Yang, Xu-Yao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents LBLLM, a lightweight binarization framework for LLMs achieving W(1+1)A4 quantization through three-stage distillation: PTQ initialization, layer-wise weight binarization with full-precision activations, then learnable activation quantization.

entry.title: Lyapunov-Certified Direct Switching Theory for Q-Learning

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Analyzes Q-learning through a direct stochastic switching system representation, showing the Bellman maximization error can be represented as a stochastic policy. Derives tighter finite-time bounds using joint spectral radius and Lyapunov functions.

entry.title: Task Switching Without Forgetting via Proximal Decoupling

author.name: Pourya Shamsolmoali, Masoumeh Zareapoor, Eric Granger, William A. P. Smith, Yue Lu

entry.summary: Proposes an operator-splitting approach for continual learning that separates task learning from stability enforcement, using proximal operators to explicitly decouple these competing objectives.

entry.title: Accelerating trajectory optimization with Sobolev-trained diffusion policies

author.name: Th\'eotime Le Hellard, Franki Nguimatsia Tiofack, Quentin Le Lidec, Justin Carpentier

entry.summary: Proposes Sobolev training for diffusion policies used as warm-starters for trajectory optimization, where matching derivatives (not just function values) prevents small approximation errors from compounding during rollout.

entry.title: FG$^2$-GDN: Enhancing Long-Context Gated Delta Networks with Doubly Fine-Grained Control

author.name: Pingwei Sun, Yuxuan Hu, Jianchao Tan, Xue Wang, Jiaqi Zhang, Yifan Lu, Yerui Sun, Yuchen Xie, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: FG²-GDN enhances Gated DeltaNet with channel-wise learning rates in the delta rule update, analogous to per-coordinate adaptive optimizers, improving long-context modeling capacity.

entry.title: Learning Posterior Predictive Distributions for Node Classification from Synthetic Graph Priors

author.name: Jeongwhan Choi, Jongwoo Kim, Woosung Kang, Noseong Park

entry.summary: Proposes learning posterior predictive distributions for universal node classification across diverse graphs by pre-training on synthetic graph priors, inspired by in-context learning in LLMs.

entry.title: Debiased neural operators for estimating functionals

author.name: Konstantin Hess, Dennis Frauen, Niki Kilbertus, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: DOPE introduces a semiparametric estimator for computing target functionals (e.g., total energy, time in range) from neural operator solutions, with debiasing to correct for neural operator errors.

entry.title: PREF-XAI: Preference-Based Personalized Rule Explanations of Black-Box Machine Learning Models

author.name: Salvatore Greco, Jacek Karolczak, Roman S{\l}owi\'nski, Jerzy Stefanowski

entry.summary: Proposes PREF-XAI, a framework for personalized explanations of black-box models that accounts for individual user preferences rather than providing one-size-fits-all explanations. Uses principled preference learning rather than heuristic adaptations.

entry.title: TrEEStealer: Stealing Decision Trees via Enclave Side Channels

author.name: Jonas Sander, Anja Rabich, Nick Mahling, Felix Maurer, Jonah Heller, Qifan Wang, Thomas Eisenbarth, David Oswald

entry.summary: Demonstrates side-channel attacks on decision trees running in trusted execution environments (TEEs), showing that TEEs don't prevent model extraction when cache-based and interrupt-based side channels are exploited.

entry.title: Trainability Beyond Linearity in Variational Quantum Objectives

author.name: Gordon Ma, Xiufan Li

entry.summary: Identifies the exact boundary of the barren plateau proof template for variational quantum algorithms, showing it applies if and only if the loss is affine in measured statistics. Provides structural characterization of trainability.

entry.title: Fast estimation of Gaussian mixture components via centering and singular value thresholding

author.name: Huan Qing

entry.summary: Proposes a simple method for estimating the number of Gaussian mixture components: center data, compute singular values, threshold. Proves consistency under mild separation conditions in high-dimensional settings.

entry.title: Model-Agnostic Meta Learning for Class Imbalance Adaptation

author.name: Hanshu Rao, Guangzeng Han, Xiaolei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces HAMR, a meta-learning framework that uses bi-level optimization to adaptively weight instances for class-imbalanced NLP tasks, with neighborhood-aware resampling to focus on hard examples. Validated across 6 datasets.

entry.title: HoWToBench: Holistic Evaluation for LLM's Capability in Human-level Writing using Tree of Writing

author.name: Andrew Zhuoer Feng, Cunxiang Wang, Yu Luo, Lin Fan, Yilin Zhou, Zikang Wang, Xiaotao Gu, Jie Tang, Hongning Wang, Minlie Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Tree-of-Writing (ToW) for LLM writing evaluation that explicitly models aggregation weights of sub-features in a tree structure, and HowToBench, a large-scale Chinese writing benchmark with 12 genres.

entry.title: VCE: A zero-cost hallucination mitigation method of LVLMs via visual contrastive editing

author.name: Yanbin Huang, Yisen Li, Guiyao Tie, Xiaoye Qu, Pan Zhou, Hongfei Wang, Zhaofan Zou, Hao Sun, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes Visual Contrastive Editing (VCE), a zero-cost post-hoc method to mitigate object hallucination in large vision-language models by analyzing model responses to contrastive visual perturbations and suppressing hallucination tendencies.

entry.title: CrossPan: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Cross-Sequence Pancreas MRI Segmentation and Generalization

author.name: Linkai Peng, Cuiling Sun, Zheyuan Zhang, Wanying Dou, Halil Ertugrul Aktas, Andrea M Bejar, Elif Keles, Tamas Gonda, Michael B Wallace, Zongwei Zhou, Gorkem Durak, Rajesh N Keswani, Ulas Bagci

entry.summary: Introduces CrossPan, a multi-institutional benchmark of 1,386 3D pancreas MRI scans across three sequences, revealing that cross-sequence domain shifts are far more severe than cross-center variability, with models collapsing from >0.85 to <0.02 Dice.

entry.title: Learning to Credit the Right Steps: Objective-aware Process Optimization for Visual Generation

author.name: Rui Li, Ke Hao, Yuanzhi Liang, Haibin Huang, Chi Zhang, YunGu, XueLong Li

entry.summary: Proposes objective-aware process optimization for visual generation using GRPO with step-specific credit assignment across multiple reward models, replacing uniform reward propagation across diffusion trajectories.

entry.title: Silicon Aware Neural Networks

author.name: Sebastian Fieldhouse, Kea-Tiong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes mapping Differentiable Logic Gate Networks directly to digital CMOS standard cell libraries, with a novel loss function optimizing circuit area and power consumption during training.

entry.title: GRAFT: Geometric Refinement and Fitting Transformer for Human Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Pradyumna YM, Yuxuan Xue, Yue Chen, Nikita Kister, Istv\'an S\'ar\'andi, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: Presents GRAFT, a learned human-scene interaction prior that predicts corrective parameter updates to iteratively refine human meshes by reasoning about 3D human-scene relationships. Achieves optimization-quality contact reasoning at feed-forward speed.

entry.title: InHabit: Leveraging Image Foundation Models for Scalable 3D Human Placement

author.name: Nikita Kister, Pradyumna YM, Istv\'an S\'ar\'andi, Jiayi Wang, Anna Khoreva, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: Introduces InHabit, a fully automatic pipeline for populating 3D scenes with interacting humans by transferring 2D foundation model knowledge to 3D via a render-generate-lift principle. From Gerard Pons-Moll's group.

entry.title: SpanVLA: Efficient Action Bridging and Learning from Negative-Recovery Samples for Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Zewei Zhou (Tony), Ruining Yang (Tony), Xuewei (Tony), Qi, Yiluan Guo, Sherry X. Chen, Tao Feng, Kateryna Pistunova, Yishan Shen, Lili Su, Jiaqi Ma

entry.summary: Proposes SpanVLA, an end-to-end autonomous driving framework integrating autoregressive VLM reasoning with flow-matching action generation. Includes negative-recovery sample learning for robustness and reduces latency via efficient action bridging.

entry.title: AnyRecon: Arbitrary-View 3D Reconstruction with Video Diffusion Model

author.name: Yutian Chen, Shi Guo, Renbiao Jin, Tianshuo Yang, Xin Cai, Yawen Luo, Mingxin Yang, Mulin Yu, Linning Xu, Tianfan Xue

entry.summary: Proposes AnyRecon, a scalable 3D reconstruction framework from arbitrary unordered sparse inputs using video diffusion, with a persistent global scene memory via capture view cache and removal of temporal compression for geometric fidelity.

entry.title: A taxonomy of barriers to trading with early misaligned AIs

author.name: Alexa Pan

entry.summary: Provides a detailed taxonomy of barriers to making deals with early misaligned AIs, covering insufficient gains from trade, counterparty risks from both sides, coordination failures, and practical implementation challenges.

entry.title: FB-NLL: A Feature-Based Approach to Tackle Noisy Labels in Personalized Federated Learning

author.name: Abdulmoneam Ali, Ahmed Arafa

entry.summary: Proposes FB-NLL, a feature-centric framework for personalized federated learning that decouples user clustering from training dynamics, making it robust to noisy labels by characterizing users through their local feature spaces.

entry.title: MMControl: Unified Multi-Modal Control for Joint Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Liyang Li, Wen Wang, Canyu Zhao, Tianjian Feng, Zhiyue Zhao, Hao Chen, Chunhua Shen

entry.summary: Presents MMControl for multi-modal control in joint audio-video generation, enabling visual and acoustic control signals (reference images, audio, depth maps, poses) via a dual-stream conditional injection mechanism in DiTs.

entry.title: SynAgent: Generalizable Cooperative Humanoid Manipulation via Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy

author.name: Wei Yao, Haohan Ma, Hongwen Zhang, Yunlian Sun, Liangjun Xing, Zhile Yang, Yuanjun Guo, Yebin Liu, Jinhui Tang

entry.summary: Presents SynAgent, a framework for cooperative humanoid manipulation that transfers single-agent human-object interaction skills to multi-agent scenarios using an interaction-preserving retargeting method based on Delaunay tetrahedralization.

entry.title: Learning Lifted Action Models from Unsupervised Visual Traces

author.name: Kai Xi, Stephen Gould, Sylvie Thi\'ebaux

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework that jointly learns state prediction, action prediction, and lifted action models from sequences of state images without action observation, using a MILP to prevent prediction collapse.

entry.title: Has Automated Essay Scoring Reached Sufficient Accuracy? Deriving Achievable QWK Ceilings from Classical Test Theory

author.name: Masaki Uto

entry.summary: Derives theoretical QWK ceilings for automated essay scoring based on classical test theory, showing what performance is achievable given human rater noise. Finds some SOTA systems already reach or exceed these ceilings.

entry.title: SimDiff: Depth Pruning via Similarity and Difference

author.name: Yuli Chen, Shuhao Zhang, Fanshen Meng, Bo Cheng, Jiale Han, Qiang Tong, Xiulei Liu

entry.summary: Proposes SimDiff, a layer importance criterion for LLM depth pruning that jointly evaluates representational similarity and transformation difference, addressing failures of cosine-distance-only methods.

entry.title: AblateCell: A Reproduce-then-Ablate Agent for Virtual Cell Repositories

author.name: Xue Xia, Chengkai Yao, Mingyu Tsoi, Xinjie Mao, Wenxuan Huang, Jiaqi Wei, Hao Wu, Cheng Tan, Lang Yu, Yuejin Yang, Siqi Sun, Zhangyang Gao

entry.summary: Introduces AblateCell, an AI agent that reproduces baselines and performs systematic ablation studies on virtual cell biology repositories, closing the verification gap in AI for biology.

entry.title: TurboEvolve: Towards Fast and Robust LLM-Driven Program Evolution

author.name: Yang Yang, Zining Zhong, Jindong Li, Jiemin Wu, Kaishen Yuan, Wenshuo Chen, Menglin Yang, Yutao Yue

entry.summary: Proposes TurboEvolve, a multi-island evolutionary framework for LLM-driven program evolution with verbalized sampling and adaptive scheduling to improve sample efficiency and robustness.

entry.title: Characterizing AlphaEarth Embedding Geometry for Agentic Environmental Reasoning

author.name: Mashrekur Rahman, Samuel J. Barrett, Christina Last

entry.summary: Characterizes the manifold geometry of Google AlphaEarth's embeddings across 12.1 million US samples, finding non-Euclidean structure with effective dimensionality of 13.3 from 64 raw dimensions, and develops agentic reasoning system.

entry.title: Skillful Global Ocean Emulation and the Role of Correlation-Aware Loss

author.name: Niraj Agarwal, Timothy A. Smith, Sergey Frolov, Laura C. Slivinski

entry.summary: Adapts GraphCast architecture for ocean-only emulation with prescribed atmospheric conditions, achieving skillful 10-15 day forecasts using correlation-aware Mahalanobis distance loss.

entry.title: Beyond Coefficients: Forecast-Necessity Testing for Interpretable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Time-Series Models

author.name: Valentina Kuskova, Dmitry Zaytsev, Michael Coppedge

entry.summary: Argues causal relevance in nonlinear time-series models should be evaluated through forecast necessity rather than coefficient magnitude, proposing an ablation-based evaluation framework.

entry.title: Hierarchically Robust Zero-shot Vision-language Models

author.name: Junhao Dong, Yifei Zhang, Hao Zhu, Yew-Soon Ong, Piotr Koniusz

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical adversarial fine-tuning framework for Vision-Language Models that leverages class hierarchies (e.g., cat → mammal) to improve adversarial robustness at both base and superclass levels. Addresses robustness degradation when attacks target parent classes.

entry.title: Choose Your Own Adventure: Non-Linear AI-Assisted Programming with EvoGraph

author.name: Vassilios Exarhakos, Jinghui Cheng, Jin L. C. Guo

entry.summary: Presents EvoGraph, an IDE plugin that represents AI-assisted coding interactions as a branching development graph, allowing developers to compare, merge, and revisit prior states. User study with 20 participants shows it addresses developer struggles with linear chat-based AI tools.

entry.title: Low-Rank Adaptation for Critic Learning in Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yuan Zhuang, Yuexin Bian, Sihong He, Jie Feng, Qing Su, Songyang Han, Jonathan Petit, Shihao Ji, Yuanyuan Shi, Fei Miao

entry.summary: Applies Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a structural-sparsity regularizer for off-policy RL critics, freezing base matrices and only optimizing low-rank adapters. Develops a LoRA formulation compatible with SimbaV2's hyperspherical normalization for SAC and FastTD3.

entry.title: ST-Prune: Training-Free Spatio-Temporal Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Lin Sha, Haiyun Guo, Tao Wang, Cong Zhang, Min Huang, Jinqiao Wang, Qinghai Miao

entry.summary: Proposes ST-Prune, a training-free token pruning framework for VLMs in autonomous driving with Motion-aware Temporal Pruning and Ring-view Spatial Pruning to exploit spatio-temporal redundancies in multi-view, multi-frame driving video input.

entry.title: ShadowPEFT: Shadow Network for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Xianming Li, Zongxi Li, Tsz-fung Andrew Lee, Jing Li, Haoran Xie, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes ShadowPEFT, a centralized PEFT framework using a depth-shared shadow module that operates in parallel to transformer layers, providing layer-level refinement rather than LoRA's independent per-weight perturbations.

entry.title: Revisiting Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Knowledge Graph Embedding

author.name: Gerard Pons, Carlos Escolano, Besim Bilalli, Anna Queralt

entry.summary: This paper identifies 'entity interference' in continual knowledge graph embedding - where new entity embeddings interfere with previously learned ones - as a overlooked cause of catastrophic forgetting beyond simple parameter drift. This reframes how CKGE methods should address forgetting.

entry.title: GOLD-BEV: GrOund and aeriaL Data for Dense Semantic BEV Mapping of Dynamic Scenes

author.name: Joshua Niemeijer, Alaa Eddine Ben Zekri, Reza Bahmanyar, Philipp M. Schm\"alzle, Houda Chaabouni-Chouayakh, Franz Kurz

entry.summary: GOLD-BEV learns dense BEV semantic maps from ego-centric sensors using time-synchronized aerial imagery as training supervision only, enabling dense annotation of dynamic scenes including moving traffic participants.

entry.title: Fairness Audits of Institutional Risk Models in Deployed ML Pipelines

author.name: Kelly McConvey, Dipto Das, Maya Ghai, Angelina Zhai, Rosa Lee, Shion Guha

entry.summary: A fairness audit of a deployed Early Warning System at Centennial College reveals systematic misallocation where younger, male, and international students are disproportionately flagged for support even when they succeed.

entry.title: Safety-Critical Contextual Control via Online Riemannian Optimization with World Models

author.name: Tongxin Li

entry.summary: Develops a sample-based Penalized Predictive Control framework grounded in Riemannian optimization for safety-critical control using only black-box simulator access, introducing barrier curvature as a key quantity.

entry.title: Streaming Structured Inference with Flash-SemiCRF

author.name: Benjamin K. Johnson, Thomas Goralski, Ayush Semwal, Hui Shen, H. Josh Jang

entry.summary: Flash-SemiCRF makes semi-Markov CRFs scalable to long sequences by avoiding materialization of edge potential tensors, enabling exact segment-level inference for speech and genomic-scale data.

entry.title: AC-SINDy: Compositional Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics

author.name: Peter Racioppo

entry.summary: AC-SINDy extends the SINDy framework for dynamics identification using arithmetic circuits instead of explicit feature libraries, enabling compositional nonlinear feature construction with sparsity over computational graphs.

entry.title: Guiding Distribution Matching Distillation with Gradient-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Linwei Dong, Ruoyu Guo, Ge Bai, Zehuan Yuan, Yawei Luo, Changqing Zou

entry.summary: GDMD combines distribution matching distillation with RL by using distillation gradients rather than raw pixel outputs as the reward signal, addressing conflicts between distillation and RL objectives.

entry.title: On the Conditioning Consistency Gap in Conditional Neural Processes

author.name: Robin Young

entry.summary: Defines the conditioning consistency gap for neural processes and proves it is O(1/n²) for CNPs with bounded encoders and Lipschitz decoders, quantifying how well NPs approximate valid stochastic processes.

entry.title: Concept Inconsistency in Dermoscopic Concept Bottleneck Models: A Rough-Set Analysis of the Derm7pt Dataset

author.name: Gonzalo N\'apoles, Isel Grau, Yamisleydi Salgueiro

entry.summary: Uses rough set theory to quantify concept-level inconsistencies in the Derm7pt dermoscopy dataset, finding 30.3% of images have inconsistent concept profiles imposing a 69.7% theoretical accuracy ceiling.

entry.title: SAGE: Training-Free Semantic Evidence Composition for Edge-Cloud Inference under Hard Uplink Budgets

author.name: Inhyeok Choi, Hyuncheol Park

entry.summary: Shows that attention-based importance selection for edge-cloud inference is suboptimal under hard bandwidth budgets, and proposes SAGE which uses semantic evidence composition to select complementary rather than individually important content for transmission.

entry.title: Budgeted Online Influence Maximization

author.name: Pierre Perrault, Jennifer Healey, Zheng Wen, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Introduces a budgeted framework for online influence maximization where influencer costs vary, better modeling real advertising campaigns. Provides theoretical regret bounds and improves state-of-the-art even for the cardinality constraint setting.

entry.title: Mind2Drive: Predicting Driver Intentions from EEG in Real-world On-Road Driving

author.name: Ghadah Alosaimi, Hanadi Alhamdan, Wenke E, Stamos Katsigiannis, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei, Toby P. Breckon

entry.summary: Proposes Mind2Drive, an EEG-based driver intention prediction framework validated with real on-road driving data across 32 sessions. TSCeption architecture achieves 90.7% accuracy in predicting driver intentions.

entry.title: From Top-1 to Top-K: A Reproducibility Study and Benchmarking of Counterfactual Explanations for Recommender Systems

author.name: Quang-Huy Nguyen, Thanh-Hai Nguyen, Khac-Manh Thai, Duc-Hoang Pham, Huy-Son Nguyen, Cam-Van Thi Nguyen, Masoud Mansoury, Duc-Trong Le, Hoang-Quynh Le

entry.summary: Systematic benchmark of 11 counterfactual explanation methods for recommender systems under a unified evaluation framework, extending from Top-1 to Top-K settings. Addresses reproducibility issues in XAI for recommenders.

entry.title: LegalBench-BR: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Brazilian Legal Decision Classification

author.name: Pedro Barbosa de Carvalho Neto

entry.summary: Introduces LegalBench-BR, the first Brazilian legal text classification benchmark, showing that BERTimbau-LoRA dramatically outperforms Claude 3.5 Haiku and GPT-4o mini on Portuguese legal classification.

entry.title: A Mechanism and Optimization Study on the Impact of Information Density on User-Generated Content Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Jiang Xiaobo, Dinghong Lai, Song Qiu, Yadong Deng, Xinkai Zhan

entry.summary: Studies how information density is the root cause of NER performance degradation on user-generated content, showing that surface-level noise symptoms share this unified cause. Proposes optimization through controlled resampling.

entry.title: Epistemic orientation in parliamentary discourse is associated with deliberative democracy

author.name: Segun Aroyehun, Stephan Lewandowsky, David Garcia

entry.summary: Introduces Evidence-Minus-Intuition (EMI) score to measure epistemic orientation in parliamentary discourse using LLM ratings. Analyzes 15 million speech segments across seven countries (1946-2025), finding evidence-based discourse correlates with deliberative democracy.

entry.title: Match-Any-Events: Zero-Shot Motion-Robust Feature Matching Across Wide Baselines for Event Cameras

author.name: Ruijun Zhang, Hang Su, Kostas Daniilidis, Ziyun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces the first zero-shot cross-dataset wide-baseline feature matching model for event cameras, with a motion-robust representation that generalizes to unseen datasets without fine-tuning.

entry.title: CAHAL: Clinically Applicable resolution enHAncement for Low-resolution MRI scans

author.name: Sergio Morell-Ortega, \'Angela Gonz\'alez-Cebri\'an, Boris Mansencal, Marien Gadea, Roberto Vivo-Hernando, Gregorio Rubio, Fernando Aparici, Maria de la Iglesia-Vaya, Gwenaelle Catheline, Pierrick Coup\'e, Jos\'e V. Manj\'on

entry.summary: Proposes CAHAL, a hallucination-robust MRI super-resolution framework using deterministic Mixture of Experts that operates in native acquisition space, avoiding anatomical hallucinations common in generative SR methods.

entry.title: DUALVISION: RGB-Infrared Multimodal Large Language Models for Robust Visual Reasoning

author.name: Abrar Majeedi, Zhiyuan Ruan, Ziyi Zhao, Hongcheng Wang, Jianglin Lu, Yin Li

entry.summary: Proposes DUALVISION, a lightweight fusion module integrating infrared and RGB information into MLLMs via patch-level cross-attention. Introduces DV-204K dataset with 25K aligned IR-RGB pairs and 204K modality-specific annotations.

entry.title: How Far Are Video Models from True Multimodal Reasoning?

author.name: Xiaotian Zhang, Jianhui Wei, Yuan Wang, Jie Tan, Yichen Li, Yan Zhang, Ziyi Chen, Daoan Zhang, Dezhi YU, Wei Xu, Songtao Jiang, Zuozhu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CLVG-Bench with 1,000+ manually annotated metadata across 47 subcategories to evaluate video models' zero-shot reasoning including physical simulation, logical reasoning, and interpretive tasks.

entry.title: Thinking Before Matching: A Reinforcement Reasoning Paradigm Towards General Person Re-Identification

author.name: Quan Zhang, Jingze Wu, Jialong Wang, Xiaohua Xie, Jianhuang Lai, Hongbo Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ReID-R, a reasoning-driven person re-identification paradigm using chain-of-thought reasoning and reinforcement learning, moving from perception-driven pattern matching to explicit identity understanding.

entry.title: DINO Eats CLIP: Adapting Beyond Knowns for Open-set 3D Object Retrieval

author.name: Xinwei He, Yansong Zheng, Qianru Han, Zhichuan Wang, Yuxuan Cai, Yang Zhou, Jingbo Xia, Yulong Wang, Jinhai Xiang, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: Proposes DINO Eats CLIP (DEC), a framework for open-set 3D object retrieval that combines DINO's fine-grained features with CLIP's generalization, using dynamic multi-view integration and synthesized data for unseen classes.

entry.title: TS-Attn: Temporal-wise Separable Attention for Multi-Event Video Generation

author.name: Hongyu Zhang, Yufan Deng, Zilin Pan, Peng-Tao Jiang, Bo Li, Qibin Hou, Zhiyang Dou, Zhen Dong, Daquan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes TS-Attn, a training-free temporal-wise separable attention mechanism for multi-event video generation. Addresses the trade-off between action fidelity and temporal consistency when generating videos from complex multi-action prompts.

entry.title: Last-Iterate Guarantees for Learning in Co-coercive Games

author.name: Siddharth Chandak, Ramanan Tamizholi, Nicholas Bambos

entry.summary: Establishes finite-time last-iterate convergence guarantees for stochastic gradient descent in co-coercive games under realistic noise assumptions that allow second moments to scale with iterate norms.

entry.title: Savage's Axioms Make Dominated Acts EU Maxima

author.name: Shuo Li

entry.summary: Shows that Savage's axioms, the foundational axioms for subjective expected utility, make dominated acts tie dominating acts in EU—a gap in the standard coherence defense of EU as blocking exploitation.

entry.title: Introducing the Labor Automation Forecasting Hub

author.name: ChristianWilliams

entry.summary: Announces Metaculus's Labor Automation Forecasting Hub with forecasts on AI-driven US labor market changes through 2035. Forecasters expect ~3% employment decline, 17.2% shrinkage in most AI-exposed occupations, and hours worked dropping from 38 to 34/week.

entry.title: HALO: Hybrid Auto-encoded Locomotion with Learned Latent Dynamics, Poincar\'e Maps, and Regions of Attraction

author.name: Blake Werner, Sergio A. Esteban, Massimiliano De Sa, Max H. Cohen, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Introduces HALO, a framework for learning latent reduced-order models of periodic hybrid dynamics from trajectory data using autoencoders, with analysis via Poincaré maps and regions of attraction for legged robot locomotion.

entry.title: Quadruped Parkour Learning: Sparsely Gated Mixture of Experts with Visual Input

author.name: Michael Ziegltrum, Jianhao Jiao, Tianhu Peng, Chengxu Zhou, Dimitrios Kanoulas

entry.summary: Investigates sparsely-gated Mixture-of-Experts architectures for vision-based robotic parkour, comparing MoE control policies against standard MLP architectures for quadruped locomotion over challenging terrain.

entry.title: TransSplat: Unbalanced Semantic Transport for Language-Driven 3DGS Editing

author.name: Yanhui Chen, Jiahong Li, Jingchao Wang, Junyi Lin, Zixin Zeng, Yang Shi

entry.summary: Proposes TransSplat, which formulates language-driven 3D Gaussian Splatting editing as a multi-view unbalanced semantic transport problem, establishing explicit semantic correspondence between edited 2D views and 3D Gaussians.

entry.title: GenerativeMPC: VLM-RAG-guided Whole-Body MPC with Virtual Impedance for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Marcelino Julio Fernando, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Jeffrin Sam, Yara Mahmoud, Konstantin Gubernatorov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: Presents GenerativeMPC, a hierarchical framework using VLM-RAG for semantic scene understanding that generates dynamic control constraints for a whole-body MPC controller on bimanual mobile manipulators.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning Improves LLM Accuracy and Reasoning in Disease Classification from Radiology Reports

author.name: Yishu Wei, Yi Lin, Adam Flanders, George Shih, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage approach (SFT then GRPO) for disease classification from radiology reports, showing RL improves both classification accuracy and reasoning quality over SFT alone.

entry.title: From Experience to Skill: Multi-Agent Generative Engine Optimization via Reusable Strategy Learning

author.name: Beining Wu, Fuyou Mao, Jiong Lin, Cheng Yang, Jiaxuan Lu, Yifu Guo, Siyu Zhang, Yifan Wu, Ying Huang, Fu Li

entry.summary: Proposes MAGEO, a multi-agent framework for Generative Engine Optimization that accumulates and transfers optimization strategies across tasks, reframing GEO as a strategy learning problem.

entry.title: Multi-modal Reasoning with LLMs for Visual Semantic Arithmetic

author.name: Chuou Xu, Liya Ji, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Explores visual semantic arithmetic (image-based analogical reasoning like 'king-man+woman=queen' but with images) using RL post-training for multimodal LLMs, motivated by robotics applications.

entry.title: Unlocking the Edge deployment and ondevice acceleration of multi-LoRA enabled one-for-all foundational LLM

author.name: Sravanth Kodavanti, Sowmya Vajrala, Srinivas Miriyala, Utsav Tiwari, Uttam Kumar, Utkarsh Kumar Mahawar, Achal Pratap Singh, Arya D, Narendra Mutyala, Vikram Nelvoy Rajendiran, Sharan Kumar Allur, Euntaik Lee, Dohyoung Kim, HyeonSu Lee, Gyusung Cho, JungBae Kim

entry.summary: Presents a hardware-aware framework for deploying multi-LoRA LLMs on Samsung Galaxy devices, enabling dynamic task switching without recompilation using application-specific LoRAs as runtime inputs.

entry.title: The Cost of Relaxation: Evaluating the Error in Convex Neural Network Verification

author.name: Merkouris Papamichail, Konstantinos Varsos, Giorgos Flouris, Jo\~ao Marques-Silva

entry.summary: Studies the error introduced by convex relaxations in neural network verification, providing analytical upper and lower bounds and showing the gap grows with network width.

entry.title: Handling and Interpreting Missing Modalities in Patient Clinical Trajectories via Autoregressive Sequence Modeling

author.name: Andrew Wang, Ellie Pavlick, Ritambhara Singh

entry.summary: Proposes reframing clinical diagnosis as an autoregressive sequence modeling task using LLM causal decoders to handle missing modalities in multimodal healthcare data. Introduces missingness-aware contrastive pre-training and models patient trajectories temporally. Addresses a practical clinical challenge of sparse, temporal multimodal data.

entry.title: Reducing the Offline-Streaming Gap for Unified ASR Transducer with Consistency Regularization

author.name: Andrei Andrusenko, Vladimir Bataev, Lilit Grigoryan, Nune Tadevosyan, Vitaly Lavrukhin, Boris Ginsburg

entry.summary: Presents a unified ASR framework for Transducer (RNNT) training supporting both offline and streaming decoding within a single model. Introduces mode-consistency regularization with efficient Triton implementation to reduce the performance gap between offline and streaming modes.

entry.title: SAHM: A Benchmark for Arabic Financial and Shari'ah-Compliant Reasoning

author.name: Rania Elbadry, Sarfraz Ahmad, Ahmed Heakl, Dani Bouch, Momina Ahsan, Muhra AlMahri, Marwa Elsaid khalil, Yuxia Wang, Salem Lahlou, Sophia Ananiadou, Veselin Stoyanov, Jimin Huang, Xueqing Peng, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie

entry.summary: Introduces SAHM, a benchmark for Arabic financial NLP and Shari'ah-compliant reasoning with 14,380 expert-verified instances across seven tasks. Evaluates 19 models, revealing significant performance gaps in Arabic financial reasoning.

entry.title: Multi-Gait Learning for Humanoid Robots Using Reinforcement Learning with Selective Adversarial Motion Prior

author.name: Yuanye Wu, Keyi Wang, Linqi Ye, Boyang Xing

entry.summary: Presents a multi-gait learning approach for humanoid robots mastering five gaits using selective Adversarial Motion Prior (AMP), applying AMP to periodic gaits while omitting it for dynamic gaits like jumping.

entry.title: Inductive Subgraphs as Shortcuts: Causal Disentanglement for Heterophilic Graph Learning

author.name: Xiangmeng Wang, Qian Li, Haiyang Xia, Hao Miao, Qing Li, Guandong Xu

entry.summary: Examines how inductive subgraphs act as spurious shortcuts in heterophilic graphs, misleading GNNs. Proposes a causal inference approach to identify and correct biased learning behavior from shortcut subgraphs.

entry.title: Counting Worlds Branching Time Semantics for post-hoc Bias Mitigation in generative AI

author.name: Alessandro G. Buda, Giuseppe Primiero, Leonardo Ceragioli, Melissa Antonelli

entry.summary: Introduces CTLF, a branching-time logic for formally reasoning about bias in generative AI outputs using counting-worlds semantics, providing formal guarantees for post-hoc bias mitigation during inference.

entry.title: Mesh Memory Protocol: Semantic Infrastructure for Multi-Agent LLM Systems

author.name: Hongwei Xu

entry.summary: Mesh Memory Protocol proposes infrastructure for cross-session, agent-to-agent cognitive collaboration in multi-agent LLM systems, addressing field-level selective acceptance, claim traceability, and contradiction handling.

entry.title: Chat2Workflow: A Benchmark for Generating Executable Visual Workflows with Natural Language

author.name: Yi Zhong, Buqiang Xu, Yijun Wang, Zifei Shan, Shuofei Qiao, Guozhou Zheng, Ningyu Zhang

entry.summary: Chat2Workflow introduces a benchmark for generating executable visual workflows from natural language, proposing an agentic framework to automate the currently manual process of workflow construction.

entry.title: Learning Hybrid-Control Policies for High-Precision In-Contact Manipulation Under Uncertainty

author.name: Hunter L. Brown, Geoffrey Hollinger, Stefan Lee

entry.summary: Presents hybrid position-force control policies for RL-based manipulation that dynamically select force vs. position control per dimension, with Mode-Aware exploration for improved learning efficiency.

entry.title: Subgraph Concept Networks: Concept Levels in Graph Classification

author.name: Lucie Charlotte Magister, Alexander Norcliffe, Iulia Duta, Pietro Lio

entry.summary: Introduces Subgraph Concept Networks that distill subgraph and graph-level concepts for graph classification through soft clustering on node concept embeddings, enabling multi-level explanations.

entry.title: FlowForge: A Staged Local Rollout Engine for Flow-Field Prediction

author.name: Xiaowen Zhang, Ziming Zhou, Fengnian Zhao, David L. S. Hung

entry.summary: FlowForge is a staged local rollout engine for flow-field prediction that predicts future states through locality-preserving update schedules with a shared lightweight predictor, reducing error amplification.

entry.title: FairTree: Subgroup Fairness Auditing of Machine Learning Models with Bias-Variance Decomposition

author.name: Rudolf Debelak

entry.summary: FairTree adapts psychometric invariance testing for ML fairness auditing, handling continuous features without discretization and decomposing disparities into systematic bias and variance components.

entry.title: ZC-Swish: Stabilizing Deep BN-Free Networks for Edge and Micro-Batch Applications

author.name: Suvinava Basak

entry.summary: Proposes Zero-Centered Swish (ZC-Swish), a drop-in activation function that dynamically anchors activation means near zero, enabling stable training of deep networks without Batch Normalization. This matters for micro-batch regimes like 3D medical imaging and federated learning where BN fails.

entry.title: Optimal Exploration of New Products under Assortment Decisions

author.name: Jackie Baek, Atanas Dinev, Thodoris Lykouris

entry.summary: Studies optimal assortment decisions for exploring new products on platforms, characterizing when and how to feature new products to learn their quality through social learning while minimizing regret.

entry.title: From Particles to Perils: SVGD-Based Hazardous Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving Systems Testing

author.name: Linfeng Liang, Xiao Cheng, Tsong Yueh Chen, Xi Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes PtoP, combining adaptive random seed generation with SVGD for diverse hazardous scenario generation in autonomous driving testing. SVGD balances attraction to high-risk regions with repulsion among particles for mode coverage.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Obfuscated XSS Payloads for Machine Learning-Based Detection

author.name: Divyesh Gabbireddy, Suman Saha

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for generating and evaluating obfuscated XSS payloads using LLMs, combining deterministic transformations with LLM-based generation and browser-based validation for behavioral correctness.

entry.title: Scripts Through Time: A Survey of the Evolving Role of Transliteration in NLP

author.name: Thanmay Jayakumar, Deepon Halder, Raj Dabre

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of transliteration's role in cross-lingual NLP, providing a taxonomy of motivations and approaches for using transliteration in language models to bridge the script barrier.

entry.title: AlignCultura: Towards Culturally Aligned Large Language Models?

author.name: Gautam Siddharth Kashyap, Mark Dras, Usman Naseem

entry.summary: Proposes AlignCultura, a pipeline for cultural alignment of LLMs grounded in UNESCO's cultural diversity principles and the HHH paradigm, introducing CULTURAX dataset.

entry.title: Does Self-Consistency Improve the Recall of Encyclopedic Knowledge?

author.name: Sho Hoshino, Ukyo Honda, Peinan Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates whether self-consistency (majority voting over chain-of-thought samples) improves encyclopedic knowledge recall, not just symbolic reasoning. Creates a knowledge-recall split of MMLU and finds self-consistency consistently helps for both reasoning and factual recall tasks.

entry.title: Explore Like Humans: Autonomous Exploration with Online SG-Memo Construction for Embodied Agents

author.name: Xu Chen, Shichao Xie, Zhining Gu, Lu Jia, Minghua Luo, Fei Liu, Zedong Chu, Yanfen Shen, Xiaolong Wu, Mu Xu

entry.summary: Proposes ABot-Explorer, an active exploration framework for embodied agents that unifies online scene graph memory construction with exploration, using semantic landmarks like doorways as cognitive anchors.

entry.title: DR-MMSearchAgent: Deepening Reasoning in Multimodal Search Agents

author.name: Shengqin Wang, Wentao Yan, Huichi Zhou, Yihang Chen, Kun Shao, Zhizhong Zhang, Yuan Xie

entry.summary: Proposes DR-MMSearchAgent for multimodal search agents, addressing premature interaction collapse through structural proximity advantage signals and context management for deep reasoning.

entry.title: PanDA: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Multimodal 3D Panoptic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yining Pan, Shijie Li, Yuchen Wu, Xulei Yang, Na Zhao

entry.summary: Presents PanDA, the first study on unsupervised domain adaptation for multimodal 3D panoptic segmentation in autonomous driving, combining LiDAR and RGB inputs. Addresses degradation under domain shifts like poor lighting and adverse weather.

entry.title: Paparazzo: Active Mapping of Moving 3D Objects

author.name: Davide Allegro, Shiyao Li, Stefano Ghidoni, Vincent Lepetit

entry.summary: Introduces Paparazzo, a learning-free approach for active mapping of moving 3D objects where a mapping agent plans its trajectory while compensating for object motion. Includes a new benchmark for this novel task.

entry.title: CoInteract: Physically-Consistent Human-Object Interaction Video Synthesis via Spatially-Structured Co-Generation

author.name: Xiangyang Luo, Xiaozhe Xin, Tao Feng, Xu Guo, Meiguang Jin, Junfeng Ma

entry.summary: Presents CoInteract for human-object interaction video synthesis, using a Human-Aware MoE in a DiT backbone to handle structural stability of hands/faces and physically plausible contact. Conditioned on reference images, text, and audio.

entry.title: SketchFaceGS: Real-Time Sketch-Driven Face Editing and Generation with Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Bo Li, Jiahao Kang, Yubo Ma, Feng-Lin Liu, Bin Liu, Fang-Lue Zhang, Lin Gao

entry.summary: Proposes SketchFaceGS, the first sketch-driven framework for real-time generation and editing of photorealistic 3D Gaussian head models from 2D sketches, overcoming sketch sparsity and depth ambiguity challenges.

entry.title: Multimodal embodiment-aware navigation transformer

author.name: Louis Dezons, Quentin Picard, R\'emi Marsal, Fran\c{c}ois Goulette, David Filliat

entry.summary: Proposes ViLiNT, a multimodal attention-based navigation policy fusing RGB, LiDAR, goal embeddings, and robot embodiment descriptors with a transformer architecture and diffusion-based trajectory generation, trained on heterogeneous multi-platform data.

entry.title: LiveVLN: Breaking the Stop-and-Go Loop in Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Xiangchen Wang, Weiye Zhu, Teng Wang, TianTian Geng, Zekai Zhang, Zhiyuan Qi, Jinyu Yang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes LiveVLN, a training-free framework that makes VLM-based navigation more continuous by overlapping execution with observation processing, eliminating the stop-and-go pattern common in vision-language navigation.

entry.title: Four-Axis Decision Alignment for Long-Horizon Enterprise AI Agents

author.name: Vasundra Srininvasan

entry.summary: Proposes four orthogonal alignment axes for evaluating long-horizon enterprise AI agents: factual precision, reasoning coherence, compliance reconstruction, and calibrated abstention.

entry.title: CoDA: Towards Effective Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via CoT-guided Domain Adaptation

author.name: Jianzhi Yan, Le Liu, Buzhou Tang, Yang Xiang, Dongning Sun, Zhiming Li

entry.summary: Proposes CoDA, a framework for cross-domain knowledge transfer via CoT-guided domain adaptation, addressing the problem of limited in-domain demonstrations for in-context learning in expertise-scarce domains.

entry.title: Time Series Augmented Generation for Financial Applications

author.name: Anton Kolonin, Alexey Glushchenko, Evgeny Bochkov, Abhishek Saxena

entry.summary: Introduces TSAG (Time Series Augmented Generation) evaluation methodology for testing LLM agents on quantitative financial time-series analysis, benchmarking SOTA agents like GPT-4o, Llama 3, and Qwen.

entry.title: AutoAWG: Adverse Weather Generation with Adaptive Multi-Controls for Automotive Videos

author.name: Jiagao Hu, Daiguo Zhou, Danzhen Fu, Fuhao Li, Zepeng Wang, Fei Wang, Wenhua Liao, Jiayi Xie, Haiyang Sun

entry.summary: Presents AutoAWG, a controllable adverse weather video generation framework for autonomous driving that uses semantics-guided adaptive fusion and vanishing point-anchored temporal synthesis to generate training data while preserving safety-critical annotations.

entry.title: SAMoRA: Semantic-Aware Mixture of LoRA Experts for Task-Adaptive Learning

author.name: Boyan Shi, Wei Chen, Shuyuan Zhao, Junfeng Shen, Shengnan Guo, Shaojiang Wang, Huaiyu Wan

entry.summary: Proposes SAMoRA, combining Mixture-of-Experts with LoRA using semantic-aware routing that explicitly matches input semantics with expert capabilities, plus adaptive weight fusion for varying task complexity.

entry.title: Think Before Writing: Feature-Level Multi-Objective Optimization for Generative Citation Visibility

author.name: Zikang Liu, Peilan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FeatGEO, a feature-level multi-objective optimization framework for generative citation visibility that optimizes interpretable structural, content, and linguistic properties rather than directly editing text.

entry.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: A Component-Wise Evaluation Framework for Medical Question Answering Systems with Health Equity Implications

author.name: Abu Noman Md Sakib, Md. Main Oddin Chisty, Zijie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VB-Score, a component-wise evaluation framework for medical QA that separately evaluates entity recognition, semantic similarity, factual consistency, and structured information completeness, with health equity implications.

entry.title: Multimodal Transformer for Sample-Aware Prediction of Metal-Organic Framework Properties

author.name: Seunghee Han, Jaewoong Lee, Jihan Kim

entry.summary: EXIT is a multimodal transformer that combines MOF identity encodings with X-ray diffraction data for sample-aware property prediction of metal-organic frameworks, addressing the problem that different samples of the same MOF can have different properties.

entry.title: Towards Streaming Target Speaker Extraction via Chunk-wise Interleaved Splicing of Autoregressive Language Model

author.name: Shuhai Peng, Hui Lu, Jinjiang Liu, Liyang Chen, Guiping Zhong, Jiakui Li, Huimeng Wang, Haiyun Li, Liang Cao, Shiyin Kang, Zhiyong Wu

entry.summary: Presents the first autoregressive models for streaming target speaker extraction, introducing a chunk-wise interleaved splicing paradigm for real-time deployment with historical context refinement.

entry.title: Collaborative Contextual Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Chih-Yu Chang, Qiyuan Chen, Tianhan Gao, David Fenning, Chinedum Okwudire, Neil Dasgupta, Wei Lu, Raed Al Kontar

entry.summary: Proposes Collaborative Contextual Bayesian Optimization (CCBO) for multiple heterogeneous clients to collaboratively learn context-to-optimal-design mappings, with theoretical convergence guarantees.

entry.title: On two ways to use determinantal point processes for Monte Carlo integration

author.name: Guillaume Gautier, R\'emi Bardenet, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Compares two DPP-based Monte Carlo integration estimators, generalizes them to continuous settings, and provides sampling algorithms. Shows how determinantal point processes can improve over standard Monte Carlo integration.

entry.title: Scalable Memristive-Friendly Reservoir Computing for Time Series Classification

author.name: Co\c{s}ku Can Horuz, Andrea Ceni, Claudio Gallicchio, Sebastian Otte

entry.summary: Proposes MARS, a parallelized reservoir computing architecture inspired by memristive devices, enabling scalable computation for time series classification while maintaining training simplicity.

entry.title: Evaluating LLM-Driven Summarisation of Parliamentary Debates with Computational Argumentation

author.name: Eoghan Cunningham, Derek Greene, James Cross, Antonio Rago

entry.summary: Proposes a formal framework for evaluating parliamentary debate summaries using computational argumentation, addressing poor correlation of existing metrics with human consistency judgments.

entry.title: Exploring Language-Agnosticity in Function Vectors: A Case Study in Machine Translation

author.name: Nurkhan Laiyk, Gerard I. G\'allego, Javier Ferrando, Fajri Koto

entry.summary: Studies whether function vectors (task representations extracted from model activations) are language-agnostic in multilingual LLMs, using machine translation as a case study. Finds translation function vectors transfer across unseen languages.

entry.title: Multi-Domain Learning with Global Expert Mapping

author.name: Pourya Shamsolmoali, Masoumeh Zareapoor, Huiyu Zhou, Oscar Mendez, Dacheng Tao, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-domain MoE framework with global expert mapping that enables domain-aware routing rather than uniform load balancing, reducing redundant representations across datasets.

entry.title: EgoMotion: Hierarchical Reasoning and Diffusion for Egocentric Vision-Language Motion Generation

author.name: Ruibing Hou, Mingyue Zhou, Yuwei Gui, Mingshuang Luo, Bingpeng Ma, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EgoMotion, a hierarchical reasoning and diffusion framework for generating 3D human motion from first-person visual observations and language instructions, addressing reasoning-generation entanglement.

entry.title: When Can We Trust Deep Neural Networks? Towards Reliable Industrial Deployment with an Interpretability Guide

author.name: Hang-Cheng Dong, Yuhao Jiang, Yibo Jiao, Lu Zou, Kai Zheng, Bingguo Liu, Dong Ye, Guodong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a post-hoc explanation-based indicator to detect false negatives in binary defect detection networks by leveraging differences between class-specific activation patterns. Claims to be first method for proactive error detection.

entry.title: Unposed-to-3D: Learning Simulation-Ready Vehicles from Real-World Images

author.name: Hongyuan Liu, Bochao Zou, Qiankun Liu, Haochen Yu, Qi Mei, Jianfei Jiang, Chen Liu, Cheng Bi, Zhao Wang, Xueyang Zhang, Yifei Zhan, Jiansheng Chen, Huimin Ma

entry.summary: Presents Unposed-to-3D, a framework for reconstructing simulation-ready 3D vehicles from real-world driving images using image-only supervision in a two-stage approach (posed images then unposed).

entry.title: VecHeart: Holistic Four-Chamber Cardiac Anatomy Modeling via Hybrid VecSets

author.name: Yihong Chen, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Proposes VecHeart, a unified framework for holistic reconstruction and generation of four-chamber cardiac structures using a Hybrid Part Transformer with part-specific queries and interleaved attention to capture inter-chamber dependencies.

entry.title: IR-Flow: Bridging Discriminative and Generative Image Restoration via Rectified Flow

author.name: Zihao Fan, Xin Lu, Jie Xiao, Dong Li, Jie Huang, Xueyang Fu

entry.summary: Proposes IR-Flow, a unified image restoration framework based on Rectified Flow that bridges discriminative and generative paradigms through multilevel data distribution flows and cumulative velocity fields.

entry.title: ReImagine: Rethinking Controllable High-Quality Human Video Generation via Image-First Synthesis

author.name: Zhengwentai Sun, Keru Zheng, Chenghong Li, Hongjie Liao, Xihe Yang, Heyuan Li, Yihao Zhi, Shuliang Ning, Shuguang Cui, Xiaoguang Han

entry.summary: Proposes ReImagine, a human video generation pipeline that decouples appearance from temporal consistency by learning appearance via image generation first, then combining with SMPL-X motion guidance and a video diffusion model for refinement.

entry.title: A Controlled Benchmark of Visual State-Space Backbones with Domain-Shift and Boundary Analysis for Remote-Sensing Segmentation

author.name: Nichula Wasalathilaka, Dineth Perera, Oshadha Samarakoon, Buddhi Wijenayake, Roshan Godaliyadda, Vijitha Herath, Parakrama Ekanayake

entry.summary: Presents a controlled benchmark comparing visual state-space model families (VMamba, MambaVision, Spatial-Mamba) for remote sensing segmentation, isolating encoder effects from decoder/training choices. Finds modest intra-family scaling gains.

entry.title: Assessing VLM-Driven Semantic-Affordance Inference for Non-Humanoid Robot Morphologies

author.name: Jess Jones, Raul Santos-Rodriguez, Sabine Hauert

entry.summary: Investigates whether VLMs can infer affordances for non-humanoid robots, introducing a hybrid dataset of real and synthetic affordance-object relations. Reveals significant performance variations across robot morphologies.

entry.title: Preventing extinction from ASI on a $50M yearly budget

author.name: Andrea_Miotti

entry.summary: ControlAI lays out its strategy and budget estimate ($50M/year) for achieving an international prohibition on ASI development, arguing this is the most promising path to averting extinction risk. The post details how funds would be allocated across government outreach, public awareness, and enforcement mechanisms.

entry.title: CentaurTA Studio: A Self-Improving Human-Agent Collaboration System for Thematic Analysis

author.name: Lei Wang, Min Huang, Eduard Dragut

entry.summary: Presents CentaurTA Studio, a web-based system for human-agent collaboration in thematic analysis with persistent prompt optimization and rubric-based evaluation, achieving up to 92.12% accuracy.

entry.title: Neuromorphic Continual Learning for Sequential Deployment of Nuclear Plant Monitoring Systems

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Sajedul Talukder, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Presents the first SNN-based anomaly detection system with continual learning for nuclear industrial control systems, using spike-encoded asynchronous sensor fusion.

entry.title: FASE : A Fairness-Aware Spatiotemporal Event Graph Framework for Predictive Policing

author.name: Pronob Kumar Barman, Pronoy Kumar Barman, Plaban Kumar Barman, Rohan Mandar Salvi

entry.summary: Presents FASE, a fairness-aware spatiotemporal framework for predictive policing that integrates crime prediction with fairness-constrained patrol allocation, tested on Baltimore crime data.

entry.title: MORPHOGEN: A Multilingual Benchmark for Evaluating Gender-Aware Morphological Generation

author.name: Mehul Agarwal, Aditya Aggarwal, Arnav Goel, Medha Hira, Anubha Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces MORPHOGEN, a benchmark for evaluating gender-aware morphological generation in French, Arabic, and Hindi. The GENFORM task requires rewriting first-person sentences in the opposite gender while preserving meaning in morphologically rich languages.

entry.title: Sherpa.ai Privacy-Preserving Multi-Party Entity Alignment without Intersection Disclosure for Noisy Identifiers

author.name: Daniel M. Jimenez-Gutierrez, Enrique Zuazua, Georgios Kellaris, Joaquin Del Rio, Oleksii Sliusarenko, Xabi Uribe-Etxebarria

entry.summary: Proposes privacy-preserving multi-party entity alignment for Vertical Federated Learning that handles noisy identifiers without revealing intersection membership, addressing limitations of standard private set intersection.

entry.title: PLaMo 2.1-VL Technical Report

author.name: Tommi Kerola, Yuya Masuda, Takashi Masuko, Toshiki Nakanishi, Daisuke Nishino, Kuniyuki Takahashi, Hanqin Wang, Yoshihiro Yamada

entry.summary: Introduces PLaMo 2.1-VL, a lightweight VLM (2B/8B) for Japanese-language edge deployment, focusing on VQA and visual grounding for factory task analysis and infrastructure anomaly detection. Includes synthetic data generation pipeline.

entry.title: LePREC: Reasoning as Classification over Structured Factors for Assessing Relevance of Legal Issues

author.name: Fanyu Wang, Xiaoxi Kang, Paul Burgess, Aashish Srivastava, Chetan Arora, Adnan Trakic, Lay-Ki Soon, Md Khalid Hossain, Lizhen Qu

entry.summary: LePREC addresses legal issue identification using structured factor reasoning, showing GPT-4o achieves only 62% precision on this task. Proposes a classification approach over structured legal factors using a dataset of 769 Malaysian court cases.

entry.title: EgoSelf: From Memory to Personalized Egocentric Assistant

author.name: Yanshuo Wang, Yuan Xu, Xuesong Li, Jie Hong, Yizhou Wang, Chang Wen Chen, Wentao Zhu

entry.summary: EgoSelf introduces a personalized egocentric assistant using graph-based interaction memory from past observations, deriving user-specific profiles for personalized services from first-person video data.

entry.title: CoCo-SAM3: Harnessing Concept Conflict in Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Yanhui Chen, Baoyao Yang, Siqi Liu, Jingchao Wang

entry.summary: CoCo-SAM3 addresses concept conflicts in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by decoupling inference into intra-class enhancement and inter-class competition to handle overlapping masks and semantic drift.

entry.title: Environmental Sound Deepfake Detection Using Deep-Learning Framework

author.name: Lam Pham, Khoi Vu, Dat Tran, Phat Lam, Vu Nguyen, David Fischinger, Alexander Schindler, Martin Boyer, Son Le

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework for environmental sound deepfake detection, exploring how different spectrograms, architectures, and pre-trained models affect detection of fake sound scenes and events.

entry.title: Multi-Cycle Spatio-Temporal Adaptation in Human-Robot Teaming

author.name: Alex Cuellar, Michael Hagenow, Julie Shah

entry.summary: Proposes an integrated approach for human-robot teaming that jointly optimizes task-level allocation and motion-level spatial adaptation across repeated manufacturing cycles.

entry.title: TabEmb: Joint Semantic-Structure Embedding for Table Annotation

author.name: Ehsan Hoseinzade, Ke Wang, Anandharaju Durai Raju

entry.summary: TabEmb proposes joint semantic-structure embeddings for table annotation that directly model column semantics and inter-column relationships rather than linearizing tables for PLM encoding.

entry.title: FOCAL-Attention for Heterogeneous Multi-Label Prediction

author.name: Chenghao Zhang, Qingqing Long, Ludi Wang, Wenjuan Cui, Jianjun Yu, Yi Du

entry.summary: FOCAL-Attention addresses semantic dilution in heterogeneous graph multi-label classification through theoretical analysis showing attention mass on task-critical neighborhoods diminishes as neighborhoods expand.

entry.title: FedSEA: Achieving Benefit of Parallelization in Federated Online Learning

author.name: Harekrushna Sahu, Pratik Jawanpuria, Pranay Sharma

entry.summary: FedSEA extends online federated learning with a stochastically extended adversary model that captures different sources of statistical variation and enables benefits of parallelization.

entry.title: Disentangling Damage from Operational Variability: A Label-Free Self-Supervised Representation Learning Framework for Output-Only Structural Damage Identification

author.name: Xudong Jian, Charikleia Stoura, Simon Scandella, Eleni Chatzi

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised framework using VICReg regularization to disentangle structural damage signals from operational variability in vibration-based structural health monitoring, without requiring labeled data.

entry.title: Ground-Level Near Real-Time Modeling for PM2.5 Pollution Prediction

author.name: Zachary R. Fox, Janet O. Agbaje, Dakotah Maguire, Javier E. Santos, Jeremy Logan, Maggie Davis, Rima Habre, Jim VanDerslice, Heidi A. Hanson

entry.summary: Develops near real-time PM2.5 pollution prediction models as digital twins for environmental monitoring, addressing limitations of existing models that rely on infrequently updated data sources.

entry.title: Analytical Extraction of Conditional Sobol' Indices via Basis Decomposition of Polynomial Chaos Expansions

author.name: Shijie Zhong, Jiangfeng Fu

entry.summary: Shows that conditional Sobol' indices for sensitivity analysis can be analytically extracted from pre-trained Polynomial Chaos Expansion models by leveraging tensor-product properties, avoiding expensive point-wise remodeling.

entry.title: CAST: Modeling Semantic-Level Transitions for Complementary-Aware Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Qian Zhang, Lech Szymanski, Haibo Zhang, Jeremiah D. Deng

entry.summary: Proposes CAST for sequential recommendation that models semantic-level transitions to capture true complementary relations, avoiding spurious correlations from co-purchase statistics.

entry.title: Syntax as a Rosetta Stone: Universal Dependencies for In-Context Coptic Translation

author.name: Abhishek Purushothama, Emma Thronson, Alexia Guo, Amir Zeldes

entry.summary: Proposes using Universal Dependencies syntactic parses to augment in-context learning for low-resource Coptic-to-English machine translation, showing that structural information can improve translation quality.

entry.title: Diagnosable ColBERT: Debugging Late-Interaction Retrieval Models Using a Learned Latent Space as Reference

author.name: Fran\c{c}ois Remy

entry.summary: Proposes a diagnostic approach for ColBERT retrieval models using learned latent spaces to identify systematic failures in biomedical/clinical concept understanding, going beyond pairwise score interpretability.

entry.title: Generative Texture Filtering

author.name: Rongjia Zheng, Shangwei Huang, Lei Zhu, Wei-Shi Zheng, Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Presents a generative approach to texture filtering that fine-tunes pre-trained generative models via supervised then reinforcement fine-tuning, using a reward function for texture removal quality.

entry.title: PortraitDirector: A Hierarchical Disentanglement Framework for Controllable and Real-time Facial Reenactment

author.name: Chaonan Ji, Jinwei Qi, Sheng Xu, Peng Zhang, Bang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PortraitDirector, a facial reenactment framework using hierarchical motion disentanglement that decomposes facial motion into spatial (physical movements) and semantic (expressions) layers for controllable, real-time results.

entry.title: Diff-SBSR: Learning Multimodal Feature-Enhanced Diffusion Models for Zero-Shot Sketch-Based 3D Shape Retrieval

author.name: Hang Cheng, Fanhe Dong, Long Zeng

entry.summary: First exploration of text-to-image diffusion models for zero-shot sketch-based 3D shape retrieval, using frozen Stable Diffusion features. Addresses sketch sparsity by extracting discriminative representations from U-Net layers.

entry.title: Allo{SR}$^2$: Rectifying One-Step Super-Resolution to Stay Real via Allomorphic Generative Flows

author.name: Zihan Wang, Xudong Huang, Junbo Qiao, Wei Li, Jie Hu, Xinghao Chen, Shaohui Lin

entry.summary: Proposes AlloSR², a framework for one-step image super-resolution using allomorphic generative flows with SNR-guided trajectory rectification to prevent prior collapse from limited training data.

entry.title: Attend what matters: Leveraging vision foundational models for breast cancer classification using mammograms

author.name: Samyak Sanghvi, Piyush Miglani, Sarvesh Shashikumar, Kaustubh R Borgavi, Veenu Singla, Chetan Arora

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for breast cancer detection from mammograms addressing ViT limitations via region-of-interest attention focusing, leveraging vision foundation models with fine-grained classification techniques.

entry.title: RF-HiT: Rectified Flow Hierarchical Transformer for General Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Ahmed Marouane Djouama, Abir Belaala, Abdellah Zakaria Sellam, Salah Eddine Bekhouche, Cosimo Distante, Abdenour Hadid

entry.summary: Proposes RF-HiT, a Rectified Flow Hierarchical Transformer for medical image segmentation that achieves linear complexity with few discretization steps, combining an hourglass transformer with multi-scale hierarchical encoding.

entry.title: CreatiParser: Generative Image Parsing of Raster Graphic Designs into Editable Layers

author.name: Weidong Chen, Dexiang Hong, Zhendong Mao, Yutao Cheng, Xinyan Liu, Lei Zhang, Yongdong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CreatiParser, a hybrid generative framework for decomposing raster graphic design images into editable text, background, and sticker layers. Uses a vision-language model for text parsing and diffusion models for visual layers.

entry.title: MedFlowSeg: Flow Matching for Medical Image Segmentation with Frequency-Aware Attention

author.name: Zhi Chen, Runze Hu, Le Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MedFlowSeg, using conditional flow matching instead of diffusion for medical image segmentation, achieving efficient deterministic generation with a frequency-aware attention mechanism for boundary precision.

entry.title: Generative Drifting for Conditional Medical Image Generation

author.name: Zirong Li, Siyuan Mei, Weiwen Wu, Andreas Maier, Lina G\"olz, Yan Xia

entry.summary: Proposes GDM, a generative drifting framework for conditional medical image generation that reformulates deterministic prediction as multi-objective learning, achieving one-step inference while balancing distribution plausibility and patient fidelity.

entry.title: Tstars-Tryon 1.0: Robust and Realistic Virtual Try-On for Diverse Fashion Items

author.name: Mengting Chen, Zhengrui Chen, Yongchao Du, Zuan Gao, Taihang Hu, Jinsong Lan, Chao Lin, Yefeng Shen, Xingjian Wang, Zhao Wang, Zhengtao Wu, Xiaoli Xu, Zhengze Xu, Hao Yan, Mingzhou Zhang, Jun Zheng, Qinye Zhou, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Presents Tstars-Tryon 1.0, a commercial-scale virtual try-on system that handles extreme poses, varying illumination, motion blur, and supports diverse fashion items including accessories and footwear with photorealistic quality.

entry.title: AeroBridge-TTA: Test-Time Adaptive Language-Conditioned Control for UAVs

author.name: Lingxue Lyu

entry.summary: Proposes AeroBridge-TTA, a language-conditioned UAV control pipeline with test-time adaptation that updates a learned latent online from observed transitions to handle execution mismatch from dynamics changes.

entry.title: Formally Verified Patent Analysis via Dependent Type Theory: Machine-Checkable Certificates from a Hybrid AI + Lean 4 Pipeline

author.name: George Koomullil

entry.summary: Applies formal verification via Lean 4 theorem proving to patent analysis, encoding claims as DAGs and verifying freedom-to-operate and claim construction with machine-checkable certificates.

entry.title: On Accelerating Grounded Code Development for Research

author.name: Santosh Ganji

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to help domain experts use coding agents by grounding them in domain-specific knowledge, addressing the gap where foundation models lack specialized scientific/technical knowledge.

entry.title: Industrial Surface Defect Detection via Diffusion Generation and Asymmetric Student-Teacher Network

author.name: Shuo Feng, Runlin Zhou, Yuyang Li, Guangcan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised defect detection method combining diffusion models (DDPM) for generating synthetic defect samples with an asymmetric teacher-student architecture for detection.

entry.title: Thermal Anomaly Detection using Physics Aware Neuromorphic Networks: Comparison between Raw and L1C Sentinel-2 Data

author.name: Stephen Smith, Cormac Purcell, Gabriele Meoni, Roberto Del Prete, Zdenka Kuncic

entry.summary: Proposes Physics-Aware Neuromorphic Network (PANN) for onboard thermal anomaly detection from satellite data, addressing bushfire and volcanic eruption early warning.

entry.title: Agent-GWO: Collaborative Agents for Dynamic Prompt Optimization in Large Language Models

author.name: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Chenghao Li, Shuxu Chen, Qigan Sun, Jiaquan Zhang, Fachrina Dewi Puspitasari, Tae-Ho Kim, Jiwei Wei, Malu Zhang, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Agent-GWO, a multi-agent framework using Grey Wolf Optimization for dynamic prompt and hyperparameter optimization of LLMs, addressing limitations of single-agent local search.

entry.title: DanceCrafter: Fine-Grained Text-Driven Controllable Dance Generation via Choreographic Syntax

author.name: Hang Yuan, Xiaolin Hu, Yan Wan, Menglin Gao, Wenzhe Yu, Cong Huang, Fei Xu, Qing Li, Christina Dan Wang, Zhou Yu, Kai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Choreographic Syntax, a theoretical framework bridging dance studies and biomechanics for fine-grained text-driven dance generation, with DanceFlow dataset.

entry.title: REVEAL: Multimodal Vision-Language Alignment of Retinal Morphometry and Clinical Risks for Incident AD and Dementia Prediction

author.name: Seowung Leem, Lin Gu, Chenyu You, Kuang Gong, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Introduces REVEAL, a multimodal vision-language framework that aligns retinal morphometric features with clinical risk factors for early Alzheimer's and dementia prediction. Uses cross-modal alignment to capture joint patterns between retinal imaging and systemic risk factors.

entry.title: A Proxy Consistency Loss for Grounded Fusion of Earth Observation and Location Encoders

author.name: Zhongying Wang, Kevin Lane, Levi Cai, Morteza Karimzadeh, Esther Rolf

entry.summary: Introduces a proxy consistency loss for fusing Earth observation satellite imagery with location encoders, leveraging proxy variables correlated with target variables to overcome label scarcity in geographic applications.

entry.title: DP-FlogTinyLLM: Differentially private federated log anomaly detection using Tiny LLMs

author.name: Isaiah Thompson, Tanmay Sen, Ritwik Bhattacharya
