entry.summary: LASER discovers that recursive architectures occupy low-dimensional linear subspaces during iterative computation, then exploits this via dynamic low-rank projections for efficient recursion, achieving 4x compute savings.

entry.title: On the Generalization Bounds of Symbolic Regression with Genetic Programming

author.name: Masahiro Nomura, Ryoki Hamano, Isao Ono

entry.summary: Provides the first learning-theoretic generalization bounds for symbolic regression with genetic programming, decomposing the generalization gap into structure-selection and constant-fitting components.

entry.title: SLO-Guard: Crash-Aware, Budget-Consistent Autotuning for SLO-Constrained LLM Serving

author.name: Christian Lysenst{\o}en

entry.summary: SLO-Guard is a crash-aware autotuner for vLLM serving that treats configuration crashes as first-class observations, combining thermal budget annealing exploration with warm-started TPE exploitation.

entry.title: CAPO: Counterfactual Credit Assignment in Sequential Cooperative Teams

author.name: Shripad Deshmukh, Jayakumar Subramanian, Raghavendra Addanki, Nikos Vlassis

entry.summary: CAPO derives the Sequential Aristocrat Utility for credit assignment in sequential cooperative teams and provides a critic-free policy gradient algorithm with closed-form per-agent advantages.

entry.title: Can Explicit Physical Feasibility Benefit VLA Learning? An Empirical Study

author.name: Yubai Wei, Chen Wu, Hashem Haghbayan

entry.summary: Studies whether adding explicit physical feasibility supervision (obstacle avoidance, kinematic constraints) improves vision-language-action models for robotics, finding that geometry-grounded objectives provide structured guidance.

entry.title: Universally Empowering Zeroth-Order Optimization via Adaptive Layer-wise Sampling

author.name: Fei Wang, Li Shen, Liang Ding, Chao Xue, Ye Liu, Changxing Ding

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive layer-wise sampling for zeroth-order optimization of LLMs, identifying that perturbation generation accounts for 40%+ of training latency and that uniform exploration across layers is suboptimal due to heterogeneous sensitivity.

entry.title: Sessa: Selective State Space Attention

author.name: Liubomyr Horbatko

entry.summary: Proposes Sessa (Selective State Space Attention), a hybrid architecture combining strengths of Transformers (input-dependent mixing) and SSMs (explicit feedback path) to address the limitation that attention dilutes with context length while SSM sensitivity decays exponentially.

entry.title: GRAIL: Autonomous Concept Grounding for Neuro-Symbolic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hikaru Shindo, Henri R\"o{\ss}ler, Quentin Delfosse, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Proposes GRAIL, a framework for autonomous grounding of relational concepts in neuro-symbolic RL. Uses LLMs for weak supervision of concept representations, then refines them through environmental interaction, eliminating need for manual concept definition.

entry.title: SPS: Steering Probability Squeezing for Better Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for Large Language Models

author.name: Yifu Huo, Chenglong Wang, Ziming Zhu, Shunjie Xing, Peinan Feng, Tongran Liu, Qiaozhi He, Tianhua Zhou, Xiaojia Chang, Jingbo Zhu, Zhengtao Yu, Tong Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Steering Probability Squeezing (SPS) to address the 'squeezing effect' in RL training where probability mass concentrates on narrow high-reward trajectories, limiting exploration diversity. Improves multi-sample performance (Pass@k) while maintaining Pass@1.

entry.title: Stability-Weighted Decoding for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Yue Wu, Jian Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Stability-Weighted Decoding (SWD) for diffusion language models, using temporal instability (KL divergence between consecutive predictions) to determine which tokens are safe to unmask. Proves unstable tokens have high mutual information with remaining context.

entry.title: Negative Momentum for Convex-Concave Optimization

author.name: Henry Shugart, Shuyi Wang, Jason M. Altschuler

entry.summary: Shows that negative momentum enables global convergence and acceleration for convex-concave min-max optimization. Resolves open questions about whether momentum can help in this foundational setting analogous to convex minimization.

entry.title: Matlas: A Semantic Search Engine for Mathematics

author.name: Haocheng Ju, Leheng Chen, Peihao Wu, Bryan Dai, Bin Dong

entry.summary: Introduces Matlas, a semantic search engine for mathematical statements built on 8.07 million statements from 435K peer-reviewed papers. Enables retrieval of mathematical knowledge for both human research and AI systems.

entry.title: Forget What Matters, Keep the Rest: Selective Unlearning of Informative Tokens

author.name: Seunghee Koh, Sunghyun Baek, Youngdong Kim, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes selective unlearning in LLMs based on token-level semantic importance, using entropy to identify informative tokens that should receive stronger forgetting loss, while preserving model utility on less informative tokens.

entry.title: Tight Auditing of Differential Privacy in MST and AIM

author.name: Georgi Ganev, Meenatchi Sundaram Muthu Selva Annamalai, Bogdan Kulynych

entry.summary: Introduces a Gaussian Differential Privacy-based auditing framework for tightly auditing MST and AIM synthetic data generators. Achieves near-tight audits: empirical μ≈0.43 vs theoretical μ=0.45 at ε=1, δ=0.01.

entry.title: Random Matrix Theory of Early-Stopped Gradient Flow: A Transient BBP Scenario

author.name: Florentin Coeurdoux, Gr\'egoire Ferr\'e, Jean-Philippe Bouchaud

entry.summary: Provides an analytically tractable random matrix model that reproduces the transient learning regime in gradient flow (signal detectable before overfitting dominates). Derives full time-dependent bulk spectrum via Dyson equation for anisotropic covariance.

entry.title: IYKYK (But AI Doesn't): Automated Content Moderation Does Not Capture Communities' Heterogeneous Attitudes Towards Reclaimed Language

author.name: Christina Chance, Rebecca Pattichis, Arjun Subramonian, James He, Shruti Narayanan, Saadia Gabriel, Kai-Wei Chang

entry.summary: Studies how automated content moderation fails to distinguish between reclaimed and hateful uses of slurs in LGBTQIA+, Black, and women communities. Collects annotated corpus showing diverse attitudes toward reclaimed language within communities.

entry.title: No-Worse Context-Aware Decoding: Preventing Neutral Regression in Context-Conditioned Generation

author.name: Yufei Tao, Ameeta Agrawal

entry.summary: NWCAD addresses neutral regression in context-conditioned LLM generation, where models overwrite correct answers when given non-informative context. Proposes a decode-time adapter with a two-stage gate that backs off to no-context decoding when context is non-informative.

entry.title: Please refuse to answer me! Mitigating Over-Refusal in Large Language Models via Adaptive Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Yupeng Qi, Ziyu Lyu, Lixin Cui, Lu Bai, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Contrastive Decoding to mitigate LLM over-refusal by observing that non-refusal tokens remain in the candidate list but are systematically not selected. Training-free and model-agnostic approach.

entry.title: SciImpact: A Multi-Dimensional, Multi-Field Benchmark for Scientific Impact Prediction

author.name: Hangxiao Zhu, Yuyu Zhang, Ping Nie, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: SciImpact is a large-scale benchmark for predicting scientific impact beyond citations, covering award recognition, media attention, patent references, and artifact adoption across 19 fields with 215K contrastive paper pairs.

entry.title: Seeing Isn't Believing: Mitigating Belief Inertia via Active Intervention in Embodied Agents

author.name: Hanlin Wang, Chak Tou Leong, Jian Wang, Wenjie Li

entry.summary: Identifies 'belief inertia' in embodied LLM agents where they stubbornly adhere to prior beliefs despite contradicting observations. Proposes the Estimate-Verify-Update (EVU) mechanism for active belief intervention.

entry.title: Who Watches the Watchmen? Humans Disagree With Translation Metrics on Unseen Domains

author.name: Finn Schmidt, Jan Philip Wahle, Terry Ruas, Bela Gipp

entry.summary: Introduces CD-ESA, a systematic cross-domain error-span-annotation dataset for evaluating MT metrics under domain shift. Fixes annotators within language pairs to isolate domain effects from annotation noise, finding that metrics trained on WMT data degrade on unseen domains.

entry.title: CoAct: Co-Active LLM Preference Learning with Human-AI Synergy

author.name: Ruiyao Xu, Mihir Parmar, Tiankai Yang, Zhengyu Hu, Yue Zhao, Kaize Ding

entry.summary: Proposes CoAct, a framework combining self-rewarding and active learning for LLM preference data collection. Uses self-consistency to identify reliable self-labeled data and samples requiring human annotation, optimizing the cost-quality tradeoff.

entry.title: Screen Before You Interpret: A Portable Validity Protocol for Benchmark-Based LLM Confidence Signals

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Companion paper to the validity protocol above, providing the portable screening protocol for benchmark-based LLM confidence signals. Specifies three core validity indices and a tier classification system adapted from clinical assessment.

entry.title: SignDPO: Multi-level Direct Preference Optimisation for Skeleton-based Gloss-free Sign Language Translation

author.name: Muxin Pu, Xiao-Ming Wu, Mei Kuan Lim, Chun Yong Chong, Wei Li, Chen Change Loy

entry.summary: Presents SignDPO, a multi-level DPO framework for skeleton-based sign language translation that performs preference alignment across spatial, temporal, and linguistic dimensions. Introduces hierarchical perturbation strategy for constructing preference pairs.

entry.title: FLiP: Towards understanding and interpreting multimodal multilingual sentence embeddings

author.name: Santosh Kesiraju, Bolaji Yusuf, \v{S}imon Sedl\'a\v{c}ek, Old\v{r}ich Plchot, Petr Schwarz

entry.summary: Introduces FLiP (Factorized Linear Projection) models for understanding sentence embedding spaces of multilingual and multimodal encoders. Recovers >75% of lexical content from embeddings, uncovering modality and language biases across LaBSE, SONAR, and Gemini.

entry.title: FreezeEmpath: Efficient Training for Empathetic Spoken Chatbots with Frozen LLMs

author.name: Yun Hong, Yan Zhou, Yang Feng

entry.summary: Proposes FreezeEmpath, an end-to-end empathetic spoken chatbot that keeps the core LLM frozen while training adapters for emotional speech understanding and generation. Avoids catastrophic forgetting and expensive empathetic speech data.

entry.title: Training for Compositional Sensitivity Reduces Dense Retrieval Generalization

author.name: Radoslav Ralev, Aditeya Baral, Iliya Zhechev, Jen Agarwal, Srijith Rajamohan

entry.summary: Reveals a fundamental tension in dense retrieval: training for compositional sensitivity (handling negation, role swaps) reduces zero-shot generalization by 8-40% nDCG@10 on NanoBEIR.

entry.title: Clinical Note Bloat Reduction for Efficient LLM Use

author.name: Jordan L. Cahoon, Chloe Stanwyck, Asad Aali, Rachel Madding, Emma Sun, Yixing Jiang, Renumathy Dhanasekaran, Emily Alsentzer

entry.summary: Introduces TRACE, a preprocessing pipeline that removes note bloat from clinical notes by leveraging EHR metadata and frequency-based deduplication. Reduces token counts substantially while maintaining or improving LLM clinical task performance.

entry.title: On the Robustness of LLM-Based Dense Retrievers: A Systematic Analysis of Generalizability and Stability

author.name: Yongkang Li, Panagiotis Eustratiadis, Yixing Fan, Evangelos Kanoulas

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic robustness study of LLM-based dense retrievers across generalizability and stability, using linear mixed-effects models across 30 datasets. Reveals that instruction-tuned models show gains but with stability concerns.

entry.title: Towards Self-Improving Error Diagnosis in Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Jiazheng Li, Emine Yilmaz, Bei Chen, Dieu-Thu Le

entry.summary: Introduces ErrorProbe, a self-improving framework for diagnosing errors in multi-agent systems that identifies responsible agents and originating error steps through a three-stage pipeline without expensive expert annotation.

entry.title: Modular Representation Compression: Adapting LLMs for Efficient and Effective Recommendations

author.name: Yunjia Xi, Menghui Zhu, Jianghao Lin, Bo Chen, Ruiming Tang, Yong Yu, Weinan Zhang

entry.summary: Discovers Mid-layer Representation Advantage (MRA) where middle LLM layers outperform final layers for recommendation tasks. Proposes modular representation compression exploiting this finding for efficient LLM-augmented recommendation.

entry.title: Audio-DeepThinker: Progressive Reasoning-Aware Reinforcement Learning for High-Quality Chain-of-Thought Emergence in Audio Language Models

author.name: Xiang He, Chenxing Li, Jinting Wang, Yan Rong, Tianxin Xie, Wenfu Wang, Li Liu, Dong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Audio-DeepThinker, using progressive reasoning-aware RL to enable explicit reasoning chains in audio language models. Introduces hybrid reasoning similarity reward for acoustic grounding of reasoning steps.

entry.title: PARM: Pipeline-Adapted Reward Model

author.name: Xingyu Fan, Wei Shao, Jiacheng Liu, Linqi Song, Pheng Ann Heng

entry.summary: Proposes PARM, a Pipeline-Adapted Reward Model that addresses inconsistency between reward model predictions and actual multi-stage pipeline outcomes. Applied to code generation for combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: LayerCache: Exploiting Layer-wise Velocity Heterogeneity for Efficient Flow Matching Inference

author.name: Guandong Li

entry.summary: Proposes LayerCache for flow matching models, exploiting heterogeneous velocity dynamics across transformer layers to enable layer-group-specific caching decisions rather than monolithic per-timestep caching.

entry.title: Co-generation of Layout and Shape from Text via Autoregressive 3D Diffusion

author.name: Zhenggang Tang, Yuehao Wang, Yuchen Fan, Jun-Kun Chen, Yu-Ying Yeh, Kihyuk Sohn, Zhangyang Wang, Qixing Huang, Alexander Schwing, Rakesh Ranjan, Dilin Wang, Zhicheng Yan

entry.summary: Presents 3D-ARD+, a model for co-generating scene layout and object shapes from text using autoregressive diffusion over multimodal tokens, enabling interactive text-to-scene generation.

entry.title: Incoherent Deformation, Not Capacity: Diagnosing and Mitigating Overfitting in Dynamic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Ahmad Droby

entry.summary: Diagnoses overfitting in dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting as primarily caused by splitting operations creating incoherent deformations rather than model capacity, with systematic ablation showing 80% of train-test gap from splitting.

entry.title: Instinct vs. Reflection: Unifying Token and Verbalized Confidence in Multimodal Large Models

author.name: Yunkai Dang, Yifan Jiang, Yizhu Jiang, Anqi Chen, Wenbin Li, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a monotone confidence fusion framework addressing instinct-reflection misalignment in MLLMs, where token-level implicit confidence diverges from verbalized self-assessment. Unifies both signals for better calibration.

entry.title: When Text Hijacks Vision: Benchmarking and Mitigating Text Overlay-Induced Hallucination in Vision Language Models

author.name: Cui Yakun, Xingqun Qi, TianTian Geng, Yuyao Zhang, Sirui Han, Yike Guo

entry.summary: Identifies Text Overlay-Induced Hallucination (TOIH) in VLMs where on-screen text contradicts visual content, and proposes VisualTextTrap benchmark to systematically evaluate this phenomenon.

entry.title: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Yuezhou Hu, Jintao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SDVG, bringing speculative decoding to block-based autoregressive video diffusion by replacing token verification with an image-quality router, achieving ~2x speedup.

entry.title: IncreFA: Breaking the Static Wall of Generative Model Attribution

author.name: Haotian Qin, Dongliang Chang, Yueying Gao, Lei Chen, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: IncreFA redefines generative model attribution as an incremental learning problem, allowing the system to continuously adapt as new AI generators emerge. Exploits hierarchical relationships among generative architectures.

entry.title: Structure-Adaptive Sparse Diffusion in Voxel Space for 3D Medical Image Enhancement

author.name: Hongxu Jiang, Fei Li, Boxiao Yu, Ying Zhang, Kaleb Smith, Kuang Gong, Wei Shao

entry.summary: Proposes a sparse voxel-space diffusion framework for 3D medical image enhancement that trains on uniformly subsampled timesteps, dramatically reducing computation while leveraging anatomical priors from degraded inputs.

entry.title: Test-Time Perturbation Learning with Delayed Feedback for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zehua Zang, Xi Wang, Fuchun Sun, Xiao Xu, Lixiang Lium, Jiahuan Zhou, Jiangmeng Li

entry.summary: PDF proposes a test-time adaptation framework for Vision-Language-Action models that mitigates trajectory overfitting through uncertainty-based data augmentation and action voting, without fine-tuning the base model.

entry.title: Embedding Arithmetic: A Lightweight, Tuning-Free Framework for Post-hoc Bias Mitigation in Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Venkatesh Thirugnana Sambandham, Torsten Sch\"on

entry.summary: Proposes an inference-time bias mitigation method for text-to-image models using embedding arithmetic to correct social bias in the embedding space without altering model weights, tested on FLUX and SD 3.5.

entry.title: Memorize When Needed: Decoupled Memory Control for Spatially Consistent Long-Horizon Video Generation

author.name: Yanjun Guo, Zhengqiang Zhang, Pengfei Wang, Xinyue Liang, Zhiyuan Ma, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a decoupled framework for spatially consistent long-horizon video generation that separates memory conditioning from generation, using a lightweight memory branch for spatial consistency while preserving generative capacity.

entry.title: AdaCluster: Adaptive Query-Key Clustering for Sparse Attention in Video Generation

author.name: Haoyue Tan, Shengnan Wang, Yulin Qiao, Juncheng Zhang, Youhui Bai, Ping Gong, Zewen Jin, Cheng Li

entry.summary: AdaCluster proposes a training-free adaptive clustering framework for sparse attention in video diffusion transformers, using angle-similarity clustering for queries and euclidean-similarity for keys to accelerate inference.

entry.title: MetaCloak-JPEG: JPEG-Robust Adversarial Perturbation for Preventing Unauthorized DreamBooth-Based Deepfake Generation

author.name: Tanjim Rahaman Fardin, S M Zunaid Alam, Mahadi Hasan Fahim, Md Faysal Mahfuz

entry.summary: Proposes MetaCloak-JPEG, adversarial perturbations that survive JPEG compression to prevent unauthorized DreamBooth-based deepfake generation, addressing a critical blind spot in existing face protection systems.

entry.title: SynAgent: Generalizable Cooperative Humanoid Manipulation via Solo-to-Cooperative Agent Synergy

author.name: Wei Yao, Haohan Ma, Hongwen Zhang, Yunlian Sun, Liangjun Xing, Zhile Yang, Yuanjun Guo, Yebin Liu, Jinhui Tang

entry.summary: Presents SynAgent, a framework for cooperative humanoid manipulation that transfers skills from single-agent to multi-agent scenarios using interaction-preserving retargeting via Delaunay tetrahedralization-based Interact Mesh.

entry.title: T-REN: Learning Text-Aligned Region Tokens Improves Dense Vision-Language Alignment and Scalability

author.name: Savya Khosla, Sethuraman T V, Aryan Chadha, Alex Schwing, Derek Hoiem

entry.summary: Proposes T-REN, an efficient encoder that maps visual data to compact text-aligned region-level representations, addressing both weak dense alignment and high token counts in vision-language encoders for tasks like open-vocabulary segmentation.

entry.title: BrainMem: Brain-Inspired Evolving Memory for Embodied Agent Task Planning

author.name: Xiaoyu Ma, Lianyu Hu, Wenbing Tang, Zixuan Hu, Zeqin Liao, Zhizhen Wu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes BrainMem, a training-free hierarchical memory system inspired by human cognition (working, episodic, semantic memory) for embodied agents, transforming interaction histories into knowledge graphs and symbolic guidelines for better task planning.

entry.title: CSF: Black-box Fingerprinting via Compositional Semantics for Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Junhoo Lee, Mijin Koo, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: Presents Compositional Semantic Fingerprinting (CSF), the first black-box method for attributing fine-tuned text-to-image models using only query access, employing compositional underspecified prompts as fingerprints.

entry.title: Rewind-IL: Online Failure Detection and State Respawning for Imitation Learning

author.name: Gehan Zheng, Sanjay Seenivasan, Matthew Johnson-Roberson, Weiming Zhi

entry.summary: Presents Rewind-IL, a training-free safeguard framework for imitation learning that detects failures via temporal inter-chunk discrepancy and recovers by rewinding to earlier states, addressing a major deployment obstacle.

entry.title: ReconVLA: An Uncertainty-Guided and Failure-Aware Vision-Language-Action Framework for Robotic Control

author.name: Lingling Chen, Zongyao Lyu, William J. Beksi

entry.summary: Introduces ReconVLA, applying conformal prediction to VLA action token outputs to produce calibrated uncertainty estimates, enabling failure detection and reliable robotic control.

entry.title: LongBench: Evaluating Robotic Manipulation Policies on Real-World Long-Horizon Tasks

author.name: Xueyao Chen, Jingkai Jia, Tong Yang, Yibo Fu, Wei Li, Wenqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces LongBench, a real-world benchmark with over 1,000 episodes for evaluating long-horizon robotic manipulation, separating context-independent and context-dependent regimes for mechanism-aware evaluation.

entry.title: Driving risk emerges from the required two-dimensional joint evasive acceleration

author.name: Hao Cheng, Yanbo Jiang, Wenhao Yu, Rui Zhou, Jiang Bian, Keyu Chen, Zhiyuan Liu, Heye Huang, Hailun Zhang, Fang Zhang, Jianqiang Wang, Sifa Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces 'evasive acceleration' (EA), a 2D risk quantification metric for autonomous driving that defines risk as the minimum acceleration needed to avoid collision, replacing 1D TTC-based methods. Validated on five open datasets.

entry.title: Bureaucratic Silences: What the Canadian AI Register Reveals, Omits, and Obscures

author.name: Dipto Das, Christelle Tessono, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed, Shion Guha

entry.summary: This paper critically analyzes Canada's Federal AI Register (released November 2025), finding that while 86% of registered AI systems are internal efficiency tools, the register obscures procurement dependencies and lacks meaningful accountability mechanisms. It uses the ADMAPS framework to expose gaps between transparency rhetoric and practice.

entry.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy for CT Report Generation

author.name: Yi Lin, Yihao Ding, Yonghui Wu, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: MARCH proposes a multi-agent framework for CT report generation that mimics radiology department hierarchies, with Resident, Fellow, and Attending agents performing drafting, revision, and quality control respectively. Aims to reduce clinical hallucinations through collaborative oversight.

entry.title: Zoom Consistency: A Free Confidence Signal in Multi-Step Visual Grounding Pipelines

author.name: Keon Kim, Krish Chelikavada

entry.summary: Identifies 'zoom consistency'—the distance between a VLM's intermediate predictions in multi-step zoom-in pipelines—as a free, calibration-free confidence signal for GUI grounding. Proves it's a linear estimator of spatial error under ideal conditions.

entry.title: Temporal Contrastive Decoding: A Training-Free Method for Large Audio-Language Models

author.name: Yanda Li, Yuhan Liu, Zirui Song, Yunchao Wei, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Salem Lahlou

entry.summary: Proposes Temporal Contrastive Decoding (TCD), a training-free method for large audio-language models that mitigates temporal smoothing bias by contrasting logits from original and temporally-blurred audio inputs. Aims to preserve transient acoustic cues that are otherwise underutilized.

entry.title: RelativeFlow: Taming Medical Image Denoising Learning with Noisy Reference

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Yiqing Dong, Wenxue Yu, Zhan Wu, Rongjun Ge, Yang Chen, Yuting He

entry.summary: RelativeFlow proposes a flow matching framework that learns from heterogeneous noisy references for medical image denoising, driving inputs from arbitrary quality levels toward unified high-quality targets without requiring clean ground truth images.

entry.title: The Semi-Executable Stack: Agentic Software Engineering and the Expanding Scope of SE

author.name: Robert Feldt, Per Lenberg, Julian Frattini, Dhasarathy Parthasarathy

entry.summary: Argues that AI agents are expanding what software engineering encompasses rather than replacing it—the 'semi-executable stack' includes natural language specifications, prompts, and agent configurations alongside traditional code. Reframes the threat narrative as an expansion of scope.

entry.title: DALM: A Domain-Algebraic Language Model via Three-Phase Structured Generation

author.name: Chao Li

entry.summary: Proposes DALM, a Domain-Algebraic Language Model that replaces unconstrained generation with structured denoising over a domain lattice, resolving domain, relation, and concept uncertainty in three phases. Aims to prevent cross-domain knowledge interference.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving LLMs Routing

author.name: Xidong Wu, Yukuan Zhang, Yuqiong Ji, Reza Shirkavand, Qian Lou, Shangqian Gao

entry.summary: Proposes PPRoute, a privacy-preserving LLM routing framework using Secure Multi-Party Computation, with optimizations to reduce the computational overhead of cryptographic protocols for dynamic model selection.

entry.title: Beyond a Single Frame: Multi-Frame Spatially Grounded Reasoning Across Volumetric MRI

author.name: Lama Moukheiber, Caleb M. Yeung, Haotian Xue, Alec Helbling, Zelin Zhao, Yongxin Chen

entry.summary: Introduces SGMRI-VQA, a 41,307-pair benchmark for multi-frame spatially grounded reasoning on volumetric MRI with chain-of-thought traces and frame-indexed bounding boxes from expert radiologists.

entry.title: JumpLoRA: Sparse Adapters for Continual Learning in Large Language Models

author.name: Alexandra Dragomir, Ioana Pintilie, Antonio Barbalau, Marius Dragoi, Florin Brad, Cristian Daniel Paduraru, Alexandru Tifrea, Elena Burceanu, Radu Tudor Ionescu

entry.summary: Proposes JumpLoRA, using JumpReLU gating to induce adaptive sparsity in LoRA blocks for continual learning, achieving dynamic parameter isolation to prevent task interference.

entry.title: VEFX-Bench: A Holistic Benchmark for Generic Video Editing and Visual Effects

author.name: Xiangbo Gao, Sicong Jiang, Bangya Liu, Xinghao Chen, Minglai Yang, Siyuan Yang, Mingyang Wu, Jiongze Yu, Qi Zheng, Haozhi Wang, Jiayi Zhang, Jie Yang, Zihan Wang, Qing Yin, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces VEFX-Dataset with 5,049 human-annotated video editing examples across 9 categories and a standardized evaluator for comparing video editing systems. Fills an important gap in benchmarking instruction-guided video editing.

entry.title: Towards Reliable Testing of Machine Unlearning

author.name: Anna Mazhar, Sainyam Galhotra

entry.summary: Frames machine unlearning testing as a first-class software engineering problem, arguing tests need coverage over proxy influence pathways, debugging capabilities, and practical oracle assumptions. Systematic treatment of an increasingly important regulatory requirement.

entry.title: The Global Neural World Model: Spatially Grounded Discrete Topologies for Action-Conditioned Planning

author.name: Noureddine Kermiche

entry.summary: Presents GNWM, a self-stabilizing world model that maps environments onto discrete 2D grids with translational equivariance and grid snapping for error correction during autoregressive rollouts. Trained via random walks for generalized dynamics learning.

entry.title: Representation Before Training: A Fixed-Budget Benchmark for Generative Medical Event Models

author.name: Inhyeok Lee, Luke Solo, Michael C. Burkhart, Bashar Ramadan, William F. Parker, Brett K. Beaulieu-Jones

entry.summary: Evaluates how representation decisions (tokenization, quantization, value encoding, temporal encoding) affect downstream clinical prediction in generative medical event models, training 28 matched transformers on MIMIC-IV.

entry.title: Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models: A Systematic Study under Real-World Distribution Shifts

author.name: Gabriel Jason Lee, Jathurshan Pradeepkumar, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroAdapt-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating test-time adaptation (TTA) methods on EEG foundation models under realistic distribution shifts including cross-device and cross-population scenarios.

entry.title: Fully Analog Resonant Recurrent Neural Network via Metacircuit

author.name: Zixin Zhou, Tianxi Jiang, Menglong Yang, Zhihua Feng, Qingbo He, Shiwu Zhang

entry.summary: Implements a fully analog resonant recurrent neural network using a metacircuit architecture of coupled electrical resonators, establishing a direct mechanical-electrical analogy for physical neural network implementation.

entry.title: Machine Learning Hamiltonian Dynamical Systems with Sparse and Noisy Data

author.name: Vedanta Thapar, Abhinav Gupta

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptable Symplectic Recurrent Neural Networks for learning Hamiltonian dynamics from sparse, noisy data by embedding symplectic structure into the architecture and avoiding time derivative estimation.

entry.title: Contraction and Hourglass Persistence for Learning on Graphs, Simplices, and Cells

author.name: Mattie Ji, Indradyumna Roy, Vikas Garg

entry.summary: Introduces Hourglass Persistence, interleaving inclusion and contraction sequences in persistent homology for graph learning, establishing new expressivity results and practical topological descriptors.

entry.title: Ranking Abuse via Strategic Pairwise Data Perturbations

author.name: Junyi Yao, Zihao Zheng, Jiayu Long

entry.summary: Studies vulnerability of MLE-based pairwise ranking systems to adversarial perturbations, showing sharp phase-transition behavior and proposing an Adaptive Subset Selection Attack.

entry.title: LoRaQ: Optimized Low Rank Approximation for 4-bit Quantization

author.name: Yann Bouquet, Alireza Khodamoradi, Sophie Y\'ang Shen, Kristof Denolf, Mathieu Salzmann

entry.summary: Proposes LoRaQ, a data-free low-rank approximation method for 4-bit quantization of diffusion transformers that doesn't require high-precision auxiliary branches, enabling fully quantized inference pipelines.

entry.title: Correction and Corruption: A Two-Rate View of Error Flow in LLM Protocols

author.name: Fernando Reitich

entry.summary: Proposes a paired-outcome measurement framework for auditing LLM protocol steps, separating correction rate from corruption rate to understand when multi-step processing helps vs. hurts, with analysis of transferability.

entry.title: Safety, Security, and Cognitive Risks in State-Space Models: A Systematic Threat Analysis with Spectral, Stateful, and Capacity Attacks

author.name: Manoj Parmar

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic treatment of safety, security, and cognitive risks in State-Space Models (S4, Mamba, etc.), proposing a formal threat framework with attack surfaces and spectral sensitivity analysis.

entry.title: AdaExplore: Failure-Driven Adaptation and Diversity-Preserving Search for Efficient Kernel Generation

author.name: Weihua Du, Jingming Zhuo, Yixin Dong, Andre Wang He, Weiwei Sun, Zeyu Zheng, Manupa Karunaratne, Ivan Fox, Tim Dettmers, Tianqi Chen, Yiming Yang, Sean Welleck

entry.summary: Proposes AdaExplore, an agent framework for efficient GPU kernel code generation that accumulates reusable knowledge from execution feedback. Uses failure-driven adaptation and diversity-preserving search for Triton kernel optimization.

entry.title: EasyVideoR1: Easier RL for Video Understanding

author.name: Chuanyu Qin, Chenxu Yang, Qingyi Si, Naibin Gu, Dingyu Yao, Zheng Lin, Peng Fu, Nan Duan, Jiaqi Wang

entry.summary: Presents EasyVideoR1, a framework extending reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) to video understanding in multimodal models. Addresses computational overhead and reproducibility challenges specific to video modality.

entry.title: A Universal Avoidance Method for Diverse Multi-branch Generation

author.name: Kyeongman Park, Minha Jhang, Kyomin Jung

entry.summary: Introduces UAG (Universal Avoidance Generation), a model-agnostic strategy that penalizes similarity among previously generated outputs to enhance multi-branch diversity in generative models. Achieves 1.9x higher diversity at 4.4x faster speed and 1/64 FLOPs compared to SOTA.

entry.title: Concurrent Criterion Validation of a Validity Screen for LLM Confidence Signals via Selective Prediction

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Tests a validity screen that classifies LLM confidence signals as Valid/Indeterminate/Invalid, showing it predicts selective prediction performance across 20 frontier LLMs. Valid models achieve AUROC=0.624 vs Invalid models at 0.357 (Cohen's d=2.81). Notes DeepSeek-R1 drops to 11.3% accuracy at 10% coverage.

entry.title: Depth Registers Unlock W4A4 on SwiGLU: A Reader/Generator Decomposition

author.name: Ziyang Liu

entry.summary: Studies post-training W4A4 quantization in SwiGLU models, introducing Depth Registers with hinge loss to reduce quantization damage from PPL 1727 to 119 (14x improvement). Decomposes damage by input-activation site into 'readers' and 'generators'.

entry.title: UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiaqi Wang (Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Haoge Deng (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Ting Pan (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Yang Liu (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Chengyuan Wang (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Fan Zhang (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence), Yonggang Qi (Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Xinlong Wang (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence)

entry.summary: Proposes UDM-GRPO, the first framework integrating Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models with reinforcement learning (GRPO). Treats final clean samples as actions and reconstructs trajectories via forward diffusion for better optimization stability.

entry.title: Multimodal Claim Extraction for Fact-Checking

author.name: Joycelyn Teo, Rui Cao, Zhenyun Deng, Zifeng Ding, Michael Sejr Schlichtkrull, Andreas Vlachos

entry.summary: Presents the first benchmark for multimodal claim extraction from social media, where posts combine text and images. Evaluates state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs under a three-part evaluation framework against gold-standard claims from real-world fact-checkers.

entry.title: Expressing Social Emotions: Misalignment Between LLMs and Human Cultural Emotion Norms

author.name: Sree Bhattacharyya, Manas Mehta, Leona Chen, Cristina Salvador, Agata Lapedriza, Shiran Dudy, James Z. Wang

entry.summary: Evaluates whether LLMs faithfully capture human patterns of social emotion expression across cultures. Proposes a psychologically informed framework showing misalignment between LLM emotion expression and cultural norms.

entry.title: StageMem: Lifecycle-Managed Memory for Language Models

author.name: Jiarui Han

entry.summary: StageMem proposes a lifecycle-managed memory framework for LLMs with three stages, treating memory as a stateful process rather than passive storage. Addresses issues of retaining uncertain items and forgetting important content.

entry.title: HeLa-Mem: Hebbian Learning and Associative Memory for LLM Agents

author.name: Jinchang Zhu, Jindong Li, Cheng Zhang, Jiahong Liu, Menglin Yang

entry.summary: HeLa-Mem is a bio-inspired memory architecture for LLM agents implementing Hebbian learning principles: association, consolidation, and spreading activation. Aims to capture the associative structure of human memory.

entry.title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models with Morality Attacks

author.name: Ying Su, Mingen Zheng, Weili Diao, Haoran Li

entry.summary: Proposes morality-based jailbreak attacks leveraging value ambiguity and value conflict scenarios. Creates a 10.3K instance dataset and four adversarial attacks to study LLMs' internal pluralistic values.

entry.title: Modeling Multi-Dimensional Cognitive States in Large Language Models under Cognitive Crowding

author.name: Lin Zhong, Siyu Zhu, Zizhen Yuan, Jinhao Cui, Xinyang Zhao, Lingzhi Wang, Hao Chen, Qing Liao

entry.summary: CognitiveBench is the first benchmark with unified annotations across four cognitive dimensions (emotion, thinking style, stance, intention). Shows LLMs perform well on single dimensions but drop sharply in joint multi-dimensional modeling.

entry.title: DORA Explorer: Improving the Exploration Ability of LLMs Without Training

author.name: Priya Gurjar, Md Farhan Ishmam, Kenneth Marino

entry.summary: DORA Explorer analyzes LLM exploration deficiency in sequential decision-making and proposes methods to improve exploration without training. Tests on Multi-Armed Bandit and text adventure games, finding current decoding strategies insufficient.

entry.title: Peerispect: Claim Verification in Scientific Peer Reviews

author.name: Ali Ghorbanpour, Soroush Sadeghian, Alireza Daghighfarsoodeh, Sajad Ebrahimi, Negar Arabzadeh, Seyed Mohammad Hosseini, Ebrahim Bagheri

entry.summary: Presents Peerispect, a system for claim-level verification in scientific peer reviews that extracts check-worthy claims, retrieves evidence from manuscripts, and verifies claims through NLI. Provides an interactive visual interface.

entry.title: DeInfer: Efficient Parallel Inferencing for Decomposed Large Language Models

author.name: You-Liang Huang, Xinhao Huang, Chengxi Liao, Zeyi Wen

entry.summary: Introduces DeInfer, a high-performance inference system for parallel inference of decomposed LLMs. Provides multiple optimizations to maximize performance when scaling up decomposed model sizes.

entry.title: Modeling Human Perspectives with Socio-Demographic Representations

author.name: Leixin Zhang, Cagri Coltekin

entry.summary: Proposes Socio-Contrastive Learning to jointly model annotator perspectives while learning socio-demographic representations. Goes beyond single demographic factors to capture complex social contexts influencing human annotation.

entry.title: Decisive: Guiding User Decisions with Optimal Preference Elicitation from Unstructured Documents

author.name: Akriti Jain, Anish Mulay, Divyansh Verma, Aishani Pandey, Pritika Ramu, Aparna Garimella

entry.summary: Presents Decisive, an interactive decision-making framework combining document-grounded reasoning with Bayesian preference inference. Learns user preference vectors through targeted elicitation while grounding decisions in objective scoring matrices.

entry.title: HiGMem: A Hierarchical and LLM-Guided Memory System for Long-Term Conversational Agents

author.name: Shuqi Cao (East China Normal University, Shanghai, China), Jingyi He (Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China), Fei Tan (East China Normal University, Shanghai, China)

entry.summary: Proposes HiGMem, a hierarchical memory system for long-term conversational agents that uses event summaries as semantic indexes for LLM-guided retrieval. Addresses the problem of bloated evidence sets from vector-similarity-only retrieval.

entry.title: Benchmarking Real-Time Question Answering via Executable Code Workflows

author.name: Wenjie Zhou, Yuan Gao, Xin Zhou, Hao Fu, Zhongjian Miao, Wei Chen, Bo Chen, Xiaobing Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes RT-QA, a dynamic evaluation framework for real-time QA that uses executable code workflows to retrieve up-to-date answers at evaluation time. Includes self-repair mechanisms to adapt to changing web content.

entry.title: SmoGVLM: A Small, Graph-enhanced Vision-Language Model

author.name: Debjyoti Mondal, Rituraj Singh, Subhadarshi Panda

entry.summary: Proposes SmoGVLM, a small VLM enhanced with graph neural networks for structured knowledge integration. Shows that small models (1.3B) trained with GNN augmentation can achieve up to 16.24% gains and outperform larger counterparts.

entry.title: VIBE: Voice-Induced open-ended Bias Evaluation for Large Audio-Language Models via Real-World Speech

author.name: Yi-Cheng Lin, Yusuke Hirota, Sung-Feng Huang, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes VIBE, a framework evaluating generative bias in Large Audio-Language Models using real-world speech and open-ended tasks. Reveals systematic biases in 11 state-of-the-art LALMs, with gender cues triggering larger shifts than accent cues.

entry.title: From Heads to Neurons: Causal Attribution and Steering in Multi-Task Vision-Language Models

author.name: Qidong Wang, Junjie Hu, Ming Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes HONES, a gradient-free framework for task-aware neuron interpretation and steering in multi-task VLMs. Routes through attention heads to identify task-critical FFN neurons, enabling targeted interventions.

entry.title: CodePivot: Bootstrapping Multilingual Transpilation in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning without Parallel Corpora

author.name: Shangyu Li, Juyong Jiang, Meibo Ren, Sizhe Zhong, Huiri Tan, Yunhao Gou, Xu Han, Chun Yong Chong, Yun Peng, Jiasi Shen

entry.summary: Proposes CodePivot, a bootstrapping approach for multilingual code transpilation using RL without parallel corpora. Addresses the practical challenge of translating between programming languages when parallel training data is unavailable.

entry.title: Beyond Pattern Matching: Seven Cross-Domain Techniques for Prompt Injection Detection

author.name: Thamilvendhan Munirathinam

entry.summary: Proposes seven cross-domain prompt injection detection techniques drawn from forensic linguistics, materials science, network security, and other fields. Addresses failure modes of current pattern-matching and fine-tuned classifier approaches.

entry.title: Document-as-Image Representations Fall Short for Scientific Retrieval

author.name: Ghazal Khalighinejad, Raghuveer Thirukovalluru, Alexander H. Oh, Bhuwan Dhingra

entry.summary: Argues that document-as-image representations are inadequate for scientific document retrieval and introduces ArXivDoc, a benchmark built from LaTeX sources that better tests retrieval across text, tables, and figures.

entry.title: Dynamic Eraser for Guided Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models

author.name: Qinghui Gong

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Semantic Steering (DSS), a training-free framework for concept erasure in diffusion models that automates safe anchor discovery and uses guided semantic steering to avoid drift and collapse.

entry.title: Topology-Aware Layer Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Pengcheng Zheng, Chaoning Zhang, Ya Wen, Wang Liu, Qigan Sun, Jiarong Mo, Jiaquan Zhang, Jewon Lee, Tae-Ho Kim, Kuien Liu, Tianyu Li, Caiyan Qin, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes topology-aware layer pruning for large vision-language models using persistent homology to represent evolving feature topology across depth, avoiding removal of transition-critical layers.

entry.title: Reducing Peak Memory Usage for Modern Multimodal Large Language Model Pipelines

author.name: Junwan Kim, Hyunkyung Bae

entry.summary: Proposes techniques to reduce peak memory usage during MLLM inference by exploiting structural regularities in vision token processing during the prefill stage, not just after.

entry.title: DVAR: Adversarial Multi-Agent Debate for Video Authenticity Detection

author.name: Hongyuan Qi, Feifei Shao, Ming Li, Hehe Fan, Jun Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes DVAR, a training-free multi-agent debate framework for video authenticity detection where competing agents (Generative vs Natural Mechanism) cross-examine evidence to determine if a video is real or AI-generated.

entry.title: ScenarioControl: Vision-Language Controllable Vectorized Latent Scenario Generation

author.name: Lili Gao, Yanbo Xu, William Koch, Samuele Ruffino, Luke Rowe, Behdad Chalaki, Dmitriy Rivkin, Julian Ost, Roger Girgis, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Introduces ScenarioControl, the first vision-language control mechanism for learned driving scenario generation, enabling text/image-conditioned synthesis of diverse 3D driving scenarios with maps, actors, and ego observations.

entry.title: When Background Matters: Breaking Medical Vision Language Models by Transferable Attack

author.name: Akash Ghosh, Subhadip Baidya, Sriparna Saha, Xiuying Chen

entry.summary: Proposes MedFocusLeak, a transferable black-box attack against medical VLMs that injects perturbations into non-diagnostic background regions to induce incorrect but clinically plausible diagnoses.

entry.title: UniGeo: Unifying Geometric Guidance for Camera-Controllable Image Editing via Video Models

author.name: Hong Jiang, Wensong Song, Zongxing Yang, Ruijie Quan, Yi Yang

entry.summary: UniGeo proposes a unified geometric guidance framework for camera-controllable image editing using video models, injecting geometric cues at multiple levels to maintain cross-view consistency during continuous camera motion. It addresses the limitations of fragmented geometric guidance and discrete view mappings in existing approaches.

entry.title: Weakly-Supervised Referring Video Object Segmentation through Text Supervision

author.name: Miaojing Shi, Jun Huang, Zijie Yue, Hanli Wang

entry.summary: WSRVOS proposes weakly-supervised referring video object segmentation using only text expressions (no masks, boxes, or points), leveraging MLLM captioning for contrastive augmentation.

entry.title: E3VS-Bench: A Benchmark for Viewpoint-Dependent Active Perception in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes

author.name: Koya Sakamoto, Taiki Miyanishi, Daichi Azuma, Shuhei Kurita, Shu Morikuni, Naoya Chiba, Motoaki Kawanabe, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: E3VS-Bench introduces a benchmark for embodied 3D visual search in Gaussian Splatting scenes, requiring agents to actively explore with 5-DoF viewpoint control to answer viewpoint-dependent questions.

entry.title: Trustworthy Endoscopic Super-Resolution

author.name: Julio Silva-Rodr\'iguez, Ender Konukoglu

entry.summary: Proposes a trustworthy super-resolution framework for endoscopic video with a lightweight error-prediction module that identifies where reconstructions are likely to fail, enabling operational confidence maps.

entry.title: MARCO: Navigating the Unseen Space of Semantic Correspondence

author.name: Claudia Cuttano, Gabriele Trivigno, Carlo Masone, Stefan Roth

entry.summary: MARCO introduces a unified model for generalizable semantic correspondence built on DINOv2 with a coarse-to-fine objective and self-distillation framework that expands beyond annotated keypoints.

entry.title: LiquidTAD: An Efficient Method for Temporal Action Detection via Liquid Neural Dynamics

author.name: Zepeng Sun, Naichuan Zheng, Hailun Xia, Junjie Wu, Liwei Bao, Xiaotai Zhang

entry.summary: LiquidTAD replaces transformer self-attention with parallelized Liquid Neural Network blocks for temporal action detection, using closed-form continuous-time formulation for efficiency while preserving temporal dynamics.

entry.title: Progressive Online Video Understanding with Evidence-Aligned Timing and Transparent Decisions

author.name: Kecheng Zhang, Zongxin Yang, Mingfei Han, Haihong Hao, Yunzhi Zhuge, Changlin Li, Junhan Zhao, Zhihui Li, Xiaojun Chang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for progressive online video understanding that decouples reasoning control from memory integration, enabling visual agents to respond precisely when sufficient evidence first appears in a video stream rather than in offline settings.

entry.title: AnchorSeg: Language Grounded Query Banks for Reasoning Segmentation

author.name: Rui Qian, Chuanhang Deng, Qiang Huang, Jian Xiong, Mingxuan Li, Yingbo Zhou, Wei Zhai, Jintao Chen, Dejing Dou

entry.summary: Introduces AnchorSeg for reasoning segmentation, reformulating it as structured conditional generation over image tokens using language-grounded query banks, explicitly disentangling 'what to segment' from 'where to segment'.

entry.title: ReFineVLA: Multimodal Reasoning-Aware Generalist Robotic Policies via Teacher-Guided Fine-Tuning

author.name: Tuan Van Vo, Tan Q. Nguyen, Khang Nguyen, Nhat Xuan Tran, Duy H. M. Nguyen, An T. Le, Ngo Anh Vien, Minh Nhat Vu

entry.summary: Proposes ReFineVLA, which fine-tunes VLA models with teacher-guided reasoning rationales, augmenting robotic datasets with reasoning from expert models to improve interpretability and generalization in long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: Breaking Validity-Induced Boundaries to Expand Algorithm Search Space: A Two-Stage AST-Based Operator for LLM-Driven Automated Heuristic Evolution

author.name: Sun Shengming, Shi Jialong

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage AST-based evolutionary operator for LLM-driven automated heuristic design that first performs structural mutations on abstract syntax trees, then uses LLM to repair invalid code, expanding the algorithm search space.

entry.title: Chain Of Interaction Benchmark (COIN): When Reasoning meets Embodied Interaction

author.name: Xianhao Wang, Xiaojian Ma, Haozhe Hu, Rongpeng Su, Yutian Cheng, Zhou Ziheng, Hangxin Liu, Lei Liu, Bin Li, Qing Li

entry.summary: Introduces COIN benchmark for evaluating interactive reasoning in robotic manipulation with 50 daily-scenario tasks requiring sequential interaction under partial observability and causally-dependent reasoning.

entry.title: SYMBOLIZER: Symbolic Model-free Task Planning with VLMs

author.name: Sami Azirar, Zlatan Ajanovic, Hermann Blum

entry.summary: SYMBOLIZER uses VLMs to automatically generate symbolic models (state interpretation and action models) for task and motion planning, eliminating the need for handcrafted symbolic representations while preserving classical planning's long-horizon reasoning.

entry.title: OFlow: Injecting Object-Aware Temporal Flow Matching for Robust Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Kuanning Wang, Ke Fan, Chenhao Qiu, Zeyu Shangguan, Yuqian Fu, Yanwei Fu, Daniel Seita, Xiangyang Xue

entry.summary: OFlow unifies temporal foresight and object-aware reasoning in VLA models by forecasting future latents with temporal flow matching and factorizing them into object-aware representations that emphasize task-relevant physical cues.

entry.title: Understanding Tool-Augmented Agents for Lean Formalization: A Factorial Analysis

author.name: Ke Zhang, Patricio Gallardo, Maziar Raissi, Sudhir Murthy

entry.summary: Conducts systematic factorial analysis of tool-augmented LLM agents for translating natural language math into Lean 4 formal proofs. Evaluates three tool categories: fine-tuned model querying, knowledge search, and compiler feedback.

entry.title: RePrompT: Recurrent Prompt Tuning for Integrating Structured EHR Encoders with Large Language Models

author.name: Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam, Drew Ross, Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao

entry.summary: Proposes RePrompT for integrating structured EHR encoders with LLMs using recurrent prompt tuning. Addresses the challenge of converting time-stamped medical codes into formats LLMs can effectively reason about while maintaining cross-patient representation learning.

entry.title: Domain-oriented RAG Assessment (DoRA): Synthetic Benchmarking for RAG-based Question Answering on Defense Documents

author.name: Bao Gia Doan, Aditya Joshi, Pantelis Elinas, Aarya Bodhankar, Oscar Leslie, Tom Marchant, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Presents DoRA, a domain-grounded RAG benchmark built from defense documents with synthetic QA covering 5 question types and 6.5K instances. Shows that domain-specific fine-tuning on DoRA yields large gains (26% improvement) over base models.

entry.title: JudgeMeNot: Personalizing Large Language Models to Emulate Judicial Reasoning in Hebrew

author.name: Itay Razumenko, Arnon Sturm, Nir Grinberg

entry.summary: Introduces a synthetic-organic supervision pipeline for personalizing LLMs to individual judges' reasoning patterns in Hebrew. Demonstrates that CLM followed by synthetic instruction-tuning outperforms other personalization techniques.

entry.title: DOSE: Data Selection for Multi-Modal LLMs via Off-the-Shelf Models

author.name: Biao Wu, Yiwu Zhong, Meng Fang, Ling Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DOSE, using off-the-shelf pretrained models (without fine-tuning) to select training data for larger VLMs. Shows these models can effectively assess text quality and image-text alignment without task-specific training.

entry.title: OASIS: On-Demand Hierarchical Event Memory for Streaming Video Reasoning

author.name: Zhijia Liang, Jiaming Li, Weikai Chen, Yanhao Zhang, Haonan Lu, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Introduces OASIS, a framework for streaming video reasoning that organizes history into hierarchical events and performs on-demand retrieval, addressing the challenge of growing history with scarce relevant evidence.

entry.title: SpatialImaginer: Towards Adaptive Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Yian Li, Yang Jiao, Bin Zhu, Tianwen Qian, Shaoxiang Chen, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes SpatialImaginer for spatial reasoning in MLLMs that generates adaptive visual representations during the reasoning process to preserve geometric structure, addressing the mismatch between spatial tasks and text-only reasoning.

entry.title: Score-Based Matching with Target Guidance for Cryo-EM Denoising

author.name: Xiaoqi Wu, Xueying Zhan, Wen Li, Junhao Wu, Xin Huang, Min Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a score-based denoising framework for cryo-EM that learns clean-data score functions with target guidance, explicitly accounting for structural consistency needed by downstream particle analysis tasks.

entry.title: AI Approach for MRI-only Full-Spine Vertebral Segmentation and 3D Reconstruction in Paediatric Scoliosis

author.name: Nathasha Naranpanawa, Maree T. Izatt, Robert D. Labrom, Geoffrey N. Askin, J. Paige Little

entry.summary: Introduces an AI framework for fully automated spine segmentation and 3D reconstruction from MRI alone in pediatric scoliosis patients, using GAN-based CT-to-MRI domain transfer to overcome training data scarcity.

entry.title: GS-STVSR: Ultra-Efficient Continuous Spatio-Temporal Video Super-Resolution via 2D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Mingyu Shi, Xin Di, Long Peng, Boxiang Cao, Anran Wu, Zhanfeng Feng, Jiaming Guo, Renjing Pei, Xueyang Fu, Yang Cao, Zhengjun Zha

entry.summary: GS-STVSR proposes an ultra-efficient continuous spatio-temporal video super-resolution framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting, avoiding the dense pixel-wise queries of implicit neural representations.

entry.title: Extending One-Step Image Generation from Class Labels to Text via Discriminative Text Representation

author.name: Chenxi Zhao, Chen Zhu, Xiaokun Feng, Aiming Hao, Jiashu Zhu, Jiachen Lei, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Jufeng Yang

entry.summary: PRISM enables pre-trained T2I models to handle long text prompts through compositional prompt decomposition, extracting constituent representations from long descriptions via a lightweight module.

entry.title: Long-Text-to-Image Generation via Compositional Prompt Decomposition

author.name: Jen-Yuan Huang, Tong Lin, Yilun Du

entry.summary: PRISM proposes compositional prompt decomposition for long text-to-image generation. A lightweight module extracts constituent representations from descriptive paragraphs for pre-trained T2I models.

entry.title: S2H-DPO: Hardness-Aware Preference Optimization for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Nitish Shukla, Surgan Jandial, Arun Ross

entry.summary: Introduces S2H-DPO, a Simple-to-Hard learning framework for VLM alignment on multi-image reasoning, constructing preference data across three hierarchical reasoning levels and applying DPO for training.

entry.title: AnchorRefine: Synergy-Manipulation Based on Trajectory Anchor and Residual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Tingzheng Jia, Kan Guo, Lanping Qian, Yongli Hu, Daxin Tian, Guixian Qu, Chunmian Lin, Baocai Yin, Jiapu Wang

entry.summary: AnchorRefine factorizes VLA action modeling into trajectory anchor (global planning) and residual refinement (local correction), inspired by how humans separate macro transport from micro adjustment during manipulation.

entry.title: Debate as Reward: A Multi-Agent Reward System for Scientific Ideation via RL Post-Training

author.name: Moein Salimi, Babak Hosseini Mohtasham, Amin Aghakasiri, Mahdi Naieni, Amir Hossein Qeysarbeigi, Mohammad Masih Shalchian Nazer, Zahra Azar, Mahdi Jafari Siavoshani, Mohammad Hossein Rohban

entry.summary: Proposes using multi-agent debate as a reward system for RL-based scientific idea generation, addressing reward hacking where models exploit imperfect evaluation proxies. Decouples methodological validation from implementation details.

entry.title: Beyond Reproduction: A Paired-Task Framework for Assessing LLM Comprehension and Creativity in Literary Translation

author.name: Ran Zhang, Steffen Eger, Arda Tezcan, Wei Zhao, Simone Paolo Ponzetto, Lieve Macken

entry.summary: Proposes a paired-task framework for evaluating LLM literary translation, separately assessing source comprehension and translational creativity through Units of Creative Potential (metaphors, wordplay). Benchmarks 23 models on 11 books.

entry.title: Coevolving Representations in Joint Image-Feature Diffusion

author.name: Theodoros Kouzelis, Spyros Gidaris, Nikos Komodakis

entry.summary: Proposes CoReDi (Coevolving Representation Diffusion) where the semantic representation space used to guide image-feature diffusion evolves during training via jointly learned linear projection.

entry.title: ZSG-IAD: A Multimodal Framework for Zero-Shot Grounded Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Qiuhui Chen, Jiaxiang Song, Shuai Tan, Weimin Zhong

entry.summary: ZSG-IAD proposes a multimodal vision-language framework for zero-shot grounded industrial anomaly detection that generates structured anomaly reports and pixel-level masks from RGB, sensor, and 3D point cloud inputs.

entry.title: Medical Image Understanding Improves Survival Prediction via Visual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Xixi Liu, Jorge Lazo, Andreas Hallqvist, Mikael Johansson, {\AA}se Johnsson, Jonas S Andersson, Ella \"Ang Eklund, Patrik Sund, Nasser Hosseini, Jennifer Alv\'en, Ida H\"aggstr\"om

entry.summary: Proposes a vision-language framework for 3D CT image understanding through visual instruction tuning on open-access CT images with radiology reports, adapted for downstream survival prediction.

entry.title: GIST: Multimodal Knowledge Extraction and Spatial Grounding via Intelligent Semantic Topology

author.name: Shivendra Agrawal, Bradley Hayes

entry.summary: GIST presents a pipeline that transforms mobile point cloud data into semantically annotated navigation topologies for cluttered environments like stores and hospitals. It combines VLMs with spatial grounding to address challenges in dense, real-world navigation scenarios.

entry.title: Integrating Graphs, Large Language Models, and Agents: Reasoning and Retrieval

author.name: Hamed Jelodar, Samita Bai, Mohammad Meymani, Parisa Hamedi, Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Ali Ghorbani

entry.summary: Survey paper categorizing methods for integrating graphs with LLMs, organized by purpose (reasoning, retrieval, generation), graph modality (knowledge graphs, scene graphs, etc.), and integration strategy (prompting, augmentation, training, agent-based). Covers the full landscape of graph-LLM integration approaches.

entry.title: To LLM, or Not to LLM: How Designers and Developers Navigate LLMs as Tools or Teammates

author.name: Varad Vishwarupe, Ivan Flechais, Nigel Shadbolt, Marina Jirotka

entry.summary: Grounded theory study based on 33 interviews at three large tech organizations examining how designers and developers decide when to use LLMs as tools vs. teammates. Finds the framing (tool vs. teammate) interacts with organizational accountability structures to determine acceptability.

entry.title: VeriCWEty: Embedding enabled Line-Level CWE Detection in Verilog

author.name: Prithwish Basu Roy, Zeng Wang, Anatolii Chuvashlov, Weihua Xiao, Johann Knechtel, Ozgur Sinanoglu, Ramesh Karri

entry.summary: Proposes an embedding-based framework for detecting and classifying common hardware vulnerabilities (CWEs) in Verilog code at both module and line level, achieving 89% precision. Addresses the gap that LLM-generated RTL code often contains security vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Lightweight Geometric Adaptation for Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Kang An, Chenhao Si, Shiqian Ma, Ming Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight curvature-aware optimization framework for Physics-Informed Neural Networks that uses secant information as a cheap proxy for local geometry. The method is plug-and-play, compatible with existing first-order optimizers.

entry.title: Transfer Learning from Foundational Optimization Embeddings to Unsupervised SAT Representations

author.name: Koyena Pal, Serdar Kadioglu

entry.summary: Investigates whether foundational optimization embeddings pre-trained on MIP problems transfer to Boolean satisfiability (SAT) problems by mapping CNF formulas into the same bipartite graph representation. Shows the embeddings capture structural regularities useful for SAT without fine-tuning.

entry.title: "Excuse me, may I say something..." CoLabScience, A Proactive AI Assistant for Biomedical Discovery and LLM-Expert Collaborations

author.name: Yang Wu, Jinhong Yu, Jingwei Xiong, Zhimin Tao, Xiaozhong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces CoLabScience, a proactive LLM assistant for biomedical collaboration that autonomously decides when and how to intervene in scientific discussions. Uses PULI (Positive-Unlabeled Learning-to-Intervene) framework trained with RL to determine optimal intervention timing.

entry.title: Rethinking the Necessity of Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation through the Lens of Adaptive Listwise Ranking

author.name: Jun Feng, Jiahui Tang, Zhicheng He, Hang Lv, Hongchao Gu, Hao Wang, Xuezhi Yang, Shuai Fang

entry.summary: Rethinks whether adaptive retrieval is necessary as LLMs become more noise-robust, and proposes AdaRankLLM with adaptive listwise reranking using passage dropout. Distills ranking capabilities into smaller models.

entry.title: Hierarchical Active Inference using Successor Representations

author.name: Prashant Rangarajan, Rajesh P. N. Rao

entry.summary: Proposes hierarchical active inference combining hierarchical environment models with successor representations for efficient planning. Demonstrates scaling active inference to complex large-scale environments inspired by brain's multi-scale representations.

entry.title: From Seeing to Simulating: Generative High-Fidelity Simulation with Digital Cousins for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation

author.name: Jasper Lu, Zhenhao Shen, Yuanfei Wang, Shugao Liu, Shengqiang Xu, Shawn Xie, Jingkai Xu, Feng Jiang, Jade Yang, Chen Xie, Ruihai Wu

entry.summary: Presents a generative framework for real-to-sim mapping from panoramas to high-fidelity simulation scenes for robot learning. Creates diverse 'cousin' scenes through semantic and geometric editing for data augmentation.

entry.title: Reckoning with the Political Economy of AI: Avoiding Decoys in Pursuit of Accountability

author.name: Janet Vertesi, danah boyd, Alex Taylor, Benjamin Shestakofsky

entry.summary: Critical examination of AI's political economy, arguing that various 'decoys' (including some accountability frameworks) create illusions of oversight while masking power consolidation by AI developers.

entry.title: Non-Stationarity in the Embedding Space of Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Jinmyeong Choi, Brad Shook, Artur Dubrawski

entry.summary: Studies non-stationarity in embedding spaces of time series foundation models, distinguishing it from general distribution shift. Examines how mean shifts, variance changes, and linear trends manifest in TSFM embeddings, connecting to statistical process control principles.

entry.title: LLM as a Tool, Not an Agent: Code-Mined Tree Transformations for Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Masakazu Yoshimura, Zitang Sun, Yuiko Sakuma, Junji Otsuka, Atsushi Irie, Takeshi Ohashi

entry.summary: Proposes LLMasTool, using LLMs as tools rather than agents for neural architecture search. Employs hierarchical tree-based NAS where LLMs mine code for architecture transformations while algorithmic search ensures executability.

entry.title: How to Approximate Inference with Subtractive Mixture Models

author.name: Lena Zellinger, Nicola Branchini, Lennert De Smet, V\'ictor Elvira, Nikolay Malkin, Antonio Vergari

entry.summary: Studies how to use subtractive mixture models (SMMs, mixtures with negative coefficients) for variational inference and importance sampling, designing expectation estimators and learning schemes for these non-standard models.

entry.title: Late Fusion Neural Operators for Extrapolation Across Parameter Space in Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Eva van Tegelen, Taniya Kapoor, George A. K. van Voorn, Peter van Heijster, Ioannis N. Athanasiadis

entry.summary: Introduces Late Fusion Neural Operator that disentangles learning state dynamics from parameter effects for better extrapolation across PDE parameter regimes, addressing distribution shifts from parameter variations.

entry.title: Continuous Limits of Coupled Flows in Representation Learning

author.name: Zilin Li, Weiwei Xu, Xuchun Tong, Xuanbo Lu, Xuanqi Zhao

entry.summary: Formalizes decentralized representation learning as coupled slow-fast dynamical systems on Riemannian manifolds, proving convergence of discrete spatial transitions to overdamped Langevin SDEs and establishing stability guarantees.

entry.title: CCAR: Intrinsic Robustness as an Emergent Geometric Property

author.name: Akash Samanta, Manish Pratap Singh, Debasis Chaudhuri

entry.summary: Proposes Class-Conditional Activation Regularization (CCAR) that engineers a block-diagonal feature space structure, confining class energy to orthogonal subspaces. Shows formal connection to Fisher Discriminant Ratio maximization and demonstrates emergent adversarial robustness.

entry.title: When Spike Sparsity Does Not Translate to Deployed Cost: VS-WNO on Jetson Orin Nano

author.name: Jason Yoo, Shailesh Garg, Souvik Chakraborty, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Demonstrates that algorithmic sparsity in spiking neural operators does not translate to actual deployment speedups on commodity edge GPUs (Jetson Orin Nano), due to software stack limitations.

entry.title: SigGate-GT: Taming Over-Smoothing in Graph Transformers via Sigmoid-Gated Attention

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: SigGate-GT applies sigmoid gating (inspired by attention sink solutions in LLMs) to graph transformers to address over-smoothing and attention entropy degeneration in the GraphGPS framework.

entry.title: TransXion: A High-Fidelity Graph Benchmark for Realistic Anti-Money Laundering

author.name: Keyang Chen, Mingxuan Jiang, Yongsheng Zhao, Zeping Li, Zaiyuan Chen, Weiqi Luo, Zhixin Li, Sen Liu, Yinan Jing, Guangnan Ye, Xihong Wu, Hongfeng Chai

entry.summary: TransXion provides a realistic benchmark for anti-money laundering research with profile-aware simulation and stochastic non-template synthesis of illicit subgraphs, addressing limitations of existing AML datasets.

entry.title: Neural Adjoint Method for Meta-optics: Accelerating Volumetric Inverse Design via Fourier Neural Operators

author.name: Chanik Kang, Hyewon Suk, Haejun Chung

entry.summary: Uses Fourier Neural Operators as a surrogate for Maxwell equation solvers in meta-optics design, predicting 3D adjoint gradient fields to accelerate volumetric inverse design.

entry.title: A Probabilistic Consensus-Driven Approach for Robust Counterfactual Explanations

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba, Jerzy Stefanowski

entry.summary: Proposes probabilistic consensus-based counterfactual explanations using normalizing flows trained with model ensemble agreement, providing a single parameter to control robustness to model changes.

entry.title: How Much Data is Enough? The Zeta Law of Discoverability in Biomedical Data, featuring the enigmatic Riemann zeta function

author.name: Paul M. Thompson

entry.summary: Proposes the 'Zeta Law' scaling framework for biomedical data discoverability based on spectral structure of data covariance operators, connecting the Riemann zeta function to performance scaling curves.

entry.title: Conditional Attribution for Root Cause Analysis in Time-Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Shashank Mishra, Karan Patil, Cedric Schockaert, Didier Stricker, Jason Rambach

entry.summary: Proposes conditional attribution for root cause analysis in time series anomaly detection, explaining anomalies relative to contextually similar normal states rather than marginal baselines.

entry.title: Modeling Higher-Order Brain Interactions via a Multi-View Information Bottleneck Framework for fMRI-based Psychiatric Diagnosis

author.name: Kunyu Zhang, Qiang Li, Vince D. Calhoun, Shujian Yu

entry.summary: Integrates O-information (a measure of higher-order interactions characterizing synergy vs redundancy) into a multi-view information bottleneck framework for fMRI-based psychiatric diagnosis.

entry.title: LoReC: Rethinking Large Language Models for Graph Data Analysis

author.name: Hongyu Zhan, Qixin Wang, Yusen Tan, Haitao Yu, Jingbo Zhou, Shuai Chen, Jia Li, Xiao Tan, Jun Xia

entry.summary: LoReC (Look, Remember, Contrast) addresses LLMs' limited capability for processing graph data by enhancing attention to graph structure within the GraphLLM paradigm.

entry.title: Online Conformal Prediction with Adversarial Semi-bandit Feedback via Regret Minimization

author.name: Junyoung Yang, Kyungmin Kim, Sangdon Park

entry.summary: Proposes a method for online conformal prediction with adversarial semi-bandit feedback, where true labels are only partially observed. Uses regret minimization to provide coverage guarantees under partial feedback from an adaptive adversary.

entry.title: Scale-free adaptive planning for deterministic dynamics & discounted rewards

author.name: Peter L. Bartlett, Victor Gabillon, Jennifer Healey, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Proposes Platypoos, a scale-free planning algorithm for deterministic dynamics with discounted rewards that adapts to unknown reward scale and smoothness, with matching lower bounds showing optimality.

entry.title: Semantic Step Prediction: Multi-Step Latent Forecasting in LLM Reasoning Trajectories via Step Sampling

author.name: Yidi Yuan

entry.summary: Applies Semantic Tube Prediction at reasoning step boundaries rather than random token spans, achieving 168x more accurate multi-step latent prediction on ProcessBench compared to 4x for random token sampling.

entry.title: Saccade Attention Networks: Using Transfer Learning of Attention to Reduce Network Sizes

author.name: Marc Estafanous (Johns Hopkins University, Neurobaby Corporation)

entry.summary: Proposes Saccade Attention Networks that learn sparse attention patterns from large pre-trained models, reducing computation by ~80% by attending only to key features. Inspired by human visual saccade mechanisms to reduce transformer sequence lengths.

entry.title: A Mechanism Study of Delayed Loss Spikes in Batch-Normalized Linear Models

author.name: Peifeng Gao, Wenyi Fang, Yang Zheng, Difan Zou

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of delayed loss spikes in batch-normalized linear models, showing that normalization can postpone instability by gradually increasing effective learning rate. Derives explicit conditions for spike onset and self-stabilization.

entry.title: Improving LLM Code Reasoning via Semantic Equivalence Self-Play with Formal Verification

author.name: Antonio Valerio Miceli Barone, Poon Tsz Nok

entry.summary: Introduces a self-play framework for code semantic equivalence in Haskell, using Liquid Haskell proofs for formal verification. Releases OpInstruct-HSx dataset of ~28k validated programs. Shows 13.3pp accuracy gain on EquiBench.

entry.title: PAC-Bayes Bounds for Gibbs Posteriors via Singular Learning Theory

author.name: Chenyang Wang, Yun Yang

entry.summary: Derives non-asymptotic PAC-Bayes generalization bounds for Gibbs posteriors using singular learning theory tools. Applicable to overparameterized models and adapts to data structure and intrinsic model complexity.

entry.title: Waking Up Blind: Cold-Start Optimization of Supervision-Free Agentic Trajectories for Grounded Visual Perception

author.name: Ashutosh Bajpai, Tamal Majumder, Akshay Nambi, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes SPECTRA, a supervision-free framework that bootstraps agentic capabilities in small vision-language models via cold-start reinforcement learning, using structured multi-turn rollouts to ground reasoning in visual observations.

entry.title: Improving reproducibility by controlling random seed stability in machine learning based estimation via bagging

author.name: Nicholas Williams, Alejandro Schuler

entry.summary: Formalizes random seed stability for ML estimators via concentration conditions and proves subbagging guarantees stability. Introduces adaptive cross-bagging to eliminate seed dependence in debiased ML with small computational overhead.

entry.title: How Creative Are Large Language Models in Generating Molecules?

author.name: Wen Tao, Yiwei Wang, Peng Zhou, Bryan Hooi, Wanlong Fang, Tianle Zhang, Xiao Luo, Yuansheng Liu, Alvin Chan

entry.summary: Studies LLM creativity in molecular generation, examining what types of creative behavior LLMs exhibit when generating molecules from natural language prompts. Proposes an evaluation framework grounded in creativity theory.

entry.title: Asset Harvester: Extracting 3D Assets from Autonomous Driving Logs for Simulation

author.name: Tianshi Cao, Jiawei Ren, Yuxuan Zhang, Jaewoo Seo, Jiahui Huang, Shikhar Solanki, Haotian Zhang, Mingfei Guo, Haithem Turki, Muxingzi Li, Yue Zhu, Sipeng Zhang, Zan Gojcic, Sanja Fidler, Kangxue Yin

entry.summary: Presents Asset Harvester, an image-to-3D pipeline converting sparse object observations from real driving logs into complete simulation-ready 3D assets for autonomous vehicle testing. Combines large-scale data curation with 3D reconstruction.

entry.title: LiFT: Does Instruction Fine-Tuning Improve In-Context Learning for Longitudinal Modelling by Large Language Models?

author.name: Iqra Ali, Talia Tseriotou, Mahmud Elahi Akhter, Yuxiang Zhou, Maria Liakata

entry.summary: LiFT introduces a longitudinal instruction fine-tuning framework for LLMs to handle temporal NLP tasks, using a curriculum that progressively increases temporal difficulty. From Liakata's group, evaluates across five datasets on tasks requiring reasoning over temporally ordered text.

entry.title: Measuring Representation Robustness in Large Language Models for Geometry

author.name: Vedant Jawandhia, Yash Sinha, Murari Mandal, Ankan Pal, Dhruv Kumar

entry.summary: GeoRepEval measures LLM robustness to equivalent geometric problem representations (Euclidean, coordinate, vector forms). Finds that models show significant performance variation across representations despite mathematical equivalence.

entry.title: Spotlights and Blindspots: Evaluation Machine-Generated Text Detection

author.name: Kevin Stowe, Kailash Patil

entry.summary: Evaluates 15 machine-generated text detection models across seven test sets. Finds no single system excels everywhere and that training data choice and evaluation metrics significantly impact apparent performance.

entry.title: Incentivizing Parametric Knowledge via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Cross-Cultural Entity Translation

author.name: Jiang Zhou, Xiaohu Zhao, Xinwei Wu, Tianyu Dong, Hao Wang, Yangyang Liu, Heng Liu, Linlong Xu, Longyue Wang, Weihua Luo, Deyi Xiong

entry.summary: EA-RLVR uses reinforcement learning with verifiable entity-level rewards to improve cross-cultural entity translation without external knowledge bases. Incentivizes LLMs to use their parametric knowledge for culturally appropriate translations.

entry.title: MNAFT: modality neuron-aware fine-tuning of multimodal large language models for image translation

author.name: Bo Li, Ningyuan Deng, Tianyu Dong, Shaobo Wang, Shaolin Zhu, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: MNAFT identifies language-agnostic and language-specific neurons in multimodal LLMs for image translation, then selectively fine-tunes them to bridge the modality gap between visual text and textual outputs.

entry.title: Auditing Support Strategies in LLMs through Grounded Multi-Turn Social Simulation

author.name: Michelle Star, Andrew Aquilina, Yu-Ru Lin

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-turn simulation framework for auditing LLM social support strategies, revealing narratives turn-by-turn and coding responses with an established support behavior taxonomy. Uses linear probes to estimate models' internal distress signals.

entry.title: How Tokenization Limits Phonological Knowledge Representation in Language Models and How to Improve Them

author.name: Disen Liao, Freda Shi

entry.summary: Investigates how tokenization limits phonological knowledge in text-only LMs, introducing STAD metric measuring misalignment between tokenization and syllable boundaries. Shows higher misalignment correlates with poorer phonological representations.

entry.title: HopRank: Self-Supervised LLM Preference-Tuning on Graphs for Few-Shot Node Classification

author.name: Ziqing Wang, Kaize Ding

entry.summary: HopRank uses graph topology under homophily assumptions for self-supervised LLM preference-tuning on text-attributed graphs, enabling few-shot node classification without abundant labels.

entry.title: More Than Meets the Eye: Measuring the Semiotic Gap in Vision-Language Models via Semantic Anchorage

author.name: Wei He

entry.summary: Introduces DIVA, a benchmark for measuring the 'semiotic gap' in Vision-Language Models - their ability to represent abstract meaning like idiomatic noun compounds. Proposes a Semantic Alignment Gap metric to quantify divergence between literal and idiomatic visual grounding.

entry.title: DuConTE: Dual-Granularity Text Encoder with Topology-Constrained Attention for Text-attributed Graphs

author.name: Lexuan Liang, Tao Zou, Xuxiang Ta, Zekun Qiu
