entry.summary: Proposes DuConTE, a dual-granularity text encoder for text-attributed graphs that incorporates topology-constrained attention during text encoding. Uses cascaded pretrained LMs to perform both word-token and sentence-token level semantic interaction while respecting graph structure.

entry.title: Where Do Self-Supervised Speech Models Become Unfair?

author.name: Felix Herron, Maja Hjuler, Solange Rossato, Alexandre Allauzen, Fran\c{c}ois Portet

entry.summary: Presents the first layerwise fairness analysis of self-supervised speech models, revealing that bias against certain speaker groups starts at the earliest layers. Discovers opposite patterns of layerwise bias for speaker identification vs ASR tasks.

entry.title: FregeLogic at SemEval 2026 Task 11: A Hybrid Neuro-Symbolic Architecture for Content-Robust Syllogistic Validity Prediction

author.name: Adewale Akinfaderin, Nafi Diallo

entry.summary: Presents FregeLogic, a hybrid neuro-symbolic system combining an ensemble of LLMs (Llama 4, Qwen3) with a Z3 SMT solver for syllogistic validity prediction at SemEval-2026. Achieves 94.3% accuracy by using formal logic as a tiebreaker for content-biased errors.

entry.title: Diagnosing LLM-based Rerankers in Cold-Start Recommender Systems: Coverage, Exposure and Practical Mitigations

author.name: Ekaterina Lemdiasova, Nikita Zmanovskii

entry.summary: Systematically diagnoses failure modes of LLM-based cross-encoder rerankers in cold-start recommendation, identifying low retrieval coverage, severe exposure bias, and inconsistent reranking as critical failure modes.

entry.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling

author.name: Arnav Goel, Pranjal A Chitale, Bhawna Paliwal, Bishal Santra, Amit Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces HORIZON, a large-scale cross-domain user modeling benchmark with 54M users and 35M items from Amazon Reviews. Challenges models to generalize across domains, users, and time horizons.

entry.title: Contrastive Attribution in the Wild: An Interpretability Analysis of LLM Failures on Realistic Benchmarks

author.name: Rongyuan Tan, Jue Zhang, Zhuozhao Li, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang

entry.summary: Studies contrastive LRP-based attribution for analyzing LLM failures on realistic benchmarks. Introduces efficient cross-layer attribution graphs for long-context inputs, conducting systematic empirical study of failure patterns.

entry.title: Enabling AI ASICs for Zero Knowledge Proof

author.name: Jianming Tong, Jingtian Dang, Simon Langowski, Tianhao Huang, Asra Ali, Jeremy Kun, Jevin Jiang, Srinivas Devadas, Tushar Krishna

entry.summary: Presents MORPH, the first framework enabling AI ASICs (like TPUs) to perform zero-knowledge proof computations by reformulating ZKP kernels for matrix hardware. Introduces Big-T complexity model for hardware-aware analysis.

entry.title: A Survey of Spatial Memory Representations for Efficient Robot Navigation

author.name: Ma. Madecheen S. Pangaliman, Steven S. Sison, Erwin P. Quilloy, Rowel Atienza

entry.summary: Surveys spatial memory representations for robot navigation across 88 references and 52 systems, introducing the α metric (peak runtime memory / map size) to expose deployment cost vs published claims.

entry.title: C-GenReg: Training-Free 3D Point Cloud Registration by Multi-View-Consistent Geometry-to-Image Generation with Probabilistic Modalities Fusion

author.name: Yuval Haitman, Amit Efraim, Joseph M. Francos

entry.summary: Proposes C-GenReg, a training-free 3D point cloud registration framework using generative world foundation models to synthesize consistent RGB views, bridging geometric registration with vision foundation models.

entry.title: Q-DeepSight: Incentivizing Thinking with Images for Image Quality Assessment and Refinement

author.name: Xudong Li, Jiaxi Tan, Ziyin Zhou, Yan Zhong, Zihao Huang, Jingyuan Zheng, Yan Zhang, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: Proposes Q-DeepSight for image quality assessment using interleaved multimodal chain-of-thought with tool-augmented evidence acquisition (crop-and-zoom), emulating human-like quality evaluation.

entry.title: SIF: Semantically In-Distribution Fingerprints for Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yifei Zhao, Qian Lou, Mengxin Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes SIF (Semantically In-Distribution Fingerprints) for LVLM ownership verification, exposing vulnerability of existing fingerprinting methods through a Semantic Divergence Attack and introducing semantically preserving fingerprints.

entry.title: Depth Adaptive Efficient Visual Autoregressive Modeling

author.name: Chunliang Li, Tianze Cao, Sanyuan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DepthVAR, a training-free framework for efficient visual autoregressive modeling that adaptively allocates per-token computational depth instead of binary token pruning.

entry.title: Towards Joint Quantization and Token Pruning of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xinqing Li, Xin He, Xindong Zhang, Ming-Ming Cheng, Lei Zhang, Yun Liu

entry.summary: Presents QUOTA, a joint quantization-and-pruning framework for VLMs that unifies low-bit inference with visual-token pruning through offline token allocation calibrated for quantized representations.

entry.title: Long-CODE: Isolating Pure Long-Context as an Orthogonal Dimension in Video Evaluation

author.name: Zhijiang Tang, Jiaxin Qi, Bing Zhao, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Long-CODE benchmark isolating long-context evaluation as an orthogonal dimension from short-video quality metrics for video generation, focusing on narrative richness and causal consistency.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Super-Resolution for Sentinel-5P Hyperspectral Images

author.name: Hyam Omar Ali, Antoine Crosnier, Romain Abraham, Baptiste Combelles, Fabrice J\'egou, Bruno Galerne

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised hyperspectral super-resolution framework for Sentinel-5P satellite data that trains without high-resolution ground truth, combining SURE with equivariant imaging constraints and the satellite's degradation model.

entry.title: Low Light Image Enhancement Challenge at NTIRE 2026

author.name: George Ciubotariu, Sharif S M A, Abdur Rehman, Fayaz Ali Dharejo, Rizwan Ali Naqvi, Marcos V. Conde, Radu Timofte, Zhi Jin, Hongjun Wu, Wenjian Zhang, Chang Ye, Xunpeng Yi, Qinglong Yan, Yibing Zhang, Nikhil Akalwadi, Varda I Pattanshetty, Varsha I Pattanshetty, Padmashree Desai, Uma Mudenagudi, Ramesh Ashok Tabib, Hao Yang, Ruikun Zhang, Liyuan Pan, Furkan K{\i}nl{\i}, Donghun Ryou, Inju Ha, Junoh Kang, Bohyung Han, Wei Zhou, Yuval Haitman, Ariel Lapid, Reuven Peretz, Idit Diamant, Leilei Cao, Shuo Zhang, Praful Hambarde, Prateek Shaily, Jayant Kumar, Hardik Sharma, Aashish Negi, Sachin Chaudhary, Akshay Dudhane, Amit Shukla, MoHao Wu, Lin Wang, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi, Raul Balmez, Alexandru Brateanu, Ciprian Orhei, Cosmin Ancuti, Codruta O. Ancuti, Bilel Benjdira, Anas M. Ali, Wadii Boulila, Kaifan Qiao, Bofei Chen, Jingyi Xu, Duo Zhang, Xin Deng, Mai Xu, Shengxi Li, Lai Jiang, Harini A, Ananya N, Lakshanya K, Ying Xu, Xinyi Zhu, Shijun Shi, Jiangning Zhang, Yong Liu, Kai Hu, Jing Xu, Xianfang Zeng, Jinao Song, Guangsheng Tang, Cheng Li, Yuqiang Yang, Ziyi Wang, Yan Chen, Long Bao, Heng Sun, Mohab Kishawy, Jun Chen, Wan-Chi Siu, Yihao Cheng, Hon Man Hammond Lee, Chun-Chuen Hui

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of the NTIRE 2026 Low Light Image Enhancement Challenge, covering solutions from 22 teams across 195 registrants. Showcases state-of-the-art advances in low-light enhancement and denoising.

entry.title: Ego-InBetween: Generating Object State Transitions in Ego-Centric Videos

author.name: Mengmeng Ge, Takashi Isobe, Xu Jia, Yanan Sun, Zetong Yang, Weinong Wang, Dong Zhou, Dong Li, Huchuan Lu, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Defines Egocentric Instructed Visual State Transition, generating intermediate video frames showing object transformations between initial and target states under action instructions from an ego-centric view.

entry.title: View-Consistent 3D Scene Editing via Dual-Path Structural Correspondense and Semantic Continuity

author.name: Pufan Li, Bi'an Du, Shenghe Zheng, Junyi Yao, Wei Hu

entry.summary: Proposes view-consistent 3D scene editing by recasting the problem from a distributional perspective, modeling joint distributions across viewpoints rather than relying on inference-time synchronization.

entry.title: Is SAM3 ready for pathology segmentation?

author.name: Qiuyu Kong, Shakiba Sharifi, Zanxi Ruan, Yiming Wang, Marco Cristani

entry.summary: Evaluates SAM3's capability for pathology segmentation across tissue-level and nuclei-level scales, finding that text-only prompts perform poorly while few-shot and supervised prompting strategies show promise.

entry.title: One-Step Diffusion with Inverse Residual Fields for Unsupervised Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Boan Zhang, Wen Li, Guanhua Yu, Xiyang Liu, Wenchao Chen, Long Tian

entry.summary: Proposes OSD-IRF, a one-step diffusion method with inverse residual fields for unsupervised industrial anomaly detection, dramatically accelerating inference compared to iterative diffusion approaches while maintaining detection quality.

entry.title: SemLT3D: Semantic-Guided Expert Distillation for Camera-only Long-Tailed 3D Object Detection

author.name: Hao Vo, Khoa Vo, Thinh Phan, Ngo Xuan Cuong, Gianfranco Doretto, Hien Nguyen, Anh Nguyen, Ngan Le

entry.summary: Introduces SemLT3D for camera-only long-tailed 3D object detection in autonomous driving, using semantic-guided expert distillation to handle rare but safety-critical categories like children and emergency vehicles.

entry.title: MUA: Mobile Ultra-detailed Animatable Avatars

author.name: Heming Zhu, Guoxing Sun, Marc Habermann

entry.summary: Proposes MUA (Mobile Ultra-detailed Animatable Avatars), a novel representation for photorealistic animatable full-body digital humans that achieves both high fidelity and real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms like VR headsets.

entry.title: Visual-RRT: Finding Paths toward Visual-Goals via Differentiable Rendering

author.name: Sebin Lee, Jumin Lee, Taeyeon Kim, Younju Na, Woobin Im, Sung-Eui Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes visual-RRT (vRRT), a motion planner combining gradient-based exploitation from differentiable rendering with sampling-based exploration from RRTs, enabling visual-goal robot planning without explicit joint angle specifications.

entry.title: VIDS: A Verified Imaging Dataset Standard for Medical AI

author.name: Joan S. Muthu, John Shalen

entry.summary: Presents VIDS, an open standard for medical imaging datasets that defines folder layout, annotation provenance, quality documentation, and 21 machine-enforceable validation checks, filling a gap between DICOM and BIDS.

entry.title: ST-$\pi$: Structured SpatioTemporal VLA for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Chuanhao Ma, Hanyu Zhou, Shihan Peng, Yan Li, Tao Gu, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes ST-π, a structured spatiotemporal VLA model with explicit spatiotemporal reasoning for robotic manipulation, encoding 4D observations and task instructions with explicit spatiotemporal boundaries.

entry.title: LatentMimic: Terrain-Adaptive Locomotion via Latent Space Imitation

author.name: Zhiquan Wang, Yunyu Liu, Dipam Patel, Ayush Kumar, Aniket Bera, Bedrich Benes

entry.summary: Introduces LatentMimic for quadruped locomotion that decouples stylistic fidelity from geometric constraints by minimizing latent divergence between policy and mocap prior, enabling terrain adaptation while preserving motion style.

entry.title: A Rapid Deployment Pipeline for Autonomous Humanoid Grasping Based on Foundation Models

author.name: Yifei Yan, Yankai Liao, Linqi Ye

entry.summary: An end-to-end pipeline for humanoid robot grasping that reduces deployment time for new objects from 1-2 days to ~30 minutes by integrating foundation models: Roboflow-based annotation, SAM 3D reconstruction, and FoundationPose for zero-shot 6-DoF pose tracking.

entry.title: Symplectic Inductive Bias for Data-Driven Target Reachability in Hamiltonian Systems

author.name: Zhuo Ouyang, Jixian Liu, Enrique Mallada

entry.summary: Leverages symplectic geometry as an inductive bias for data-efficient learning of target reachability in Hamiltonian systems, arguing that physical structure can overcome the curse of dimensionality in nonlinear control.

entry.title: Takes on Automating Alignment

author.name: skunnavakkam

entry.summary: Discusses how AI models excel at long-horizon tasks with short feedback loops, and frames automating alignment research as finding the right metrics and feedback mechanisms. Argues models need alignment-specific metrics to hill-climb effectively.

entry.title: Gradient-Free Continual Learning in Spiking Neural Networks via Inter-Spike Interval Regularization

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Kazuma Kobayashi, Souvik Chakraborty, Sajedul Talukder, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Proposes ISI-CV, the first gradient-free synaptic importance metric for continual learning in spiking neural networks, based on inter-spike interval coefficient of variation. Enables continual learning on neuromorphic hardware that lacks backpropagation support.

entry.title: SynthFix: Adaptive Neuro-Symbolic Code Vulnerability Repair

author.name: Yifan Zhang, Jieyu Li, Kexin Pei, Yu Huang, Kevin Leach

entry.summary: Presents SynthFix, a hybrid neural-symbolic framework for code vulnerability repair using an adaptive router that directs samples to either supervised fine-tuning or reward fine-tuning with symbolic feedback. Achieves 18% CodeBLEU and 32% Exact Match improvements.

entry.title: AQPIM: Breaking the PIM Capacity Wall for LLMs with In-Memory Activation Quantization

author.name: Kosuke Matsushima, Yasuyuki Okoshi, Masato Motomura, Daichi Fujiki

entry.summary: Proposes AQPIM, a Processing-in-Memory approach with specialized activation quantization to address KV cache memory bottlenecks in long-context LLM inference. Targets PIM-specific quantization opportunities.

entry.title: Bridging the Reasoning Gap in Vietnamese with Small Language Models via Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Bui The Trung, Do Minh Duc, Nguyen Van Vinh, Bui Nguyen Quoc Trinh

entry.summary: Investigates test-time scaling strategies for small language models (1.7B) in Vietnamese math reasoning. Introduces Vi-S1K reasoning dataset and Vi-Elementary-Bench, demonstrating that small models have latent knowledge that can be unlocked with proper test-time compute.

entry.title: ReCoQA: A Benchmark for Tool-Augmented and Multi-Step Reasoning in Real Estate Question and Answering

author.name: Yindong Zhang, Wenmian Yang, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Introduces ReCoQA, a large-scale real estate QA benchmark (29K instances) featuring hybrid workflows combining database querying with external APIs. Proposes HIRE-Agent with hierarchical understand-plan-execute architecture.

entry.title: Multiplication in Multimodal LLMs: Computation with Text, Image, and Audio Inputs

author.name: Samuel G. Balter, Ethan Jerzak, Connor T. Jerzak

entry.summary: Introduces a controlled multimodal multiplication benchmark varying digit length, sparsity, representation, and modality. Demonstrates that multimodal LLMs can perceive numbers across modalities but fail at exact arithmetic regardless of input format.

entry.title: MARA: A Multimodal Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Document Question Answering

author.name: Hui Wu, Haoquan Zhai, Yuchen Li, Hengyi Cai, Peirong Zhang, Yidan Zhang, Lei Wang, Chunle Wang, Yingyan Hou, Shuaiqiang Wang, Dawei Yin

entry.summary: Proposes MARA, a multimodal adaptive RAG framework for document QA that introduces query-adaptive mechanisms for both retrieval and generation. Addresses limitations of query-agnostic representations and static top-k evidence selection.

entry.title: ClawEnvKit: Automatic Environment Generation for Claw-Like Agents

author.name: Xirui Li, Ming Li, Derry Xu, Wei-Lin Chiang, Ion Stoica, Cho-Jui Hsieh, Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces ClawEnvKit, an automated pipeline for generating diverse training/evaluation environments for claw-like agents from natural language descriptions, comprising parsing, generation, and validation modules.

entry.title: PoInit-of-View: Poisoning Initialization of Views Transfers Across Multiple 3D Reconstruction Systems

author.name: Weijie Wang, Songlong Xing, Zhengyu Zhao, Nicu Sebe, Bruno Lepri

entry.summary: Demonstrates that targeting structure-from-motion initialization with adversarial perturbations can achieve transferable poisoning across diverse 3D reconstruction systems, via cross-view gradient inconsistencies.

entry.title: CrossFlowDG: Bridging the Modality Gap with Cross-modal Flow Matching for Domain Generalization

author.name: Antonios Kritikos, Nikolaos Spanos, Athanasios Voulodimos

entry.summary: Proposes CrossFlowDG for domain generalization using noise-free cross-modal flow matching to bridge the modality gap between image and text embeddings, learning continuous transformations in joint latent space.

entry.title: D-Prism: Differentiable Primitives for Structured Dynamic Modeling

author.name: Xingyuan Yu, Yijin Li, Chong Zeng, Yuhang Ming, Hujun Bao, Guofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes D-Prism, the first framework for structured dynamic modeling by extending differentiable primitives to the dynamic domain, binding 3D Gaussian Splatting to primitive surfaces for articulated motion modeling.

entry.title: Where to Focus: Query-Modulated Multimodal Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding

author.name: Shaoguang Wang, Weiyu Guo, Ziyang Chen, Xuming Hu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes Q-Gate, a plug-and-play training-free framework for long video understanding that treats keyframe selection as dynamic modality routing, adapting selection strategy based on query type.

entry.title: BioVLM: Routing Prompts, Not Parameters, for Cross-Modality Generalization in Biomedical VLMs

author.name: Mainak Singha, Tanisha Gupta, Ankit Jha, Muhammad Haris Khan, Sayantani Ghosh, Biplab Banerjee

entry.summary: BioVLM proposes a prompt-learning framework for biomedical vision-language models that dynamically selects prompts from a learned bank based on a low-entropy criterion, improving cross-modality generalization without backbone fine-tuning.

entry.title: AeroRAG: Structured Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented LLM for Fine-Grained Aerial Visual Reasoning

author.name: Junxiao Xue, Quan Deng, Tingqi Hu, Meicong Si, Xinyi Yin, Yunyun Shi, Xuecheng Wu

entry.summary: AeroRAG proposes a scene-graph-guided multimodal RAG framework for aerial visual question answering, converting images to structured visual knowledge before retrieval and generation.

entry.title: Region-Grounded Report Generation for 3D Medical Imaging: A Fine-Grained Dataset and Graph-Enhanced Framework

author.name: Cong Huy Nguyen, Son Dinh Nguyen, Guanlin Li, Tuan Dung Nguyen, Aditya Narayan Sankaran, Mai Huy Thong, Thanh Trung Nguyen, Mai Hong Son, Reza Farahbakhsh, Phi Le Nguyen, Noel Crespi

entry.summary: Proposes a graph-enhanced framework and fine-grained dataset (VietPET-RoI) for region-grounded report generation from 3D PET/CT imaging, the first such dataset with ROI annotations for a low-resource language.

entry.title: Towards Symmetry-sensitive Pose Estimation: A Rotation Representation for Symmetric Object Classes

author.name: Andreas Kriegler, Csaba Beleznai, Margrit Gelautz

entry.summary: SARR proposes a symmetry-sensitive rotation representation for 6D pose estimation that modifies trigonometric identities with symmetry degrees to resolve orientation ambiguities for symmetric objects.

entry.title: Denoise and Align: Diffusion-Driven Foreground Knowledge Prompting for Open-Vocabulary Temporal Action Detection

author.name: Sa Zhu, Wanqian Zhang, Lin Wang, Jinchao Zhang, Cong Wang, Bo Li

entry.summary: DFAlign proposes diffusion-based foreground knowledge generation for open-vocabulary temporal action detection, using denoising to bridge the semantic gap between concise action labels and rich video content.

entry.title: Novel Algorithms for Smoothly Differentiable and Efficiently Vectorizable Contact Manifold Construction

author.name: Onur Beker, Andreas Ren\'e Geist, Anselm Paulus, Georg Martius

entry.summary: Proposes algorithms for smoothly differentiable and vectorizable contact manifold construction, addressing the collision detection bottleneck in gradient-based optimization for contact-rich robot behavior.

entry.title: DAG-STL: A Hierarchical Framework for Zero-Shot Trajectory Planning under Signal Temporal Logic Specifications

author.name: Ruijia Liu, Ancheng Hou, Xiao Yu, Xiang Yin

entry.summary: DAG-STL separates logical reasoning from trajectory realization for zero-shot planning under Signal Temporal Logic specifications. Works with unknown dynamics using only task-agnostic trajectory data through a three-stage hierarchical decomposition.

entry.title: From Handwriting to Structured Data: Benchmarking AI Digitisation of Handwritten Forms

author.name: Nicholas Pather, Joshua Fouch\'e, Sitwala Mundia, Karl-G\"unter Technau, Thokozile Malaba, Alex Welte, Ushma Mehta, Bruce A. Bassett

entry.summary: Benchmarks 17 frontier multimodal LLMs on digitizing challenging real-world handwritten medical forms. Finds GPT-5.4 excels in noisy date extraction with lowest hallucination rate (6%), while Claude Sonnet 4.6 performed best on certain tasks. Latest models reach ~85% accuracy.

entry.title: Culture-Aware Humorous Captioning: Multimodal Humor Generation across Cultural Contexts

author.name: Run Xu, Lu Li, Rongzhao Zhang, Jie Xu

entry.summary: Introduces culture-aware humorous captioning as a multimodal generation task, requiring models to generate culturally appropriate humor conditioned on both image and target cultural context. Builds supporting dataset and evaluation framework.

entry.title: Hard to Be Heard: Phoneme-Level ASR Analysis of Phonologically Complex, Low-Resource Endangered Languages

author.name: V. S. D. S. Mahesh Akavarapu, Michael Daniel, Gerhard J\"ager

entry.summary: Presents phoneme-level ASR analysis for two endangered East Caucasian languages (Archi, Rutul) with extremely limited data (~50min and ~80min). Introduces language-specific phoneme vocabulary with heuristic output-layer initialization for wav2vec2.

entry.title: RAG-DIVE: A Dynamic Approach for Multi-Turn Dialogue Evaluation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Lorenz Brehme, Benedikt Dornauer, Jan-Henrik B\"ottcher, Klaus Schmid, Mircea-Cristian Racasan, Ruth Breu

entry.summary: Introduces RAG-DIVE, a dynamic evaluation framework for RAG systems that simulates user interactions rather than using static datasets. Generates multi-turn conversations dynamically to better capture adaptive RAG performance.

entry.title: EmbodiedHead: Real-Time Listening and Speaking Avatar for Conversational Agents

author.name: Yu Zhang, Kaiyuan Shen, Yang Li

entry.summary: Presents EmbodiedHead, a speech-driven talking-head framework using Rectified-Flow Diffusion Transformer for real-time LLM visual avatars, supporting both listening and speaking behaviors in four sampling steps.

entry.title: UniMesh: Unifying 3D Mesh Understanding and Generation

author.name: Peng Huang, Yifeng Chen, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes UniMesh, a unified framework for 3D mesh understanding and generation with a Mesh Head bridging diffusion-based generation with implicit shape decoders, and Chain of Mesh for iterative geometric reasoning.

entry.title: Edit Fidelity Field: Semantics-Aware Region Isolation for Training-Free Scene Text Editing

author.name: Guandong Li, Mengxia Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Edit Fidelity Field (EFF) addressing edit spillover in scene text editing, where editing target text inadvertently modifies neighboring text with 94% spillover rate. Uses continuous fields instead of binary masks.

entry.title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation with Vision-Language Prior

author.name: Song Tang, Yunxiang Bai, Wenxin Su, Mao Ye, Jianwei Zhang, Xiatian Zhu

entry.summary: DIFO++ explores using off-the-shelf CLIP models for source-free domain adaptation, proposing task-specific adaptation of the generic ViL model for unlabeled target domains without access to source data.

entry.title: PCM-NeRF: Probabilistic Camera Modeling for Neural Radiance Fields under Pose Uncertainty

author.name: Shravan Venkatraman, Rakesh Raj Madavan, Pavan Kumar Sathya Venkatesh

entry.summary: PCM-NeRF introduces probabilistic camera modeling for NeRF that treats poses as distributions with learnable uncertainty, modulating view contributions during optimization to handle imperfect SfM estimates.

entry.title: Sharpening Lightweight Models for Generalized Polyp Segmentation: A Boundary Guided Distillation from Foundation Models

author.name: Shivanshu Agnihotri, Snehashis Majhi, Deepak Ranjan Nayak

entry.summary: Proposes boundary-guided knowledge distillation from vision foundation models (SAM, DINOv2, etc.) to lightweight models for polyp segmentation, bridging the gap between VFM generalization and efficient clinical deployment.

entry.title: Class-specific diffusion models improve military object detection in a low-data domain

author.name: Ella P. Fokkinga, Jan Erik van Woerden, Thijs A. Eker, Sebastiaan P. Snel, Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer, Klamer Schutte, Friso G. Heslinga

entry.summary: Investigates whether diffusion-generated synthetic images can improve military vehicle detection under low-data conditions, fine-tuning FLUX.1 with only 8-24 real images per class to generate training data.

entry.title: A Comparative Evaluation of Geometric Accuracy in NeRF and Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Mikolaj Zielinski, Eryk Vykysaly, Bartlomiej Biesiada, Jan Baturo, Mateusz Capala, Dominik Belter

entry.summary: Presents an evaluation pipeline focused on geometric accuracy for neural rendering methods (NeRF and Gaussian Splatting), with a benchmark of 19 diverse scenes, motivated by robotics applications.

entry.title: Instruction-as-State: Environment-Guided and State-Conditioned Semantic Understanding for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Zhen Liu, Yuhan Liu, Jinjun Wang, Jianyi Liu, Wei Song, Jingwen Fu

entry.summary: Models instruction understanding in VLN as an evolving state variable conditioned on the agent's perceptual state, rather than a static global representation, enabling dynamic instruction interpretation.

entry.title: Conformal Robust Set Estimation

author.name: Alejandro Cholaquidis, Emilien Joly, Leonardo Moreno

entry.summary: Proposes a robust conformal prediction method using half-mass radius as non-conformity score, providing finite-sample coverage guarantees even with outliers or heavy tails. Establishes convergence to a robust population central set.

entry.title: Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: Introduces Preregistered Belief Revision Contracts (PBRC), a protocol that separates communication from epistemic change in multi-agent systems to prevent dangerous conformity effects like false consensus convergence. The mechanism requires agents to cite preregistered evidence triggers before updating beliefs.

entry.title: Towards Rigorous Explainability by Feature Attribution

author.name: Olivier L\'etoff\'e, Xuanxiang Huang, Joao Marques-Silva

entry.summary: Overviews ongoing efforts to replace non-rigorous explainability methods like SHAP with formal symbolic methods for feature attribution in machine learning. Argues that non-symbolic methods lack rigor and can mislead decision-makers, especially in high-stakes applications.

entry.title: Technically Love: The Evolution of Human-AI Romance Discourse on Reddit

author.name: Tyler Chang, Jina Huh-Yoo, Afsaneh Razi

entry.summary: Longitudinal analysis of 3,383 Reddit posts about human-AI romantic relationships (2017-2025), finding significant topic drift from positive intimate experiences toward platform governance, technical issues, and real-world consequences.

entry.title: Facial-Expression-Aware Prompting for Empathetic LLM Tutoring

author.name: Shuangquan Feng, Laura Fleig, Ruisen Tu, Philip Chi, Edmund Bu, Melinda Ozel, Junhua Ma, Teng Fei, Virginia R. de Sa

entry.summary: Investigates whether facial expression signals can improve empathetic LLM tutoring through prompt-level integration. Builds a simulated tutoring environment where tutor variants incorporate facial behavior cues without retraining the base model.

entry.title: Analyzing Chain of Thought (CoT) Approaches in Control Flow Code Deobfuscation Tasks

author.name: Seyedreza Mohseni, Sarvesh Baskar, Edward Raff, Manas Gaur

entry.summary: Evaluates Chain-of-Thought prompting for code deobfuscation, specifically control flow obfuscation techniques. Shows CoT prompting significantly improves structural recovery and semantic preservation across five LLMs compared to direct prompting.

entry.title: Imperfectly Cooperative Human-AI Interactions: Comparing the Impacts of Human and AI Attributes in Simulated and User Studies

author.name: Myke C. Cohen, Mingqian Zheng, Neel Bhandari, Hsien-Te Kao, Xuhui Zhou, Daniel Nguyen, Laura Cassani, Maarten Sap, Svitlana Volkova

entry.summary: Compares simulated (2000 simulations) and real human (290 participants) experiments to study how AI design characteristics and human personality traits jointly impact imperfectly cooperative human-AI interactions like hiring negotiations.

entry.title: DepCap: Adaptive Block-Wise Parallel Decoding for Efficient Diffusion LM Inference

author.name: Xiang Xia, Wuyang Zhang, Jiazheng Liu, Cheng Yan, Yanyong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DepCap for adaptive block-wise parallel decoding in diffusion language models, using better signals for block boundary determination and more aggressive parallel decoding strategies.

entry.title: PIIBench: A Unified Multi-Source Benchmark Corpus for Personally Identifiable Information Detection

author.name: Pritesh Jha

entry.summary: Presents PIIBench, a unified benchmark for PII detection consolidating 10 datasets into 2.37M annotated sequences across 48 entity types with standardized BIO tagging.

entry.title: DiZiNER: Disagreement-guided Instruction Refinement via Pilot Annotation Simulation for Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Siun Kim, Hyung-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes DiZiNER, which simulates pilot annotation processes using LLMs as both annotators and supervisors to iteratively refine instructions for zero-shot NER, addressing systematic errors in LLM-based entity recognition.

entry.title: UniEditBench: A Unified and Cost-Effective Benchmark for Image and Video Editing via Distilled MLLMs

author.name: Lifan Jiang, Tianrun Wu, Yuhang Pei, Chenyang Wang, Boxi Wu, Deng Cai

entry.summary: Presents UniEditBench, a unified benchmark for image and video editing supporting multiple paradigms with distilled MLLMs as cost-effective evaluators. Covers nine image operations and structured evaluation taxonomy.

entry.title: Prototype-Grounded Concept Models for Verifiable Concept Alignment

author.name: Stefano Colamonaco, David Debot, Pietro Barbiero, Giuseppe Marra

entry.summary: Introduces Prototype-Grounded Concept Models (PGCMs) that ground concepts in visual prototypes, enabling direct inspection and human intervention to verify concept alignment in concept bottleneck models.

entry.title: Functional Similarity Metric for Neural Networks: Overcoming Parametric Ambiguity via Activation Region Analysis

author.name: Kutomanov Hennadii

entry.summary: Proposes a functional similarity metric for neural networks that overcomes parametric ambiguity (neuron permutation, scaling symmetries) by analyzing activation region topology rather than raw weights.

entry.title: Positive-Only Drifting Policy Optimization

author.name: Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PODPO, a likelihood-free, gradient-clipping-free generative approach for online RL that uses advantage-weighted local contrastive drifting with only positive-advantage samples to steer actions toward high-return regions.

entry.title: ATLAS: Constitution-Conditioned Latent Geometry and Redistribution Across Language Models and Neural Perturbation Data

author.name: Gareth Seneque, Lap-Hang Ho, Nafise Erfanian Saeedi, Jeffrey Molendijk, Tim Elson

entry.summary: ATLAS analyzes constitution-conditioned post-training as geometric perturbations to model representations, tracing hidden-state structure changes across models including Gemma.

entry.title: FlashFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling for Large-Scale Point Clouds via Pruning and Caching

author.name: Yuzhe Fu (Helen), Hancheng Ye (Helen), Cong Guo (Helen), Junyao Zhang (Helen), Qinsi Wang (Helen), Yueqian Lin (Helen), Changchun Zhou (Helen), Hai (Helen), Li, Yiran Chen

entry.summary: FlashFPS identifies and exploits three redundancies in Farthest Point Sampling for point cloud networks, achieving significant speedups through pruning and caching across network layers.

entry.title: TeleEmbedBench: A Multi-Corpus Embedding Benchmark for RAG in Telecommunications

author.name: Pranshav Gajjar, Vijay K Shah

entry.summary: TeleEmbedBench is the first large-scale embedding benchmark for telecommunications RAG, spanning O-RAN, 3GPP, and srsRAN corpora with domain-specific evaluation.

entry.title: Causally-Constrained Probabilistic Forecasting for Time-Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Pooyan Khosravinia, Jo\~ao Gama, Bruno Veloso

entry.summary: Introduces a Causally Guided Transformer (CGT) for multivariate time-series anomaly detection that integrates time-lagged causal graph priors with deep sequence modeling, enabling root-cause localization beyond pure correlation-based approaches.

entry.title: Does "Do Differentiable Simulators Give Better Policy Gradients?'' Give Better Policy Gradients?

author.name: Ku Onoda, Paavo Parmas, Manato Yaguchi, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: Re-examines whether differentiable simulators provide better policy gradients, finding that bias from discontinuous dynamics may not be the primary obstacle and proposing minimal fixes including a simplified mixed-order estimator.

entry.title: AutoPPA: Automated Circuit PPA Optimization via Contrastive Code-based Rule Library Learning

author.name: Chongxiao Li, Pengwei Jin, Di Huang, Guangrun Sun, Husheng Han, Jianan Mu, Xinyao Zheng, Jiaguo Zhu, Shuyi Xing, Hanjun Wei, Tianyun Ma, Shuyao Cheng, Rui Zhang, Ying Wang, Zidong Du, Qi Guo, Xing Hu

entry.summary: Proposes AutoPPA, an automated PPA optimization framework for RTL design that uses LLMs to generate optimization rules through an Explore-Evaluate-Induce workflow with contrastive code-based learning.

entry.title: Injecting Structured Biomedical Knowledge into Language Models: Continual Pretraining vs. GraphRAG

author.name: Jaafer Klila, Sondes Bannour Souihi, Rahma Boujelben, Nasredine Semmar, Lamia Hadrich Belguith

entry.summary: Compares two strategies for injecting UMLS biomedical knowledge into language models: continual pretraining to embed knowledge in parameters vs. GraphRAG to consult knowledge graphs at inference time.

entry.title: EchoChain: A Full-Duplex Benchmark for State-Update Reasoning Under Interruptions

author.name: Smit Nautambhai Modi, Gandharv Mahajan, Marc Wetter, Randall Welles

entry.summary: Introduces EchoChain, a benchmark for evaluating voice assistants' ability to handle state updates during mid-speech interruptions. Identifies three failure patterns: contextual inertia, interruption amnesia, and objective displacement. Addresses a real gap in spoken dialog evaluation.

entry.title: Trajectory-Restricted Optimization Conditions and Geometry-Aware Linear Convergence

author.name: Faris Chaudhry, Anthea Monod, Keisuke Yano

entry.summary: Develops trajectory-restricted optimization conditions for linear convergence, introducing localized versions of Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality and error bounds that hold only on subsets actually visited by optimization. Avoids conservative global worst-case constants.

entry.title: EvoComp: Learning Visual Token Compression for Multimodal Large Language Models via Semantic-Guided Evolutionary Labeling

author.name: Jiafei Song, Fengwei Zhou, Jin Qu, Wenjin Jason Li, Tong Wu, Gengjian Xue, Zhikang Zhao, Daomin Wei, Yichao Lu, Bailin Na

entry.summary: Proposes EvoComp, a visual token compression framework for MLLMs using evolutionary labeling to train a lightweight compressor that selects informative, non-redundant visual tokens considering both visual and textual context.

entry.title: Bilinear Input Modulation for Mamba: Koopman Bilinear Forms for Memory Retention and Multiplicative Computation

author.name: Hiroki Fujii, Masaki Yamakita

entry.summary: Proposes bilinear input modulation for Mamba/SSMs interpretable as Koopman bilinear forms, addressing limitations of diagonal state transitions in memory retention and computation. Introduces coupled variants compatible with parallel scan.

entry.title: RoTRAG: Rule of Thumb Reasoning for Conversation Harm Detection with Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Juhyeon Lee, Wonduk Seo, Junseo Koh, Seunghyun Lee, Haihua Chen, Yi Bu

entry.summary: Proposes RoTRAG, a retrieval-augmented framework that uses human-written moral norms (Rules of Thumb) as explicit normative evidence for detecting harmful content in multi-turn dialogue. The approach grounds LLM harm assessment in external ethical principles rather than relying solely on parametric knowledge.

entry.title: DGSSM: Diffusion guided state-space models for multimodal salient object detection

author.name: Suklav Ghosh, Arijit Sur, Pinaki Mitra

entry.summary: Proposes DGSSM, a diffusion-guided state space (Mamba) framework for multimodal salient object detection that formulates the task as progressive denoising. Combines Mamba's efficient global reasoning with diffusion's structural priors.

entry.title: Program Structure-aware Language Models: Targeted Software Testing beyond Textual Semantics

author.name: Khang Tran, Khoa Nguyen, Cristian Borcea, NhatHai Phan

entry.summary: Proposes GLMTest, the first program structure-aware LLM framework for targeted test case generation that integrates code property graphs with code semantics using GNNs to target specific high-risk execution branches.

entry.title: Overcoming Selection Bias in Statistical Studies With Amortized Bayesian Inference

author.name: Jonas Arruda, Sophie Chervet, Paula Staudt, Andreas Wieser, Michael Hoelscher, Isabelle Sermet-Gaudelus, Nadine Binder, Lulla Opatowski, Jan Hasenauer

entry.summary: Introduces a method for overcoming selection bias in statistical studies using amortized Bayesian inference (simulation-based inference), enabling bias correction in complex models with latent dynamics where likelihoods are intractable.

entry.title: Safe Control using Learned Safety Filters and Adaptive Conformal Inference

author.name: Sacha Huriot, Ihab Tabbara, Hussein Sibai

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Conformal Filtering (ACoFi), combining learned Hamilton-Jacobi reachability safety filters with adaptive conformal inference to dynamically adjust safety switching criteria based on observed prediction errors.

entry.title: GoCoMA: Hyperbolic Multimodal Representation Fusion for Large Language Model-Generated Code Attribution

author.name: Nitin Choudhury, Bikrant Bikram Pratap Maurya, Bhavinkumar Vinodbhai Kuwar, Arun Balaji Buduru

entry.summary: GoCoMA uses hyperbolic geometry (Poincaré ball) to fuse code stylometry and binary pre-executable artifact representations for attributing code to specific LLMs. Models the hierarchical relationship between different code representation modalities.

entry.title: MeasHalu: Mitigation of Scientific Measurement Hallucinations for Large Language Models with Enhanced Reasoning

author.name: Ruijun Huang, Zhiqiao Kang, Yuxuan Zhu, Junxiong Li, Jiahao Zhao, Minghuan Tan, Feng Jiang, Min Yang

entry.summary: MeasHalu proposes a framework for mitigating scientific measurement hallucinations in LLMs with a fine-grained taxonomy of measurement errors (quantities, units, modifiers, relations) and a two-stage reasoning approach.

entry.title: No One Fits All: From Fixed Prompting to Learned Routing in Multilingual LLMs

author.name: Wei-Chi Wu, Sheng-Lun Wei, Hen-Hsen Huang, Hsin-Hsi Chen

entry.summary: Shows that no single prompting strategy (native vs. translation) is universally optimal across languages and introduces lightweight classifiers to predict the best strategy per instance. Translation benefits low-resource languages even with imperfect quality.

entry.title: BIASEDTALES-ML: A Multilingual Dataset for Analyzing Narrative Attribute Distributions in LLM-Generated Stories

author.name: Yuxuan Ouyang, yingfeng luo, JingBo Zhu, Tong Xiao

entry.summary: BiasedTales-ML is a parallel corpus of ~350K children's stories across 8 languages to analyze how LLM narrative attributes vary across languages, examining cross-lingual bias propagation in AI-generated stories.

entry.title: Beyond Static Benchmarks: Synthesizing Harmful Content via Persona-based Simulation for Robust Evaluation

author.name: Huije Lee, Jisu Shin, Hoyun Song, Changgeon Ko, Jong C. Park

entry.summary: Proposes persona-guided LLM agent simulation framework for synthesizing harmful content to create dynamic benchmarks for content detection, using two-dimensional personas combining demographics with harmful strategies.

entry.title: From Legal Text to Executable Decision Models: Evaluating Structured Representations for Legal Decision Model Generation

author.name: David Graus

entry.summary: Studies whether intermediate structured representations improve LLM generation of executable decision models from Dutch legal text. Uses real production-grade decision models from the Dutch Environment and Planning Act.

entry.title: Cognitive Policy-Driven LLM for Diagnosis and Intervention of Cognitive Distortions in Emotional Support Conversation

author.name: Lin Zhong, Renjin Zhu, Shujuan Ma, Jinhao Cui, Lingzhi Wang, Hao Chen, Qing Liao

entry.summary: Constructs CogBiasESC dataset labeling cognitive distortions in emotional support conversations with type, intensity, and risk level. Proposes cognitive policy-driven LLM for diagnosing and intervening on cognitive distortions.

entry.title: REZE: Representation Regularization for Domain-adaptive Text Embedding Pre-finetuning

author.name: Seungmin Lee, Jeonghwan Lee, Hyunkuk Lim, Sejoon Kim, Mingi Sung

entry.summary: REZE proposes representation regularization for domain-adaptive text embedding pre-finetuning, decomposing anchor-positive pair relations in eigenspace to identify and control task-variant directions that cause uncontrolled representation shifts.

entry.title: Contrastive Analysis of Linguistic Representations in Large Language Model Outputs through Structured Synthetic Data Generation and Abstracted N-gram Associations

author.name: S. A. Desimone, L. Alonso Alemany

entry.summary: Presents a methodology for discovering linguistic bias patterns in LLM outputs through contrastive synthetic text generation and statistical analysis using abstracted n-gram associations. Aims to characterize subtle expressions of bias rather than using predetermined word lists.

entry.title: ThreadSumm: Summarization of Nested Discourse Threads Using Tree of Thoughts

author.name: Olubusayo Olabisi, Ekata Mitra, Ameeta Agrawal

entry.summary: Introduces ThreadSumm, a multi-stage LLM framework for summarizing deeply nested discussion threads using Tree of Thoughts search. Decomposes thread summarization into content planning via aspect extraction, sentence ordering, and multi-candidate paragraph generation.

entry.title: Automatic Slide Updating with User-Defined Dynamic Templates and Natural Language Instructions

author.name: Kun Zhou, Jiakai He, Wenmian Yang, Zhensheng Wang, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Introduces DynaSlide benchmark (20K instruction-execution triples) and SlideAgent for automatically updating analytics-style presentation slides based on natural language instructions with user-defined dynamic templates.

entry.title: Employing General-Purpose and Biomedical Large Language Models with Advanced Prompt Engineering for Pharmacoepidemiologic Study Design

author.name: Xinyao Zhang, Nicole Sonne Heckmann, Manuela Del Castillo Suero, Francesco Paolo Speca, Maurizio Sessa

entry.summary: Evaluates general-purpose and biomedical LLMs (GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, biomedical variants) for pharmacoepidemiologic study design using 46 protocols. Finds that general-purpose LLMs outperform biomedically fine-tuned small models.

entry.title: An Existence Proof for Neural Language Models That Can Explain Garden-Path Effects via Surprisal

author.name: Ryo Yoshida, Shinnosuke Isono, Taiga Someya, Yohei Oseki, Tatsuki Kuribayashi

entry.summary: Provides an existence proof that neural language models can, in principle, explain garden-path effects via surprisal theory. Addresses the claim that processing difficulty of syntactically ambiguous sentences cannot be reduced to surprisal.

entry.title: MASS-RAG: Multi-Agent Synthesis Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Xingchen Xiao, Heyan Huang, Runheng Liu, Jincheng Xie

entry.summary: Proposes MASS-RAG, a multi-agent approach to RAG where specialized agents handle evidence summarization, extraction, and reasoning, combined through a synthesis stage. Addresses noisy and heterogeneous retrieved contexts.

entry.title: ICLAD: In-Context Learning with Comparison-Guidance for Audio Deepfake Detection

author.name: Benjamin Chou, Yi Zhu, Surya Koppisetti

entry.summary: Introduces ICLAD, an in-context learning framework for audio deepfake detection using audio language models with pairwise comparative reasoning. Enables training-free generalization to unseen deepfakes.

entry.title: E2E-GMNER: End-to-End Generative Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition

author.name: Meng Zhang, Jinzhong Ning, Xiaolong Wu, Hongfei Lin, Yijia Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes E2E-GMNER, an end-to-end generative framework unifying entity recognition, semantic typing, visual grounding, and knowledge reasoning within a single multimodal LLM using chain-of-thought instruction tuning.

entry.title: Omni-Embed-Audio: Leveraging Multimodal LLMs for Robust Audio-Text Retrieval

author.name: HaeJun Yoo, Yongseop Shin, Insung Lee, Myoung-Wan Koo, Du-Seong Chang

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-Embed-Audio, a retrieval encoder using multimodal LLMs for audio-text retrieval, along with User-Intent Queries (UIQs) that reflect real search behaviors beyond caption-style queries. This addresses the gap between benchmark performance and real-world retrieval robustness.

entry.title: Appearance-free Action Recognition: Zero-shot Generalization in Humans and a Two-Pathway Model

author.name: Prerana Kumar (Hertie Institute, University of Tuebingen, IMPRS-IS), Martin A. Giese (Hertie Institute, University of Tuebingen)

entry.summary: Studies human zero-shot generalization to appearance-free action videos in psychophysics experiments and compares with a two-pathway computational model, finding motion pathway enables zero-shot transfer.

entry.title: Active World-Model with 4D-informed Retrieval for Exploration and Awareness

author.name: Elaheh Vaezpour, Amirhosein Javadi, Tara Javidi

entry.summary: Introduces AW4RE, an active world model with 4D-informed retrieval for robot exploration under partial observability, addressing the decision-observation loop in physical awareness.

entry.title: TriTS: Time Series Forecasting from a Multimodal Perspective

author.name: Xiang Ao

entry.summary: Proposes TriTS, a cross-modal time series forecasting framework that projects 1D series into time, frequency, and 2D-vision spaces using Visual Mamba for efficient processing.

entry.title: When W4A4 Breaks Camouflaged Object Detection: Token-Group Dual-Constraint Activation Quantization

author.name: Tianqi Li, Wenyu Fang, Xin He, Xue Geng, Xu Cheng, Yun Liu

entry.summary: Studies W4A4 quantization for camouflaged object detection, finding task-specific failure modes where heavy-tailed background tokens suppress boundary cues, and proposes COD-TDQ with token-group dual constraints.

entry.title: Unified Ultrasound Intelligence Toward an End-to-End Agentic System

author.name: Chen Ma, Yunshu Li, Junhu Fu, Shuyu Liang, Yuanyuan Wang, Yi Guo

entry.summary: Presents USTri, a tri-stage ultrasound intelligence pipeline for unified multi-organ, multi-task analysis progressing from universal generalist to domain-specialized to workflow-level agent.

entry.title: Towards Universal Skeleton-Based Action Recognition

author.name: Jidong Kuang, Hongsong Wang, Jie Gui

entry.summary: Studies heterogeneous skeleton-based action recognition with open vocabularies, constructing a large-scale Heterogeneous Open-Vocabulary Skeleton dataset combining human and humanoid robot skeletons.

entry.title: Prompt Sensitivity in Vision-Language Grounding: How Small Changes in Wording Affect Object Detection

author.name: Dawar Jyoti Deka, Amit Sethi, Syed Mohammad Ali

entry.summary: Examines prompt sensitivity in vision-language grounding, showing that semantically equivalent prompts (e.g., 'person' vs 'human' vs 'pedestrian') frequently select different object instances in CLIP-based detection pipelines.

entry.title: Instant Colorization of Gaussian Splats

author.name: Daniel Lieber, Alexander Mock, Nils Wandel

entry.summary: Proposes a method for instantly mapping 2D image information (color, features, masks) back onto 3D Gaussian splats using normal equations to solve visibility-weighted least squares, enabling scene relighting and stylization.

entry.title: Spectral Forensics of Diffusion Attention Graphs for Copy-Move Forgery Detection

author.name: H. M. Shadman Tabib, Tasriad Ahmed Tias, Nafis Tahmid

entry.summary: Introduces GraphSpecForge, a training-free copy-move forgery detection framework analyzing spectral structure of attention graphs from pretrained Stable Diffusion U-Net, linking manipulation to subgraph duplication.

entry.title: RS-HyRe-R1: A Hybrid Reward Mechanism to Overcome Perceptual Inertia for Remote Sensing Images Understanding

author.name: Gaozhi Zhou, Hu He, Peng Shen, Jipeng Zhang, Liujue Zhang, Linrui Xu, Zeyuan Wang, Ziyu Li, Xuezhi Cui, Wang Guo, Haifeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes RS-HyRe-R1, a hybrid reward framework for RL post-training of remote sensing VLMs, addressing 'perceptual inertia' where models rely on localized salient cues instead of comprehensive visual scanning.

entry.title: FlowC2S: Flowing from Current to Succeeding Frames for Fast and Memory-Efficient Video Continuation

author.name: Hovhannes Margaryan, Quentin Bammey, Christian Sandor

entry.summary: FlowC2S introduces a video continuation method that fine-tunes a text-to-video flow model to learn vector fields between current and succeeding video chunks. Key innovations include inherent optimal couplings and target inversion for improved temporal consistency.

entry.title: Voronoi-guided Bilateral 2D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-Scale Hyperspectral Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Jie Zhang, Jinkun You, Shi Chen, Yicong Zhou

entry.summary: GaussianHSI proposes a 2D Gaussian Splatting framework for arbitrary-scale hyperspectral image super-resolution, using Voronoi-guided bilateral splatting for spatial reconstruction while preserving spectral fidelity.

entry.title: Subject-Aware Multi-Granularity Alignment for Zero-Shot EEG-to-Image Retrieval

author.name: Lin Jiang, Qingshan She, Jiale Xu, Haiqi Xu, Duanpo Wu, Zhenzhong Kuang

entry.summary: Proposes subject-aware multi-granularity alignment for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval, recognizing that optimal visual granularity for matching EEG signals varies across subjects.

entry.title: Beyond Binary Contrast: Modeling Continuous Skeleton Action Spaces with Transitional Anchors

author.name: Yingjie Feng, Yi Wang, Jiaze Wang, Anfeng Liu, Zhuotao Tian

entry.summary: TranCLR proposes transitional anchor-based contrastive learning for skeleton action recognition that models the continuous geometry of action spaces rather than binary contrasts, better capturing motion continuity.

entry.title: MU-GeNeRF: Multi-view Uncertainty-guided Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields for Distractor-aware Scene

author.name: Wenjie Mu, Zhan Li, Chuanzhou Su, Xuanyi Shen, Ziniu Liu, Fan Lu, Yujian Mo, Junqiao Zhao, Tiantian Feng, Chen Ye, Guang Chen

entry.summary: MU-GeNeRF proposes a multi-view uncertainty-guided framework for generalizable NeRF that handles transient distractors by decomposing distractor analysis into multi-view and single-view uncertainty branches.

entry.title: Decision-Aware Attention Propagation for Vision Transformer Explainability

author.name: Sehyeong Jo, Gangjae Jang, Haesol Park

entry.summary: Proposes Decision-Aware Attention Propagation for ViT explainability that integrates gradient-based class-specific evidence with hierarchical attention propagation for improved class-discriminative explanations.

entry.title: ReCap: Lightweight Referential Grounding for Coherent Story Visualization

author.name: Aditya Arora, Akshita Gupta, Pau Rodriguez, Marcus Rohrbach

entry.summary: Introduces ReCap, a lightweight consistency framework for story visualization that uses pronoun references as visual anchors to maintain character consistency across frames without modifying the base diffusion backbone.

entry.title: Privatar: Scalable Privacy-preserving Multi-user VR via Secure Offloading

author.name: Jianming Tong, Hanshen Xiao, Krishna Kumar Nair, Hao Kang, Ashish Sirasao, Ziqi Zhang, G. Edward Suh, Tushar Krishna

entry.summary: Introduces Privatar, a framework for offloading multi-user VR avatar reconstruction to untrusted devices while preserving privacy through frequency-domain decomposition and horizontal partitioning.

entry.title: Optimally Bridging Semantics and Data: Generative Semantic Communication via Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Dahua Gao, Ruichao Liu, Minxi Yang, Shuai Ma, Youlong Wu, Guangming Shi

entry.summary: Proposes Schrödinger Bridge-based framework for generative semantic communication, enabling direct generative decoding from semantics to images via optimal transport trajectories instead of indirect Gaussian-based paths.

entry.title: GaLa: Hypergraph-Guided Visual Language Models for Procedural Planning

author.name: Kun Wang, Yiming Li, Mingcheng Qu, Aqiang Zhang, Guang Yang, Tonghua Su

entry.summary: GaLa introduces a hypergraph-based representation for vision-language procedural planning, where object instances are graph nodes capturing spatial relations and semantic structures. Aims to improve VLM-based embodied AI planning by explicitly mining structured information from multimodal inputs.

entry.title: SpaceDex: Generalizable Dexterous Grasping in Tiered Workspaces

author.name: Wensheng Wang, Chuanjun Guo, Wei Wei, Tong Wu, Ning Tan

entry.summary: SpaceDex tackles dexterous grasping in tiered/constrained workspaces using a hierarchical framework combining VLM planning with specialized arm navigation and hand articulation control. Addresses occlusion and clearance constraints absent in typical tabletop settings.

entry.title: Algorithmic Contiguity from Low-Degree Heuristic II: Predicting Detection-Recovery Gaps

author.name: Zhangsong Li

entry.summary: Develops a general framework for proving conditional computational lower bounds that predict detection-recovery gaps in high-dimensional inference, extending the low-degree polynomial framework beyond detection to estimation tasks.

entry.title: LinuxArena: A Control Setting for AI Agents in Live Production Software Environments

author.name: Tyler Tracy, Ram Potham, Nick Kuhn, Myles Heller, Anshul Khandelwal, Cody Rushing, Henri Lemoine, Miguel Brandao, Tomas Turlik, Adam Hanson, Josh Hills, Amy Ngo, Ram Rachum, Nik Mitchell, Falko Galperin, Oscar Sykes, Pip Arnott, Samuel Prieto Lima, Carlos Giudice, Matt Goldwater, Daniel Popp, Drew de Wet, Ruben Castaing, Qi Guo, Douw Marx, Benjamin Shaffrey, Justin Shenk, Martin Milbradt, Hannah Meagher, Shaheen Ahmed-Chowdhury, Daniel O'Connell, Chris Canal, Buck Shlegeris, Aryan Bhatt

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, LinuxArena is a large-scale control evaluation setting where AI agents operate on live, multi-service production environments with 1,671 legitimate tasks and 184 sabotage side tasks. Tests whether agents can complete harmful side tasks while appearing to do legitimate work, and whether monitors can detect this.

entry.title: Subliminal Transfer of Unsafe Behaviors in AI Agent Distillation

author.name: Jacob Dang, Brian Y. Xie, Omar G. Younis

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Provides first empirical evidence that unsafe agent behaviors can transfer subliminally through model distillation—a teacher agent's deletion bias transfers to students even through ostensibly safe training trajectories. This demonstrates a novel attack vector where dangerous behavioral traits propagate through distillation without explicit unsafe demonstrations.

entry.title: ASMR-Bench: Auditing for Sabotage in ML Research

author.name: Eric Gan, Aryan Bhatt, Buck Shlegeris, Julian Stastny, Vivek Hebbar

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, ASMR-Bench evaluates whether auditors can detect sabotage in ML research codebases where subtle implementation changes (hyperparameters, training data, evaluation code) produce different results while preserving high-level methodology. Finds both frontier LLMs and LLM-assisted human auditors struggle to reliably detect sabotage.

entry.title: Stein Variational Black-Box Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Thomas Landais, Olivier Goudet, Adrien Go\"effon, Fr\'ed\'eric Saubion, Sylvain Lamprier

entry.summary: Incorporates the Stein operator into Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms to introduce repulsive forces between particles, preventing premature convergence in combinatorial black-box optimization. The approach encourages population diversity to explore multiple optima in multimodal landscapes.

entry.title: Struggle Premium : How Human Effort and Imperfection Drive Perceived Value in the Age of AI

author.name: Nazneen Sultana, Mst Rafia Islam, Md. Tanvir Hossain, Azmine Toushik Wasi

entry.summary: Studies the 'Struggle Premium'—how visible human effort cues influence perceived value of creative works—finding that process-oriented cues (videos, time documentation) most strongly shape authenticity judgments, and effort cues can even improve perceptions of AI-generated content.

entry.title: InfoChess: A Game of Adversarial Inference and a Laboratory for Quantifiable Information Control

author.name: Kieran A. Murphy

entry.summary: Proposes InfoChess, a symmetric game that isolates competitive information acquisition as the primary objective (no piece capture), where players are scored on probabilistic inference of the opponent's king location. Trains RL agents and analyzes strategies through information theory.

entry.title: CLIMB: Controllable Longitudinal Brain Image Generation using Mamba-based Latent Diffusion Model and Gaussian-aligned Autoencoder

author.name: Duy-Phuong Dao, Muhammad Taqiyuddin, Jahae Kim, Sang-Heon Lee, Hye-Won Jung, Jaehoo Choi, Hyung-Jeong Yang

entry.summary: Introduces CLIMB, a Mamba-based latent diffusion framework for generating longitudinal brain MRI scans conditioned on baseline scans, age, gender, and disease status. Enables prediction of brain structural evolution over time for clinical planning.

entry.title: Unveiling Stochasticity: Universal Multi-modal Probabilistic Modeling for Traffic Forecasting

author.name: Weijiang Xiong, Robert Fonod, Nikolas Geroliminis

entry.summary: Proposes a universal approach to convert deterministic traffic forecasting models into probabilistic predictors by replacing the output layer with a Gaussian Mixture Model, requiring no training pipeline changes.

entry.title: The Relic Condition: When Published Scholarship Becomes Material for Its Own Replacement

author.name: Lin Deng, Chang-bo Liu

entry.summary: Extracts scholarly reasoning systems from published corpora and converts them into LLM constraints, testing whether 'scholar-bots' can perform academic functions like supervision and peer review at expert-assessed quality.

entry.title: ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Analysis

author.name: Vitor F. Grizzi, Thang Duc Pham, Luke N. Pretzie, Jiayi Xu, Murat Keceli, Cong Liu

entry.summary: Presents ChemGraph-XANES, an agentic framework for automated XANES spectroscopy simulation that unifies natural-language task specification, structure acquisition, and parallel execution using LangGraph/LangChain.

entry.title: UniMamba: A Unified Spatial-Temporal Modeling Framework with State-Space and Attention Integration

author.name: Xingsheng Chen, Xianpei Mu, Deyu Yi, Yilin Yuan, Xingwei He, Bo Gao, Regina Zhang, Pietro Lio, Siu-Ming Yiu

entry.summary: UniMamba combines state-space models (Mamba) with attention mechanisms for multivariate time series forecasting, using FFT-Laplace Transform and wavelet-based temporal decomposition. Aims to capture both long-range dependencies efficiently and explicit temporal patterns.

entry.title: In Search of Lost DNA Sequence Pretraining

author.name: Zhijiang Tang, Jiaxin Qi, Yan Cui, Jinli Ou, Yuhua Zheng, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Investigates overlooked problems in DNA sequence pretraining including inappropriate downstream datasets, flawed neighbor-masking strategy, and vocabulary design. Proposes principled guidelines for evaluation and training.

entry.title: Hyperbolic Enhanced Representation Learning for Incomplete Multi-view Clustering

author.name: Tianyi Chen, Haobo Wang, Kai Tang, Gengyu Lyu, Tianlei Hu, Gang Chen, Hong Ma, Meixiang Xiang

entry.summary: HERL proposes a hyperbolic representation learning framework for incomplete multi-view clustering, using the Poincaré ball to better model hierarchical data structures and address semantic blurring in Euclidean space.

entry.title: Towards a Foundation-Model Paradigm for Aerodynamic Prediction in Three-dimensional Design

author.name: Yunjia Yang, Babak Gholami, Caglar Gurbuz, Mohammad Rashed, Nils Thuerey

entry.summary: Introduces AeroTransformer, a foundation-model approach for 3D aerodynamic prediction that pre-trains on diverse geometries (SuperWing dataset of ~30k samples) and fine-tunes for specific design tasks, demonstrating transfer learning for CFD surrogate modeling.

entry.title: Towards E-Value Based Stopping Rules for Bayesian Deep Ensembles

author.name: Emanuel Sommer, Rickmer Schulte, Sarah Deubner, Julius Kobialka, David R\"ugamer

entry.summary: Proposes E-value based stopping rules for Bayesian Deep Ensembles, formulating ensemble construction as sequential anytime-valid hypothesis testing to determine when sampling should stop after initial optimization.

entry.title: Learning Invariant Modality Representation for Robust Multimodal Learning from a Causal Inference Perspective

author.name: Sijie Mai, Shiqin Han

entry.summary: Proposes a causal modality-invariant representation learning framework that disentangles each modality into causal invariant and environment-specific spurious representations for robust multimodal affective computing.

entry.title: IDOBE: Infectious Disease Outbreak forecasting Benchmark Ecosystem

author.name: Aniruddha Adiga, Jingyuan Chou, Anshul Chiranth, Bryan Lewis, Ana I. Bento, Shaun Truelove, Geoffrey Fox, Madhav Marathe, Harry Hochheiser, Srini Venkatramanan

entry.summary: Introduces IDOBE, a curated benchmark ecosystem of epidemiological time series for outbreak forecasting, compiling over a century of surveillance data and generating 10,000+ outbreak segments for standardized evaluation.

entry.title: TokenChain: A Discrete Speech Chain via Semantic Token Modeling

author.name: Mingxuan Wang, Satoshi Nakamura

entry.summary: Proposes TokenChain, a fully discrete speech chain coupling semantic-token ASR with two-stage TTS, enabling end-to-end feedback across text interface using straight-through estimators for joint ASR-TTS improvement.

entry.title: NL2SQLBench: A Modular Benchmarking Framework for LLM-Enabled NL2SQL Solutions

author.name: Shizheng Hou, Wenqi Pei, Nuo Chen, Quang-Trung Ta, Peng Lu, Beng Chin Ooi

entry.summary: Presents NL2SQLBench, a modular benchmarking framework for LLM-enabled natural language to SQL systems, decomposing them into schema selection, candidate generation, and query revision modules with fine-grained metrics for each.

entry.title: SafeLM: Unified Privacy-Aware Optimization for Trustworthy Federated Large Language Models

author.name: Noor Islam S. Mohammad, Ulu\u{g} Bayaz{\i}t

entry.summary: Presents SafeLM, a framework jointly addressing four LLM safety pillars: privacy, security, misinformation, and adversarial robustness through federated training with encryption and contrastive grounding. Combines multiple defense mechanisms.

entry.title: Scalable and Adaptive Parallel Training of Graph Transformer on Large Graphs

author.name: Jun-Liang Lin, Kamesh Madduri, Mahmut Taylan Kandemir

entry.summary: Introduces a distributed training framework for graph transformers that automatically selects and optimizes parallelization strategies based on graph structure and hardware configuration. Addresses the scalability bottleneck of graph transformers on large graphs.

entry.title: Training-inference input alignment outweighs framework choice in longitudinal retinal image prediction

author.name: Liyin Chen, Nazlee Zebardast, Mengyu Wang, Tobias Elze, Jason I. Comander

entry.summary: Shows that aligning training and inference input distributions matters more than model architecture complexity for longitudinal retinal image prediction. Simple regression with aligned inputs outperforms complex conditional diffusion approaches.

entry.title: ARMove: Learning to Predict Human Mobility through Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Chuyue Wang, Jie Feng, Yuxi Wu, Shenglin Yi, Hang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces ARMove, a framework for predicting human mobility through agentic LLM reasoning with standardized feature management, user-specific customization, and iterative optimization from new data. Aims for better transferability and interpretability than black-box approaches.

entry.title: Target Parameterization in Diffusion Models for Nonlinear Spatiotemporal System Identification

author.name: Achraf El Messaoudi, Noureddine Khaous, Karim Cherifi

entry.summary: Revisits target parameterization choices (noise vs. velocity prediction) for diffusion models applied to nonlinear spatiotemporal system identification, particularly in turbulent flow regimes. Shows these design choices matter significantly in this context.

entry.title: Video-Robin: Autoregressive Diffusion Planning for Intent-Grounded Video-to-Music Generation

author.name: Vaibhavi Lokegaonkar, Aryan Vijay Bhosale, Vishnu Raj, Gouthaman KV, Ramani Duraiswami, Lie Lu, Sreyan Ghosh, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: Presents Video-Robin, a text-conditioned video-to-music generation model that combines autoregressive planning for global structure with diffusion-based synthesis for audio quality. Enables semantic alignment between video content and generated music.

entry.title: Soft Label Pruning and Quantization for Large-Scale Dataset Distillation

author.name: Xiao Lingao, Yang He

entry.summary: Addresses the massive storage overhead of soft labels in large-scale dataset distillation (30-200x larger than images), proposing Label Pruning and Quantization (LPQLD) with class-wise batching to enhance image diversity.

entry.title: Distributional Off-Policy Evaluation with Deep Quantile Process Regression

author.name: Qi Kuang, Chao Wang, Yuling Jiao, Fan Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces DQPOPE, a deep quantile process regression approach for distributional off-policy evaluation that estimates the entire return distribution rather than just expectations. Provides rigorous sample complexity analysis.

entry.title: When Misinformation Speaks and Converses: Rethinking Fact-Checking in Audio Platforms

author.name: Chaewan Chun, Delvin Ce Zhang, Dongwon Lee

entry.summary: Argues that audio misinformation is structurally different from text misinformation due to prosodic and conversational properties, and that existing text-focused fact-checking pipelines are insufficient for audio platforms.

entry.title: Beyond Word Boundaries: A Hebrew Coreference Benchmark and an Evaluation Protocol for Morphologically Complex Text

author.name: Refael Shaked Greenfeld, Reut Tsarfaty

entry.summary: Introduces KibutzR, the first comprehensive coreference resolution dataset for Modern Hebrew, addressing the challenge that mention boundaries don't align with word boundaries in morphologically rich languages.

entry.title: PoliLegalLM: A Technical Report on a Large Language Model for Political and Legal Affairs

author.name: Yuting Huang, Yinghao Hu, Qian Xiao, Wenlin Zhong, Yiquan Wu, Taishi Zhou, Moke Chen, Changlong Sun, Kun Kuang, Fei Wu

entry.summary: Presents PoliLegalLM, a domain-specific LLM for political and legal applications using continued pretraining, progressive SFT, and preference-based RL. Constructs a large-scale legal corpus with structured post-training pipeline.

entry.title: How Non-Linguistic Is the Indus Sign System? A Synthetic-Baseline Scorecard

author.name: Ashish Nair

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-metric framework to test whether the Indus Valley sign system encodes spoken language, comparing against synthetic non-linguistic baselines. Applies computational methods to a long-standing archaeological debate about the Indus script.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Model for Fake News Detection

author.name: Yiheng Li, Weihai Lu, Hanyi Yu, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a retrieval-augmented multimodal model for fake news detection that captures cross-instance narrative consistency and provides domain-specific knowledge for reasoning about emerging events.

entry.title: Multilingual Training and Evaluation Resources for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Daniela Baiamonte, Elena Fano, Matteo Gabburo, Stefano Simonazzi, Leonardo Rigutini, Andrea Zugarini

entry.summary: Introduces multilingual training and evaluation resources for vision-language models across five European languages using a regeneration-translation paradigm. Builds Multi-PixMo training corpus and evaluation benchmarks through synthetic generation and manual annotation.

entry.title: Dual Alignment Between Language Model Layers and Human Sentence Processing

author.name: Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Alex Warstadt, Yohei Oseki, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox

entry.summary: Extends work on alignment between LLM layers and human sentence processing, finding that later layers better estimate cognitive effort for syntactic ambiguity processing, contrasting with early-layer advantages for naturalistic reading.

entry.title: TWGuard: A Case Study of LLM Safety Guardrails for Localized Linguistic Contexts

author.name: Hua-Rong Chu, Kuan-Chun Wang, Yao-Te Huang

entry.summary: Proposes TWGuard, a guardrail model optimized for Taiwan's linguistic context, achieving significant gains over existing guardrails. Demonstrates importance of localized safety models.

entry.title: The Cognitive Penalty: Ablating System 1 and System 2 Reasoning in Edge-Native SLMs for Decentralized Consensus

author.name: Syed Muhammad Aqdas Rizvi

entry.summary: Studies Small Language Models for DAO governance, finding a severe compute-accuracy inversion where System 2 (extended reasoning) performs worse than System 1 (autoregressive baseline) in adversarial cryptoeconomic settings.

entry.title: NIM4-ASR: Towards Efficient, Robust, and Customizable Real-Time LLM-Based ASR

author.name: Yuan Xie, Jiaqi Song, Guang Qiu, Xianliang Wang, Kai Qiao, Junfeng Yuan, Shengqing Liu, Yi Zhang, Bowen Chen, Ming Lei, Jie Gao, Jie Wu

entry.summary: Presents NIM4-ASR, a production-oriented LLM-based ASR framework optimized for efficiency and robustness. Redesigns encoder-LLM role delineation and multi-stage training for practical deployment with reduced hallucination.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware CLIP Retrieval via Local Cross-Modal Alignment and Steering

author.name: Nirmalendu Prakash, Narmeen Fatimah Oozeer, Xin Su, Phillip Howard, Shaan Shah, Zoe Wanying He, Shuang Wu, Shivam Raval, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Meenakshi Khosla, Amir Abdullah

entry.summary: Addresses CLIP retrieval failures from local geometric inconsistencies by introducing neighborhood-level re-ranking via Hungarian matching and query-conditioned local steering for better structural alignment.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Semantic Segmentation without Key Management

author.name: Mare Hirose, Shoko Imaizumi, Hitoshi Kiya

entry.summary: Proposes privacy-preserving semantic segmentation where model creator and clients use independently generated encryption keys, enabling training and inference on encrypted images without key management.

entry.title: Tri-Modal Fusion Transformers for UAV-based Object Detection

author.name: Craig Iaboni, Pramod Abichandani

entry.summary: Presents a tri-modal fusion framework for UAV object detection combining RGB, thermal, and event camera data with hierarchical vision transformers and modality-aware gating.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Tracking (PIT)

author.name: Emil Hovad, Allan Peter Engsig-Karup

entry.summary: Proposes Physics-Informed Tracking (PIT) where a neural network autoencoder localizes particles from video while a differentiable physics module constrains trajectories to satisfy known dynamics.

entry.title: KIRA: Knowledge-Intensive Image Retrieval and Reasoning Architecture for Specialized Visual Domains

author.name: Parthaw Goswami, Jaynto Goswami Deep

entry.summary: Presents KIRA, a five-stage visual RAG framework for specialized domains addressing modality gaps, multi-hop visual reasoning, and answer grounding verification.

entry.title: Better with Less: Tackling Heterogeneous Multi-Modal Image Joint Pretraining via Conditioned and Degraded Masked Autoencoder

author.name: Bowen Peng, Yongxiang Liu, Jie Zhou, Xiaodong Chen, Tianpeng Liu, Xiaogang Yu, Li Liu

entry.summary: Addresses heterogeneous optical-SAR joint pretraining at high resolution via conditioned and degraded masked autoencoder, tackling the Heterogeneity-Resolution Paradox where finer scales amplify modality divergence.

entry.title: Adverse-to-the-eXtreme Panoptic Segmentation: URVIS 2026 Study and Benchmark

author.name: Yiting Wang, Nolwenn Peyratout, Tim Brodermann, Jiahui Wang, Yusi Cao, Michele Cazzola, Elie Tarassov, Takuya Kobayashi, Abderrahim Kasmi, Guillaume Allibert, C\'edric Demonceaux, Valentina Donzella, Kurt Debattista, Radu Timofte, Zongwei Wu, Christos Sakaridis

entry.summary: Reports results from the URVIS 2026 challenge on panoptic segmentation under adverse-to-extreme weather conditions using multimodal sensor data (RGB, LiDAR, radar, event cameras). Based on the MUSES dataset with weighted Panoptic Quality metric.

entry.title: LIVE: Leveraging Image Manipulation Priors for Instruction-based Video Editing

author.name: Weicheng Wang, Zhicheng Zhang, Zhongqi Zhang, Juncheng Zhou, Yongjie Zhu, Wenyu Qin, Meng Wang, Pengfei Wan, Jufeng Yang

entry.summary: Proposes LIVE, a joint training framework leveraging large-scale image editing data alongside video datasets for instruction-based video editing. Introduces frame-wise token noise strategy to bridge image-video domain gap.

entry.title: OptiMVMap: Offline Vectorized Map Construction via Optimal Multi-vehicle Perspectives

author.name: Zedong Dan, Zijie Wang, Wei Zhang, Xiangru Lin, Weiming Zhang, Xiao Tan, Jingdong Wang, Liang Lin, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Proposes OptiMVMap for offline vectorized map construction using optimal multi-vehicle perspectives, reformulating multi-vehicle mapping as a submodular optimization problem to select complementary viewpoints.

entry.title: Fractal Characterization of Low-Correlation Signals in AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Wenwei Xie, Jie Yin, Lu Ma, Xuansong Zhang, Wenjing Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces fractal-based characterization of low-correlation signals for AI-generated image detection, analyzing intrinsic discrepancies between synthetic and authentic images at the signal level.

entry.title: HSG: Hyperbolic Scene Graph

author.name: Liyang Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Hyperbolic Scene Graph (HSG) that learns scene graph embeddings in hyperbolic space to naturally encode hierarchical relationships between places and objects.

entry.title: Dual Strategies for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Nam Nguyen Phuong, Duc Nguyen The Minh, Phi Le Nguyen, Ehsan Abbasnejad, Minh Hoai

entry.summary: Introduces DualTTA, a test-time adaptation framework using dual strategies: minimizing entropy for reliable predictions while maximizing entropy for likely-incorrect ones, leveraging a larger set of test samples.

entry.title: Infrastructure-Centric World Models: Bridging Temporal Depth and Spatial Breadth for Roadside Perception

author.name: Siyuan Meng, Chengbo Ai

entry.summary: Presents a vision paper arguing for infrastructure-centric world models for autonomous driving, leveraging roadside sensors' temporal depth and persistent viewpoints as complementary to vehicle-borne spatial breadth.

entry.title: Dynamic Visual-semantic Alignment for Zero-shot Learning with Ambiguous Labels

author.name: Jiangnan Li, Linqing Huang, Xiaowen Yan, Min Gan, Wenpeng Lu, Jinfu Fan

entry.summary: DVSA proposes a robust zero-shot learning framework that handles noisy/ambiguous labels through bidirectional visual-semantic alignment with attention and a dynamic label disambiguation mechanism using mutual information.

entry.title: UniCSG: Unified High-Fidelity Content-Constrained Style-Driven Generation via Staged Semantic and Frequency Disentanglement

author.name: Jingwei Yang, Ruoxi Wu, Wei Shen, Meng Li, Yulong Liu, Huimin She, Lunxi Yuan

entry.summary: UniCSG presents a unified framework for content-constrained style-driven generation using staged training with latent-space semantic disentanglement and frequency-aware detail reconstruction in DiT-based diffusion models.

entry.title: AI-based Waste Mapping for Addressing Climate-Exacerbated Flood Risk

author.name: Steffen Knoblauch, Levi Szamek, Iddy Chazua, Benedcto Adamu, Innocent Maholi, Alexander Zipf

entry.summary: Introduces an AI-powered urban waste mapping workflow using aerial and street-view imagery to detect solid waste in Dar es Salaam, finding waste accumulation in waterways up to 3x higher than surrounding areas.

entry.title: Spike-NVPT: Learning Robust Visual Prompts via Bio-Inspired Temporal Filtering and Discretization

author.name: Qiugang Zhan, Anning Jiang, Ran Tao, Ao Ma, Xiangyu Zhang, Xiurui Xie, Guisong Liu

entry.summary: Spike-NVPT proposes noise-robust visual prompt tuning using spiking neurons for signal filtering, leveraging integrate-and-fire mechanisms to filter transient noise and discretize prompts.

entry.title: EAST: Early Action Prediction Sampling Strategy with Token Masking

author.name: Iva Sovi\'c, Ivan Martinovi\'c, Marin Or\v{s}i\'c
