entry.summary: Introduces EAST, a framework for early action prediction that uses a randomized training strategy sampling time steps to separate observed and unobserved frames, enabling a single model to work across all observation ratios. Joint learning on observed and future representations boosts performance.

entry.title: Advancing Vision Transformer with Enhanced Spatial Priors

author.name: Qihang Fan, Huaibo Huang, Mingrui Chen, Hongmin Liu, Ran He

entry.summary: Proposes EVT (Euclidean enhanced Vision Transformer), building on RMT by using Euclidean distance decay instead of Manhattan distance and incorporating additional spatial priors to improve Vision Transformer performance.

entry.title: Enhancing Glass Surface Reconstruction via Depth Prior for Robot Navigation

author.name: Jiamin Zheng, Jingwen Yu, Guangcheng Chen, Hong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework using depth foundation models with RANSAC-based alignment to reconstruct glass surfaces for robot navigation, introducing GlassRecon dataset with ground truth for glass regions.

entry.title: Full Feature Spiking Neural Network Simulation on Micro-Controllers for Neuromorphic Applications at the Edge

author.name: L. Niedermeier, J. L. Krichmar

entry.summary: Demonstrates running the full CARLsim spiking neural network simulator on an RP2350 microcontroller with 8MB memory using IEEE 16-bit floats, enabling neuromorphic applications at the edge.

entry.title: On-Orbit Space AI: Federated, Multi-Agent, and Collaborative Algorithms for Satellite Constellations

author.name: Ziyang Wang

entry.summary: Surveys on-orbit space AI across federated learning, multi-agent coordination, and collaborative algorithms for satellite constellations, identifying algorithmic requirements for constellation-scale autonomy.

entry.title: Refinement of Accelerated Demonstrations via Incremental Iterative Reference Learning Control for Fast Contact-Rich Imitation Learning

author.name: Koki Yamane, Cristian C. Beltran-Hernandez, Steven Oh, Masashi Hamaya, Sho Sakaino

entry.summary: Proposes Incremental Iterative Reference Learning Control (I2RLC) to refine time-accelerated robot demonstrations for fast contact-rich imitation learning, gradually increasing acceleration across iterations.

entry.title: NaviFormer: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Transformer-like Model to Holistically Solve the Navigation Problem

author.name: Daniel Fuertes, Andrea Cavallaro, Carlos R. del-Blanco, Fernando Jaureguizar, Narciso Garc\'ia

entry.summary: Introduces NaviFormer, a Transformer-based deep RL model that holistically solves both high-level route planning and low-level path planning for global navigation.

entry.title: MM-Hand: A 21-DOF Multi-modal Modular Dexterous Robotic Hand with Remote Actuation

author.name: Zhuoheng Li, Qingquan Lin, Checheng Yu, Qiangyu Chen, Zhiqian Lan, Lutong Zhang, Hongyang Li, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Presents MM-Hand, a 21-DOF dexterous robotic hand using remote tendon-driven actuation to free in-hand space for multi-modal sensing. Integrates spring-return tendon-driven fingers, modular 3D-printed structures, and quick-connect maintenance features.

entry.title: Safer Trajectory Planning with CBF-guided Diffusion Model for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles

author.name: Peiwen Yang, Shiyu Bai, Weisong Wen, Yixin Gao, Jiahao Hu

entry.summary: AeroTrajGen combines diffusion models with control barrier function (CBF)-guided sampling for safe UAV trajectory planning. CBF guidance during reverse diffusion ensures collision-free trajectories without needing extensive safety-verified training data.

entry.title: Adaptive Kernel Selection for Kernelized Diffusion Maps

author.name: Othmane Aboussaad, Adam Miraoui, Boumediene Hamzi, Houman Owhadi

entry.summary: Proposes two approaches for adaptive kernel selection in Kernelized Diffusion Maps: a variational loop learning kernel parameters by differentiating through the eigenproblem, and an unsupervised cross-validation pipeline for kernel family selection.

entry.title: Taming Asynchronous CPU-GPU Coupling for Frequency-aware Latency Estimation on Mobile Edge

author.name: Jiesong Chen, Jun You, Zhidan Liu, Zhenjiang Li

entry.summary: Addresses the challenge of predicting model inference latency on mobile devices under Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling, where processor frequencies change dynamically. Proposes a frequency-aware estimation method that handles CPU-GPU coupling.

entry.title: Exploring LLM-based Verilog Code Generation with Data-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Testbench Automation

author.name: Mu-Chi Chen, Po-Hsuan Huang, Yu-Hung Kao, Yen-Fu Liu, Yu-Kai Hung, Cheng Liang, Shao-Chun Ho, Chia-Heng Tu, Shih-Hao Hung

entry.summary: Explores LLM-based Verilog code generation with data-efficient fine-tuning and automated testbench creation through multi-agent models. Achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art on VerilogEval v2 with less training data.

entry.title: LLM attribution analysis across different fine-tuning strategies and model scales for automated code compliance

author.name: Jack Wei Lun Shi, Minghao Dang, Wawan Solihin, Justin K. W. Yeoh

entry.summary: Applies perturbation-based attribution analysis to compare how different fine-tuning strategies (FFT, LoRA, QLoRA) and model scales affect LLM interpretive behavior for automated code compliance. Finds full fine-tuning produces more focused attribution patterns than parameter-efficient methods.

entry.title: BioHiCL: Hierarchical Multi-Label Contrastive Learning for Biomedical Retrieval with MeSH Labels

author.name: Mengfei Lan, Lecheng Zheng, Halil Kilicoglu

entry.summary: Proposes BioHiCL, which leverages hierarchical MeSH annotations for multi-label contrastive learning in biomedical retrieval. The 0.1B and 0.3B models achieve strong performance on biomedical retrieval, sentence similarity, and QA tasks.

entry.title: Robust Synchronisation for Federated Learning in The Face of Correlated Device Failure

author.name: Stefan Behfar, Richard Mortier

entry.summary: Addresses correlated device failures in federated learning by improving Probabilistic Synchronous Parallel methods. Shows that correlated availability and data distribution can introduce systematic bias.

entry.title: Training Time Prediction for Mixed Precision-based Distributed Training

author.name: Minchul Kang, Changyong Shin, Jinwoo Jeong, Hyunho Lee, Younghun Go, Gyeongmin Kim, Gyeongsik Yang, Chuck Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes a precision-aware distributed training time predictor that accounts for mixed precision settings, reducing prediction error from 147.85% MAPE to much lower levels.

entry.title: SetFlow: Generating Structured Sets of Representations for Multiple Instance Learning

author.name: Nikola Jovi\v{s}i\'c, Milica \v{S}kipina, Vanja \v{S}venda

entry.summary: Introduces SetFlow, a generative architecture using flow matching and Set Transformer design to model entire MIL bags in representation space for data augmentation. Handles permutation invariance and captures intra-bag dependencies.

entry.title: G-PARC: Graph-Physics Aware Recurrent Convolutional Neural Networks for Spatiotemporal Dynamics on Unstructured Meshes

author.name: Jack T. Beerman, Tyler J. Abele, Mehdi Taghizadeh, Andrew Davis, Zo\"e J. Gray, Negin Alemazkoor, Xinfeng Gao, H. S. Udaykumar, Stephen S. Baek

entry.summary: Proposes G-PARC, extending physics-aware recurrent convolutional networks to irregular meshes using graph neural networks with moving least squares kernels for spatial derivative approximation.

entry.title: An Interpretable Framework Applying Protein Words to Predict Protein-Small Molecule Complementary Pairing Rules

author.name: Jingke Chen, Jingrui Zhong, Tazneen Hossain Tani, Zidong Su, Xiaochun Zhang, Boxue Tian

entry.summary: Develops PWRules framework for interpretable protein-small molecule binding predictions using 'protein words' (semantic sequence units) and complementary pairing rules with privileged fragments. Achieves competitive performance with physics-based and deep learning models.

entry.title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Contextual Bayesian PEFT for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Habibeh Naderi, Behrouz Haji Soleimani, Stan Matwin

entry.summary: Introduces CoCo-LoRA, a multimodal uncertainty-aware PEFT method that conditions Bayesian low-rank adaptation on both text and audio context. Addresses the limitation of existing Bayesian PEFT being unimodal.

entry.title: Self-Reinforcing Controllable Synthesis of Rare Relational Data via Bayesian Calibration

author.name: Chongsheng Zhang, Hao Wang, Zelong Yu, Esteban Garces Arias, Julian Rodemann, Zhanshuo Zhang, Qilong Li, Gaojuan Fan, Krikamol Muandet, Christian Heumann

entry.summary: Proposes RDDG, an in-context learning framework using progressive chain-of-thought to generate tabular data for imbalanced classification, with Bayesian calibration feedback to guide LLMs toward better synthesis quality.

entry.title: OC-Distill: Ontology-aware Contrastive Learning with Cross-Modal Distillation for ICU Risk Prediction

author.name: Zhongyuan Liang, Junhyung Jo, Hyang-Jung Lee, Sang Kyu Kim, Irene Y. Chen

entry.summary: Proposes OC-Distill for ICU risk prediction, combining ontology-aware contrastive pretraining (using clinical relationships as similarity) with cross-modal distillation from clinical notes to physiological signals.

entry.title: Live LTL Progress Tracking: Towards Task-Based Exploration

author.name: Noel Brindise, Cedric Langbort, Melkior Ornik

entry.summary: Presents a framework using 'tracking vectors' to monitor progress of autonomous agents through complex multi-stage tasks specified in finite linear temporal logic (LTL), enabling detailed task execution tracking.

entry.title: Revisiting Auxiliary Losses for Conditional Depth Routing: An Empirical Study

author.name: Qingwei Lin

entry.summary: Empirical study comparing auxiliary losses for conditional depth routing in transformers, evaluating gate designs under controlled conditions with 157.5M parameter models.

entry.title: LLM-AUG: Robust Wireless Data Augmentation with In-Context Learning in Large Language Models

author.name: Pranshav Gajjar, Manan Tiwari, Sayanta Seth, Vijay K. Shah

entry.summary: LLM-AUG uses in-context learning in LLMs for data augmentation in wireless communication, generating synthetic training samples in learned embedding spaces for modulation and interference classification.

entry.title: Sonata: A Hybrid World Model for Inertial Kinematics under Clinical Data Scarcity

author.name: Blaise Delaney, Salil Patel, Yuji Xing, Dominic Dootson, Karin Sevegnani

entry.summary: Introduces Sonata, a compact 3.77M-parameter latent world model for IMU-based clinical analysis pre-trained on harmonized public datasets, using future state prediction rather than reconstruction for learning under clinical data scarcity.

entry.title: Scalable Neighborhood-Based Multi-Agent Actor-Critic

author.name: Tim Goppelsroeder, Rasmus Jensen

entry.summary: Proposes MADDPG-K, which restricts each agent's critic to the k closest agents rather than all agents, enabling constant-size critic input regardless of total agent count for scalable multi-agent RL.

entry.title: Balance-Guided Sparse Identification of Multiscale Nonlinear PDEs with Small-coefficient Terms

author.name: Zhenhua Dang, Lei Zhang, Long Wang, Guowei He

entry.summary: Proposes BG-SINDy for data-driven discovery of governing equations in multiscale systems, using dominant balance principles to rank terms by relative contribution rather than absolute coefficient magnitude.

entry.title: ProtoCLIP: Prototype-Aligned Latent Refinement for Robust Zero-Shot Chest X-Ray Classification

author.name: Florian Kittler, Sheethal Bhat, Andreas Maier

entry.summary: Proposes ProtoCLIP, a refinement strategy for CLIP-style vision-language models for zero-shot chest X-ray classification that addresses co-occurrence bias through curated negative samples and distilled anchor alignment.

entry.title: Reciprocal Co-Training (RCT): Coupling Gradient-Based and Non-Differentiable Models via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yunshuo Tian, Akayou Kitessa, Tanuja Chitnis, Yijun Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces a reciprocal co-training framework coupling an LLM with a Random Forest via reinforcement learning, where each model improves using signals from the other through iterative feedback loops.

entry.title: CoLLM: A Unified Framework for Co-execution of LLMs Federated Fine-tuning and Inference

author.name: Shaoyuan Huang, Xiaokai Wang, Na Yan, Xiaofei Wang, Wenyu Wang, Yansha Deng

entry.summary: Proposes CoLLM, a co-execution framework unifying federated fine-tuning and inference for LLMs at the edge, addressing the inefficiency of treating them as isolated workloads.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Self-Play for Realistic Highway Traffic Simulation

author.name: Jinkai Qiu, Alessandro Saviolo, Chaojie Wang, Mingke Wang, Xiaoyu Huang

entry.summary: Presents PHASE, a heterogeneous agent self-play framework for realistic highway traffic simulation with explicit per-agent conditioning for controllability and synthetic scenario generation.

entry.title: SynopticBench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Generating Weather Forecast Discussions of the Future

author.name: Timothy B. Higgins, Antonios Mamalakis, Chirag Agarwal

entry.summary: Introduces SynopticBench, a large-scale dataset of 1.37M text samples pairing National Weather Service forecast discussions with meteorological images for evaluating VLMs on weather forecasting. Tests whether current VLMs can handle the complexity of atmospheric phenomena.

entry.title: Operationalizing Fairness in Text-to-Image Models: A Survey of Bias, Fairness Audits and Mitigation Strategies

author.name: Megan Smith, Venkatesh Thirugnana Sambandham, Florian Richter, Laura Crompton, Matthias Uhl, Torsten Sch\"on

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of fairness in text-to-image generation models, organizing existing work into a taxonomy of bias types and fairness notions. Distinguishes between 'target fairness' (normative ideals) and 'threshold fairness' (actionable standards).

entry.title: Lorentz Framework for Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Zahid Hasan, Masud Ahmed, Nirmalya Roy

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic segmentation framework in hyperbolic Lorentz space that uses text embeddings to guide hierarchical pixel-level representations. Overcomes numerical instability issues of the Poincaré ball model while providing uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Harness as an Asset: Enforcing Determinism via the Convergent AI Agent Framework (CAAF)

author.name: Tianbao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes the Convergent AI Agent Framework (CAAF) to enforce determinism in LLM agents for safety-critical engineering through recursive atomic decomposition, domain invariant registries, and convergence proofs. Addresses sycophantic compliance and context decay.

entry.title: TensorHub: Rethinking AI Model Hub with Tensor-Centric Compression

author.name: Tingfeng Lan, Zirui Wang, Yunjia Zheng, Zhaoyuan Su, Juncheng Yang, Yue Cheng

entry.summary: Presents TensorHub, a tensor-centric system for reducing AI model storage through fine-grained deduplication and compression. Uses tensor-level fingerprinting and clustering to identify redundancy across models without annotations.

entry.title: FlowRefiner: Flow Matching-Based Iterative Refinement for 3D Turbulent Flow Simulation

author.name: Yilong Dai, Yiming Sun, Yiheng Chen, Shengyu Chen, Xiaowei Jia, Runlong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes FlowRefiner, a flow matching-based iterative refinement framework for 3D turbulent flow simulation. Replaces stochastic denoising with deterministic ODE-based correction and uses a decoupled sigma schedule for stability.

entry.title: StrEBM: A Structured Latent Energy-Based Model for Blind Source Separation

author.name: Yuan-Hao Wei

entry.summary: Proposes StrEBM, a structured latent energy-based model for blind source separation where different latent dimensions get their own learnable structural biases rather than sharing a single energy function. Aims for identifiable and decoupled latent representations.

entry.title: ONTO: A Token-Efficient Columnar Notation for LLM Input Optimization

author.name: Harshavardhanan Deekeswar

entry.summary: Presents ONTO, a columnar notation format that declares field names once and arranges values in pipe-delimited rows, dramatically reducing token count for LLM input. A 1,000-record IoT dataset drops from ~80K tokens in JSON to far fewer.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Causal MDPs for Sequential Constraint Repair in Engineering Simulation Pipelines

author.name: Chuhan Qiao

entry.summary: Introduces PI-CMDP, a framework for constrained MDPs with layered DAG constraint dependencies, featuring an Identify-Compress-Estimate pipeline for causal identification and state compression in engineering simulation.

entry.title: Prompting Foundation Models for Zero-Shot Ship Instance Segmentation in SAR Imagery

author.name: Islam Mansour, Francescopaolo Sica, Michael Schmitt

entry.summary: Explores using foundation vision models (SAM2) with YOLOv11 for zero-shot ship instance segmentation in SAR imagery without any pixel-level annotations. Shows spatial constraints from SAR-trained detector alone can regularize foundation model predictions.

entry.title: The Collaboration Gap in Human-AI Work

author.name: Varad Vishwarupe, Marina Jirotka, Nigel Shadbolt, Ivan Flechais

entry.summary: Introduces a conceptual framework for understanding why human-AI collaboration with LLMs remains fragile, based on grounded theory analysis of 16 practitioner interviews. Identifies that stable collaboration depends on grounding conditions beyond model capability.

entry.title: Balanced Co-Clustering of Users and Items for Embedding Table Compression in Recommender Systems

author.name: Runhao Jiang, Renchi Yang, Donghao Wu

entry.summary: Proposes BACO, a balanced co-clustering framework for compressing embedding tables in recommender systems by clustering users and items to share embeddings, reducing parameter count while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: When Informal Text Breaks NLI: Tokenization Failure, Distribution Shift, and Targeted Mitigations

author.name: Avinash Goutham Aluguvelly

entry.summary: Studies how informal text (slang, emoji, Gen-Z fillers) degrades NLI accuracy, showing that emoji causes catastrophic failure due to [UNK] token mappings while slang is largely handled by existing tokenizers.

entry.title: Efficient Task Adaptation in Large Language Models via Selective Parameter Optimization

author.name: Weijie Wan, Jiangjiang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes selective parameter optimization for LLM task adaptation using parameter element importance evaluation to identify which parameters are crucial for general vs. task-specific knowledge, reducing catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Comparing Human and Large Language Model Interpretation of Implicit Information

author.name: Antonio De Santis, Tommaso Bonetti, Andrea Tocchetti, Marco Brambilla

entry.summary: Introduces Implicit Information Extraction (IIE) task and pipeline that builds knowledge graphs from implicit meanings in text. Finds LLMs are more conservative than humans in extracting implicit information.

entry.title: Calibrating Model-Based Evaluation Metrics for Summarization

author.name: Hongye Liu, Dhanajit Brahma, Ricardo Henao

entry.summary: Proposes a framework generating proxy summary evaluation scores without reference summaries or expensive models, plus GIRB calibration method for aligning raw predictions with true quality distributions.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Approach for Claim Verification from Tabular Data Documents

author.name: Rudra Ranajee Saha, Laks V. S. Lakshmanan, Raymond T. Ng

entry.summary: MACE is a multi-agent framework for claim verification from tabular data with three specialized agents (Planner, Executor, Verifier) using zero-shot Chain-of-Thought, producing interpretable verification traces.

entry.title: MAPLE: A Meta-learning Framework for Cross-Prompt Essay Scoring

author.name: Salam Albatarni, May Bashendy, Sohaila Eltanbouly, Tamer Elsayed

entry.summary: Proposes MAPLE, a meta-learning framework using prototypical networks for cross-prompt automated essay scoring. Achieves SOTA on ELLIPSE and LAILA datasets, demonstrating transferability across writing prompts including Arabic.

entry.title: Modeling Multiple Support Strategies within a Single Turn for Emotional Support Conversations

author.name: Jie Zhu, Huaixia Dou, Junhui Li, Lifan Guo, Feng Chen, Jinsong Su, Chi Zhang, Fang Kong

entry.summary: Formulates emotional support conversation as multi-strategy utterance generation where each turn can contain multiple support strategies. Proposes All-in-One and One-by-One generation methods enhanced with cognitive reasoning.

entry.title: Exploring Concreteness Through a Figurative Lens

author.name: Saptarshi Ghosh, Tianyu Jiang

entry.summary: Analyzes how LLMs internally represent concreteness in literal vs figurative language usage through layerwise geometric analysis. Finds that LLMs separate literal and figurative usage in early layers, with mid-to-late layers compressing concreteness into a consistent one-dimensional direction.

entry.title: BhashaSutra: A Task-Centric Unified Survey of Indian NLP Datasets, Corpora, and Resources

author.name: Raghvendra Kumar, Devankar Raj, Sriparna Saha

entry.summary: Presents the first unified survey of Indian NLP resources covering 200+ datasets, 50+ benchmarks, and 100+ models across text, speech, and multimodal tasks for India's 22 scheduled languages and many dialects.

entry.title: PersonalHomeBench: Evaluating Agents in Personalized Smart Homes

author.name: Nikhil Verma, InJung Yang, Sungil Kim, KoKeun Kim, YoungJoon Kim, Manasa Bharadwaj, Yolanda Liu, Kevin Ferreira

entry.summary: Introduces PersonalHomeBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents in personalized smart home environments with context-dependent tasks and comprehensive tool support.

entry.title: Aligning Language Models for Lyric-to-Melody Generation with Rule-Based Musical Constraints

author.name: Hao Meng, Siyuan Zheng, Shuran Zhou, Qiangqiang Wang, Yang Song

entry.summary: Proposes an alignment framework for lyric-to-melody generation using rule-based musical constraints with DPO and KTO, avoiding human annotation while improving musical plausibility of LLM-generated melodies.

entry.title: HQA-VLAttack: Towards High Quality Adversarial Attack on Vision-Language Pre-Trained Models

author.name: Han Liu, Jiaqi Li, Zhi Xu, Xiaotong Zhang, Xiaoming Xu, Fenglong Ma, Yuanman Li, Hong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes HQA-VLAttack, a black-box adversarial attack framework for vision-language models that generates high-quality perturbations considering both positive and negative pair similarities while reducing query cost.

entry.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Adversarial Transferability in Medical Imaging Models

author.name: Emily Curl, Kofi Ampomah, Md Erfan, Sayanton Dibbo

entry.summary: Argues that Attack Success Rate alone is insufficient for evaluating adversarial robustness in medical imaging, proposing multi-metric evaluation including perturbation strength, image quality, and cross-architecture transferability.

entry.title: BOOKAGENT: Orchestrating Safety-Aware Visual Narratives via Multi-Agent Cognitive Calibration

author.name: Bo Gao, Chang Liu, Yuyang Miao, Siyuan Ma, Ser-Nam Lim

entry.summary: Proposes BookAgent, a multi-agent framework for generating safety-aware illustrated storybooks with child-specific safety constraints integrated into narrative planning and multi-modal verification.

entry.title: Generative Semantic Communication via Alternating Dual-Domain Posterior Sampling

author.name: Shunpu Tang, Qianqian Yang

entry.summary: Proposes alternating dual-domain posterior sampling for generative semantic communication, proving posterior sampling preserves data distributions better than MAP estimation for wireless image transmission.

entry.title: CATP: Confidence-Aware Token Pruning for Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Yuhan Gao, Shuhao Kang, Xin He, Bing Li, Xu Cheng, Yun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CATP, a confidence-aware token pruning framework for camouflaged object detection that hierarchically prunes easily distinguishable tokens to focus computation on boundary regions.

entry.title: Adaptive Forensic Feature Refinement via Intrinsic Importance Perception

author.name: Jiazhen Yang, Junjun Zheng, Kejia Chen, Xiangheng Kong, Jie Lei, Zunlei Feng, Bingde Hu, Yang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive forensic feature refinement for synthetic image detection, modeling optimal representational hierarchy in visual foundation models for transferable forgery detection.

entry.title: UGD: An Unsupervised Geometric Distance for Evaluating Real-world Noisy Point Cloud Denoising

author.name: Zhiyong Su, Jincan Wu, Yonghui Liu, Zheng Li, Weiqing Li

entry.summary: Proposes UGD, an unsupervised geometric distance metric for evaluating point cloud denoising without requiring ground-truth clean point clouds. Learns a patch-wise prior model from clean point clouds to enable real-world evaluation.

entry.title: Comparison Drives Preference: Reference-Aware Modeling for AI-Generated Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Minghao Zou, Gen Liu, Guanghui Yue, Baoquan Zhao, Zhihua Wang, Paul L. Rosin, Hantao Liu, Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a reference-aware approach to AI-generated video quality assessment that evaluates quality through inter-video comparison rather than analyzing each video independently, better matching human perception.

entry.title: Marrying Text-to-Motion Generation with Skeleton-Based Action Recognition

author.name: Jidong Kuang, Hongsong Wang, Jie Gui

entry.summary: Proposes CoAMD, a unified framework for skeleton-based action recognition and text-to-motion generation using coordinate-based autoregressive motion diffusion with semantic guidance from a multi-modal action recognizer.

entry.title: DreamShot: Personalized Storyboard Synthesis with Video Diffusion Prior

author.name: Junjia Huang, Binbin Yang, Pengxiang Yan, Jiyang Liu, Bin Xia, Zhao Wang, Yitong Wang, Liang Lin, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Introduces DreamShot, a video diffusion model-based storyboard synthesis framework for controllable multi-shot generation with consistent characters, scenes, and transitions.

entry.title: RemoteShield: Enable Robust Multimodal Large Language Models for Earth Observation

author.name: Rui Min, Liang Yao, Shiyu Miao, Shengxiang Xu, Yuxuan Liu, Chuanyi Zhang, Shimin Di, Fan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes RemoteShield to improve robustness of MLLMs for Earth Observation against realistic perturbations including cloud/fog cover and diverse textual variations.

entry.title: The First Challenge on Mobile Real-World Image Super-Resolution at NTIRE 2026: Benchmark Results and Method Overview

author.name: Jiatong Li, Zheng Chen, Kai Liu, Jingkai Wang, Zihan Zhou, Xiaoyang Liu, Libo Zhu, Jue Gong, Radu Timofte, Yulun Zhang, Congyu Wang, Zihao Wang, Ke Wu, Xinzhe Zhu, Fengkai Zhang, Zhongbao Yang, Long Sun, Jiangxin Dong, Jinshan Pan, Jiachen Tu, Yaokun Shi, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Renyuan Situ, Yixin Yang, Zhaorun Zhou, Junyang Chen, Yuqi Li, Chuanguang Yang, Weilun Feng, Chuanyue Yan, Yuedong Tan, Yingli Tian, Zhenzhong Chen, Tongqi Guo, Ruhan Liu, Sangzi Shi, Huazhang Deng, Jie Yang, Wenzhuo Ma, Yuantong Zhang, Daiqin Yang, Tianrun Chen, Deyi Ji, Yuxiao Jiang, Qi Zhu, Lanyun Zhu, Yuwen Pan, Runze Tian, Mingyu Shi, Zhanfeng Feng, Yuanfei Bao, Jiaming Guo, Renjing Pei, Xin Di, Long Peng, Linfeng Jiang, Xueyang Fu, Yang Cao, Zhengjun Zha, Choulhyouc Lee, Shyang-En Weng, Yi-Cheng Liao, Jorge Tyrakowski, Yu-Syuan Xu, Wei-Chen Chiu, Ching-Chun Huang, Yoonjin Im, Jihye Park, Hyungju Chun, Hyunhee Park, MinKyu Park, Xiaoxuan Yu, Jianxing Zhang, Yuxuan Jiang, Chengxi Zeng, Tianhao Peng, Fan Zhang, David Bull, Watchara Ruangsang, Supavadee Aramvith, JiaHao Deng, Wei Zhou, Hongyu Huang, Shaohui Lin, Zihan Wang, Yilin Chen, Yunchen Li, Junbo Qiao, Wei Li, Jiao Xie, Gaoqi He, Wenxi Li

entry.summary: Reports the NTIRE 2026 challenge on mobile real-world image super-resolution with x4 scaling, evaluating models executable on mobile devices. 108 registrants with 16 teams achieving valid results.

entry.title: From Adaptation to Generalization: Adaptive Visual Prompting for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Evren \c{C}etinkaya, Sangmin Lee, Jung Uk Kim, Hong Joo Lee, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Proposes APEX, an adaptive prompt extraction framework for medical image segmentation that retrieves input-specific prompts from learnable memory using Fourier spectrum domain features.

entry.title: AutoVQA-G: Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Visual Question Answering and Grounding Annotation

author.name: Rongsheng Hu, Runwei Guan, Yicheng Di, Jiayu Bao, Yuan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces AutoVQA-G, a self-improving agentic framework for automated VQA with grounding annotation, using Chain-of-Thought reasoning for verification and memory-augmented prompt optimization.

entry.title: GeGS-PCR: Effective and Robust 3D Point Cloud Registration with Two-Stage Color-Enhanced Geometric-3DGS Fusion

author.name: Jiayi Tian, Haiduo Huang, Tian Xia, Wenzhe Zhao, Pengju Ren

entry.summary: GeGS-PCR presents a two-stage point cloud registration method that combines geometric, color, and 3D Gaussian Splatting information for robust registration in low-overlap scenarios, using LoRA optimization for efficiency.

entry.title: GR4CIL: Gap-compensated Routing for CLIP-based Class Incremental Learning

author.name: Tianqi Wang, Jingcai Guo

entry.summary: GR4CIL proposes gap-compensated routing for CLIP-based class incremental learning, combining task discrimination with knowledge routing to avoid old-knowledge drift while maintaining calibrated cross-task responses.

entry.title: Brain-Inspired Capture: Evidence-Driven Neuromimetic Perceptual Simulation for Visual Decoding

author.name: Feixue Shao, Guangze Shi, Xueyu Liu, Yongfei Wu, Mingqiang Wei, Jianan Zhang, Jianbo Lu, Guiying Yan, Weihua Yang

entry.summary: BI-Cap proposes a brain-inspired visual decoding paradigm that emulates human visual system processing through neuromimetic transformations and mutual information-guided regulation for BCI applications.

entry.title: CFSR: Geometry-Conditioned Shadow Removal via Physical Disentanglement

author.name: Pan Wang, Yihao Hu, Xiujin Liu, Hang Wang

entry.summary: CFSR proposes physics-constrained shadow removal by integrating 3D geometric cues with foundation model semantics in a custom HVI color space, bridging 2D-3D domain gap for shadow removal.

entry.title: Enhancing Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models via Dynamic Prefix Weighting

author.name: Hyeonseo Jang, Hyuk Kwon, Kibok Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Dynamic Prefix Weighting for continual learning of VLMs, dynamically assigning weights to prefixes rather than normalizing them uniformly, complemented by adapters for domain-class incremental learning.

entry.title: CanonSLR: Canonical-View Guided Multi-View Continuous Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Xu Wang, Shengeng Tang, Wan Jiang, Yaxiong Wang, Lechao Cheng, Richang Hong

entry.summary: CanonSLR proposes canonical-view guided multi-view continuous sign language recognition using frontal-view-anchored teacher-student learning and sequence-level soft-target distillation.

entry.title: Learned Nonlocal Feature Matching and Filtering for RAW Image Denoising

author.name: Marco S\'anchez-Beeckman (IAC3, Departament de Ci\`encies Matem\`atiques i Inform\`atica, Universitat de les Illes Balears), Antoni Buades (IAC3, Departament de Ci\`encies Matem\`atiques i Inform\`atica, Universitat de les Illes Balears)

entry.summary: Proposes a RAW image denoising architecture incorporating classical self-similarity-based denoising principles with learned nonlocal feature matching and filtering, bridging classical denoising knowledge with deep learning.

entry.title: Relative State Estimation using Event-Based Propeller Sensing

author.name: Ravi Kumar Thakur, Luis Granados Segura, Jan Klivan, Radim \v{S}petl\'ik, Tobi\'a\v{s} Vinkl\'arek, Matou\v{s} Vrba, Martin Saska

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for relative state estimation between quadrotors using event cameras to detect and track propellers, leveraging event cameras' low latency and high dynamic range for UAV swarms.

entry.title: Impact of leaky dynamics on predictive path integration accuracy in recurrent neural networks

author.name: Yanlin Zhang, Yan Zhang, Muhua Zheng, Kesheng Xu

entry.summary: Studies how leaky dynamics in recurrent neural networks affect the emergence of hexagonal grid-cell-like firing patterns for path integration, showing that adaptive time scales enhance regularity of spatial representations.

entry.title: The Magnitude of Dominated Sets: A Pareto Compliant Indicator Grounded in Metric Geometry

author.name: Michael T. M. Emmerich

entry.summary: Investigates magnitude from metric geometry as a new Pareto-compliant quality indicator for multi-objective optimization, showing it relates to but differs from hypervolume by including lower-dimensional contributions.

entry.title: An Edge-Host-Cloud Architecture for Robot-Agnostic, Caregiver-in-the-Loop Personalized Cognitive Exercise: Multi-Site Deployment in Dementia Care

author.name: Wenzheng Zhao, Ruth Palan Lopez, Shu Fen Wung, Fengpei Yuan

entry.summary: Presents Speaking Memories, a distributed robotic platform for personalized cognitive exercise in dementia care, integrating caregiver knowledge, edge intelligence, and embodied agents with multi-site deployment.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Optimization for Accelerated Convergence of Redundant Dual-Arm Minimum Time Problems

author.name: Jushan Chen, Jonathan Fried, Santiago Paternain

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based optimization framework for minimizing dual-arm robot trajectory time, enabling L∞ Cartesian error constraints that gradient-based methods couldn't handle efficiently.

entry.title: Think before Go: Hierarchical Reasoning for Image-goal Navigation

author.name: Pengna Li, Kangyi Wu, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Lin Zhao, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: HRNav decomposes image-goal navigation into high-level reasoning/planning and low-level execution, inspired by human cognitive principles of deliberate reasoning guiding reactive execution. Addresses failure modes when targets are distant or in other rooms.

entry.title: StableIDM: Stabilizing Inverse Dynamics Model against Manipulator Truncation via Spatio-Temporal Refinement

author.name: Kerui Li, Zhe Jing, Xiaofeng Wang, Zheng Zhu, Yukun Zhou, Guan Huang, Dongze Li, Qingkai Yang, Huaibo Huang

entry.summary: StableIDM addresses manipulator truncation (partial observability of the robot arm in images) in inverse dynamics models through spatio-temporal refinement including robot-centric masking, directional feature aggregation, and temporal reasoning.

entry.title: Bayesian experimental design: grouped geometric pooled posterior via ensemble Kalman methods

author.name: Huchen Yang, Xinghao Dong, Jinlong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a grouped geometric pooled posterior framework for Bayesian experimental design that maintains accuracy while keeping computational cost at the amortized level, addressing the tradeoff between per-sample inference and amortized approaches.

entry.title: Attraction, Repulsion, and Friction: Introducing DMF, a Friction-Augmented Drifting Model

author.name: Arkadii Kazanskii, Tatiana Petrova, Konstantin Bagrianskii, Aleksandr Puzikov, Radu State

entry.summary: Extends Drifting Models with theoretical analysis of repulsive regimes and proves identifiability of the drift-field equilibrium, introducing a friction-augmented variant with finite-horizon error bounds.

entry.title: CAARL: In-Context Learning for Interpretable Co-Evolving Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Etienne Tajeuna, Patrick Asante Owusu, Armelle Brun, Shengrui Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CAARL, which uses LLMs for co-evolving time series forecasting by decomposing series into autoregressive segments, constructing temporal dependency graphs, and serializing them into narratives for chain-of-thought-like reasoning.

entry.title: Neighbor Embedding for High-Dimensional Sparse Poisson Data

author.name: Noga Mudrik, Adam S. Charles

entry.summary: Develops neighbor embedding methods specifically designed for high-dimensional sparse Poisson count data, common in neuroscience, NLP, and communications. Existing methods like t-SNE assume continuous data and fail on sparse counts.

entry.title: ltzGLUE: Luxembourgish General Language Understanding Evaluation

author.name: Alistair Plum, Felicia K\"orner, Anne-Marie Lutgen, Laura Bernardy, Fred Philippy, Emilia Milano, Nils Rehlinger, C\'edric Lothritz, Tharindu Ranasinghe, Barbara Plank, Christoph Purschke

entry.summary: Presents ltzGLUE, the first NLU benchmark for Luxembourgish covering NER, topic classification, and intent classification. Evaluates various pre-trained language models for this underserved language.

entry.title: Conditional Evidence Reconstruction and Decomposition for Interpretable Multimodal Diagnosis

author.name: Shaowen Wan, Yanjun Lv, Lu Zhang, Dajiang Zhu, Bharat Biswal, Tianming Liu, Xiaobo Li, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a conditional evidence reconstruction framework for multimodal medical diagnosis that handles incomplete modalities and provides interpretable decomposition of diagnostic evidence.

entry.title: PPEDCRF: Dynamic-CRF-Guided Selective Perturbation for Background-Based Location Privacy in Video Sequences

author.name: Bo Ma, Weiqi Yan, Jinsong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes PPEDCRF, a privacy protection framework that selectively perturbs background regions in video frames to prevent location identification through visual geo-tagging, using dynamic CRF for location-sensitive region estimation.

entry.title: Enhancing Zero-shot Personalized Image Aesthetics Assessment with Profile-aware Multimodal LLM

author.name: Chun Wang, Chenfeng Wei, Chenyang Liu, Weihong Deng

entry.summary: Proposes P-MLLM for zero-shot personalized image aesthetics assessment using user profiles as contextual signals, with selective fusion modules for controlled visual integration into a frozen LLM.

entry.title: Dual-Anchoring: Addressing State Drift in Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Kangyi Wu, Pengna Li, Kailin Lyu, Lin Zhao, Qingrong He, Jinjun Wang, Jianyi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Dual-Anchoring for vision-language navigation addressing State Drift in long scenarios through Progress Drift and Memory Drift mitigation, anchoring the agent's internal state to task progress and visited landmarks.

entry.title: MEDN: Motion-Emotion Feature Decoupling Network for Micro-Expression Recognition

author.name: Chenxing Hu, Kun Xie, Qiguang Miao, Ruyi Liu, Quan Wang, Zongkai Yang

entry.summary: MEDN introduces a motion-emotion feature decoupling network for micro-expression recognition, with separate branches for explicit motion cues (AUs) and implicit emotion information.

entry.title: Chatting about Upper-Body Expressive Human Pose and Shape Estimation

author.name: Yuxiang Zhao, Wei Huang, Yujie Song, Liu Wang, Huan Zhao

entry.summary: CoEvoer proposes a one-stage cross-dependency transformer for upper-body expressive human pose and shape estimation, enabling explicit feature interaction across body, face, and hand regions.

entry.title: HABIT: Chrono-Synergia Robust Progressive Learning Framework for Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Shiqi Zhang, Qinlei Huang, Zhiheng Fu, Yinwei Wei

entry.summary: HABIT proposes a robust progressive learning framework for composed image retrieval that addresses the Noise Triplet Correspondence problem arising from annotation errors, estimating semantic discrepancy and adapting progressively.

entry.title: EmbodiedLGR: Integrating Lightweight Graph Representation and Retrieval for Semantic-Spatial Memory in Robotic Agents

author.name: Paolo Riva, Leonardo Gargani, Matteo Frosi, Matteo Matteucci

entry.summary: EmbodiedLGR proposes a lightweight graph-based memory architecture for robotic agents, enabling efficient storage and retrieval of semantic-spatial observations for human-robot interaction with human-like response times.

entry.title: mEOL: Training-Free Instruction-Guided Multimodal Embedder for Vector Graphics and Image Retrieval

author.name: Kyeong Seon Kim, Baek Seong-Eun, Lee Jung-Mok, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: Proposes mEOL, a training-free instruction-guided multimodal embedding framework using MLLMs to map text, raster images, and SVG code into an aligned embedding space for vector graphics retrieval.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Attention Analysis and Optimization in Vision-Language Models: A Study on Visual Reliability

author.name: Lijie Zhou

entry.summary: Studies cross-modal attention in VLMs revealing text shortcut learning, and proposes adversarial evaluation framework with LoRA fine-tuning strategies to improve visual reliability.

entry.title: HyKey: Hyperspectral Keypoint Detection and Matching in Minimally Invasive Surgery

author.name: Alexander Saikia, Chiara Di Vece, Zhehua Mao, Sierra Bonilla, Chloe He, Joao Ramalhinho, Tobias Czempiel, Sophia Bano, Danail Stoyanov

entry.summary: Develops HyKey, a hyperspectral keypoint detection model for minimally invasive surgery using hybrid 3D-2D CNN to extract spatial-spectral features from snapshot hyperspectral imaging.

entry.title: ReTrack: Evidence-Driven Dual-Stream Directional Anchor Calibration Network for Composed Video Retrieval

author.name: Zixu Li, Yupeng Hu, Zhiwei Chen, Qinlei Huang, Guozhi Qiu, Zhiheng Fu, Meng Liu

entry.summary: ReTrack proposes a dual-stream directional anchor calibration network for composed video retrieval, addressing information density discrepancy between video and text modalities in multi-modal queries.

entry.title: DifFoundMAD: Foundation Models meet Differential Morphing Attack Detection

author.name: Lazaro J. Gonzalez-Soler, Andr\'e D\"orsch, Christian Rathgeb, Christoph Busch

entry.summary: DifFoundMAD leverages vision foundation model embeddings for differential morphing attack detection with parameter-efficient finetuning, replacing traditional face recognition embeddings.

entry.title: INTENT: Invariance and Discrimination-aware Noise Mitigation for Robust Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Zhiwei Chen, Yupeng Hu, Zhiheng Fu, Zixu Li, Jiale Huang, Qinlei Huang, Yinwei Wei

entry.summary: INTENT addresses noisy triplet correspondence in composed image retrieval by distinguishing cross-modal correspondence noise from modality-inherent noise, applying invariance and discrimination-aware mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Characterising LLM-Generated Competency Questions: a Cross-Domain Empirical Study using Open and Closed Models

author.name: Reham Alharbi, Valentina Tamma, Terry R. Payne, Jacopo de Berardinis

entry.summary: Empirical study characterizing how different LLMs (open and closed) generate competency questions for ontology engineering across domains. Examines how model parameters, specialization, and accessibility affect the quality and characteristics of generated ontology requirements.

entry.title: Using Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs to Improve the Interpretability of Machine Learning Models in Manufacturing

author.name: Thomas Bayer, Alexander Lohr, Sarah Wei{\ss}, Bernd Michelberger, Wolfram H\"opken

entry.summary: Presents a method combining Knowledge Graphs with LLMs to improve interpretability of ML models in manufacturing, storing domain data and ML explanations in a KG and using selective retrieval to generate user-friendly explanations.

entry.title: Seeing the Intangible: Survey of Image Classification into High-Level and Abstract Categories

author.name: Delfina Sol Martinez Pandiani, Valentina Presutti

entry.summary: Survey systematically reviewing research on high-level visual understanding, focusing on abstract concepts in image classification. Categorizes high-level semantics into commonsense, emotional, aesthetic, and inductive interpretative clusters.

entry.title: Explainable Iterative Data Visualisation Refinement via an LLM Agent

author.name: Burak Susam, Tingting Mu

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic pipeline using LLMs to iteratively refine data visualization by bridging quantitative assessment with qualitative human insight, treating visualization evaluation and hyperparameter tuning as an automated optimization loop.

entry.title: Uncertainty, Vagueness, and Ambiguity in Human-Robot Interaction: Why Conceptualization Matters

author.name: Xiaowen Sun, Cornelius Weber, Matthias Kerzel, Josua Spisak, Stefan Wermter

entry.summary: Proposes a consistent conceptual foundation for uncertainty, vagueness, and ambiguity in human-robot interaction, addressing contradictory definitions and inconsistent terminology that undermine empirical comparability in HRI research.

entry.title: MRGEN: A Conceptual Framework for LLM-Powered Mixed Reality Authoring Tools for Education

author.name: Mohammed Oussama Seddini (LIUM), Mohamed Ez-Zaouia (UR, IRISA, DRUID), Ngoc Luyen Le (Heudiasyc), Iza Marfisi (LIUM, IUT Laval)

entry.summary: MRGEN is a framework for LLM-powered mixed reality authoring tools that help teachers create MR learning activities. A user study with 24 participants showed LLM-powered authoring reduced task duration by 36% with 90%+ finding AI support helpful.

entry.title: The Crutch or the Ceiling? How Different Generations of LLMs Shape EFL Student Writings

author.name: Hengky Susanto, David James Woo, Chingyi Yeung, Stephanie Wing Yan Lo-Philip, Chi Ho Yeung

entry.summary: Examines how different generations of LLMs affect EFL student writing, assessing whether smarter models act as scaffolds or compensatory crutches. Compares compositions assisted by LLMs before and after ChatGPT's release using multiple metrics.

entry.title: Natural gradient descent with momentum

author.name: Anthony Nouy, Agust\'in Somacal

entry.summary: Studies natural gradient descent (NGD) with momentum for optimization on nonlinear manifolds like neural networks and tensor networks. Provides theoretical analysis showing momentum-enhanced NGD can achieve faster convergence with locally optimal updates in function space.

entry.title: CSLE: A Reinforcement Learning Platform for Autonomous Security Management

author.name: Kim Hammar

entry.summary: Presents CSLE, a reinforcement learning platform for autonomous security management that enables experimentation under realistic conditions using emulation systems. Bridges the gap between simulation-only RL security solutions and operational deployment.

entry.title: HYPERHEURIST: A Simulated Annealing-Based Control Framework for LLM-Driven Code Generation in Optimized Hardware Design

author.name: Shiva Ahir, Prajna Bhat, Alex Doboli

entry.summary: Proposes HYPERHEURIST, a simulated annealing framework that treats LLM-generated RTL hardware designs as intermediate candidates, filtering and optimizing for both correctness and power-performance-area metrics.

entry.title: cuNNQS-SCI: A Fully GPU-Accelerated Framework for High-Performance Configuration Interaction Selection with Neural Network Quantum States

author.name: Daran Sun, Bowen Kan, Haoquan Long, Hairui Zhao, Haoxu Li, Yicheng Liu, Pengyu Zhou, Ankang Feng, Wenjing Huang, Yida Gu, Zhenyu Li, Honghui Shang, Yunquan Zhang, Dingwen Tao, Ninghui Sun, Guangming Tan

entry.summary: Introduces cuNNQS-SCI, a fully GPU-accelerated framework for neural network quantum state selected configuration interaction, removing CPU bottlenecks in quantum chemistry simulations.

entry.title: Phase Transitions as the Breakdown of Statistical Indistinguishability

author.name: Taiyo Narita, Hideyuki Miyahara

entry.summary: Introduces a novel characterization of phase transitions using hypothesis testing, defining them as breakdown of statistical indistinguishability. Demonstrates identification of Ising model critical points without prior knowledge.

entry.title: Stylistic-STORM (ST-STORM) : Perceiving the Semantic Nature of Appearance

author.name: Hamed Ouattara, Pierre Duthon, Pascal Houssam Salmane, Fr\'ed\'eric Bernardin, Omar Ait Aider

entry.summary: Proposes ST-STORM for self-supervised learning that preserves weather-related appearance features rather than learning invariances to them, relevant for autonomous driving weather perception.

entry.title: AIFIND: Artifact-Aware Interpreting Fine-Grained Alignment for Incremental Face Forgery Detection

author.name: Hao Wang, Beichen Zhang, Yanpei Gong, Shaoyi Fang, Zhaobo Qi, Yuanrong Xu, Xinyan Liu, Weigang Zhang

entry.summary: AIFIND addresses incremental face forgery detection by using artifact-aware semantic anchors to stabilize feature spaces during continual learning. It combats catastrophic forgetting through fixed semantic coordinate systems derived from low-level artifact cues. Incremental deepfake detection is practically important as new forgery types constantly emerge.

entry.title: Joint-Centric Dual Contrastive Alignment with Structure-Preserving and Information-Balanced Regularization

author.name: Habibeh Naderi, Behrouz Haji Soleimani, Stan Matwin

entry.summary: Presents HILBERT, a cross-attentive multimodal framework for learning document-level audio-text representations from long, segmented sequences in low-resource settings. Uses frozen pretrained encoders with cross-modal attention and a reciprocal dual contrastive objective to handle dimensional imbalance between modalities.

entry.title: CGCMA: Conditionally-Gated Cross-Modal Attention for Event-Conditioned Asynchronous Fusion

author.name: Yunxiang Guo

entry.summary: Proposes CGCMA for asynchronous multimodal fusion where a dense primary stream must be fused with sporadic external context, separating text-conditioned grounding from lag-aware trust control. Tests on cryptocurrency markets as a stress test.

entry.title: FedOBP: Federated Optimal Brain Personalization through Cloud-Edge Element-wise Decoupling

author.name: Xingyan Chen, Tian Du, Changqiao Xu, Fuzhen Zhuang, Lujie Zhong, Gabriel-Miro Muntean, Enmao Diao

entry.summary: Proposes FedOBP for personalized federated learning with element-wise model decoupling using quantile-based thresholding and importance scores extending optimal brain damage theory.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Depression Estimation via Disentangled Evidential Learning

author.name: Fangyuan Liu, Sirui Zhao, Zeyu Zhang, Jinyang Huang, Feng-Qi Cui, Bin Luo, Tong Xu, Meng Li, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EviDep, an evidential learning framework for depression estimation that quantifies severity alongside aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties via Normal-Inverse-Gamma distributions, addressing overconfident misdiagnoses in clinical settings.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Bayesian Low-Rank Adaptation for Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Learning

author.name: Habibeh Naderi, Behrouz Haji Soleimani, Stan Matwin

entry.summary: Introduces CALIBER, another multimodal uncertainty-aware PEFT framework for audio-text learning, extending Bayesian low-rank adaptation with cross-modal attention conditioning. Very similar to CoCo-LoRA (same authors).

entry.title: Neuroscience Inspired Graph Operators Towards Edge-Deployable Virtual Sensing for Irregular Geometries

author.name: William Howes, Farid Ahmed, Kazuma Kobayashi, Souvik Chakraborty, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Proposes neuroscience-inspired graph operators for edge-deployable virtual sensing on irregular geometries, using spiking neuron integration for power-efficient neural operator inference.

entry.title: Covariance-Based Structural Equation Modeling in Small-Sample Settings with $p>n$

author.name: Hiroki Hasegawa, Aoba Tamura, Yukihiko Okada

entry.summary: Extends covariance-based structural equation modeling (SEM) to small-sample settings where the number of variables exceeds observations (p>n), using a novel decomposition into self- and cross-covariance components.

entry.title: L1 Regularization Paths in Linear Models by Parametric Gaussian Message Passing

author.name: Yun-Peng Li, Hans-Andrea Loeliger

entry.summary: Proposes two dual algorithms for computing L1 regularization paths in state space settings using parametric Gaussian message passing, applicable to Kalman smoothing, SVMs, and LASSO.

entry.title: BOIL: Learning Environment Personalized Information

author.name: Rohan Patil, Henrik I. Christensen

entry.summary: BOIL uses PageRank and common information maximization to extract environment structure insights for guiding long-term multi-agent behavior in problems like coverage and patrolling.

entry.title: Trustworthy deep domain adaptation for wearable photoplethysmography signal analysis with decision-theoretic uncertainty quantification

author.name: Ciaran Bench

entry.summary: Develops decision-theoretic uncertainty quantification for domain adaptation in wearable photoplethysmography signals, addressing hallucinations in generative domain adaptation models.

entry.title: STEP-PD: Stage-Aware and Explainable Parkinson's Disease Severity Classification Using Multimodal Clinical Assessments

author.name: Md Mezbahul Islam, John Michael Templeton, Christian Poellabauer, Ananda Mohan Mondal

entry.summary: STEP-PD classifies Parkinson's disease severity using clinically interpretable boundaries from multi-visit PPMI data, integrating subjective questionnaires and objective clinical measures.

entry.title: RASP-Tuner: Retrieval-Augmented Soft Prompts for Context-Aware Black-Box Optimization in Non-Stationary Environments

author.name: Enze Pan

entry.summary: Presents RASP-Tuner, which uses retrieval-augmented soft prompts for context-aware black-box optimization in non-stationary environments, combining regime identification via retrieval with mixture-of-experts surrogates.

entry.title: Towards Real-Time ECG and EMG Modeling on $\mu$ NPUs

author.name: Josh Millar, Ashok Samraj Thangarajan, Soumyajit Chatterjee, Hamed Haddadi

entry.summary: Introduces PhysioLite, a lightweight NPU-compatible model for ECG/EMG signal analysis on microcontroller-scale hardware, using learnable wavelet filter banks and hardware-aware design to enable real-time physiological inference on wearables.

entry.title: Generalization Boundaries of Fine-Tuned Small Language Models for Graph Structural Inference

author.name: Michal Podstawski

entry.summary: Systematically investigates generalization boundaries of fine-tuned small language models (3-4B parameters) for graph structural inference, examining size and family distribution generalization axes.

entry.title: Dissipative Latent Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Modeling and Identification of Electromechanical Systems

author.name: Youyuan Long, Gokhan Solak, Arash Ajoudani

entry.summary: Proposes DiLaR-PINN, a physics-informed neural network that enforces dissipative constraints on residual learning for electromechanical systems, preventing artificial energy injection by unconstrained neural networks.

entry.title: An Integrated Deep-Learning Framework for Peptide-Protein Interaction Prediction and Target-Conditioned Peptide Generation with ConGA-PePPI and TC-PepGen

author.name: Chupei Tang, Junxiao Kong, Moyu Tang, Di Wang, Jixiu Zhai, Ronghao Xie, Shangkun Sima, Tianchi Lu

entry.summary: Presents an integrated framework for peptide-protein interaction prediction (ConGA-PepPI) and target-conditioned peptide generation (TC-PepGen), combining prediction, localization, and generation capabilities.

entry.title: Faster by Design: Interactive Aerodynamics via Neural Surrogates Trained on Expert-Validated CFD

author.name: Nicholas Thumiger, Andrea Bartezzaghi, Mattia Rigotti, Cezary Skura, Thomas Frick, Elisa Serioli, Fabrizio Arbucci, A. Cristiano I. Malossi

entry.summary: Presents a neural surrogate trained on expert-validated CFD data for race-car aerodynamics, introducing a high-fidelity LMP2-class RANS dataset spanning six operating conditions to enable interactive design exploration.

entry.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Risk-Sensitive Estimation via Conditional Value-at-Risk

author.name: Feras Al Taha, Eilyan Bitar

entry.summary: Proposes a distributionally robust approach to risk-sensitive estimation using CVaR with Wasserstein ambiguity sets, showing the problem reduces to a semidefinite program for finitely supported nominal distributions.

entry.title: Modeling User Exploration Saturation: When Recommender Systems Should Stop Pushing Novelty

author.name: Enock O. Ayiku, Evelyn Osei, Emebo Onyeka

entry.summary: Studies exploration saturation in recommender systems—the point where further novelty injection no longer improves engagement—proposing user-dependent models for adaptive exploration control.

entry.title: FairLogue: Evaluating Intersectional Fairness across Clinical Machine Learning Use Cases using the All of Us Research Program

author.name: Nick Souligne, Vignesh Subbian

entry.summary: Introduces FairLogue, a toolkit for intersectional fairness auditing of clinical ML models, evaluated on the All of Us dataset across multiple prediction tasks. Addresses the gap where most fairness evaluations assess demographic attributes independently rather than intersectionally.

entry.title: Scalable Quantum Error Mitigation with Physically Informed Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Huaxin Wang, Xinge Wu, Jiajun Liu, Ruiqing He, Jiandong Shang, Hengliang Guo, Qiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes GEM, a graph neural network framework for quantum error mitigation that encodes quantum circuits as attributed graphs with hardware noise parameters. Addresses scalability limitations of traditional QEM methods.

entry.title: Towards Deep Encrypted Training: Low-Latency, Memory-Efficient, and High-Throughput Inference for Privacy-Preserving Neural Networks

author.name: Nges Brian Njungle, Eric Jahns, Michel A. Kinsy

entry.summary: Develops optimized algorithms for batched homomorphic encryption-friendly neural networks, including pipeline architecture for different batch sizes. Addresses the gap between single-image HE inference and practical batch processing needs.

entry.title: Singularity Formation: Synergy in Theoretical, Numerical and Machine Learning Approaches

author.name: Yixuan Wang

entry.summary: PhD thesis developing numerical and theoretical approaches for understanding singularity formation in PDEs, including the Navier-Stokes equations. Combines ML-guided numerical methods with formal analytical frameworks.

entry.title: E2E-WAVE: End-to-End Learned Waveform Generation for Underwater Video Multicasting

author.name: Khizar Anjum, Tingcong Jiang, Dario Pompili

entry.summary: Presents E2E-WAVE, the first end-to-end learned waveform generation for underwater video multicasting. Embeds semantic similarity into physical waveforms so decoding errors produce semantically similar rather than arbitrary corruptions. Achieves +5dB PSNR over FEC baselines.

entry.title: Leveraging Kernel Symmetry for Joint Compression and Error Mitigation in Edge Model Transfer

author.name: Anis Hamadouche, Mathini Sellathurai

entry.summary: Proposes a degrees-of-freedom based codec that exploits structured symmetry in convolutional kernels to compress neural network transmission, sending only unique coefficients and reconstructing full weights at the receiver. Includes a projection step for robustness under noisy channels.

entry.title: Learning Unanimously Acceptable Lotteries via Queries

author.name: Davin Choo, Paul W. Goldberg, Nicholas Teh

entry.summary: Studies query-based algorithms for finding unanimously acceptable lotteries over options for multiple stakeholders, providing deterministic and randomized algorithms with complexity bounds. Relevant to fair AI deployment requiring stakeholder consensus.

entry.title: On The Mathematics of the Natural Physics of Optimization

author.name: I. M. Ross

entry.summary: Explores whether optimization algorithms obey 'natural laws of motion' by connecting terminal transversality conditions of optimal control with KKT conditions. Develops a non-Newtonian dynamics theory for optimization algorithm primitives.

entry.title: A Quasi-Experimental Developer Study of Security Training in LLM-Assisted Web Application Development

author.name: Mohammed Kharma, Ahmed Sabbah, Radi Jarrar, Samer Zain, Mohammad Alkhanafseh, David Mohaisen

entry.summary: Quasi-experimental study examining whether security training improves code quality when developers use LLM-assisted Java development. 12 developers completed pre/post training tasks; results assessed via manual code review.

entry.title: DiffuSAM: Diffusion Guided Zero-Shot Object Grounding for Remote Sensing Imagery

author.name: Geet Sethi, Panav Shah, Ashutosh Gandhe, Soumitra Darshan Nayak

entry.summary: Proposes DiffuSAM, a hybrid pipeline combining diffusion-based localization cues with segmentation models (RemoteSAM, SAM3) for zero-shot object grounding in remote sensing, achieving 14% improvement in Acc@0.5.

entry.title: Centre manifold theorem for maps along manifolds of fixed points

author.name: Lachlan Ewen MacDonald

entry.summary: Proves a centre manifold theorem for maps along manifolds-with-boundary of fixed points, with application to gradient descent with large step size on two-layer matrix factorization.

entry.title: TacticGen: Grounding Adaptable and Scalable Generation of Football Tactics

author.name: Sheng Xu, Guiliang Liu, Tarak Kharrat, Yudong Luo, Mohamed Aloulou, Javier L\'opez Pe\~na, Konstantin Sofeikov, Adam Reid, Paul Roberts, Steven Spencer, Joe Carnall, Ian McHale, Oliver Schulte, Hongyuan Zha, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: Presents TacticGen, a generative model for football tactic generation using multi-agent diffusion transformers conditioned on game context. Formulates tactics as sequences of multi-agent movements and interactions.

entry.title: DeepRitzSplit Neural Operator for Phase-Field Models via Energy Splitting

author.name: Chih-Kang Huang, Ludovick Gagnon, Miha Zalo\v{z}nik, Beno\^it Appolaire

entry.summary: Proposes DeepRitzSplit, a neural operator combining convex-concave energy splitting with physics-informed learning to accelerate phase-field solidification simulations. Bridges classical numerical schemes with deep learning.

entry.title: Spectral bandits for smooth graph functions

author.name: Michal Valko, R\'emi Munos, Branislav Kveton, Tom\'a\v{s} Koc\'ak

entry.summary: Studies bandits with payoffs smooth on a graph, introducing effective dimension and two algorithms with regret bounds that don't scale poorly with node count. Applicable to content recommendation on graphs.

entry.title: Learning the Riccati solution operator for time-varying LQR via Deep Operator Networks

author.name: Jun Chen, Umberto Biccari, Junmin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes learning the Riccati solution operator for time-varying LQR via Deep Operator Networks, replacing repeated numerical integration with a learned surrogate. Provides control-theoretic guarantees.

entry.title: Revisiting a Pain in the Neck: A Semantic Reasoning Benchmark for Language Models

author.name: Yang Liu, Hongming Li, Melissa Xiaohui Qin, Qiankun Liu, Chao Huang

entry.summary: SemanticQA benchmarks language models on semantic phrase processing including idioms, noun compounds, and verbal constructions. Reveals substantial performance variation on tasks requiring semantic reasoning across architectures and scales.

entry.title: Beyond Black-Box Labels: Interpretable Criteria for Diagnosing SubjectiveNLP Tasks

author.name: Nisrine Rair, Alban Goupil, Valeriu Vrabie, Emmanuel Chochoy

entry.summary: Proposes a schema-level diagnostic for auditing annotation schemas before gold-label commitment, separating unstable criteria from systematic category overlap. Applied to persuasive value extraction in commercial documents.

entry.title: Dynamic Emotion and Personality Profiling for Multimodal Deception Detection

author.name: Li Zheng, Yanyi Luo, Hao Fei, Yuzhe Ding, Yujie Huang, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Donghong Ji

entry.summary: Proposes Rel-DDEP for multimodal deception detection using dynamic emotion and personality profiling with reliability-weighted fusion in Gaussian distribution space. Constructs dataset with deception, emotion, and personality labels.

entry.title: Beyond Overlap Metrics: Rewarding Reasoning and Preferences for Faithful Multi-Role Dialogue Summarization

author.name: Xiaoyong Mei, Tingting Zuo, Da Chen, Guangyu Hu, Xiangyu Wen, Chao Duan, Mingyan Zhang, Fudan Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes reward-based optimization for multi-role dialogue summarization coupling cognitive-style reasoning with preference alignment. Distills structured reasoning traces from a teacher model for reasoning-aware summarization.

entry.title: Learning to Control Summaries with Score Ranking

author.name: Hongye Liu, Liang Ding, Ricardo Henao

entry.summary: Proposes a loss function aligning model outputs with fine-grained evaluation scores (FineSurE) to enable both quality improvement and dimension-specific control in summarization, addressing trade-offs between completeness and conciseness.

entry.title: Are Emotion and Rhetoric Neurons in LLM? Neuron Recognition and Adaptive Masking for Emotion-Rhetoric Prediction Steering

author.name: Li Zheng, Xin Zhang, Shuyi He, Fei Li, Chong Teng, Jiangming Yang, Donghong Ji, Zhuang Li

entry.summary: Systematically investigates emotion and rhetoric neurons in LLMs, proposing adaptive masking for prediction steering. Addresses counterintuitive phenomena in traditional neuron masking approaches.

entry.title: Beyond Fine-Tuning: In-Context Learning and Chain-of-Thought for Reasoned Distractor Generation

author.name: Elaf Alhazmi, Quan Z. Sheng, Wei Emma Zhang

entry.summary: Explores using LLM in-context learning and chain-of-thought for generating plausible wrong answers (distractors) for multiple-choice questions, comparing against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models. Shows LLMs can better capture expert reasoning for distractor selection.

entry.title: Mix and Match: Context Pairing for Scalable Topic-Controlled Educational Summarisation

author.name: Nathikan Yodthapa, Thanapong Intharah, Sahan Bulathwela

entry.summary: Investigates pairwise data augmentation for training small language models for topic-controlled summarization. Combines contexts from different documents to create contrastive training examples, showing consistent improvements with augmentation scale.

entry.title: ComPASS: Towards Personalized Agentic Social Support via Tool-Augmented Companionship

author.name: Zhaopei Huang, Yanfeng Jia, Jiayi Zhao, Xinjie Zhang, Wenxuan Wang, Qin Jin

entry.summary: Explores empowering conversational agents with external tools to provide personalized social support, grounded in psychology's concept of social support. Designs user-centric tools simulating multimedia applications for different types of social support.

entry.title: LQM: Linguistically Motivated Multidimensional Quality Metrics for Machine Translation

author.name: Samar M. Magdy, Fakhraddin Alwajih, Abdellah El Mekki, Wesam El-Sayed, Muhammad Abdul-Mageed

entry.summary: Introduces LQM, a linguistically motivated hierarchical error taxonomy for MT evaluation covering six linguistic levels. Addresses limitations of language-agnostic evaluation for diglossic languages like Arabic.

entry.title: LLMAR: A Tuning-Free Recommendation Framework for Sparse and Text-Rich Industrial Domains

author.name: Ryogo Hishikawa, Ichiro Kataoka, Shinya Yuda

entry.summary: Proposes LLMAR, a tuning-free recommendation framework for sparse, text-rich B2B domains that uses LLM reasoning to capture latent user motives without training. Addresses data sparsity in industrial applications.

entry.title: ESsEN: Training Compact Discriminative Vision-Language Transformers in a Low-Resource Setting

author.name: Clayton Fields, Casey Kennington

entry.summary: Explores training compact vision-language models in low-resource settings, finding two-tower encoders outperform one-tower in this regime. Inspired by child language development data sparsity patterns.

entry.title: Fast Online 3D Multi-Camera Multi-Object Tracking and Pose Estimation

author.name: Linh Van Ma, Tran Thien Dat Nguyen, Moongu Jeon

entry.summary: Proposes a fast online method for joint 3D multi-object tracking and pose estimation using multiple monocular cameras, requiring only 2D detections with a Bayes-optimal filter implementation.

entry.title: Expert-Annotated Embryo Image Dataset with Natural Language Descriptions for Evidence-Based Patient Communication in IVF

author.name: Nicklas Neu, Thomas Ebner, Jasmin Primus, Bernhard Schenkenfelder, Raphael Zefferer, Mathias Brunbauer, Florian Kromp

entry.summary: Introduces an expert-annotated embryo image dataset with natural language descriptions for IVF, targeting interpretable AI-assisted embryo selection and evidence-based patient communication.

entry.title: Camo-M3FD: A New Benchmark Dataset for Cross-Spectral Camouflaged Pedestrian Detection

author.name: Henry O. Velesaca, Andrea Mero, Guillermo A. Castillo, Angel D. Sappa

entry.summary: Introduces Camo-M3FD, a benchmark for cross-spectral camouflaged pedestrian detection combining visible and thermal sensors, addressing an unexplored gap in safety-critical human detection.

entry.title: CoGR-MoE: Concept-Guided Expert Routing with Consistent Selection and Flexible Reasoning for Visual Question Answering

author.name: Xiyin Zeng, Yi Lu, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CoGR-MoE for VQA using concept-guided expert routing with answer option semantics to balance routing stability and flexibility in mixture-of-experts models.

entry.title: TSM-Pose: Topology-Aware Learning with Semantic Mamba for Category-Level Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Jinshuo Liu, Bingtao Ma, Junlin Su, Guanyuan Pan, Beining Wu, Cheng Yang, Jiaxuan Lu, Chenggang Yan, Shuai Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TSM-Pose, a framework for category-level object pose estimation combining topology-aware learning with a Mamba-based architecture to capture category-shared topological structures. It introduces a Topology Extractor and Semantic Mamba module for robust generalization to unseen instances.

entry.title: TeMuDance: Contrastive Alignment-Based Textual Control for Music-Driven Dance Generation

author.name: Xinran Liu, Diptesh Kanojia, Wenwu Wang, Zhenhua Feng

entry.summary: Introduces TeMuDance, a framework enabling text-based control for music-conditioned dance generation without requiring manually annotated music-text-motion triplet datasets. Uses motion as a shared semantic anchor between modalities.

entry.title: IMA-MoE: An Interpretable Modality-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Characterizing the Neurobiological Signatures of Binge Eating Disorder

author.name: Lin Zhao, Qiaohui Gao, Elizabeth Martin, Kurt P. Schulz, Tom Hildebrandt, Robyn Sysko, Tianming Liu, Xiaobo Li

entry.summary: Proposes IMA-MoE, an interpretable modality-aware Mixture-of-Experts framework for characterizing neurobiological signatures of Binge Eating Disorder using multimodal brain data.

entry.title: CDSA-Net:Collaborative Decoupling of Vascular Structure and Background for High-Fidelity Coronary Digital Subtraction Angiography

author.name: Si Li, Chen-Kai Hu, Zhenhuan Lyu, Yuanqing He

entry.summary: Proposes CDSA-Net for coronary digital subtraction angiography that decouples vascular structure preservation from background restoration, addressing boundary artifacts and grayscale fidelity issues.

entry.title: Generalizable Face Forgery Detection via Separable Prompt Learning

author.name: Enrui Yang, Yuezun Li

entry.summary: Proposes SePL (Separable Prompt Learning) for CLIP-based face forgery detection, disentangling forgery-specific from forgery-irrelevant information through the text modality.

entry.title: Multi-Camera Self-Calibration in Sports Motion Capture: Leveraging Human and Stick Poses

author.name: Fan Yang, Changsoo Jung, Ryosuke Kawamura, Hon Yung Wong

entry.summary: Introduces a tool-free multi-camera extrinsic calibration method for sports motion capture that jointly leverages human body keypoints and rigid stick-like implements (e.g., golf clubs) of known length. A three-stage optimization pipeline resolves global scale without traditional calibration targets.

entry.title: Dual-stream Spatio-Temporal GCN-Transformer Network for 3D Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Jiawen Duan, Jian Xiang, Zhiqiang Li, Linlin Xue, Wan Xiang

entry.summary: MixTGFormer proposes a dual-stream architecture combining GCNs and Transformers for 3D human pose estimation, modeling spatial and temporal skeletal relationships through parallel channels for global-local feature fusion.

entry.title: PlankFormer: Robust Plankton Instance Segmentation via MAE-Pretrained Vision Transformers and Pseudo Community Image Generation

author.name: Masaharu Miyazaki, Yurie Otake, Koichi Ito, Wataru Makino, Jotaro Urabe, Takafumi Aoki

entry.summary: PlankFormer introduces a plankton instance segmentation framework using MAE-pretrained Vision Transformers and synthetic pseudo community image generation to overcome scarce annotated data.

entry.title: Multi-View Hierarchical Graph Neural Network for Sketch-Based 3D Shape Retrieval

author.name: Hang Cheng, Muyan He, Mingyu Fan, Chengfeng Xie, Xi Cheng, Long Zeng

entry.summary: MV-HGNN proposes a multi-view hierarchical graph neural network for sketch-based 3D shape retrieval, constructing view-level graphs to capture geometric relationships between views and enable zero-shot retrieval.

entry.title: LBFTI: Layer-Based Facial Template Inversion for Identity-Preserving Fine-Grained Face Reconstruction

author.name: Zixuan Shen, Zhihua Xia, Kaikai Gan, Peipeng Yu

entry.summary: Proposes LBFTI, a method to reconstruct identity-preserving face images from facial templates by decomposing faces into foreground, midground, and background layers with dedicated generators. This highlights privacy risks in face recognition systems where templates alone can leak identity information.

entry.title: Towards Robust Text-to-Image Person Retrieval: Multi-View Reformulation for Semantic Compensation

author.name: Chao Yuan, Yujian Zhao, Haoxuan Xu, Guanglin Niu

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic compensation framework using LLMs for text-to-image person retrieval, addressing 'Expression Drift' where semantically equivalent texts produce different embeddings. Uses multi-view reformulation to enhance cross-modal consistency.

entry.title: A Two-Stage Multi-Modal MRI Framework for Lifespan Brain Age Prediction

author.name: Dingyi Zhang, Ruiying Liu, Yun Wang

entry.summary: Develops a two-stage multi-modal MRI framework for lifespan brain age prediction, combining structural and diffusion MRI with late fusion across developmental stage classification and within-stage age estimation.

entry.title: AstroSURE: Learning to Remove Noise from Astronomical Images Without Ground Truth Data

author.name: Omid Vaheb, Sebastien Fabbro, Stark Draper

entry.summary: Evaluates deep learning denoising methods trainable without clean ground truth on astronomical imaging data from HST and CFHT, comparing Noise2Noise, SURE, and blind-spot methods using detection-oriented metrics.

entry.title: Chatting about Conditional Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Yuxiang Zhao, Wei Huang, Haipeng Zeng, Huan Zhao, Yujie Song

entry.summary: Proposes CiT for conditional trajectory prediction inspired by theory of mind, performing cross-time-domain intention interaction analysis for ego-agent-conditioned prediction of surrounding agents.

entry.title: On Scalability of Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms on Combinatorial Optimisation Problems

author.name: Menghao Tang, Zimin Liang, Miqing Li

entry.summary: Studies scalability of multi-objective evolutionary algorithms on combinatorial optimization problems, finding that simple algorithms like SEMO can outperform sophisticated MOEAs, unlike in continuous optimization.

entry.title: Similarity-based Portfolio Construction for Black-box Optimization

author.name: Catalin-Viorel Dinu, Diederick Vermetten, Carola Doerr

entry.summary: Proposes similarity-based portfolio construction for black-box optimization that selects algorithm portfolios based on problem similarity, offering variance reduction and complementarity between algorithms.

entry.title: Interdisciplinary Workshop on Mechanical Intelligence: Summary Report

author.name: Victoria A. Webster-Wood, Nicholas Gravish, Amir Alavi, Andres F Arrieta, Sarah Bergbreiter, Anthony Bloch, Laura Blumenschein, C. Chase Cao, Aja Mia Carter, Paolo Celli, Tony Chen, Margaret Coad, Mark Cutkosky, Michael Dickey, Brian Do, Robert Full, Mahdi Haghshenas-Jaryani, Kaushik Jayaram, Aaron Johnson, Eva Kanso, Emma Lejeune, Chen Li, Suyi Li, Jeffrey Lipton, Rob MacCurdy, Matt McHenry, Jean-Michel Mongeau, Todd Murphey, Mark Plecnik, Jordan Raney, Ryan D. Sochol, Hannah Stuart, Zeynep Temel, Michael Tolley, Barry Trimmer, T. J. Wallin, Kon-Well Wang, Wenzhong Yan, Mark Yim, Wenlong Zhang

entry.summary: Summary report from the 2024 Interdisciplinary Workshop on Mechanical Intelligence at NSF, covering how structural features of materials and robots can encode intelligence through mechanical properties rather than computation.

entry.title: Emergency Stopping for Liquid-manipulating Robots

author.name: Samuli Hynninen, Ville Kyrki

entry.summary: Presents an emergency stop system for robots manipulating liquids in open containers, formulated as optimal control in MPC framework to generate time-optimal spill-free stopping trajectories.

entry.title: Autonomous Vehicle Collision Avoidance With Racing Parameterized Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Shathushan Sivashangaran, Vihaan Dutta, Apoorva Khairnar, Sepideh Gohari, Azim Eskandarian

entry.summary: Proposes parameterized deep RL collision avoidance trained out-of-distribution using race car overtaking scenarios, transferring to autonomous vehicle emergency collision avoidance at vehicle dynamics limits.

entry.title: LiDAR-based Crowd Navigation with Visible Edge Group Representation

author.name: Allan Wang, Aaron Steinfeld

entry.summary: Proposes visible edge-based group representation for LiDAR-based crowd navigation, showing that group prediction accuracy affects navigation performance only marginally while the representation simplifies the system.

entry.title: Greedy Kalman-Swarm: Improving State Estimation in Robot Swarms in Harsh Environments

author.name: Phunyapa Suksomboon, Paulo Garcia

entry.summary: Proposes Greedy Kalman-Swarm for decentralized state estimation in robot swarms, combining Kalman filtering with greedy neighbor selection to improve collective accuracy without centralized processing.

entry.title: Time-Division Multiplexing Actuation in Tendon-Driven Arms: Lightweight Design and Fault Tolerance

author.name: Shoujie Li, Changqing Guo, Jianle Xu, Hong Luo, Xueqian Wang, Wenbo Ding, Bin Liang
