entry.summary: Presents Time-Division Multiplexing Actuation for tendon-driven robotic arms, reducing actuator count while preserving torque output and fault tolerance for aerospace applications.

entry.title: Memory Centric Power Allocation for Multi-Agent Embodied Question Answering

author.name: Chengyang Li, Shuai Wang, Kejiang Ye, Weijie Yuan, Boyu Zhou, Yik-Chung Wu, Chengzhong Xu, Huseyin Arslan

entry.summary: Proposes a 'quality of memory' model for multi-agent embodied question answering, using generative adversarial exam to assess memory retrieval quality, and memory-centric power allocation under communication constraints.

entry.title: Locomotion of an Elastic Snake Robot via Natural Dynamics

author.name: Tristan Ehlert, Arne Sachtler, Annika Schmidt, Davide Calzolari, Alin Albu-Sch\"affer

entry.summary: Investigates using nonlinear natural dynamics and eigenmanifold theory for efficient locomotion gaits on an elastic snake robot. Shows that gaits based on switching between nonlinear normal modes are more efficient than state-of-the-art approaches.

entry.title: COFFAIL: A Dataset of Successful and Anomalous Robot Skill Executions in the Context of Coffee Preparation

author.name: Alex Mitrevski, Ayush Salunke

entry.summary: COFFAIL provides a dataset of both successful and anomalous robot skill executions during coffee preparation, including bimanual manipulation. Addresses the gap that most manipulation datasets only include successes.

entry.title: Algebraic Invariants of Lightning Self-Attention

author.name: Yulia Alexandr, Hao Duan, Guido Mont\'ufar

entry.summary: Studies the algebraic geometry of lightning self-attention by analyzing polynomial coefficients as coordinates of an algebraic variety, identifying linear and nonlinear families of algebraic invariants.

entry.title: rlvrbook.com

author.name: kian

entry.summary: Announces a mini-book on Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), a technique central to modern LLM training. Shared as a v0 draft at rlvrbook.com.

entry.title: Aletheia: Physics-Conditioned Localized Artifact Attention (PhyLAA-X) for End-to-End Generalizable and Robust Deepfake Video Detection

author.name: Devendra Ghori

entry.summary: Introduces PhyLAA-X for deepfake detection, incorporating physics-derived features (optical flow, specular reflectance, rPPG) directly into the attention mechanism. Aims to improve cross-generator generalization and robustness against compression and adversarial attacks.

entry.title: DREAM: Dynamic Retinal Enhancement with Adaptive Multi-modal Fusion for Expert Precision Medical Report Generation

author.name: Nagur Shareef Shaik, Teja Krishna Cherukuri, Dong Hye Ye

entry.summary: Introduces DREAM, a framework for automated retinal medical report generation using two-stage fusion of visual data with clinician-curated keywords, designed to work well with limited data.

entry.title: Autonomous Unmanned Aircraft Systems for Enhanced Search and Rescue of Drowning Swimmers: Image-Based Localization and Mission Simulation

author.name: Sascha Emanuel Zell, Toni Schneidereit, Armin F\"ugenschuh, Michael Breu{\ss}

entry.summary: Proposes a drone-based system for search and rescue of drowning swimmers, combining image-based localization with mission simulation for autonomous UAV fleet deployment near swimming areas.

entry.title: DART: Learning-Enhanced Model Predictive Control for Dual-Arm Non-Prehensile Manipulation

author.name: Autrio Das, Shreya Bollimuntha, Madala Venkata Renu Jeevesh, Keshab Patra, Tashmoy Gosh, Nagamanikandan G, Arun Kumar, Madhava Krishna

entry.summary: DART presents a dual-arm framework for non-prehensile manipulation (like carrying objects on a tray) integrating nonlinear MPC with impedance control. Evaluates three strategies for modeling tray-object dynamics.

entry.title: SSMamba: A Self-Supervised Hybrid State Space Model for Pathological Image Classification

author.name: Enhui Chai, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Xingyu Li, Tianxiang Cui

entry.summary: Proposes SSMamba, a hybrid state space model for pathological image classification that combines self-supervised learning with Mamba architecture to address cross-magnification domain shift and local-global feature modeling.

entry.title: AST: Adaptive, Seamless, and Training-Free Precise Speech Editing

author.name: Sihan Lv, Yechen Jin, Zhen Li, Jintao Chen, Jinshan Zhang, Ying Li, Jianwei Yin, Meng Xi

entry.summary: Proposes AST, a training-free speech editing framework that uses latent recomposition with a pre-trained autoregressive TTS model to selectively stitch preserved and synthesized speech segments.

entry.title: An `Inverse' Experimental Framework to Estimate Market Efficiency

author.name: Thomas Asikis, Heinrich Nax

entry.summary: Proposes an 'inverse' experimental framework to estimate market efficiency from double auction data by using AI agents to infer true valuations, addressing a fundamental economics measurement problem.

entry.title: Modelling Gas-Phase Reaction Kinetics with Guided Particle Diffusion Sampling

author.name: Andrew Millard, Zheng Zhao, Henrik Pedersen

entry.summary: Applies physics-guided diffusion sampling to gas-phase reaction kinetics problems governed by advection-reaction-diffusion equations, demonstrating reconstruction of full spatiotemporal trajectories from sparse observations. More realistic evaluation than typical PDE benchmarks.

entry.title: Q-SINDy: Quantum-Kernel Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics with Provable Coefficient Debiasing

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Introduces Q-SINDy, a quantum-kernel-augmented framework for sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics, identifying and solving a 'coefficient cannibalization' failure mode where quantum features absorb coefficient mass from polynomial bases.

entry.title: When Earth Foundation Models Meet Diffusion: An Application to Land Surface Temperature Super-Resolution

author.name: Yiheng Chen, Zihui Ma, Peishi Jiang, Yilong Dai, Qikai Hu, Xinyue Ye, Lingyao Li, Rita Sousa, Runlong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes EFDiff, a framework using the Prithvi-EO-2.0 Earth foundation model to guide diffusion-based super-resolution of land surface temperature under extreme spatial degradation. Injects geospatial embeddings via cross-attention.

entry.title: Horospherical Depth and Busemann Median on Hadamard Manifolds

author.name: Yangdi Jiang, Xiaotian Chang, Cyrus Mostajeran

entry.summary: Introduces horospherical depth and Busemann median on Hadamard manifolds, providing an intrinsic notion of statistical depth that doesn't require tangent-space linearization. Proves nested, geodesically convex depth regions.

entry.title: IceBreaker for Conversational Agents: Breaking the First-Message Barrier with Personalized Starters

author.name: Hongwei Zheng, Weiqi Wu, Zhengjia Wang, Guanyu Jiang, Haoming Li, Tianyu Wu, Yongchun Zhu, Jingwu Chen, Feng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Conversation Starter Generation—generating personalized first messages to overcome the 'first-message barrier' where users have vague needs but no explicit query. Addresses proactive conversational AI.

entry.title: Motion-Guided Semantic Alignment with Negative Prompts for Zero-Shot Video Action Recognition

author.name: Yiming Wang, Frederick W. B. Li, Jingyun Wang

entry.summary: Presents a framework for zero-shot video action recognition enhancing CLIP with motion separation, aggregation, and negative prompts for semantic alignment between video features and text.

entry.title: Inference-Time Temporal Probability Smoothing for Stable Video Segmentation with SAM2 under Weak Prompts

author.name: Dawar Jyoti Deka

entry.summary: Proposes inference-time temporal probability smoothing for SAM2-based video segmentation under weak prompts, improving temporal stability without retraining or architectural changes.

entry.title: LookasideVLN: Direction-Aware Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Yuwei Ning, Ganlong Zhao, Yipeng Qin, Si Liu, Yang Liu, Liang Lin, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Proposes LookasideVLN for aerial vision-and-language navigation that exploits directional cues in natural language instructions for more accurate spatial reasoning and computational efficiency.

entry.title: Region-Affinity Attention for Whole-Slide Breast Cancer Classification in Deep Ultraviolet Imaging

author.name: Nagur Shareef Shaik, Teja Krishna Cherukuri, Dong Hye Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Region-Affinity Attention for whole-slide breast cancer classification using deep ultraviolet fluorescence imaging, avoiding patch-based fragmentation.

entry.title: Frequency-guided Multi-level Reasoning for Scene Graph Generation in Video

author.name: Chenxing Li, Yiping Duan, Xiaoming Tao

entry.summary: Proposes FReMuRe for video scene graph generation, using frequency-guided multi-level reasoning with relation-specific branches and frequency-aware dual-branch predicate embedding to handle long-tail distributions.

entry.title: R-FLoRA: Residual-Statistic-Gated Low-Rank Adaptation for Single-Image Face Morphing Attack Detection

author.name: Raghavendra Ramachandra

entry.summary: Proposes R-FLoRA for single-image face morphing attack detection, integrating Laplacian residual statistics with a frozen vision transformer using residual-statistic-gated low-rank adapters.

entry.title: Exploring Boundary-Aware Spatial-Frequency Fusion for Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Song Yu, Yang Hu, Haokang Ding, Zhifang Liao, Yucheng Song

entry.summary: BASFNet proposes a camouflaged object detection framework combining boundary-aware frequency domain and spatial domain features, with a phase-spectrum-based edge exploration module.

entry.title: Neural Network-Based Adaptive Event-Triggered Control for Dual-Arm Unmanned Aerial Manipulator Systems

author.name: Yang Wang, Hai Yu, Wei He, Jianda Han, Yongchun Fang, Xiao Liang

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive event-triggered neural network control for dual-arm unmanned aerial manipulators, addressing coupling between arms and platform while reducing communication bandwidth.

entry.title: Shepherding UAV Swarm with Action Prediction Based on Movement Constraints

author.name: Yusuke Tsunoda, Yusuke Goto, Takao Sato

entry.summary: Proposes sheepdog-inspired UAV swarm control that predicts swarm behavior while accounting for motion constraints of real robots, unlike conventional point-mass models.

entry.title: A Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability-Guided Search Framework for Efficient and Safe Indoor Planar Robot Navigation

author.name: Hanyang Hu, Cameron Siu, Mo Chen

entry.summary: Combines offline Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis with online graph search for indoor robot navigation. Precomputed HJ value functions serve as heuristics and safety constraints to speed up online planning.

entry.title: Modeling of ASD/TD Children's Behaviors in Interaction with a Virtual Social Robot During a Music Education Program Using Deep Neural Networks

author.name: Armin Tandiseh, Morteza Memari, Alireza Taheri

entry.summary: Develops a deep learning system to model and distinguish behavioral patterns of ASD and neurotypical children interacting with a virtual social robot during music education, both for classification and behavior generation.

entry.title: DataCenterGym: A Physics-Grounded Simulator for Multi-Objective Data Center Scheduling

author.name: Nilavra Pathak, Samadrita Biswas, Nirmalya Roy

entry.summary: Introduces DataCenterGym, a physics-grounded simulator for job scheduling in geo-distributed data centers that integrates compute queueing, thermal dynamics, HVAC, and temperature-dependent degradation. Provides a Gymnasium-compatible testbed for RL-based scheduling research.

entry.title: Diffusion Autoencoder for Unsupervised Artifact Restoration in Handheld Fundus Images

author.name: Mathumetha Palani, Kavya Puthumana, Ayantika Das, Ganapathy Krishnamurthi

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised diffusion autoencoder for restoring artifacts in handheld fundus images, integrating a context encoder with the denoising process without requiring paired supervision.

entry.title: Matched-Learning-Rate Analysis of Attention Drift and Transfer Retention in Fine-Tuned CLIP

author.name: Ruize Xia

entry.summary: Studies attention drift and transfer retention in fine-tuned CLIP through controlled matched-learning-rate comparisons between Full Fine-Tuning and LoRA. Shows learning rate strongly modulates stability across both methods.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Generation: From Commodity WiFi to High-Fidelity mmWave and RFID Sensing

author.name: Zhixiong Yang, Long Jing, Yao Li, Shuli Cheng, Guoxuan Chi, Chenyu Wen

entry.summary: Proposes RF-CMG, a diffusion-based method to synthesize high-fidelity mmWave and RFID data from data-rich WiFi signals, decoupling cross-modal generation into high-frequency guidance and low-frequency constraint.

entry.title: Graph Transformer-Based Pathway Embedding for Cancer Prognosis

author.name: Koushik Howlader, Md Tauhidul Islam, Wei Le

entry.summary: Proposes PATH-FORMER using graph transformers with learnable gene embeddings to construct pathway representations for cancer prognosis, improving on approaches that use raw molecular inputs or simple aggregations.

entry.title: Semantic-based Distributed Learning for Diverse and Discriminative Representations

author.name: Zhuojun Tian, Chaouki Ben Issaid, Mehdi Bennis

entry.summary: Proposes a distributed learning framework ensuring diverse and discriminative representations by reformulating global optimization with mutual information constraints for both i.i.d. and non-i.i.d. data settings.

entry.title: Forecasting Ionospheric Irregularities on GNSS Lines of Sight Using Dynamic Graphs with Ephemeris Conditioning

author.name: Mert Can Turkmen, Eng Leong Tan, Yee Hui Lee

entry.summary: Models the ionosphere as a dynamic graph over pierce points for GNSS forecasting, introducing ephemeris conditioning to exploit predictable satellite trajectories for forecasting on future lines of sight.

entry.title: Fuzzy Encoding-Decoding to Improve Spiking Q-Learning Performance in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Aref Ghoreishee, Abhishek Mishra, Lifeng Zhou, John Walsh, Anup Das, Nagarajan Kandasamy

entry.summary: Develops a fuzzy encoder-decoder architecture for spiking Q-networks in autonomous driving, addressing information loss in spike conversion and limited Q-value discrimination in spiking networks.

entry.title: FM-CAC: Carbon-Aware Control for Battery-Buffered Edge AI via Time-Series Foundation Models

author.name: Kang Yang, Walid A. Hanafy, Prashant Shenoy, Mani Srivastava

entry.summary: Proposes FM-CAC, a carbon-aware control framework for edge AI that uses batteries as temporal buffers and time series foundation models to optimize energy consumption and reduce carbon emissions. Jointly optimizes software pipeline variants, hardware operating points, and battery actions.

entry.title: SynthPID: P&ID digitization from Topology-Preserving Synthetic Data

author.name: Suraj Prasad, Pinak Mahapatra

entry.summary: Introduces SynthPID for digitizing piping and instrumentation diagrams using topology-preserving synthetic data generation. Addresses the severe data scarcity (only 12 public annotated images) by generating structurally realistic synthetic process plant diagrams.

entry.title: FairNVT: Improving Fairness via Noise Injection in Vision Transformers

author.name: Qiaoyue Tang, Sepidehsadat Hosseini, Mengyao Zhai, Thibaut Durand, Greg Mori

entry.summary: Proposes FairNVT, a lightweight debiasing framework for pretrained transformers that learns task and sensitive embeddings via adapters, applies calibrated noise to sensitive embeddings, and uses orthogonality constraints to reduce bias while preserving accuracy.

entry.title: SPaRSe-TIME: Saliency-Projected Low-Rank Temporal Modeling for Efficient and Interpretable Time Series Prediction

author.name: K. A. Shahriar

entry.summary: Presents SPaRSe-TIME, a time series forecasting framework that decomposes temporal modeling into saliency, memory, and trend components using projection onto informative subspaces. Aims to reduce computation by focusing on sparse informative patterns rather than processing all time steps uniformly.

entry.title: Scaling Human-AI Coding Collaboration Requires a Governable Consensus Layer

author.name: Tianfu Wang, Zhezheng Hao, Yin Wu, Wei Wu, Qiang Lin, Hande Dong, Nicholas Jing Yuan, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes 'Agentic Consensus,' a paradigm where a typed property graph world model replaces code as the primary artifact of AI-assisted development, addressing the control failure in 'vibe coding' where structural commitments are lost.

entry.title: A Sugeno Integral View of Binarized Neural Network Inference

author.name: Isma\"il Baaj, Henri Prade

entry.summary: Establishes a connection between binarized neural networks and Sugeno integrals, showing activation threshold tests can be written as Sugeno integrals on binary inputs, yielding explicit set-function and rule-based representations.

entry.title: Domain-Specialized Object Detection via Model-Level Mixtures of Experts

author.name: Svetlana Pavlitska, Malte St\"uven, Beyza Keskin, J. Marius Z\"ollner

entry.summary: Investigates model-level Mixture-of-Experts for object detection, combining YOLO-based detectors trained on semantic data subsets with learned gating networks. Analyzes suitability for improving performance and interpretability.

entry.title: Duality for the Adversarial Total Variation

author.name: Leon Bungert, Lucas Schmitt

entry.summary: Establishes duality theory for adversarial total variation used in adversarial training of binary classifiers, including dual representations and subdifferential characterizations using nonlocal gradient and divergence.

entry.title: Revisiting Active Sequential Prediction-Powered Mean Estimation

author.name: Maria-Eleni Sfyraki, Jun-Kun Wang

entry.summary: Revisits active sequential prediction-powered mean estimation where ground-truth labels are queried probabilistically, and ML predictions fill in otherwise. Finds that the simplest approach (constant query probability) often achieves the smallest confidence width, simplifying the method.

entry.title: Mira-Embeddings-V1: Domain-Adapted Semantic Reranking for Recruitment via LLM-Synthesized Data

author.name: Zhaohua Liang, Zhilin Wang, Renjie Cao, Yining Zhang

entry.summary: Presents mira-embeddings-v1, a domain-adapted semantic reranking system for recruitment that uses LLM-synthesized training data to reshape embedding space and a lightweight reranking head for boundary correction.

entry.title: On the Importance and Evaluation of Narrativity in Natural Language AI Explanations

author.name: Mateusz Cedro, David Martens

entry.summary: Argues that XAI explanations should be presented as narratives rather than static feature importance lists, drawing on social science and linguistics. Proposes evaluation criteria based on four narrative properties.

entry.title: RoMathExam: A Longitudinal Dataset of Romanian Math Exams (1895-2025) with a Seven-Decade Core (1957-2025)

author.name: Luca-Ncolae Cuclea, Sabin-Codrut Badea, Adrian-Marius Dumitran

entry.summary: Introduces RoMathExam, a longitudinal dataset of Romanian high-school math exams spanning 1895-2025 with 10,592 problems. Enriched with curriculum-aligned topic tags and embeddings for studying educational AI.

entry.title: DocQAC: Adaptive Trie-Guided Decoding for Effective In-Document Query Auto-Completion

author.name: Rahul Mehta, Kavin R V, Indrajit Pal, Tushar Abhishek, Pawan Goyal, Manish Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes DocQAC, an adaptive trie-guided decoding framework for in-document query auto-completion that steers language models using user query prefixes toward document-specific completions.

entry.title: Amortized Inverse Kinematics via Graph Attention for Real-Time Human Avatar Animation

author.name: Muhammad Saif Ullah Khan, Chen-Yu Wang, Tim Prokosch, Michael Lorenz, Bertram Taetz, Didier Stricker

entry.summary: Introduces IK-GAT, a graph attention network for real-time inverse kinematics that recovers full-body joint orientations from 3D positions in a single forward pass.

entry.title: EdgeVTP: Exploration of Latency-efficient Trajectory Prediction for Edge-based Embedded Vision Applications

author.name: Seungjin Kim, Reza Jafarpourmarzouni, Christopher Neff, Hamed Tabkhi, Vinit Katariya

entry.summary: Presents EdgeVTP, an embedded-first vehicle trajectory predictor combining graph modeling with a one-shot curve decoder for deterministic latency on Jetson-class devices.

entry.title: Channel Attention-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Referring Image Segmentation

author.name: Chen Yang

entry.summary: Proposes channel attention-guided cross-modal knowledge distillation for referring image segmentation, transferring high-order vision-language correlations to smaller student networks.

entry.title: Rethinking Cross-Dose PET Denoising: Mitigating Averaging Effects via Residual Noise Learning

author.name: Yichao Liu, Zongru Shao, Yueyang Teng, Junwen Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a residual noise learning framework for cross-dose PET denoising that explicitly separates noise from signal rather than learning averaged representations across dose levels.

entry.title: CAM3DNet: Comprehensively mining the multi-scale features for 3D Object Detection with Multi-View Cameras

author.name: Mingxi Pang, Dingheng Wang, Zekun Li, Zhenping Sun, Bo Wang, Zhihang Wang, Zhao-Xu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CAM3DNet for multi-view camera-based 3D object detection with composite queries, adaptive self-attention, and multi-scale hybrid sampling modules for better multi-scale feature utilization.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 Rip Current Detection and Segmentation (RipDetSeg) Challenge Report

author.name: Andrei Dumitriu, Aakash Ralhan, Florin Miron, Florin Tatui, Radu Tudor Ionescu, Radu Timofte, Abdullah Naeem, Anav Katwal, Ayon Dey, Md Tamjidul Hoque, Asuka Shin, Hiroto Shirono, Kosuke Shigematsu, Gaurav Mahesh, Anjana Nanditha, Jiji CV, Akbarali Vakhitov, Sang-Chul Lee, Xinger Li, Chun'an Yu, Junhao Chen, Yang Yang, Gundluri Yuvateja Reddy, Harshitha Palaram, Gejalakshmi N, Jeevitha S, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi, Amitabh Tripathi, Modugumudi Mahesh, Santosh Kumar Vipparthi, Subrahmanyam Murala

entry.summary: Reports on the NTIRE 2026 Rip Current Detection and Segmentation challenge, targeting automatic identification of hazardous rip currents in beach imagery from diverse international sources.

entry.title: Deep learning based Non-Rigid Volume-to-Surface Registration for Brain Shift compensation Using Point Cloud

author.name: Eashrat Jahan Muniya, Gernot Kronreif, Ander Biguri, Wolfgang Birkfellner, Sepideh Hatamikia

entry.summary: Proposes deep learning-based non-rigid volume-to-surface registration for brain shift compensation using point clouds from surgical microscopes, avoiding disruptive intra-operative imaging.

entry.title: Chaos-Enhanced Prototypical Networks for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification

author.name: Chinhtakuntla Meghan Sai, Murarisetty V Sai Kartheek, Sita Devi Bharatula, Karthik Seemakurthy

entry.summary: Integrates a Logistic Chaos Module into Prototypical Networks for few-shot medical image classification, using deterministic chaos to inject controlled perturbations during training for more robust embeddings.

entry.title: Neutrally Evolving Interlocking Complexity in the Quandary Den

author.name: Andrew Walsh

entry.summary: Introduces the Quandary Den, an artificial life model exploring how neutral evolution (without adaptive pressure) can lead to increased interlocking complexity through subfunctionalization and masking mechanisms.

entry.title: Leveraging VR Robot Games to Facilitate Data Collection for Embodied Intelligence Tasks

author.name: Yihan Zhang, Ziyun Huang, Linqi Ye

entry.summary: Presents a gamified VR data collection framework combining procedural scene generation, VR-based humanoid robot control, and automatic task evaluation for embodied intelligence research.

entry.title: Planning Smooth and Safe Control Laws for a Unicycle Robot Among Obstacles

author.name: Aref Amiri, Basak Sakcak, Steven M. LaValle

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for safe unicycle robot navigation using a novel QP formulation for smooth vector fields and an analytic nonlinear feedback controller satisfying Nagumo's theorem for forward invariance. Claims twice faster arrival times than prior methods.

entry.title: Automating Crash Diagram Generation Using Vision-Language Models: A Case Study on Multi-Lane Roundabouts

author.name: Xiao Lu, Hao Zhen, Jidong J. Yang

entry.summary: Investigates using VLMs to automate crash diagram generation from police reports for multilane roundabouts. GPT-4o performs best among tested models on a 10-metric evaluation system.

entry.title: Beyond Passive Viewing: A Pilot Study of a Hybrid Learning Platform Augmenting Video Lectures with Conversational AI

author.name: Mohammed Abraar, Raj Abhijit Dandekar, Rajat Dandekar, Sreedath Panat

entry.summary: Pilot study of a hybrid learning platform combining real-time conversational AI tutors with video lectures, finding improved engagement and learning outcomes in a controlled experiment with 58 participants.

entry.title: SocialWise: LLM-Agentic Conversation Therapy for Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder to Enhance Communication Skills

author.name: Albert Tang

entry.summary: SocialWise is a browser-based application combining LLM conversational agents with therapeutic RAG to help individuals with ASD practice everyday conversations, providing structured feedback on tone, engagement, and phrasing.

entry.title: Applied Explainability for Large Language Models: A Comparative Study

author.name: Venkata Abhinandan Kancharla

entry.summary: Comparative study of three LLM explainability techniques (Integrated Gradients, Attention Rollout, SHAP) on fine-tuned DistilBERT for sentiment classification. Finds gradient-based attribution provides more stable explanations than attention-based methods.

entry.title: Consistency Analysis of Sentiment Predictions using Syntactic & Semantic Context Assessment Summarization (SSAS)

author.name: Sharookh Daruwalla, Nitin Mayande, Shreeya Verma Kathuria, Nitin Joglekar, Charles Weber

entry.summary: Proposes the SSAS framework for improving LLM sentiment prediction consistency by establishing syntactic and semantic context as a pre-processing step, enforcing bounded attention. Addresses the tension between LLM stochasticity and enterprise requirements for reliable analytics.

entry.title: VoodooNet: Achieving Analytic Ground States via High-Dimensional Random Projections

author.name: Wladimir Silva

entry.summary: Presents VoodooNet, a non-iterative neural architecture that uses high-dimensional random projections and the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse instead of SGD training. Achieves 98.1% on MNIST and 86.63% on Fashion-MNIST in a single step.

entry.title: MambaBack: Bridging Local Features and Global Contexts in Whole Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Sicheng Chen, Chad Wong, Tianyi Zhang, Enhui Chai, Zeyu Liu, Fei Xia

entry.summary: Proposes MambaBack for whole slide image analysis, addressing challenges of spatial locality disruption in 1D sequence flattening and memory efficiency for Mamba-based multiple instance learning.

entry.title: Sketch and Text Synergy: Fusing Structural Contours and Descriptive Attributes for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval

author.name: Siyuan Wang, Hanchen Gao, Guangming Zhu, Jiang Lu, Yiyue Ma, Tianci Wu, Jincai Huang, Liang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes STBIR framework for fine-grained image retrieval by synergizing hand-drawn sketches (structural contours) with text descriptions (color/texture), using curriculum learning for robustness.

entry.title: SegMix:Shuffle-based Feedback Learning for Semantic Segmentation of Pathology Images

author.name: Zhiling Yan, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Nan Ying, Yanli Lei, Guanglei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SegMix, a shuffle-based feedback learning method for semantic segmentation of pathology images using only image-level labels, improving upon CAM-based pseudo-label generation.

entry.title: Robust Multispectral Semantic Segmentation under Missing or Full Modalities via Structured Latent Projection

author.name: Irem Ulku, Erdem Akag\"und\"uz, \"Omer \"Ozg\"ur Tanr{\i}\"over

entry.summary: Proposes CBC-SLP for robust multispectral semantic segmentation that preserves both modality-invariant and modality-specific information, handling missing modalities without degrading full-modality performance.

entry.title: Can LLMs Understand the Impact of Trauma? Costs and Benefits of LLMs Coding the Interviews of Firearm Violence Survivors

author.name: Jessica H. Zhu, Shayla Stringfield, Vahe Zaprosyan, Michael Wagner, Michel Cukier, Joseph B. Richardson Jr

entry.summary: Assesses LLMs for qualitative coding of firearm violence survivor interviews, comparing open-source model performance against human coders for thematic analysis.

entry.title: BAGEL: Benchmarking Animal Knowledge Expertise in Language Models

author.name: Jiacheng Shen, Masato Hagiwara, Milad Alizadeh, Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon, Marius Miron, David Robinson, Emmanuel Chemla, Sara Keen, Gagan Narula, Mathieu Lauri\`ere, Matthieu Geist, Olivier Pietquin

entry.summary: Introduces BAGEL, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on specialized animal knowledge including taxonomy, morphology, habitat, behavior, and vocalization across diverse scientific sources. Tests how well LLMs handle domain-specific biological knowledge under closed-book evaluation.

entry.title: Multi-Label Phase Diagram Prediction in Complex Alloys via Physics-Informed Graph Attention Networks

author.name: Eunjeong Park, Amrita Basak

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-informed graph attention network for multi-label phase diagram prediction in complex alloys, coupling element-aware representations with thermodynamic constraints to predict phase equilibria.

entry.title: Chronax: A Jax Library for Univariate Statistical Forecasting and Conformal Inference

author.name: Xan Carey, Yash Deshmukh, Aileen Huang, Sunit Jadhav, Omkar Tekawade, Lorraine Yang, Anvesha Tiwary, Gerardo Riano, Amy Greenwald, Denizalp Goktas

entry.summary: Introduces Chronax, a JAX library for time series forecasting with conformal inference, designed for modern accelerator-oriented workflows and large-scale parallelism.

entry.title: Reference-state System Reliability method for scalable uncertainty quantification of coherent systems

author.name: Ji-Eun Byun, Hyeuk Ryu, Junho Song

entry.summary: Proposes the Reference-state System Reliability method for scalable probabilistic evaluation of coherent systems, using Monte Carlo sampling instead of decomposition-based methods.

entry.title: STRIKE: Additive Feature-Group-Aware Stacking Framework for Credit Default Prediction

author.name: Swattik Maiti, Ritik Pratap Singh, Fardina Fathmiul Alam

entry.summary: STRIKE is a feature-group-aware stacking framework for credit default prediction that decomposes high-dimensional heterogeneous data into interpretable feature groups processed by specialized models.

entry.title: Federated Rule Ensemble Method in Medical Data

author.name: Ke Wan, Kensuke Tanioka, Toshio Shimokawa

entry.summary: Proposes a federated RuleFit framework for interpretable machine learning on distributed medical data, enabling collaborative model training without sharing raw data while maintaining interpretability through rule-based models.

entry.title: Neural Shape Operator Surrogates -- Expression Rate Bounds

author.name: Helmut Harbrecht, Christoph Schwab

entry.summary: Proves error bounds for neural operator surrogates of PDEs on families of diffeomorphic domains, showing how parametric holomorphy enables efficient approximation. Purely mathematical/theoretical contribution.

entry.title: Parkinson's Disease Detection via Self-Supervised Dual-Channel Cross-Attention on Bilateral Wrist-Worn IMU Signals

author.name: Meheru Zannat

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised cross-attention encoder for Parkinson's disease detection from bilateral wrist-worn IMU signals, achieving 93% accuracy on a 469-subject dataset.

entry.title: Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Differential Equations and Data-Driven Algorithms for HVAC Systems

author.name: Hanfeng Zhai, Hongtao Qiao, Hassan Mansour, Christopher Laughman

entry.summary: Presents a scalable simulation framework for HVAC systems coupling physics-informed neural ODEs with DAE solvers, achieving stable long-horizon prediction through gradient-stabilized latent evolution.

entry.title: Barrier-enforced multi-objective optimization for direct point and sharp interval forecasting

author.name: Worachit Amnuaypongsa, Yotsapat Suparanonrat, Pana Wanitchollakit, Jitkomut Songsiri

entry.summary: Proposes a barrier-enforced multi-objective optimization framework for simultaneous point and interval forecasting, ensuring non-crossing prediction intervals while adaptively balancing multiple objectives.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Biological $2\mathrm{D}{+}t$ Reaction-Diffusion Systems

author.name: William Lavery, Jodie A. Cochrane, Christian Olesen, Dagim S. Tadele, John T. Nardini, Sara Hamis

entry.summary: Extends biologically-informed neural networks (BINNs) from 1D+t to 2D+t reaction-diffusion systems within a PINN framework, combining data preprocessing, equation identification, and parameter estimation.

entry.title: A3-FPN: Asymptotic Content-Aware Pyramid Attention Network for Dense Visual Prediction

author.name: Meng'en Qin, Yu Song, Quanling Zhao, Xiaodong Yang, Yingtao Che, Xiaohui Yang

entry.summary: Proposes A3-FPN, an asymptotic content-aware pyramid attention network for dense visual prediction that enables global feature interaction through a horizontally-spread column network.

entry.title: Quantifying how AI Panels improve precision

author.name: Nicholas CL Beale

entry.summary: Derives a formula for estimating precision of AI panel approaches (multiple AIs) for screening applications, showing how panel size and pairwise correlation affect selection quality.

entry.title: SAND: The Challenge on Speech Analysis for Neurodegenerative Disease Assessment

author.name: Giovanna Sannino, Ivanoe De Falco, Nadia Brancati, Laura Verde, Maria Frucci, Daniel Riccio, Vincenzo Bevilacqua, Antonio Di Marino, Lucia Aruta, Valentina Virginia Iuzzolino, Gianmaria Senerchia, Myriam Spisto, Raffaele Dubbioso

entry.summary: Introduces the SAND challenge for using speech analysis to detect neurodegenerative diseases like ALS, addressing the lack of standardized benchmarks in this space. Focuses on progressive dysarthria as a biomarker. Important for clinical AI standardization.

entry.title: Learning-Based Sparsification of Dynamic Graphs in Robotic Exploration Algorithms

author.name: Adithya V. Sastry, Bibek Poudel, Weizi Li

entry.summary: Presents a transformer-based framework trained with PPO to prune rapidly growing graphs in robotic exploration, achieving up to 96% graph size reduction. Addresses the computational bottleneck of growing graph structures in frontier-based exploration.

entry.title: Medial Axis Aware Learning of Signed Distance Functions

author.name: Samuel Weidemaier, Christoph Norden-Smoch, Martin Rumpf

entry.summary: Proposes a variational method for computing accurate signed distance functions from point clouds, explicitly modeling the medial axis through a phase field approximation. Uses neural network parameterization with Ambrosio-Tortorelli type regularization.

entry.title: Fairness Constraints in High-Dimensional Generalized Linear Models

author.name: Yixiao Lin, James Booth

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for enforcing fairness constraints in high-dimensional GLMs when sensitive attributes are unavailable, by inferring them from auxiliary features. Addresses privacy/legal restrictions on sensitive attribute access.

entry.title: Agentic Risk-Aware Set-Based Engineering Design

author.name: Varun Kumar, George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-agent LLM framework for early-stage engineering design using set-based design philosophy. Demonstrates on aerodynamic airfoil design with specialized agents for coding, design, systems engineering, and analysis.

entry.title: The Virtue of Sparsity in Complexity

author.name: Nima Afsharhajari, Jonathan Yu-Meng Li

entry.summary: Distinguishes capacity sparsity from factor sparsity in high-dimensional asset pricing, showing they are complements rather than competitors. Demonstrates that expanding feature spaces with nonlinear expansions combined with basis pursuit improves out-of-sample performance.

entry.title: Unveiling Deepfakes: A Frequency-Aware Triple Branch Network for Deepfake Detection

entry.title: Early Detection of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) Using YOLOv12 Deep Learning Model

author.name: Enas E. Ahmed, Salah A. Aly, Mayar Moner

entry.summary: Applies YOLOv12 for classification of AML cells with Otsu thresholding preprocessing, achieving 99.3% accuracy.

entry.title: Finetuning Borges

author.name: Linch

entry.summary: A humorous meta-literary experiment attempting to fine-tune a Chinese LLM to generate Borges' 'Pierre Menard, Author of the Quixote' - itself a story about recreating a text verbatim. Explores memorization vs. generation in LLMs.

entry.title: A Two-Stage, Object-Centric Deep Learning Framework for Robust Exam Cheating Detection

author.name: Van-Truong Le, Le-Khanh Nguyen, Trong-Doanh Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for detecting exam cheating using YOLOv8 for student localization followed by behavioral classification. A straightforward application of existing computer vision models to surveillance.

entry.title: Fear of crowding out

author.name: jchan

entry.summary: Discusses organizational dynamics around whether criticism of altruistic work is productive or discouraging, exploring when initiative-crowding-out effects make suboptimal execution actively harmful.

entry.title: If a room feels off the lighting is probably too "spiky" or too blue

author.name: habryka

entry.summary: Practical guide to room lighting quality, explaining how low Color Rendering Index (CRI) and overly blue/spiky spectral profiles make spaces feel uncomfortable. Recommends high-CRI, warm lighting based on space design experience.

entry.title: The "Budgeting" Skill Has The Most Betweenness Centrality (Probably)

author.name: JenniferRM

entry.summary: Argues that budgeting skills have the highest betweenness centrality in the network of human skills, based on the author's data science analysis from ~2017. Calls for study groups focused on leveling up budgeting abilities.

entry.title: The Box

author.name: 0xA

entry.summary: A philosophical thought experiment about a mahogany box containing a burning rose, where grabbing it would retroactively save 1000 lives from a historical horror. An exploration of moral philosophy and decision-making under certainty.

entry.title: Why am I sleeping so well lately?

author.name: Philip Harker

entry.summary: Personal investigation into why the author's sleep improved dramatically while staying at Lighthaven campus in Berkeley, analyzing variables like lighting, temperature, and routine changes.

entry.title: A lesson in courage from science camp

author.name: Joe Rogero

entry.summary: A personal narrative about learning courage at a science camp, involving teenage social dynamics and standing up against bullying. Not technical content.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 20, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
A major model release and a wave of safety-critical findings dominate today's research landscape.

  • Qwen3.5-Omni sets new SOTA across 215 benchmarks as a hundred-billion-parameter omni-modal model with 256k context and 100M+ hours of audio-visual training data
  • π₀.₇ from Physical Intelligence demonstrates a steerable generalist robotic foundation model with emergent cross-task transfer capabilities
  • MatRIS-MoE breaks the billion-parameter barrier for universal machine learning interatomic potentials via a distributed training framework called Janus

AI safety research is exceptionally strong today. ASMR-Bench tests whether auditors can detect subtle sabotage in ML codebases. Subliminal unsafe behavior transfer through model distillation reveals a novel attack surface for agentic systems. GRIFT uses gradient fingerprints to detect and suppress reward hacking in RL-trained reasoning models. LinuxArena provides the largest control setting (1,671 tasks) for evaluating agent safety in live production environments.

  • Chain-of-Thought prompting consistently degrades visual spatial reasoning across 17 models and 13 benchmarks, challenging universal CoT assumptions
  • DELEGATE-52 shows even frontier models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude 4.6 Opus, GPT 5.4) corrupt 25% of document content during long delegated editing workflows
  • MEDLEY-BENCH reveals a dissociation in AI metacognition: scale improves self-evaluation but not self-regulation

entry.title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report

author.name: Qwen Team

entry.summary: Qwen3.5-Omni is a massive omni-modal model scaling to hundreds of billions of parameters with 256k context, trained on 100M+ hours of audio-visual data. It achieves SOTA on 215 audio/audio-visual benchmarks, surpassing Gemini-3.1 Pro on key audio tasks using a Hybrid Attention MoE architecture for both Thinker and Talker components.

entry.title: ${\pi}_{0.7}$: a Steerable Generalist Robotic Foundation Model with Emergent Capabilities

author.name: Physical Intelligence, Bo Ai, Ali Amin, Raichelle Aniceto, Ashwin Balakrishna, Greg Balke, Kevin Black, George Bokinsky, Shihao Cao, Thomas Charbonnier, Vedant Choudhary, Foster Collins, Ken Conley, Grace Connors, James Darpinian, Karan Dhabalia, Maitrayee Dhaka, Jared DiCarlo, Danny Driess, Michael Equi, Adnan Esmail, Yunhao Fang, Chelsea Finn, Catherine Glossop, Thomas Godden, Ivan Goryachev, Lachlan Groom, Haroun Habeeb, Hunter Hancock, Karol Hausman, Gashon Hussein, Victor Hwang, Brian Ichter, Connor Jacobsen, Szymon Jakubczak, Rowan Jen, Tim Jones, Gregg Kammerer, Ben Katz, Liyiming Ke, Mairbek Khadikov, Chandra Kuchi, Marinda Lamb, Devin LeBlanc, Brendon LeCount, Sergey Levine, Xinyu Li, Adrian Li-Bell, Vladislav Lialin, Zhonglin Liang, Wallace Lim, Yao Lu, Enyu Luo, Vishnu Mano, Nandan Marwaha, Aikys Mongush, Liam Murphy, Suraj Nair, Tyler Patterson, Karl Pertsch, Allen Z. Ren, Gavin Schelske, Charvi Sharma, Baifeng Shi, Lucy Xiaoyang Shi, Laura Smith, Jost Tobias Springenberg, Kyle Stachowicz, Will Stoeckle, Jiaming Tang, Jimmy Tanner, Shalom Tekeste, Marcel Torne, Kyle Vedder, Quan Vuong, Anna Walling, Haohuan Wang, Jason Wang, XuDong Wang, Chris Whalen, Samuel Whitmore, Blake Williams, Charles Xu, Sukwon Yoo, Lili Yu, Wuming Zhang, Zhuoyang Zhang, Ury Zhilinsky

entry.summary: Physical Intelligence presents π₀.₇, a robotic foundation model that achieves strong out-of-the-box performance across diverse tasks through diverse context conditioning during training, enabling zero-shot cross-embodiment generalization and multi-stage task execution.

entry.title: Breaking the Training Barrier of Billion-Parameter Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials

author.name: Yuanchang Zhou, Hongyu Wang, Yiming Du, Yan Wang, Mingzhen Li, Siyu Hu, Xiangyu Zhang, Weijian Liu, Chen Wang, Zhuoqiang Guo, Long Wang, Jingde Bu, Yutong Lu, Guangming Tan, Weile Jia

entry.summary: Introduces MatRIS-MoE, a billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model for universal machine learning interatomic potentials, along with Janus, a distributed training framework deployed across two Exascale supercomputers. Breaks the training barrier for billion-parameter physics simulations.

entry.title: ASMR-Bench: Auditing for Sabotage in ML Research

author.name: Eric Gan, Aryan Bhatt, Buck Shlegeris, Julian Stastny, Vivek Hebbar

entry.summary: Introduces ASMR-Bench, a benchmark for detecting sabotage in ML research codebases—testing whether auditors (human or LLM) can find subtle implementation flaws that produce misleading experimental results. Found that both frontier LLMs and LLM-assisted humans struggled to reliably detect sabotage, with the best performance being modest. This directly addresses AI safety concerns about autonomous AI research agents.

entry.title: Subliminal Transfer of Unsafe Behaviors in AI Agent Distillation

author.name: Jacob Dang, Brian Y. Xie, Omar G. Younis

entry.summary: Provides first empirical evidence that unsafe agent behaviors can transfer subliminally through model distillation, where a teacher's deletion bias transfers to students via ostensibly safe task trajectories with all explicit deletion keywords removed.

entry.title: LinuxArena: A Control Setting for AI Agents in Live Production Software Environments

author.name: Tyler Tracy, Ram Potham, Nick Kuhn, Myles Heller, Anshul Khandelwal, Cody Rushing, Henri Lemoine, Miguel Brandao, Tomas Turlik, Adam Hanson, Josh Hills, Amy Ngo, Ram Rachum, Nik Mitchell, Falko Galperin, Oscar Sykes, Pip Arnott, Samuel Prieto Lima, Carlos Giudice, Matt Goldwater, Daniel Popp, Drew de Wet, Ruben Castaing, Qi Guo, Douw Marx, Benjamin Shaffrey, Justin Shenk, Martin Milbradt, Hannah Meagher, Shaheen Ahmed-Chowdhury, Daniel O'Connell, Chris Canal, Buck Shlegeris, Aryan Bhatt

entry.summary: Introduces LinuxArena, a control setting with 20 environments, 1,671 main tasks, and 184 side tasks for evaluating AI agent safety in live production environments. Tests sabotage detection with Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5-nano monitors.

entry.title: HarmfulSkillBench: How Do Harmful Skills Weaponize Your Agents?

author.name: Yukun Jiang, Yage Zhang, Michael Backes, Xinyue Shen, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: First large-scale measurement study of harmful skills in agent ecosystems, analyzing 98,440 skills across two major registries and finding 4.93% are potentially harmful, enabling cyber attacks, fraud, privacy violations, etc. Introduces HarmfulSkillBench for evaluating weaponization of LLM agents.

entry.title: LLMs Corrupt Your Documents When You Delegate

author.name: Philippe Laban and Tobias Schnabel and Jennifer Neville

entry.summary: DELEGATE-52 reveals that even frontier models (Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude 4.6 Opus, GPT 5.4) corrupt 25% of document content during long delegated editing workflows across 52 professional domains, highlighting fundamental reliability gaps.

entry.title: Discover and Prove: An Open-source Agentic Framework for Hard Mode Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4

author.name: Chengwu Liu, Yichun Yin, Ye Yuan, Jiaxuan Xie, Botao Li, Siqi Li, Jianhao Shen, Yan Xu, Lifeng Shang, Ming Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces 'Hard Mode' automated theorem proving where the system must discover the answer before constructing a proof, unlike standard benchmarks that embed answers in statements. Releases MiniF2F-Hard and FIMO-Hard benchmarks plus DAP, an agentic framework using LLM reasoning with self-reflection.

entry.title: Polarization by Default: Auditing Recommendation Bias in LLM-Based Content Curation

author.name: Nicol\`o Pagan, Christopher Barrie, Chris Andrew Bail, Petter T\"ornberg

entry.summary: Audits recommendation biases in LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google when curating social media content, finding that across 540,000 simulated selections, LLMs show structural polarization biases that differ substantially by provider and are difficult to fully mitigate via prompting.

entry.title: MEDLEY-BENCH: Scale Buys Evaluation but Not Control in AI Metacognition

author.name: Farhad Abtahi, Abdolamir Karbalaie, Eduardo Illueca-Fernandez, Fernando Seoane

entry.summary: Introduces MEDLEY-BENCH, evaluating metacognition (monitoring and regulating one's own reasoning) in 35 models from 12 families, finding a robust dissociation: evaluation ability scales with model size but control/regulation does not.

entry.title: Chain-of-Thought Degrades Visual Spatial Reasoning Capabilities of Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Sai Srinivas Kancheti, Aditya Sanjiv Kanade, Vineeth N. Balasubramanian, Tanuja Ganu

entry.summary: Shows that Chain-of-Thought prompting consistently degrades performance in visual spatial reasoning across 17 models and 13 benchmarks. Demonstrates that reasoning models suffer from shortcut learning, hallucinating visual details from textual priors even without images.

entry.title: Detecting and Suppressing Reward Hacking with Gradient Fingerprints

author.name: Songtao Wang, Quang Hieu Pham, Fangcong Yin, Xinpeng Wang, Jocelyn Qiaochu Chen, Greg Durrett and Xi Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Gradient Fingerprint (GRIFT) for detecting reward hacking in RLVR by analyzing models' internal gradient computations rather than surface-level text monitoring. Compresses CoT gradients into compact fingerprints that distinguish genuine from hacking reasoning.

entry.title: AgentV-RL: Scaling Reward Modeling with Agentic Verifier

author.name: Jiazheng Zhang and Ziche Fu and Zhiheng Xi and Wenqing Jing and Mingxu Chai and Wei He and Guoqiang Zhang and Chenghao Fan and Chenxin An and Wenxiang Chen and Zhicheng Liu and Haojie Pan and Dingwei Zhu and Tao Gui and Qi Zhang and Xuanjing Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Agentic Verifier for LLM reasoning, transforming reward modeling into a multi-turn tool-augmented process with bidirectional verification (forward tracing from premises to conclusions and backward checking). Shows improvements in RL training for reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Where does output diversity collapse in post-training?

author.name: Constantinos Karouzos, Xingwei Tan, Nikolaos Aletras

entry.summary: Traces output diversity collapse through three Olmo 3 post-training lineages (Think, Instruct, RL-Zero), finding that collapse location co-varies with data composition rather than training method, and that the generation format contributes independently from model weights.

entry.title: Hallucination as Trajectory Commitment: Causal Evidence for Asymmetric Attractor Dynamics in Transformer Generation

author.name: G. Aytug Akarlar

entry.summary: Provides causal evidence that LLM hallucination is an early trajectory commitment governed by asymmetric attractor dynamics. Shows factual/hallucinated trajectories diverge at the first token, with hallucinated activations being much more 'sticky' than correct ones.

entry.title: LACE: Lattice Attention for Cross-thread Exploration

author.name: Yang Li, Zirui Zhang, Yang Liu, Chengzhi Mao

entry.summary: LACE transforms parallel reasoning from independent trials into coordinated processes by enabling cross-thread attention, allowing concurrent reasoning paths to share intermediate insights and correct each other during inference.

entry.title: Faster LLM Inference via Sequential Monte Carlo

author.name: Yahya Emara, Mauricio Barba da Costa, Chi-Chih Chang, Cameron Freer, Tim Vieira, Ryan Cotterell, Mohamed S. Abdelfattah

entry.summary: Proposes SMC-SD (Sequential Monte Carlo Speculative Decoding), which replaces token-level rejection in speculative decoding with importance-weighted resampling over draft particles. Trades exactness for speed while maintaining theoretical approximation bounds.

entry.title: Aligning What Vision-Language Models See and Perceive with Adaptive Information Flow

author.name: Chengxin Liu, Wonseok Choi, Chenshuang Zhang, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: Identifies that VLMs often attend to correct image regions but still produce wrong answers due to suboptimal information flow, where text tokens attend too much to irrelevant visual tokens. Proposes modulating attention during inference to fix this misalignment without retraining.

entry.title: TwoHamsters: Benchmarking Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety in Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Chaoshuo Zhang and Yibo Liang and Mengke Tian and Chenhao Lin and Zhengyu Zhao and Le Yang and Chong Zhang and Yang Zhang and Chao Shen

entry.summary: Introduces TwoHamsters benchmark with 17.5k prompts probing Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety (MCCU) in text-to-image models, where individually benign concepts combine to create unsafe content. Evaluates 10 models and 16 defense mechanisms.

entry.title: Beyond Distribution Sharpening: The Importance of Task Rewards

author.name: Sarthak Mittal, Leo Gagnon, Guillaume Lajoie

entry.summary: Presents explicit comparison between distribution sharpening and task-reward-based RL, showing fundamental limitations and instability of sharpening approaches. Demonstrates that task rewards genuinely teach new capabilities rather than merely surfacing latent ones.

entry.title: Why Fine-Tuning Encourages Hallucinations and How to Fix It

author.name: Guy Kaplan, Zorik Gekhman, Zhen Zhu, Lotem Rozner, Yuval Reif, Swabha Swayamdipta, Derek Hoiem, Roy Schwartz

entry.summary: Explains why supervised fine-tuning induces hallucinations (knowledge degradation during training) and proposes a self-distillation method that regularizes output-distribution drift, along with freezing strategies to suppress unnecessary factual plasticity.

entry.title: CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution

author.name: Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Tongwen Huang, Yiming Hu, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes CoEvolve, a framework for training LLM agents where the agent and training data co-evolve: feedback signals from rollouts identify failure patterns, which guide LLM-based task synthesis to update the training distribution in a closed loop.

entry.title: Cut Your Losses! Learning to Prune Paths Early for Efficient Parallel Reasoning

author.name: Jiaxi Bi, Tongxu Luo, Wenyu Du, Zhengyang Tang, Benyou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes STOP (Super TOken for Pruning), a learnable method for pruning futile reasoning paths in parallel Large Reasoning Models. Introduces a systematic taxonomy of path pruning methods and demonstrates effectiveness across 1.5B to 20B parameter models.

entry.title: Experience Compression Spectrum: Unifying Memory, Skills, and Rules in LLM Agents

author.name: Xing Zhang, Guanghui Wang, Yanwei Cui, Wei Qiu, Ziyuan Li, Bing Zhu, Peiyang He

entry.summary: Proposes the Experience Compression Spectrum, a unifying framework positioning agent memory, skills, and rules along a single axis of increasing compression (5-20x for memory, 50-500x for skills, 1000x+ for rules). Analysis of 1,136 references reveals less than 1% cross-citation between memory and skill communities.

entry.title: The Spectral Geometry of Thought: Phase Transitions, Instruction Reversal, Token-Level Dynamics, and Perfect Correctness Prediction in How Transformers Reason

author.name: Yi Liu

entry.summary: Discovers spectral phase transitions in LLM hidden activations during reasoning vs factual recall across 11 models and 5 architecture families. Identifies seven phenomena including reasoning spectral compression and instruction tuning reversal.

entry.title: Beyond a Single Frame: Multi-Frame Spatially Grounded Reasoning Across Volumetric MRI

author.name: Lama Moukheiber, Caleb M. Yeung, Haotian Xue, Alec Helbling, Zelin Zhao, Yongxin Chen

entry.summary: Introduces SGMRI-VQA, a 41,307-pair benchmark for multi-frame spatially grounded reasoning on volumetric MRI. Built from expert radiologist annotations, each QA pair includes chain-of-thought traces with frame-indexed bounding boxes, addressing the gap in evaluating VLMs on volumetric medical imaging.

entry.title: CiPO: Counterfactual Unlearning for Large Reasoning Models through Iterative Preference Optimization

author.name: Junyi Li, Yongqiang Chen, Ningning Ding

entry.summary: Introduces CiPO, a framework for machine unlearning in Large Reasoning Models that uses counterfactual reasoning to selectively remove knowledge from chain-of-thought traces via iterative preference optimization, avoiding degradation of reasoning ability.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Repo-level Code Localization

author.name: Xiufeng Xu, Xiufeng Wu, Zejun Zhang, Yi Li

entry.summary: Identifies a 'Keyword Shortcut' bias in code localization benchmarks where models rely on lexical matching rather than structural reasoning. Introduces KA-LogicQuery benchmark requiring structural reasoning without naming hints and a neurosymbolic approach to address the gap.

entry.title: Mind's Eye: A Benchmark of Visual Abstraction, Transformation and Composition for Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Rohit Sinha, Aditya Kanade, Sai Srinivas Kancheti, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Tanuja Ganu

entry.summary: Introduces Mind's Eye benchmark testing multimodal LLMs on visual cognitive tasks inspired by human intelligence tests, organized under Abstraction-Relation-Transformation taxonomy. Humans achieve 80% while top MLLMs remain below 50%, revealing significant gaps in visuospatial reasoning.

entry.title: Predicting Where Steering Vectors Succeed

author.name: Jayadev Billa

entry.summary: Introduces the Linear Accessibility Profile (LAP), a training-free diagnostic using the logit lens to predict when and where steering vectors will be effective, achieving high correlation (ρ=0.86-0.91) across multiple models.

entry.title: SocialGrid: A Benchmark for Planning and Social Reasoning in Embodied Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Hikaru Shindo, Hanzhao Lin, Lukas Helff, Patrick Schramowski, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Introduces SocialGrid, an Among Us-inspired multi-agent environment evaluating LLM agents on planning, task execution, and social reasoning. Finds GPT-OSS-120B achieves below 60% on basic tasks, with agents getting stuck in loops. Offers a Planning Oracle to isolate social from planning deficits.

entry.title: Do Vision-Language Models Truly Perform Vision Reasoning? A Rigorous Study of the Modality Gap

author.name: Yige Xu, Yongjie Wang, Zizhuo Wu, Kaisong Song, Jun Lin, Zhiqi Shen

entry.summary: Introduces CrossMath benchmark with text-only, image-only, and image+text formats of identical problems to isolate whether VLM reasoning is truly vision-grounded. Finds significant modality gaps suggesting heavy reliance on textual reasoning.

entry.title: Weak-to-Strong Knowledge Distillation Accelerates Visual Learning

author.name: Baiang Li, Wenhao Chai, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Proposes a counterintuitive 'weak-to-strong' knowledge distillation approach where a weaker frozen teacher accelerates early training of stronger students, achieving up to 4.8x training speedup on ImageNet classification and generalizing to detection and segmentation tasks.

entry.title: QuantSightBench: Evaluating LLM Quantitative Forecasting with Prediction Intervals

author.name: Jeremy Qin and Maksym Andriushchenko

entry.summary: Proposes QuantSightBench evaluating LLMs on quantitative forecasting using prediction intervals rather than simple binary/multiple-choice questions, requiring scale awareness, internal consistency across confidence levels, and calibration over continuous outcomes.

entry.title: AtManRL: Towards Faithful Reasoning via Differentiable Attention Saliency

author.name: Max Henning H\"oth, Kristian Kersting, Bj\"orn Deiseroth, Letitia Parcalabescu

entry.summary: Introduces AtManRL, combining differentiable attention manipulation with reinforcement learning to improve faithfulness of chain-of-thought reasoning. Uses saliency-based rewards to encourage CoT traces that genuinely influence model predictions.

entry.title: The Harder Path: Last Iterate Convergence for Uncoupled Learning in Zero-Sum Games with Bandit Feedback

author.name: C\^ome Fiegel, Pierre M\'enard, Tadashi Kozuno, Michal Valko, Vianney Perchet

entry.summary: Studies last-iterate convergence for uncoupled learning in zero-sum games with bandit feedback. Proves a tight Ω(T^{-1/4}) lower bound for policy convergence to Nash equilibrium and provides matching algorithms, showing this is strictly harder than average-iterate convergence.

entry.title: Exascale Multi-Task Graph Foundation Models for Imbalanced, Multi-Fidelity Atomistic Data

author.name: Massimiliano Lupo Pasini, Jong Youl Choi, Kshitij Mehta, Richard Messerly, Rylie Weaver, Linda Ungerboeck, Isaac Lyngaas, Benajmin Stump, Ashwin M. Aji, Karl W. Schulz, Jorda Polo

entry.summary: Presents an exascale workflow for materials discovery using HydraGNN graph foundation models, jointly training on 16 datasets (544M+ structures, 85+ elements) on Frontier supercomputer. Enables screening 1.1B structures in 50 seconds.

entry.title: PRL-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark Evaluating LLMs' Capabilities in Frontier Physics Research

author.name: Tingjia Miao, Wenkai Jin, Muhua Zhang, Jinxin Tan, Yuelin Hu, Tu Guo, Jiejun Zhang, Yuhan Wang, Wenbo Li, Yinuo Gao, Shuo Chen, Weiqi Jiang, Yayun Hu, Zixing Lei, Xianghe Pang, Zexi Liu, Yuzhi Zhang, Linfeng Zhang, Kun Chen, Wei Wang, Weinan E, Siheng Chen

entry.summary: PRL-Bench evaluates LLMs' ability to conduct end-to-end physics research workflows using 100 curated papers, testing beyond simple knowledge comprehension to assess exploratory capabilities needed for agentic science. This is a systematic attempt to map the frontier of LLMs in executing real research tasks.

entry.title: Symbolic Guardrails for Domain-Specific Agents: Stronger Safety and Security Guarantees Without Sacrificing Utility

author.name: Yining Hong, Yining She, Eunsuk Kang, Christopher S. Timperley, Christian K\"astner

entry.summary: Studies symbolic guardrails as a practical path toward provable safety guarantees for AI agents, analyzing 80 benchmarks to identify evaluable policies and showing symbolic guardrails can guarantee safety without significantly sacrificing utility.

entry.title: EVIL: Evolving Interpretable Algorithms for Zero-Shot Inference on Event Sequences and Time Series with LLMs

author.name: David Berghaus

entry.summary: EVIL uses LLM-guided evolutionary search to discover interpretable Python/NumPy algorithms for dynamical systems inference (temporal point processes, Markov jump processes, time series). Single evolved algorithms generalize across datasets without training.

entry.title: From Seeing to Simulating: Generative High-Fidelity Simulation with Digital Cousins for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation

author.name: Jasper Lu, Zhenhao Shen, Yuanfei Wang, Shugao Liu, Shengqiang Xu, Shawn Xie, Jingkai Xu, Feng Jiang, Jade Yang, Chen Xie, and Ruihai Wu

entry.summary: Presents a generative framework for converting real-world panoramas into high-fidelity simulation scenes, then synthesizing diverse 'cousin' scenes via semantic and geometric editing. Supports interactive manipulation tasks and multi-room stitching for large-scale environments.

entry.title: Placing Puzzle Pieces Where They Matter: A Question Augmentation Framework for Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yangyi Fang, Jiaye Lin, Xiaoliang Fu, Cong Qin, Haolin Shi

entry.summary: Proposes PieceHint, a framework for RL-based LLM training that strategically identifies critical reasoning bottlenecks and provides targeted hints rather than uniform hint provision, addressing the easy/hard problem dilemma in reinforcement learning for reasoning.

entry.title: Stochasticity in Tokenisation Improves Robustness

author.name: Sophie Steger, Rui Li, Sofiane Ennadir, Anya Sims, Arno Solin, Franz Pernkopf, Martin Trapp

entry.summary: Demonstrates that stochastic tokenization during pre-training and fine-tuning improves LLM robustness to adversarial attacks and random perturbations. Systematically studies this across pre-training, SFT, and in-context learning regimes.

entry.title: R1 CoT illegibility revisited

author.name: nostalgebraist

entry.summary: Reruns experiments from the paper 'Reasoning Models Sometimes Output Illegible Chains of Thought' using a different R1 provider (Novita vs Targon) and finds dramatically lower illegibility scores (2.30 vs 4.30), with better GPQA accuracy. Provides strong evidence that the original paper's findings about R1 CoT illegibility may be artifacts of a specific model deployment rather than inherent model behavior.

entry.title: The Illusion of Equivalence: Systematic FP16 Divergence in KV-Cached Autoregressive Inference

author.name: Ranjith Chodavarapu and Lei Xu

entry.summary: Demonstrates that KV caching introduces systematic FP16 divergence in transformer inference due to non-associative floating-point accumulation, with 100% token divergence rate across three models even under greedy decoding.

entry.title: Ragged Paged Attention: A High-Performance and Flexible LLM Inference Kernel for TPU

author.name: Jevin Jiang, Ying Chen, Blake A. Hechtman, Fenghui Zhang, Yarong Mu

entry.summary: Presents Ragged Paged Attention (RPA), a high-performance attention kernel optimized for TPUs using Pallas and Mosaic, addressing the gap in efficient LLM inference on non-GPU accelerators through fine-grained tiling and custom pipelining.

entry.title: Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for High-Quality Image Generation

author.name: Sucheng Ren, Qihang Yu, Ju He, Xiaohui Shen, Alan Yuille, Liang-Chieh Chen

entry.summary: FreqFlow introduces frequency-aware conditioning into flow matching for image generation, using a two-branch architecture that explicitly handles low-frequency structure and high-frequency details with time-dependent adaptive weighting.

entry.title: LLM Reasoning Is Latent, Not the Chain of Thought

author.name: Wenshuo Wang

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that LLM reasoning should be studied as latent-state trajectory formation rather than surface chain-of-thought. Formalizes three competing hypotheses about the locus of reasoning (latent states vs. CoT vs. generic serial compute).

entry.title: When Do Early-Exit Networks Generalize? A PAC-Bayesian Theory of Adaptive Depth

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Establishes the first PAC-Bayesian generalization theory for early-exit neural networks, proving bounds that depend on exit-depth entropy and expected depth rather than maximum depth. Shows early exiting provides provable regularization benefits.

entry.title: Disentangling Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs: A Methodological Investigation of Internal Mechanisms

author.name: Tanja Baeumel, Josef van Genabith, Simon Ostermann

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs perform arithmetic by tracing internal mechanisms using early decoding. Finds that models recognize arithmetic tasks early but correct results emerge only in final layers, with proficient models showing clear division of labor between attention (information propagation) and MLP (aggregation) modules.

entry.title: RAGognizer: Hallucination-Aware Fine-Tuning via Detection Head Integration

author.name: Fabian Ridder, Laurin Lessel, Malte Schilling

entry.summary: Introduces RAGognizer, a hallucination-aware fine-tuning approach that uses internal state representations as training signals for detecting closed-domain hallucinations in RAG, along with RAGognize dataset of naturally occurring hallucinations with token-level annotations.

entry.title: Beyond Surface Statistics: Robust Conformal Prediction for LLMs via Internal Representations

author.name: Yanli Wang, Peng Kuang, Xiaoyu Han, Kaidi Xu, Haohan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a conformal prediction framework for LLM QA using internal representations (Layer-Wise Information scores) rather than output statistics. Measures how input conditioning reshapes entropy across model depth for more robust uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Sample Complexity Bounds for Stochastic Shortest Path with a Generative Model

author.name: Jean Tarbouriech, Matteo Pirotta, Michal Valko, Alessandro Lazaric

entry.summary: Derives tight sample complexity bounds for learning near-optimal policies in Stochastic Shortest Path problems with a generative model. Reveals that SSPs with zero minimum cost may be unlearnable, making them strictly harder than finite-horizon/discounted settings.

entry.title: Enhancing AI and Dynamical Subseasonal Forecasts with Probabilistic Bias Correction

author.name: Hannah Guan, Soukayna Mouatadid, Paulo Orenstein, Judah Cohen, Haiyu Dong, Zekun Ni, Jeremy Berman, Genevieve Flaspohler, Alex Lu, Jakob Schloer, Joshua Talib, Jonathan A. Weyn, Lester Mackey

entry.summary: Introduces probabilistic bias correction (PBC), an ML framework that learns to correct systematic errors in subseasonal weather forecasts from both dynamical and AI models. Doubles useful forecast skill for ECMWF models at 2-6 week timescales.

entry.title: Sequential KV Cache Compression via Probabilistic Language Tries: Beyond the Per-Vector Shannon Limit

author.name: Gregory Magarshak

entry.summary: Proposes sequential KV cache compression using probabilistic language tries that exploit the sequential structure of token data, going beyond per-vector Shannon limits. Uses prefix deduplication and predictive coding for cross-session compression.

entry.title: (1D) Ordered Tokens Enable Efficient Test-Time Search

author.name: Zhitong Gao, Parham Rezaei, Ali Cy, Mingqiao Ye, Nata\v{s}a Jovanovi\'c, Jesse Allardice, Afshin Dehghan, Amir Zamir, Roman Bachmann, O\u{g}uzhan Fatih Kar

entry.summary: Demonstrates that 1D ordered (coarse-to-fine) tokenization enables more effective test-time search in autoregressive image generation compared to 2D grid tokenizers, because intermediate states carry semantic meaning that verifiers can meaningfully evaluate.

entry.title: Harmonizing Multi-Objective LLM Unlearning via Unified Domain Representation and Bidirectional Logit Distillation

author.name: Yisheng Zhong, Sijia Liu, Zhuangdi Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-objective LLM unlearning framework that harmonizes knowledge removal, utility preservation, over-refusal avoidance, and adversarial robustness through unified domain representation and bidirectional logit distillation.

entry.title: Neural Continuous-Time Markov Chain: Discrete Diffusion via Decoupled Jump Timing and Direction

author.name: Jingyuan Li, Xiaoyi Jiang, Fukang Wen, Wei Liu, Renqian Luo, Yi Zhu, Zuoqiang Shi, Pipi Hu

entry.summary: Neural CTMC proposes decomposing discrete diffusion models into separate exit rate (when to jump) and jump distribution (where to go) components, aligning with the fundamental structure of continuous-time Markov chains. Shows improvements on language generation tasks.

entry.title: Reasoning-targeted Jailbreak Attacks on Large Reasoning Models via Semantic Triggers and Psychological Framing

author.name: Zehao Wang, Lanjun Wang

entry.summary: Identifies a novel attack on Large Reasoning Models that injects harmful content into reasoning steps while preserving correct final answers, using semantic triggers and psychological framing to bypass safety alignment.

entry.title: DPrivBench: Benchmarking LLMs' Reasoning for Differential Privacy

author.name: Erchi Wang, Pengrun Huang, Eli Chien, Om Thakkar, Kamalika Chaudhuri, Yu-Xiang Wang, Ruihan Wu

entry.summary: Introduces DPrivBench, a benchmark testing whether LLMs can reason about differential privacy, with instances asking if algorithms satisfy stated DP guarantees. Designed to resist shortcut reasoning and covers diverse DP topics at multiple difficulty levels.

entry.title: How Hypocritical Is Your LLM judge? Listener-Speaker Asymmetries in the Pragmatic Competence of Large Language Models

author.name: Judith Sieker and Sina Zarrie{\ss}

entry.summary: Studies asymmetry between LLMs' pragmatic listening (judging appropriateness) and pragmatic speaking (generating appropriate language), finding that many models are 'hypocritical judges' who can evaluate pragmatic quality but fail to produce it.

entry.title: Discovering quantum phenomena with Interpretable Machine Learning

author.name: Paulin de Schoulepnikoff, Hendrik Poulsen Nautrup, Hans J. Briegel, and Gorka Mu\~noz-Gil

entry.summary: Demonstrates that variational autoencoders can learn physically meaningful representations from unlabeled quantum datasets, augmented with symbolic methods to discover compact analytical order parameters. Applied to experimental Rydberg-atom data and classical shadows.

entry.title: AEGIS: Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation for Knowledge-Preserving Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning

author.name: Guransh Singh

entry.summary: Introduces AEGIS, a method to prevent catastrophic forgetting of VQA capabilities when fine-tuning vision-language models for robotic control. Addresses the cross-modal gradient asymmetry between flow-matching action gradients and cross-entropy-trained backbones.

entry.title: DINOv3 Beats Specialized Detectors: A Simple Foundation Model Baseline for Image Forensics

author.name: Jieming Yu, Qiuxiao Feng, Zhuohan Wang, Xiaochen Ma

entry.summary: Shows that DINOv3 with LoRA adaptation and a lightweight decoder surpasses all prior specialized image forensics methods for detecting manipulated images, improving pixel-level F1 by 17 points with only 9.1M trainable parameters.

entry.title: Learning to Reason with Insight for Informal Theorem Proving

author.name: Yunhe Li, Hao Shi, Bowen Deng, Wei Wang, Mengzhe Ruan, Hanxu Hou, Zhongxiang Dai, Siyang Gao, Chao Wang, Shuang Qiu, Linqi Song

entry.summary: Proposes DeepInsightTheorem, a hierarchical dataset and progressive multi-stage SFT framework for informal theorem proving that explicitly extracts core techniques and proof sketches to cultivate insightful reasoning in LLMs.

entry.title: Evaluating the Progression of Large Language Model Capabilities for Small-Molecule Drug Design

author.name: Shriram Chennakesavalu, Kirill Shmilovich, Hayley Weir, Colin Grambow, John Bradshaw, Patricia Suriana, Chen Cheng, Kangway Chuang

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark suite for evaluating LLM capabilities in small-molecule drug design spanning property prediction, representation transformations, and molecular design, formulated as RL environments. Finds frontier models improving but significant room remains.

entry.title: Reevaluating "AGI Ruin: A List of Lethalities" in 2026

author.name: lc

entry.summary: A 2026 re-evaluation of Eliezer Yudkowsky's 2022 'AGI Ruin: A List of Lethalities' in light of four years of AI development. Examines which of the 43 doom arguments have held up, which have been weakened, and how the overall picture has changed.

entry.title: DeepER-Med: Advancing Deep Evidence-Based Research in Medicine Through Agentic AI

author.name: Zhizheng Wang, Chih-Hsuan Wei, Joey Chan, Robert Leaman, Chi-Ping Day, Chuan Wu, Mark A Knepper, Antolin Serrano Farias, Jordina Rincon-Torroella, Hasan Slika, Betty Tyler, Ryan Huu-Tuan Nguyen, Asmita Indurkar, M\'elanie H\'ebert, Shubo Tian, Lauren He, Noor Naffakh, Aseem Aseem, Nicholas Wan, Emily Y Chew, Tiarnan D L Keenan, Zhiyong Lu

entry.summary: DeepER-Med is an agentic AI framework for evidence-based medical research that incorporates explicit evidence appraisal criteria and inspectable reasoning, addressing trustworthiness gaps in existing deep research systems for clinical use.

entry.title: Majority Voting for Code Generation

author.name: Tim Launer, Jonas H\"ubotter, Marco Bagatella, Ido Hakimi, Andreas Krause

entry.summary: Investigates Functional Majority Voting (FMV) for code generation, using runtime execution signatures on test inputs for consensus, achieving substantial performance gains on LiveCodeBench and serving as an aggregation strategy for test-time RL.

entry.title: The World Leaks the Future: Harness Evolution for Future Prediction Agents

author.name: Chuyang Wei (1 and 2), Maohang Gao (1 and 2), Zhixin Han (2), Kefei Chen (2 and 3), Yu Zhuang (2), Haoxiang Guan (1 and 2), Yanzhi Zhang (2), Yilin Cheng (2), Jiyan He (2), Huanhuan Chen (1), Jian Li (3), Yu Shi (2), Yitong Duan (2), Shuxin Zheng (2) ((1) University of Science and Technology of China, (2) Zhongguancun Academy, Beijing, China, (3) Tsinghua University)

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for future prediction agents that uses temporal contrasts between earlier and later predictions to provide self-supervision (evolutionary signal) without waiting for final outcomes. Enables agents to improve factor tracking and evidence gathering.

entry.title: MemEvoBench: Benchmarking Memory MisEvolution in LLM Agents

author.name: Weiwei Xie, Shaoxiong Guo, Fan Zhang, Tian Xia, Xue Yang, Lizhuang Ma, Junchi Yan, Qibing Ren

entry.summary: MemEvoBench is the first benchmark evaluating long-horizon memory safety in LLM agents against adversarial memory injection, noisy tool outputs, and biased feedback. Tests how contaminated memory leads to behavioral drift over time.

entry.title: One-Shot Generative Flows: Existence and Obstructions

author.name: Panos Tsimpos, Daniel Sharp, Youssef Marzouk

entry.summary: Studies theoretical conditions under which generative flow models can achieve straight-line (one-step) transport between source and target distributions. Proves a sharp dichotomy: under endpoint independence, straight-line flows exist only for Gaussian or uniform targets on the circle.

entry.title: How people use Copilot for Health

author.name: Beatriz Costa-Gomes, Pavel Tolmachev, Eloise Taysom, Viknesh Sounderajah, Hannah Richardson, Philipp Schoenegger, Xiaoxuan Liu, Matthew M Nour, Seth Spielman, Samuel F. Way, Yash Shah, Michael Bhaskar, Harsha Nori, Christopher Kelly, Peter Hames, Bay Gross, Mustafa Suleyman, Dominic King

entry.summary: Analyzes 500,000+ de-identified health conversations with Microsoft Copilot to characterize how people use conversational AI for health queries. Develops a 12-category intent taxonomy and reveals that ~20% involve personal symptom assessment.

entry.title: Aletheia: Gradient-Guided Layer Selection for Efficient LoRA Fine-Tuning Across Architectures

author.name: Abdulmalek Saket

entry.summary: Introduces Aletheia, a gradient-guided method for selecting which transformer layers receive LoRA adapters, achieving 15-28% training speedup across 81 experiments covering 14 models from 8 architecture families (0.5B-72B).

entry.title: StoSignSGD: Unbiased Structural Stochasticity Fixes SignSGD for Training Large Language Models

author.name: Dingzhi Yu, Rui Pan, Yuxing Liu, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: StoSignSGD fixes the non-convergence issue of SignSGD on non-smooth objectives by injecting structural stochasticity while maintaining unbiased updates, achieving convergence rates matching lower bounds in convex settings and being applied to LLM training.

entry.title: FineSteer: A Unified Framework for Fine-Grained Inference-Time Steering in Large Language Models

author.name: Zixuan Weng, Jinghuai Zhang, Kunlin Cai, Ying Li, Peiran Wang and Yuan Tian

entry.summary: FineSteer decomposes inference-time steering into conditional steering and fine-grained vector synthesis stages, enabling precise control over when and how to steer LLM internal representations to address safety violations and hallucinations.

entry.title: Brain Score Tracks Shared Properties of Languages: Evidence from Many Natural Languages and Structured Sequences

author.name: Jingnong Qu, Ashvin Ranjan, Shane Steinert-Threlkeld

entry.summary: Finds that LMs trained on various natural languages and even structured non-language data (genome, Python, nested parentheses) achieve similar Brain Scores, suggesting Brain Score captures general structural processing properties rather than language-specific features.
