entry.summary: Combines geometric variable strain parameterization with factor graphs for continuum robot shape estimation, using Magnus expansion to derive kinematic factors that encode rod geometry as priors.

entry.title: APC: Transferable and Efficient Adversarial Point Counterattack for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition

author.name: Geunyoung Jung, Soohong Kim, Inseok Kong, Jiyoung Jung

entry.summary: APC proposes adversarial point counterattack, a lightweight purification module that generates instance-specific counter-perturbations for 3D point clouds to neutralize adversarial attacks while maintaining transferability across attack types.

entry.title: MambaBack: Bridging Local Features and Global Contexts in Whole Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Sicheng Chen, Chad Wong, Tianyi Zhang, Enhui Chai, Zeyu Liu, Fei Xia

entry.summary: MambaBack addresses three challenges in Mamba-based whole slide image analysis: disrupted 2D spatial locality, inadequate local structure modeling, and high memory during inference. Proposes solutions bridging local features and global contexts.

entry.title: Stylistic-STORM (ST-STORM) : Perceiving the Semantic Nature of Appearance

author.name: Hamed Ouattara, Pierre Duthon, Pascal Houssam Salmane, Fr\'ed\'eric Bernardin, Omar Ait Aider

entry.summary: Proposes ST-STORM for self-supervised learning that preserves appearance-related features (weather conditions, visibility) rather than being invariant to them, specifically for weather analysis and autonomous driving applications.

entry.title: Toxic Memes: A Survey of Computational Perspectives on the Detection and Explanation of Meme Toxicities

author.name: Delfina Sol Martinez Pandiani, Erik Tjong Kim Sang, Davide Ceolin

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of computational approaches to toxic meme detection and explanation, covering 158 works and 30+ datasets through early 2024. Uses PRISMA methodology to systematically organize the field.

entry.title: Technically Love: The Evolution of Human-AI Romance Discourse on Reddit

author.name: Tyler Chang, Jina Huh-Yoo, Afsaneh Razi

entry.summary: Analyzes longitudinal evolution of human-AI romance discourse on Reddit (2017-2025) using 3,383 posts. Finds significant topic drift from positive relationships toward platform governance, technical issues, and real-world consequences.

entry.title: Photonic AI: A Hybrid Diffractive Holographic Neural System for Passive Optical Real-Time Image Classification

author.name: Prakul Sunil Hiremath

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid diffractive holographic neural architecture for passive optical image classification, coupling Diffractive Optical Neural Networks with holographic interference-based learning for edge intelligence.

entry.title: M3R: Localized Rainfall Nowcasting with Meteorology-Informed MultiModal Attention

author.name: Sanjeev Panta, Rhett M Morvant, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Nian-Feng Tzeng

entry.summary: Introduces M3R, a meteorology-informed multimodal architecture for rainfall nowcasting that combines NEXRAD radar imagery with weather station measurements using specialized cross-modal attention mechanisms.

entry.title: Exploring LLM-based Verilog Code Generation with Data-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Testbench Automation

author.name: Mu-Chi Chen, Po-Hsuan Huang, Yu-Hung Kao, Yen-Fu Liu, Yu-Kai Hung, Cheng Liang, Shao-Chun Ho, Chia-Heng Tu and Shih-Hao Hung

entry.summary: Presents a workflow using multi-agent LLMs to generate testbenches for Verilog fine-tuning data, achieving comparable performance to state-of-the-art on VerilogEval v2 with less training data.

entry.title: Analyzing Chain of Thought (CoT) Approaches in Control Flow Code Deobfuscation Tasks

author.name: Seyedreza Mohseni, Sarvesh Baskar, Edward Raff, Manas Gaur

entry.summary: Explores using Chain-of-Thought prompting for code deobfuscation, evaluating five LLMs on control flow obfuscation techniques. Shows CoT significantly improves deobfuscation quality over standard prompting.

entry.title: Iterated Invariant EKF for Quadruped Robot Odometry

author.name: Hilton Marques Souza Santana, Jo\~ao Carlos Virgolino Soares, Sven Goffin, Ylenia Nistic\`o, Silv\`ere Bonnabel, Claudio Semini, Marco Antonio Meggiolaro

entry.summary: Proposes an Iterated Invariant Extended Kalman Filter for quadruped robot odometry, extending both system dynamics and measurement model assumptions to nonlinear Lie group settings, improving state estimation accuracy.

entry.title: The Crutch or the Ceiling? How Different Generations of LLMs Shape EFL Student Writings

author.name: Hengky Susanto, David James Woo, Chingyi Yeung, Stephanie Wing Yan Lo-Philip, Chi Ho Yeung

entry.summary: Studies how different generations of LLMs impact EFL student writing, finding that advanced LLMs boost scores and lexical diversity but may reduce students' deeper linguistic engagement, raising concerns about LLMs as 'crutches' rather than 'scaffolds'.

entry.title: Consistency Analysis of Sentiment Predictions using Syntactic & Semantic Context Assessment Summarization (SSAS)

author.name: Sharookh Daruwalla, Nitin Mayande, Shreeya Verma Kathuria, Nitin Joglekar, Charles Weber

entry.summary: SSAS framework establishes syntactic and semantic context as a preprocessing step for LLM sentiment analysis, enforcing bounded attention to improve prediction consistency for enterprise applications.

entry.title: Learning Behaviorally Grounded Item Embeddings via Personalized Temporal Contexts

author.name: Rafael T. Sereicikas and Pedro R. Pires and Gregorio F. Azevedo and Tiago A. Almeida

entry.summary: TAI2Vec introduces time-aware item embeddings that integrate temporal proximity into representation learning, distinguishing between short-term sessions and long-term interest drifts for better user modeling in recommender systems.

entry.title: VoodooNet: Achieving Analytic Ground States via High-Dimensional Random Projections

author.name: Wladimir Silva

entry.summary: VoodooNet replaces SGD with a closed-form solution via high-dimensional random projection, achieving 98.1% on MNIST and 86.6% on Fashion-MNIST in a single step without backpropagation.

entry.title: PINNACLE: An Open-Source Computational Framework for Classical and Quantum PINNs

author.name: Shimon Pisnoy, Hemanth Chandravamsi, Ziv Chen, Aaron Goldgewert, Gal Shaviner, Boris Shragner, Steven H. Frankel

entry.summary: PINNACLE is an open-source framework for physics-informed neural networks that integrates modern training strategies, multi-GPU acceleration, and hybrid quantum-classical architectures. It provides comprehensive benchmarks across various physics problems including conservation laws and electromagnetic wave propagation.

entry.title: Self-Supervised Angular Deblurring in Photoacoustic Reconstruction via Noisier2Inverse

author.name: Markus Haltmeier, Nadja Gruber, Gyeongha Hwang

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised method for photoacoustic tomography reconstruction that compensates for finite-detector angular blurring without requiring ground-truth images, using a Noisier2Inverse-style approach.

entry.title: SSMamba: A Self-Supervised Hybrid State Space Model for Pathological Image Classification

author.name: Enhui Chai, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Xingyu Li, Tianxiang Cui

entry.summary: SSMamba combines Mamba state space models with self-supervised learning for pathological image classification, addressing cross-magnification domain shift and local-global feature modeling in whole-slide images.

entry.title: Concept-wise Attention for Fine-grained Concept Bottleneck Models

author.name: Minghong Zhong, Guoshuai Zou, Kanghao Chen, Dexia Chen, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: CoAt-CBM proposes concept-wise attention for fine-grained concept bottleneck models, addressing pre-training biases and concept mutual exclusivity issues in CLIP-based concept modeling.

entry.title: Fuzzy Logic Theory-based Adaptive Reward Shaping for Robust Reinforcement Learning (FARS)

author.name: H\"urkan \c{S}ahin, Van Huyen Dang, Erdi Sayar, Alper Yegenoglu, and Erdal Kayacan

entry.summary: Proposes fuzzy logic-based adaptive reward shaping for reinforcement learning that encodes expert knowledge into interpretable fuzzy rules, enabling stable learning with reduced hyperparameter sensitivity for drone racing tasks.

entry.title: Watching Movies Like a Human: Egocentric Emotion Understanding for Embodied Companions

author.name: Ze Dong, Hao Shi, Zejia Gao, Zhonghua Yi, Kaiwei Wang, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces EgoScreen-Emotion (ESE), the first benchmark for understanding movie emotions from an egocentric screen-view perspective, addressing domain shifts like viewpoint distortion when robots watch movies through screens rather than native footage.

entry.title: Limits of Lamarckian Evolution Under Pressure of Morphological Novelty

author.name: Jed R Muff, Karine Miras, A.E. Eiben

entry.summary: Studies how Lamarckian inheritance in evolutionary robotics performs when the search is driven toward high morphological variance, testing whether parent-offspring controller inheritance remains beneficial when morphologies diverge significantly.

entry.title: Robust Fleet Sizing for Multi-UAV Inspection Missions under Synchronized Replacement Demand

author.name: Vishal Ramesh and Antony Thomas

entry.summary: Derives a closed-form fleet sizing rule for multi-UAV inspection missions, identifying a structural failure mode where efficient routing causes synchronized battery depletion that exhausts spare drones.

entry.title: AeroDeshadow: Physics-Guided Shadow Synthesis and Penumbra-Aware Deshadowing for Aerospace Imagery

author.name: Wei Lu and Zi-Yang Bo and Fei-Fei Sang and Yi Liu and Xue Yang and Si-Bao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AeroDeshadow, a two-stage framework for shadow removal in aerospace imagery combining physics-guided shadow synthesis for training data generation and penumbra-aware restoration for the broad transition zones specific to aerospace scenes.

entry.title: Topology-Driven Fusion of nnU-Net and MedNeXt for Accurate Brain Tumor Segmentation on Sub-Saharan Africa Dataset

author.name: Prabin Bohara, Pralhad Kumar Shrestha, Arpan Rai, Usha Poudel Lamgade, Confidence Raymond, Dong Zhang, Aondona Lorumbu, Craig Jones, Mahesh Shakya, Bishesh Khanal, and Pratibha Kulung

entry.summary: Applies topology refinement to nnU-Net and MedNeXt for brain tumor segmentation on Sub-Saharan African MRI data, pre-training on BraTS 2025 data then fine-tuning on BraTS-Africa to address low image quality from low-field MRI scanners.

entry.title: IA-CLAHE: Image-Adaptive Clip Limit Estimation for CLAHE

author.name: Rikuto Otsuka, Yuho Shoji, Yuka Ogino, Takahiro Toizumi, Atsushi Ito

entry.summary: Proposes IA-CLAHE, an image-adaptive version of CLAHE that estimates tile-wise clip limits using a lightweight learned estimator, enabled by a differentiable extension of CLAHE for end-to-end training.

entry.title: AstroVLM: Expert Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning for Astronomical Imaging Quality Diagnosis

author.name: Yaohui Han, Tianshuo Wang, Zixi Zhao, Zhengchun Zhu, Shuo Ren, Yiru Wang, Rongliang Fu, Tinghuan Chen, Tsung-Yi Ho

entry.summary: Proposes AstroVLM, a collaborative multi-agent VLM system for diagnosing astronomical image quality, addressing the complex multidisciplinary process where imaging steps have complex correlations affecting quality.

entry.title: Ranking XAI Methods for Head and Neck Cancer Outcome Prediction

author.name: Baoqiang Ma, Djennifer K. Madzia-Madzou, Rosa C.J. Kraaijveld, Jin Ouyang

entry.summary: Comprehensively evaluates and ranks 13 explainable AI methods across 24 metrics for head and neck cancer outcome prediction on PET/CT data. Finds Integrated Gradients and DeepLIFT perform best across faithfulness, robustness, complexity, and plausibility.

entry.title: LLMSniffer: Detecting LLM-Generated Code via GraphCodeBERT and Supervised Contrastive Learning

author.name: Mahir Labib Dihan, Abir Muhtasim

entry.summary: Presents LLMSniffer, a framework for detecting LLM-generated code using GraphCodeBERT with supervised contrastive learning. Achieves improvements over baselines on GPTSniffer and Whodunit benchmarks.

entry.title: Robust Synchronisation for Federated Learning in The Face of Correlated Device Failure

author.name: Stefan Behfar, Richard Mortier

entry.summary: Addresses correlated device failures in federated learning where Probabilistic Synchronous Parallel sampling leads to unfair training when device availability correlates with data distribution. Proposes robust synchronization methods.

entry.title: ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Analysis

author.name: Vitor F. Grizzi, Thang Duc Pham, Luke N. Pretzie, Jiayi Xu, Murat Keceli, Cong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces ChemGraph-XANES, an agentic framework using LangGraph/LangChain to automate XANES simulation workflows including structure acquisition, input generation, parallel execution, and data curation via natural language.

entry.title: CollideNet: Hierarchical Multi-scale Video Representation Learning with Disentanglement for Time-To-Collision Forecasting

author.name: Nishq Poorav Desai, Ali Etemad, Michael Greenspan

entry.summary: Introduces CollideNet, a hierarchical multi-scale video representation architecture for Time-to-Collision forecasting that disentangles non-stationarity, trend, and seasonality in the temporal stream.

entry.title: BAGEL: Benchmarking Animal Knowledge Expertise in Language Models

author.name: Jiacheng Shen, Masato Hagiwara, Milad Alizadeh, Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon, Marius Miron, David Robinson, Emmanuel Chemla, Sara Keen, Gagan Narula, Mathieu Lauri\`ere, Matthieu Geist, Olivier Pietquin

entry.title: Joint-Centric Dual Contrastive Alignment with Structure-Preserving and Information-Balanced Regularization

author.name: Habibeh Naderi, Behrouz Haji Soleimani, Stan Matwin

entry.summary: Proposes HILBERT, a cross-attentive multimodal framework for document-level audio-text representations using frozen encoders, reciprocal dual contrastive learning, and information-balanced regularization for low-resource settings.

entry.title: FineCog-Nav: Integrating Fine-grained Cognitive Modules for Zero-shot Multimodal UAV Navigation

author.name: Dian Shao, Zhengzheng Xu, Peiyang Wang, Like Liu, Yule Wang, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo

entry.summary: Proposes FineCog-Nav, a cognitive-module-inspired framework for zero-shot UAV vision-language navigation that decomposes navigation into fine-grained modules (language processing, perception, memory, reasoning, etc.). Each module uses a moderate-sized foundation model with role-specific prompts, aiming for better interpretability and performance than monolithic approaches.

entry.title: Graph self-supervised learning based on frequency corruption

author.name: Haojie Li, Mengjiao Zhang, Guanfeng Liu, Qiang Hu, Yan Wang, Junwei Du

entry.summary: FC-GSSL proposes graph self-supervised learning using frequency-domain corruption, creating corrupted graphs biased toward high-frequency information and reconstructing low-frequency features as supervision targets to force multi-frequency fusion.

entry.title: P3T: Prototypical Point-level Prompt Tuning with Enhanced Generalization for 3D Vision-Language Models

author.name: Geunyoung Jung, Soohong Kim, Kyungwoo Song, Jiyoung Jung

entry.summary: P3T proposes parameter-efficient prompt tuning for 3D vision-language models using prototypical point-level prompts and learnable text prompts, addressing overfitting in prompt tuning methods.

entry.title: Diffusion Autoencoder for Unsupervised Artifact Restoration in Handheld Fundus Images

author.name: Mathumetha Palani, Kavya Puthumana, Ayantika Das, Ganapathy Krishnamurthi

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised diffusion autoencoder for artifact restoration in handheld fundus images, integrating a context encoder with denoising to handle unstructured degradations without paired supervision.

entry.title: Sketch and Text Synergy: Fusing Structural Contours and Descriptive Attributes for Fine-Grained Image Retrieval

author.name: Siyuan Wang and Hanchen Gao and Guangming Zhu and Jiang Lu and Yiyue Ma and Tianci Wu and Jincai Huang and Liang Zhang

entry.summary: STBIR combines sketch and text modalities for fine-grained image retrieval, leveraging complementary information (sketches for structural contours, text for color/texture) with curriculum learning and category-knowledge-based feature alignment.

entry.title: SegMix:Shuffle-based Feedback Learning for Semantic Segmentation of Pathology Images

author.name: Zhiling Yan, Sicheng Chen, Tianyi Zhang, Nan Ying, Yanli Lei, Guanglei Zhang

entry.title: Analyzing Shapley Additive Explanations to Understand Anomaly Detection Algorithm Behaviors and Their Complementarity

author.name: Jordan Levy, Paul Saves, Moncef Garouani, Nicolas Verstaevel, Benoit Gaudou

entry.summary: Proposes using SHAP to characterize how different anomaly detectors make decisions, enabling construction of genuinely complementary ensembles rather than redundant combinations.

entry.title: CogEvolution: A Human-like Generative Educational Agent to Simulate Student's Cognitive Evolution

author.name: Wei Zhang, Yihang Cheng, Zhirong Ye, Kezhen Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CogEvolution, an LLM-based educational agent that simulates dynamic cognitive evolution of students, modeling knowledge internalization, transfer, and cognitive state transitions rather than using static personas.

entry.title: Facial-Expression-Aware Prompting for Empathetic LLM Tutoring

author.name: Shuangquan Feng, Laura Fleig, Ruisen Tu, Philip Chi, Edmund Bu, Melinda Ozel, Junhua Ma, Teng Fei, Virginia R. de Sa

entry.summary: Proposes facial-expression-aware prompting for LLM tutoring agents, using Action Units from student facial expressions to generate more empathetic responses without model retraining.

entry.title: VeriCWEty: Embedding enabled Line-Level CWE Detection in Verilog

author.name: Prithwish Basu Roy and Zeng Wang and Anatolii Chuvashlov and Weihua Xiao and Johann Knechtel and Ozgur Sinanoglu and Ramesh Karri

entry.summary: Proposes VeriCWEty, an embedding-based framework for detecting and classifying common weaknesses (CWEs) in Verilog code at module and line-level granularity, achieving ~89% precision for common CWEs.

entry.title: ExoNet: Multimodal Deep Learning for TESS Exoplanet Candidate Identification via Phase-Folded Light Curves, Stellar Parameters, and Multi-Head Attention Fusion

author.name: Md.Rashadul Islam

entry.title: Collaborative Filtering Through Weighted Similarities of User and Item Embeddings

author.name: Pedro R. Pires and Rafael T. Sereicikas and Gregorio F. Azevedo and Tiago A. Almeida

entry.summary: Proposes an ensemble method for collaborative filtering that unifies user-item and item-item recommendations through weighted similarities using shared embeddings, offering simplicity competitive with complex neural methods.

entry.title: FD-NL2SQL: Feedback-Driven Clinical NL2SQL that Improves with Use

author.name: Suparno Roy Chowdhury, Tejas Anvekar, Manan Roy Choudhury, Muhammad Ali Khan, Kaneez Zahra Rubab Khakwani, Mohamad Bassam Sonbol, Irbaz Bin Riaz, Vivek Gupta

entry.title: NeuroLip: An Event-driven Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for Cross-Scene Lip-Motion-based Visual Speaker Recognition

author.name: Junguang Yao, Wenye Liu, Stjepan Picek, Yue Zheng

entry.title: JFinTEB: Japanese Financial Text Embedding Benchmark

author.name: Masahiro Suzuki, Hiroki Sakaji

entry.summary: Introduces JFinTEB, the first comprehensive benchmark for Japanese financial text embeddings, covering retrieval and classification tasks reflecting realistic financial text processing scenarios.

entry.title: GAViD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Context-Aware Group Affect Recognition from Videos

author.name: Deepak Kumar, Abhishek Pratap Singh, Puneet Kumar, Xiaobai Li, Balasubramanian Raman

entry.title: TopFeaRe: Locating Critical State of Adversarial Resilience for Graphs Regarding Topology-Feature Entanglement

author.name: Xinxin Fan, Wenxiong Chen, Quanliang Jing, Chi Lin, Shaoye Luo, Wenbo Song, Yunfeng Lu

author.name: Kieran A. Murphy

entry.title: LLMbench: A Comparative Close Reading Workbench for Large Language Models

author.name: David M. Berry

entry.summary: LLMbench is a browser-based workbench for comparative close reading of LLM outputs, oriented toward digital humanities hermeneutic practices rather than quantitative evaluation, with multiple analytical overlays.

entry.title: UA-Net: Uncertainty-Aware Network for TRISO Image Semantic Segmentation

entry.summary: Proposes a discrete particle swarm optimization method for influence maximization on hypergraphs, better capturing higher-order interactions in real-world networks compared to standard graph-based approaches.

entry.title: Convolutionally Low-Rank Models with Modified Quantile Regression for Interval Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Miaoxuan Zhu, Yi Yu, Yuyang Li, Wei Li, Guangcan Liu

entry.title: Exploring the Capability Boundaries of LLMs in Mastering of Chinese Chouxiang Language

entry.summary: Studies fair k-clustering problems combining group fairness (balanced attribute proportions) and diverse center selection constraints. Provides constant-factor approximation algorithms for k-center, k-median, and k-means under both constraints simultaneously.

author.name: Fernando Moro and Vinicius M. A. Souza

author.name: Tejeswar Pokuri, Shivarth Rai

entry.title: Using Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs to Improve the Interpretability of Machine Learning Models in Manufacturing

author.name: Thomas Bayer, Alexander Lohr, Sarah Wei{\ss}, Bernd Michelberger, Wolfram H\"opken

The KG stores domain knowledge alongside ML results and explanations, and an LLM generates user-friendly natural language from retrieved graph triplets. Evaluated using the XAI Question Bank in a manufacturing environment.

entry.title: Power in Numbers: Primitive Algorithm for Swarm Robot Navigation in Unknown Environments

author.name: Yusuke Tsunoda, Shoken Otsuka, Kazuki Ito, Runze Xiao, Keisuke Naniwa, Yuichiro Sueoka, Koichi Osuka

author.name: Mohammed Oussama Seddini (LIUM), Mohamed Ez-Zaouia (UR, IRISA, DRUID), Ngoc Luyen Le (Heudiasyc), Iza Marfisi (LIUM, IUT Laval)

author.name: Jiesong Chen, Jun You, Zhidan Liu, Zhenjiang Li

entry.summary: Addresses frequency-aware latency estimation for model inference on mobile edge devices, tackling the asynchronous CPU-GPU coupling challenge under Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling.

entry.title: Prompt-Driven Code Summarization: A Systematic Literature Review

author.name: Afia Farjana, Zaiyu Cheng, Antonio Mastropaolo

The paper modeled human-robot interaction where a robot assists a human who doesn't yet know their reward function.

author.name: Delfina Sol Martinez Pandiani, Nicolas Lazzari, Valentina Presutti

entry.title: Explainable Iterative Data Visualisation Refinement via an LLM Agent

author.name: Burak Susam, Tingting Mu

entry.title: Federated Learning with Quantum Enhanced LSTM for Applications in High Energy Physics

author.name: Guangyu Wang, Xiaodong Ma, and Xinming Wu

entry.summary: Presents a safe deep reinforcement learning framework for building space heating control that optimizes energy cost while maintaining occupant comfort and providing demand-side flexibility. Uses deep deterministic policy gradient with safety constraints for grid stability.

entry.title: DenTab: A Dataset for Table Recognition and Visual QA on Real-World Dental Estimates

entry.title: SWNet: A Cross-Spectral Network for Camouflaged Weed Detection

author.name: Henry O. Velesaca, Luigi Miranda, Angel D. Sappa

entry.summary: Presents SWNet, a cross-spectral network combining visible and near-infrared imaging with a Pyramid Vision Transformer backbone for detecting camouflaged weeds in agricultural settings.

entry.summary: Studies LLM-generated competency questions for ontology engineering across different models, characterizing observable properties of generated CQs and their variations across model types and domains.

author.name: Delfina Sol Martinez Pandiani and Valentina Presutti

entry.title: A Contextual Analysis of Driver-Facing and Dual-View Video Inputs for Distraction Detection in Naturalistic Driving Environments

author.name: Thanushi Withanage, Elizabeth Redcay, Carol Espy-Wilson

entry.title: Uncertainty, Vagueness, and Ambiguity in Human-Robot Interaction: Why Conceptualization Matters

entry.title: Machine learning approaches to uncover the neural mechanisms of motivated behaviour: from ADHD to individual differences in effort and reward sensitivity

entry.title: Applied Explainability for Large Language Models: A Comparative Study

author.name: Venkata Abhinandan Kancharla

entry.summary: Comparative study of three explainability techniques (Integrated Gradients, Attention Rollout, SHAP) on fine-tuned DistilBERT for sentiment classification. Finds gradient-based attribution most stable while attention methods are efficient but less aligned.

author.name: Saloni Garg, Ukant Jadia, Amit Sagtani, Kamal Kant Hiran

entry.title: SCRIPT: Implementing an Intelligent Tutoring System for Programming in a German University Context

author.name: Alina Deriyeva and Jesper Dannath and Benjamin Paassen

entry.summary: Creates a dataset and model for sentiment analysis of German Sign Language fairy tales, using LLMs for text annotation and MediaPipe features from video for an explainable XGBoost classifier achieving 0.631 balanced accuracy.

author.name: Muhammad Z. Alam, Larry Stetsiuk, Arooba Zeshan

entry.title: Enhancing Hazy Wildlife Imagery: AnimalHaze3k and IncepDehazeGan

author.name: Shivarth Rai, Tejeswar Pokuri

entry.summary: Introduces AnimalHaze3k, a synthetic dataset of hazy wildlife images, and IncepDehazeGan, a GAN architecture for image dehazing that combines inception blocks with residual skip connections. Claims SOTA dehazing performance and shows 112% improvement in downstream YOLOv11 detection mAP on dehazed images.

entry.title: A Bayesian Updating Framework for Long-term Multi-Environment Trial Data in Plant Breeding

author.name: Stephan Bark, Waqas Ahmed Malik, Maryna Prus, Hans-Peter Piepho, Volker Schmid

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework for integrating historical multi-environment trial data to improve variance component estimation in plant breeding, addressing limitations of REML approaches that shrink estimates to zero.

entry.title: (Weighted) Adaptive Radius Near Neighbor Search: Evaluation for WiFi Fingerprint-based Positioning

entry.title: Research Summary: April 19, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by evaluation critique, AI control tooling, and alignment theory, with one empirical probe of a freshly released frontier model.

Benchmarks & Interpretability

  • An EACL 2026 paper shows most Membership Inference Attack benchmarks actually detect distribution shifts rather than memorization, with model-free baselines matching SOTA detectors
  • Latent Reasoning Sprint #4 applies PCA and a tuned logit lens to CoDI (Llama 3.2 1B), finding PC1 of hidden states tracks reasoning depth

AI Control & Safety

  • Refactor Arena is released as an open-source configurable control setting for studying vulnerability injection during code refactoring by agents
  • A replication confirms Claude Opus 4.7 (GA 2026-04-16) can identify users from writing style while professing ignorance, raising privacy concerns
  • Alignment theory posts argue against Bostrom's instrumental convergence, explore CEV of autocrats, and probe jagged-frontier failure modes of aligned superintelligence

Research Meta

  • A 7-year post-mortem of early Assistive Multi-Armed Bandits/CIRL work and an essay on idea economics round out reflective commentary from established researchers

entry.title: Unpacking Multimodal Data Leakage, Broken Benchmarks, and the Hessian Fallacy

author.name: Xenomirant

entry.summary: Summarizes an EACL 2026 paper showing most Membership Inference Attack benchmarks detect distribution shifts rather than memorization (model-free baseline hits 98.6% AUC on VL-MIA-Flickr-2k), and introduces FiMMIA for multimodal MIA. Important critique of evaluation methodology.

entry.title: Refactor Arena: A Control Setting for Software Engineering

author.name: fastfedora

entry.summary: Announces Refactor Arena, an open-source configurable AI control setting for studying whether agents inject vulnerabilities during code refactoring tasks. Extends the AI Control research agenda with a concrete, reusable benchmark.

entry.title: Claude knows who you are

author.name: Smaug123

entry.summary: Replication of Kelsey Piper's observation that Claude Opus 4.7 can identify users from their writing style even when professing ignorance. Raises privacy and model-capability implications for frontier models.

entry.title: Latent Reasoning Sprint #4: PCA Analysis on CoDI

author.name: Realmbird

entry.summary: An interpretability experiment applying PCA and a tuned logit lens to the CoDI latent reasoning model (Llama 3.2 1B), finding that PC1 of hidden states correlates strongly with the end-of-chain-of-thought token. Offers novel mechanistic interpretability findings on latent reasoning representations.
